What You’ll Be Part Of:

As a key member of the Client Data Science team, you will be responsible for a variety of critical tasks, including:

• Collaborating on complex problems, both independently and as part of a team, while writing and optimizing R, Python, or SQL scripts for effective data processing.

• Adapting existing tools and methods to meet evolving needs, balancing workloads across various projects, and leveraging solid machine learning and statistical skills to inform data-driven decisions.

• Collecting, aggregating, and manipulating data from multiple sources, applying analytical techniques to derive insights, and creating clear visualizations or reports.

• Engaging with internal and external teams to clarify requirements, address challenges, and develop tailored solutions, while documenting project status and updates in tools like JIRA.

• Communicating effectively with diverse audiences, translating complex findings into accessible formats through written reports and presentations, and actively participating in team discussions to support collaboration and problem-solving.

Responsibilities:

Your expected workday will consist of:

• 5% Internal Collaboration

• 95% Hands on: Reporting, Coding, Debugging, Developing, Methods, etc

Qualifications and Education Requirements:

• Education: Bachelor's degree in a quantitative or social science field;

• Coding Experience: 1+ year coding in SQL or Python;

• Technical Knowledge: Introductory knowledge of Analytics, Statistics, and AI coding tools;

• Communication: Exceptional written and verbal communication with internal stakeholders at all levels. Must be proactive and curious

Preferred Skills:

• Experience with analytical and data processing software, such as AWS s3, Snowflake, and Databricks

• Prior role in the Ad Tech industry

Additional Notes:

• 
iSpot’s Client Data Science team expects all candidates to have a range of soft skills, including but not limited to: critical thinking, attention to detail, and effective communication. Additionally, the following soft skills are required for success in this role: Issue identification; Willingness to ask questions; Time management; Focus and prioritization; Teamwork.

iSpot is looking for a Senior Support Analyst to join our team. This position requires a unique blend of domain-specific product knowledge, technical proficiency, and exceptional written communication skills. As a senior member of the team, you will lead technical communications and serve as a primary technical point of contact for our clients

Responsibilities:

• Senior Queue Management: Serve as the final escalation point for complex Zendesk tickets, maintaining strict 24-hour SLAs while overseeing ticket labeling, taxonomy, and queue performance metrics.

• Account & User Activation: Review client contracts and order forms to execute and oversee complex account provisioning, user access setups, and advanced product configuration.

• Technical Communication: Lead external client communications, translating complex methodologies, data ingestion workflows, and reporting metrics into clear, executive-ready written explanations. 

• Technical Ownership: Ownership of backend and UI issue resolution. Evaluate, troubleshoot, and replicate complex UI bugs and data discrepancies; document actionable findings, escalate unresolved issues to Engineering via Jira within 24 hours, communicate status updates to users and validate release. 

• Data Verification & Querying: Execute advanced backend database queries via MySQL to validate metadata and airings, track data processing, and isolate root causes of reported data issues.

• Pixel Generation & QA: Quickly and independently generate, validate, and QA complex custom tracking tags and pixels using correct parameters, IDs, and DSP specifications across web and streaming platforms.

• API Diagnostics: Execute API calls matching dashboard functionality and perform in-depth technical diagnostics prior to escalating to Engineering.

• Outage Communications: Lead platform status communications during Severity 1–2 system outages, independently drafting, reviewing, and publishing timely, polished, executive- and client-ready technical updates.

• Innovative Problem Solving: Proactively identify systemic technical issues, driving the development and implementation of new solutions and workflows to prevent recurring tickets.

• Mentorship & Guidance: Mentor and guide Level I, Level II, and Level III analysts through ticket shadowing, technical workflow coaching, and skill development.

• Knowledge Management & Process Evolution: Take full ownership of standard operating procedures, knowledge bases, and internal troubleshooting guides, continually updating them to reflect platform changes and new technical solutions.

• Cross-Functional Operations: Partner with Solutions, Content Operations, Product, Engineering, and Commercial teams to advocate for customer needs, optimize internal resolution paths, and inform product enhancements.

Qualifications and Education Requirements:

• Database & API Diagnostics (4+ Years): Advanced experience writing SQL queries (MySQL), inspecting browser dev tools, making API calls, and analyzing complex datasets to troubleshoot root causes.

• Tracking & Pixel QA (3+ Years): Direct experience generating, validating, and troubleshooting digital tracking tags/pixels across web and streaming environments.

• Platform & Operations (4+ Years): Proven experience in ticket queue management, response macros, and metadata tagging in Zendesk, Jira, Salesforce, or similar platforms. Demonstrated ability to track, report, and improve personal and team performance metrics.

• AI Tools & Prompt Engineering: Demonstrated ability to integrate AI into technical support workflows. Proven capability in structured prompt engineering, context optimization, and utilizing AI for rapid data analysis, script generation, and drafting technical correspondence.

• Technical Writing & Communication: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with a track record of leading client-facing communications and explaining complex platform methodologies to non-technical and executive audiences.

• Strategic Problem Solving: Superior critical thinking skills with a methodical approach to identifying root causes across interconnected systems and engineering novel solutions.

• Detail & Adaptability: Highly organized and process-oriented, with the adaptability and leadership needed to thrive in a fast-evolving ad-tech ecosystem.

What You’ll Be Part Of:

iSpot is the market leader in real-time TV ad measurement, providing the most comprehensive and actionable data to the advertising industry’s top brands, agencies, and media companies. We are seeking a seasoned and curious Senior Product Manager to join our team and help shape the next generation of identity-powered measurement across CTV and streaming.

This is a high-impact individual contributor role at the intersection of identity resolution, outcomes measurement, and performance optimization, a space that is evolving rapidly as the industry navigates privacy-first data collaboration. You will own and drive major product features end-to-end, partnering closely with engineering, data science, and go-to-market teams to build solutions that matter to our clients.

You are a product practitioner who thrives in complex, data-rich environments. You have hands-on experience with data clean rooms - such as Amazon Marketing Cloud (AMC) or Google Ads Data Hub (ADH) - and understand how identity underpins every layer of modern TV measurement. You are ready to lead, influence, and deliver.

Responsibilities:

Product Strategy and Roadmap: Lead the strategy and execution of major product features within iSpot’s identity and measurement portfolio. Influence broader product vision and align your roadmap with business goals and client needs.

Identity & Clean Room Expertise: Serve as the product owner for capabilities that leverage data clean rooms (e.g., AMC, ADH) and identity resolution frameworks to enable privacy-safe audience measurement and optimization. Define requirements and work with engineering and data science to bring these capabilities to life.

Market and Customer Research: Conduct in-depth research to understand the evolving identity landscape, competitive offerings, and client requirements. Use these insights to inform prioritization and product decisions.

Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with engineering, design, data science, sales, and customer success to deliver high-quality products on time and within scope. Drive alignment across teams and keep stakeholders informed and engaged.

Customer Advocacy: Engage directly with customers and internal stakeholders to gather feedback and ensure that client needs are central to how we build. Be the voice of the customer on your product area.

Data-Driven Decision Making: Use data to justify direction, prioritize investments, and connect product decisions to measurable customer and commercial value. Define and track KPIs to measure feature success and drive continuous improvement.

Documentation and Communication: Lead the creation and maintenance of clear, accurate, and helpful product documentation. Present confidently to cross-functional teams and leadership, driving engagement and alignment.

Mentorship: Guide the development of Associate PMs and PMs on the team, sharing knowledge and contributing to a culture of craft and continuous learning.

Qualifications and Education Requirements:

• 4+ years of product management experience, with demonstrated mastery in product lifecycle management and a track record of shipping meaningful features in data-intensive environments.

• Deep knowledge of the identity ecosystem, including identity resolution methodologies, household and person-level identifiers, and the role of privacy-enhancing technologies in modern measurement.

• Strong understanding of CTV and streaming advertising measurement, including audience delivery, reach and frequency, and outcomes attribution across linear and digital video.

• Proven ability to influence broader product strategy and vision, aligning product decisions with business goals while navigating ambiguity and competing priorities.

• Strong technical and data acumen—comfortable leading productive conversations with engineering and data science teams on topics such as data modeling, API integrations, and probabilistic matching.

• Excellent communication skills, with the ability to present confidently to larger groups, drive engagement, and articulate complex concepts—such as identity linkage or incremental lift—to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Experience mentoring or guiding junior product managers is a plus.

• Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field (e.g., Computer Science, Data Science, Business); Master’s degree is a plus.

Preferred Experience:

• Familiarity with the IAB Tech Lab’s measurement and Open RTB standards and an interest in contributing to industry working groups.

• Experience at a measurement company, media company, agency, or adtech platform working on cross-screen or cross-platform audience products.

• Exposure to outcomes measurement, including sales lift, brand lift, or multi-touch attribution (MTA).

We’re on a mission to make banking 10x better.
At 10x Banking ("ten-ex banking") we’re transforming the financial industry with our cloud-native core banking platform. 10x's platform powers global banks and financial institutions including Chase UK, Old Mutual and Westpac.
We offer a diverse, global community that thrives on innovation and collaboration. Tackling exciting challenges with the utmost integrity, we aim to make a positive impact through our work for our clients, their customers and the communities we work in.
Be part of something bigger – join us and transform and industry.

About the role

As a Senior Product Manager, you will lead two closely connected product areas within our core banking platform: our foundational core domain services and our migration tooling. The foundational services provide the common model and capabilities through which banks create and manage customers and organisations, financial products, and the accounts that connect them. The migration tooling enables clients to move complex customer, account, product and transaction data from legacy platforms onto 10x safely, efficiently and with confidence. 
This is a senior individual contributor role with significant scope and influence. You will set product direction across multiple engineering teams, shape cross-platform architecture and sequencing, and work directly with clients undertaking complex core modernisation programmes. You will be expected to operate comfortably at both strategic and technical depth, turning difficult platform and data problems into clear product outcomes and executable plans. 
Our product teams are cross-functional and durable, bringing product and engineering together to deliver measurable customer and business value. You will partner particularly closely with engineering leaders, architects, implementation teams and client technology stakeholders. 

What you will do 

• Own the vision, strategy, outcomes and roadmap for the foundational core domain services and migration tooling, aligning them with 10x product strategy and client needs. 
• Lead product work across the teams responsible for parties, products and accounts, creating a coherent and externally understandable platform experience rather than a collection of internal services. 
• Define how clients migrate data onto 10x, covering the end-to-end journey from data mapping and preparation through ingestion, validation, reconciliation, rehearsal, cutover and post-migration assurance. 
• Work at technical depth with engineers and architects on domain models, APIs, event schemas, data contracts, sequencing, performance, observability, resiliency and operational controls. 
• Partner with client technology, data and migration teams to understand source platforms, target operating models, migration risks and integration constraints. 
• Set clear product outcomes and make evidence-based trade-offs across platform simplification, migration capability, client commitments, reliability, scalability and time to value. 
• Lead discovery for complex and ambiguous problems, combining direct client engagement, technical investigation, operational insight, market context and product analytics. 
• Translate strategy and customer problems into clear requirements, hypotheses and delivery increments without prescribing engineering solutions unnecessarily. 
• Coordinate dependencies across Product, Engineering, Architecture, Implementation, Support and Commercial teams, resolving ambiguity and driving decisions. 
• Act as a trusted senior product representative in client and prospect discussions, explaining platform concepts, migration approaches, trade-offs and roadmap direction credibly to both technical and executive audiences. 
• Define measures of success and use data to assess product adoption, migration performance, reliability, client effort and commercial impact. 
• Help evolve how product and engineering work at 10x, including the responsible adoption of agentic, AI-assisted product development lifecycle and software development lifecycle practices. 
• Coach and influence other product managers, raising the quality of technical product thinking, discovery, documentation and decision-making across the organisation. 

What success looks like 
In your first 12 months, you will: 
• Establish a clear strategy, outcome framework and prioritised roadmap across foundational core services and migration tooling. 
• Create strong alignment across the teams responsible for parties, products, accounts and migrations, with clear ownership, interfaces and shared outcomes. 
• Deepen 10x’s ability to support safe, repeatable and scalable client migrations, reducing friction and increasing confidence for both prospects and live clients. 
• Drive measurable improvements in the usability, reliability, performance or adoption of the product areas you own. 
• Build trusted relationships with engineering, architecture, implementation, client-facing teams and client technology leaders. 
• Become a recognised subject matter expert who can represent these product areas with credibility from detailed engineering discussions through to executive and client conversations. 
• Make practical progress towards more agentic product and software development practices, demonstrating improvements in quality, speed, traceability or decision-making rather than adopting AI for its own sake. 
• Raise the standard of technical product management and cross-team product leadership across 10x. 
Requirements
Ideally, you will have...

• Experience as a Senior Product Manager, Lead Product Manager or equivalent in B2B SaaS, fintech, banking infrastructure or enterprise technology. 
• A strong record of setting direction and delivering outcomes for technically complex platform products used by multiple clients, teams or product lines. 
• The technical fluency to work credibly with engineers and architects on APIs, event-driven systems, distributed services, data models and cloud-native architectures. 
• Experience owning products where data integrity, correctness, scalability, auditability and operational resilience are critical. 
• Experience leading multiple related product areas or engineering teams and aligning their work around a coherent strategy and customer outcome. 
• Strong product judgement, including the ability to move between long-term platform strategy, detailed technical constraints and immediate client needs. 
• Experience working directly with enterprise clients and senior stakeholders through complex implementation or transformation programmes. 
• A proven ability to influence across organisational boundaries, make difficult prioritisation decisions and create clarity without relying on formal authority. 
• Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts in straightforward commercial and customer language. 
• A rigorous approach to discovery, outcome definition, measurement and product decision-making. 

We'd especially love to hear from you if you have...

• Hands-on product experience with core banking platforms, banking ledgers, account or product domain models, or other systems of record. 
• Led or materially contributed to a core banking migration, or another complex, high-volume data migration between platforms. 
• Experience of migration patterns using bulk file transfer and object storage such as Amazon S3, as well as API-led ingestion and validation. 
• Experience with data mapping, transformation, schema evolution, sequencing, reconciliation, cutover, rollback, migration rehearsals or migration observability. 
• Delivered API-first or event-driven products and worked with technologies or concepts such as REST APIs, Kafka, microservices and AWS. 
• Worked on products that support progressive modernisation, coexistence between legacy and target platforms, or phased customer and product migration. 
• Experience introducing or scaling agentic and AI-assisted practices across the product development lifecycle (PDLC) and software development lifecycle (SDLC), with a clear understanding of where human judgement, governance and quality controls remain essential. 
• Experience using AI agents or automation to improve activities such as discovery synthesis, requirements development, solution exploration, specification, testing, code delivery, documentation or knowledge management. 
• Experience operating across multiple geographies or regulated financial services environments.

At 10x Banking, we believe in empowering you to get the job done! Our benefits are here to support you be the best you can be. 

• 25 days of holiday in addition to Bank/Public Holidays (with the option to swap some public holidays for alternative dates such as Diwali or Eid)

AALTO, a global leader in Stratospace. Based in Farnborough, AALTO is an Airbus subsidiary that manufactures, operates, and delivers services with its solar-powered, stratospheric platform: Zephyr.
Zephyr’s persistence enables continuous flight for months at a time. Its current flight-time record of over 67 days in the stratosphere. From above 60,000+ft, or 20km above ground, AALTO can deliver several applications including direct-to-device connectivity and high-resolution Earth observation.
AALTO operates in a new operational layer between most of air traffic and low-Earth orbit, Stratospace. This is where high-altitude platforms led by Zephyr deliver services to commercial and government partners. We can help monitor environments, observe borders, track natural disasters and connect unconnected communities.

Join us as we create a new domain of aerospace: Stratospace. You’ll be part of a highly-skilled, innovative and passionate group of people – Team AALTO. Together, we can Unlock Stratospace.

About The Role

This is a high-impact permanent role for an experienced technical publications leader who can bring structure, pace and assurance to a complex, supplier-enabled aerospace programme. You will be the principal link between AALTO Engineering, CAMO, Product Support, Line Maintenance, Quality, Configuration Management, the technical publications provider and the CSDB software provider.
Your goal is to establish, lead and continuously improve a controlled and sustainable operating model: source information is ready when authors need it; Data Modules are accurate, compliant and configuration-controlled; and approved publications are safe and practical for use.

Responsibilities to include:

• Lead programme delivery: own the integrated plan, milestones, dependencies, risks, issues and decisions, while providing clear progress and recovery reporting.

• Connect suppliers and stakeholders: coordinate internal teams and external providers, resolve queries, secure timely inputs and manage deliverable acceptance and rework.

• Establish S1000D and CSDB governance: define Business Rules, DMRL controls, coding, applicability, workflow, permissions, data ownership, status and release controls.

• Assure technical quality: assess engineering source-data readiness and challenge Data Modules for technical accuracy, compliance, clarity, usability and configuration integrity.

• Create a robust approval and release route: take content from approved engineering sources through verification, CAMO engagement, operational validation, baselining and controlled release.

• Control in-service change: implement processes for publication queries, defects, urgent interim instructions and permanent corrections, including effectivity, distribution and retirement.

• Build lasting capability: introduce practical measures, develop users and reviewers, embed effective ways of working, and lead the long-term growth of the technical publications capability.

Skills and Knowledge Required

• Substantial experience in aerospace technical publications, aircraft maintenance, support engineering or continuing airworthiness.

• Hands-on delivery experience with ASD S1000D and a CSDB, including modular Data Modules and DMRL governance.

• A strong record of leading complex programmes involving suppliers, schedules, risks, issues and dependencies.

• The judgement to assess maintenance instructions for technical accuracy, applicability, usability and safe execution.

• Experience working across Engineering, CAMO or continued airworthiness, Configuration Management and maintenance operations.

• Confident stakeholder leadership, facilitation, written communication and executive reporting skills.

In addition to a competitive, market-aligned salary, we offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your wellbeing, financial security, and work-life balance:
Performance Bonus
Benefit from our short-term incentive plan, recognising and rewarding individual and company success.
Generous Annual Leave
Enjoy 25 days of annual leave, giving you the time to rest, recharge, and spend time on what matters most.
Private Healthcare
Access private medical insurance, alongside dental and optical cashback schemes, helping you and your family stay healthy.
Pension Contributions
Plan confidently for the future with our competitive personal pension scheme.
Income Protection & Life Assurance
Gain added peace of mind through income protection and life assurance cover, providing support when you need it most.
Electric Vehicle & Car Scheme
Access our salary sacrifice vehicle scheme, offering a cost-effective way to drive the latest cars.
Employee Assistance Programme
Receive confidential professional support whenever you need it through our dedicated employee assistance programme.
Employee Discounts
Enjoy a wide range of discounts and offers through Perkbox, covering everything from shopping and travel to leisure activities and everyday essentials.
This is all part of our commitment to creating an environment where our people can thrive both professionally and personally.

Does this opportunity excite you but you’re not 100% sure if you meet all the requirements for the role? Or are you concerned that ‘normal’ office hours aren’t possible given your personal circumstances? Whilst we can’t accommodate every flexible working request, we’ll try to find a practical solution. So why not engage with us and find out more about this role?

The Role & Key Responsibilities

Job Title: Senior Business Change & Technology Project Manager (12 Month Fixed Term Contract)

Location: Peterborough (Hybrid) 

Are you an experienced Project Manager who thrives on delivering complex business and technology change across global organisations? Do you enjoy navigating ambiguity, aligning senior stakeholders, and leading teams to deliver measurable value?

Our BTS Global Delivery Team is growing, and we’re looking for aSenior Business Change & Technology Project Manager to join our PMaaS (Project Management as a Service) function. Operating as an internal consultancy, PMaaS deploys project and programme managers into strategically critical assignments across ABF’s global businesses. In this role, you’ll take end-to-end ownership of major business change and technology programmes, from shaping scope through to benefits realisation.

What you'll be doing:

 • Managing the end-to-end delivery of assigned business and technology change projects, ensuring alignment with strategic objectives and governance standards.

 • Defining project scope, approach, and schedule, with a focus on delivering measurable outcomes on time and within budget.

 • Managing multi-disciplinary teams across federated businesses, including PMaaS colleagues, local business resources, and external partners.

 • Facilitating business readiness and change adoption through clear planning and engagement with end users and operational leaders.

 • Applying appropriate delivery methodologies—Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid—to suit project needs while ensuring continuous improvement.

 • Carefully managing risks, issues, and dependencies across concurrent high-profile initiatives, often involving C-level stakeholders.

 • Reporting regularly on progress, value delivery, and benefits realisation, ensuring business cases are owned and outcomes.

 • Supporting the growth of the PMaaS practice by mentoring others, sharing best practice, and contributing to the development of tools and templates.

What you'll bring:

 • Skilled in engaging with C-suite executives and tailoring communication methods to meet the needs of both operational and strategic audiences.

 • Excellent leadership, influencing, and relationship-building skills with a collaborative, consultative mindset.

 • Experience in effectively delivering business and technology change projects within a federated enterprise environment.

 • Extensive knowledge of project budgeting, planning, and stakeholder engagement, with experience managing budgets in the millions.

 • Deep experience in change management and preparing business users for effective technology adoption.

 • Proficient in both Agile and Waterfall methodologies and confident in applying a pragmatic blend to suit project contexts.

 • Proficiency with Microsoft Project, Excel, PowerPoint, Visio, and other key project delivery tools.

Location

Hybrid, a mix of office and homeworking. This role will be based at our Peterborough offices on the Lynchwood Business Park.
About The Company
Associated British Foods Business Technology Services are continually reviewing our benefits to ensure our staff feel rewarded…

Associated British Foods is a global giant when it comes to the world of food processing and retail. Our ingredients division is the world’s second-largest producer of both sugar and baker’s yeast and our grocery brands occupy leading positions across the globe meaning that, in the UK, nine out of ten households use our brands.

Associated British Foods Business Technology Services (BTS) was first established in 2008 to deliver a centralised IT infrastructure and service to our fellow ABF businesses. We have now grown and operate in over 185 locations spread across 23 countries supported by a fantastic team of nearly 200. Our customers are at the heart of everything we do and we’re looking for people who are eager to join us in supporting and delivering this vision.

We want you to be a part of our future and to support you, so below are a handful of some of our benefits that are offered to our employees.

 • AB Foods BTS match up to 10% pension (contributory)

 • Up to 10% Bonus

 • Opportunity to buy up to 5 days holiday per calendar year

 • Discounts on ABF products such as Twinings, Silverspoon, Pataks and Ryvita

 • 24/7 free and confidential access to an Employee Assistance Programme to support you as and when necessary

 • Free lunch option available every day

 • Access to a staff shop with discounted ABF brand products

We’re looking for dedicated and conscientious people who embrace and live our values. If you are an individual who thrives in a collaborative, trusting and pioneering work environment, ABF could be the right company for you.

All recruitment activities into our ABF BTS team are supported by our AB Agri business.

Making your application

Ready to apply? Great! Simply register your details and upload your CV via our careers website – it usually takes just a few minutes. Please do not delay making your application. In the event of a high candidate response to this vacancy we may close the application period before the date shown and without notice.

So that we can support you to perform at your best, please let us know of any adjustments that may be required throughout the recruitment process by emailing careers@abagri.com

As part of your application, we ask you to answer some equal opportunities questions that help us to monitor how inclusive our recruitment process is and identify areas we can improve in. This information is anonymised, separate from your application and is never seen by the hiring panel. You can choose not to answer these questions with no impact on your application.

ABF BTS recruitment is supported by our AB Agri group and we politely request no contact from recruitment agencies or media sales. We have a PSL and do not accept speculative CVs from recruitment agencies nor accept the fees associated with them.

Role Overview
We are seeking an experienced Senior Cloud Engineer to join our Technology Services team. This role is at the heart of designing, implementing, and managing secure, scalable, and highly resilient cloud infrastructure across Azure and AWS. You will define technology direction, lead large and complex projects end-to-end, and collaborate with development teams, architects, and business stakeholders to deliver cloud solutions that power a broad range of technology initiatives — including AI-driven platforms, containerized applications, and enterprise data workloads.
Experience in the Insurance or Financial Services industry is a plus, but strong technical depth and a continuous improvement mindset are what matter most.
Location
Remote (U.S.)

Level
Senior Individual Contributor

Cloud Platforms
Azure • AWS

Reports To
VP, Technology Services

Industry
InsurTech / Financial Services preferred

Key Responsibilities
Cloud Infrastructure & Architecture
• Design, implement, and manage secure, scalable, and highly resilient cloud infrastructure across Azure and AWS.
• Define technology direction for cloud solutions and drive end-to-end implementation across teams.
• Collaborate with development teams, cloud architects, and product teams to architect solutions for complex, enterprise-scale projects.
• Configure and administer virtual networks, VMs, and web application hosting environments.
• Develop and maintain infrastructure-as-code (IaC) using Terraform to enforce consistency and repeatability across cloud environments.
Project Leadership & Cross-Team Execution
• Lead large, complex technology projects spanning diverse technologies and multiple cross-functional teams.
• Define project schedules, milestones, and priorities based on high-level business objectives; manage execution with minimal supervision.
• Serve as a results-driven technical lead who can independently drive initiatives from concept through delivery.
• Communicate project status, risks, and decisions clearly to stakeholders at all levels.
Containers & Microservices Architecture
• Design, implement, and operate container-based infrastructure and managed Kubernetes environments across Azure and AWS (AKS, EKS), including cluster lifecycle management, scaling, and capacity planning.
• Architect and support microservices solutions leveraging Docker and Kubernetes, applying best practices for service decomposition, inter-service communication, and API gateway integration.
• Design and manage container registries and image pipelines across platforms (Azure Container Registry, Amazon ECR) including vulnerability scanning, image versioning, and promotion workflows.
• Implement and manage serverless container services (Azure Container Apps, AWS Fargate, AWS Lambda container images) for event-driven and workload-appropriate deployment patterns.
• Define and enforce container security standards including network policies, pod security, secrets management (Azure Key Vault, AWS Secrets Manager), and runtime protection.
• Integrate container workloads with cloud-native networking, load balancing, and ingress services across both platforms (Azure Application Gateway, AWS ALB/NLB).
• Support CI/CD pipeline integration for containerized application builds, testing, and automated deployment to non-production and production environments.
• Establish and maintain observability practices for containerized workloads including logging, metrics, and distributed tracing across Azure Monitor, AWS CloudWatch, and third-party tooling.
AI Platform Engineering
• Bring multi-year, hands-on AI engineering experience to the design, build, and ongoing operation of enterprise-grade AI solutions and platforms.
• Deep working knowledge of AI technologies and platforms including Claude (Anthropic) and ChatGPT (OpenAI), including API integration, prompt engineering, and enterprise deployment patterns.
• Design and support infrastructure for AI-powered applications built with modern development tools such as Claude Code, Replit, and Vercel.
• Support AI and data platform workloads across Azure (Databricks, Data Factory, Azure OpenAI) and AWS (SageMaker, Bedrock) environments.
• Contribute to the architecture and operational management of enterprise AI platforms, ensuring performance, availability, and security.
Security & Compliance
• Create and maintain cloud security strategies, policies, procedures, and supporting documentation.
• Develop and maintain infrastructure architecture, audit, and InfoSec documentation in line with regulatory and business requirements.
• Ensure compliance with standard business practices, industry best practices, and applicable regulatory frameworks (particularly relevant in Insurance/FinServ contexts).
• Implement and enforce security controls across cloud environments including identity, networking, and data protection layers.
Operations & Operational Excellence
• Define and document operational processes around cloud monitoring, alerting, and infrastructure management.
• Provide technical support and issue resolution for cloud-hosted environments.
• Lead root cause analysis (RCA) for critical outages and incidents; engineer and implement permanent solutions.
• Maintain accurate and auditable records of incident resolutions, configuration changes, and operational decisions to support compliance and knowledge continuity.
• Drive a culture of continuous improvement through proactive monitoring, automation, and operational refinement.
• Provide technical guidance and mentorship to less experienced team members.
Qualifications
Education
• Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
Required Experience
• 10+ years of overall IT experience, with 5+ years as a cloud or infrastructure engineer in production environments.
• Proven hands-on experience designing, implementing, and supporting cloud solutions in Azure and AWS; GCP experience a plus.
• Demonstrated ability to lead large, complex technology projects across diverse technologies and cross-functional teams with minimal supervision.
• Deep expertise with core cloud services across Azure and AWS: compute, networking, storage, identity/IAM, security, managed Kubernetes (AKS/EKS), and data platform services.
• Strong background in Linux and Windows system administration.
• Deep experience with networking and security concepts in large-scale, production cloud environments including VNets, VPCs, NSGs, firewalls, private endpoints, and zero-trust access patterns.
• Hands-on experience with containerization and microservices: Docker, Kubernetes, and managed Kubernetes services (AKS and/or EKS) in production environments.
• Terraform expertise is required — candidates must demonstrate hands-on experience authoring, managing, and scaling IaC in production multi-cloud environments.
• Multi-year hands-on AI experience, including deep understanding of AI platforms such as Claude (Anthropic) and ChatGPT (OpenAI), and practical experience building and supporting AI-powered applications.
• Experience building and supporting applications developed using AI-assisted development platforms such as Claude Code, Replit, Vercel, or similar rapid-development tooling.
• Strong operational experience defining and documenting processes for cloud monitoring, alerting, and infrastructure management.
• Experience developing infrastructure architecture documentation and InfoSec/audit deliverables.
• Demonstrated ability to work effectively within large, cross-functional teams with strong communication skills.

• Cloud certifications: Azure (AZ-104, AZ-204, AZ-303, AZ-400) and/or AWS (Solutions Architect, DevOps Engineer, or equivalent) preferred, not required.
• Supplemental IaC tooling: familiarity with cloud-native tools such as Azure Bicep, AWS CloudFormation, or AWS CDK is a plus.
• CI/CD tooling: Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, AWS CodePipeline, or similar.
• Relational and NoSQL databases: MS SQL Server, Cosmos DB, PostgreSQL.
• Observability and monitoring platforms: Datadog experience strongly preferred, including infrastructure monitoring, APM, log management, and alerting across multi-cloud environments.
• Background in the Insurance or Financial Services industry.

• Technical Excellence
• AI Platform Fluency

• Project Leadership & Self-Direction
• Continuous Improvement Mindset

• Cross-Functional Collaboration
• Security-First Thinking

• Root Cause Problem Solving

Job Title: Head of FP&A
Employment type: Permanent, hybrid (2 days per week in our Manchester office)
Salary: Competitive, depending on experience

We’re looking for a Head of FP&A to build and lead the financial planning and analysis function at AccessPay, a growing, PE-backed SaaS business.

This newly created role offers the opportunity to shape our planning processes, develop our financial models and influence decisions across the business. Reporting directly to the CFO and working closely with the Financial Controller, you’ll provide the executive leadership team and PE sponsor with clear insight into performance, growth opportunities and investment decisions.

You’ll combine hands-on financial analysis with commercial business partnering, working closely with department heads across sales, product and other functions. As the business scales, you’ll also have the opportunity to build and develop a small FP&A team.

• Lead the annual budgeting process and rolling forecasts, working with department heads to develop plans and assess performance against budget and forecast.
• Own and develop the group’s financial models, including three-statement modelling, scenario planning and sensitivity analysis.
• Develop our SaaS KPI framework, ensuring consistent definitions and reporting across ARR, MRR, NRR, churn, CAC, LTV, Rule of 40 and gross margin.
• Provide clear variance analysis and commercial recommendations to support strategic and operational decisions.
• Prepare board reporting packs, investor materials and management information for the PE sponsor, alongside the CFO and Financial Controller.
• Partner with commercial, sales and product teams on pricing, deal structuring and unit economics.
• Support long-range planning, investment appraisal and business case development, as well as M&A due diligence, deal modelling and integration planning.
• Improve planning tools, systems and processes, and lead and develop FP&A analysts as the function grows.

You’ll have experience leading FP&A activity and be comfortable moving between detailed modelling and discussions with senior stakeholders. You’ll be able to challenge assumptions constructively, explain what the numbers mean and turn analysis into practical recommendations.

We’re looking for:
• An ACA, ACCA, CIMA or equivalent qualification, or a strong finance or analytics background with relevant experience.
• Proven FP&A leadership experience, ideally in a PE-backed or high-growth SaaS or technology business.
• Strong financial modelling skills and advanced Excel proficiency—our planning processes are currently Excel-based.
• A strong working knowledge of SaaS metrics and KPI frameworks.
• Commercial judgement, clear communication and the confidence to present to senior leadership.
• Experience managing or developing a small team, with the ability to work both strategically and hands-on.
Experience with FP&A or planning systems and reporting tools such as Power BI would be an advantage, but isn’t essential.

This is an opportunity to establish an FP&A function with direct access to the CFO and exposure to executive and investor decision-making. You’ll have scope to shape how we plan, measure performance and support the next stage of the business’s growth.

Job Title: Internal Auditor
Employment type: Permanent, hybrid (1-2 days a week in our Manchester office)
Salary: Up to £40,000 per annum, depending on experience

AccessPay is a Manchester-based fintech, founded in 2012, that helps finance and treasury teams automate their payments and cash management. Our cloud platform connects businesses’ finance systems directly to their banks, so they can send payments securely and keep track of their cash. Because our customers trust us with their money, strong governance, security and compliance are central to how we work.

Trust is central to everything we do, and independent assurance is how we prove it. As our Internal Auditor, you will deliver AccessPay’s internal audit schedule and support the external audits carried out by our assessment bodies, helping us keep our industry certifications and test that our controls work in practice.

You will sit within our GSI team, working closely with the Head of Governance and Risk and alongside colleagues in Compliance, Assurance, Internal IT and Cyber Security. It is a hands-on role with plenty of exposure to different parts of the business, and a real opportunity for an experienced auditor to take the initiative, shape how we audit and tackle new challenges.

• Plan, scope and carry out internal audits in line with the annual audit schedule, including thematic and targeted reviews.
• Identify findings and get to the root cause, then write clear, high-impact audit reports with practical recommendations and executive summaries.
• Track remediation of audit issues and follow up to confirm that actions have been completed properly.
• Co-ordinate cross-functional audits, working with a variety of teams including Technology, HR, Cyber Security and Internal IT.
• Support external audits and assessments, and work with internal and external stakeholders so that AccessPay maintains its industry certifications.
• Help ensure we comply with applicable laws, regulations and internal policies.
• Help manage the employee screening process, raising any issues with senior management and recruiting managers promptly.
• Support our mandatory training processes.

You will have:
• Practical experience in auditing, including planning and conducting audits, and reporting on findings.
• A highly motivated, self-starting approach, with the ability to work autonomously, exercise sound judgement, and take ownership of deliverables with minimal supervision.
• A willingness to embrace challenges and the confidence to question established ways of working.
• Strong analytical skills and excellent attention to detail.
• The ability to collaborate effectively with colleagues across different business functions, and to communicate findings clearly both verbally and in writing.
• Strong time management skills, with the ability to prioritise competing demands and meet deadlines.
• Strong project management skills, with the ability to juggle more than one audit or task at a time.
• An appreciation of IT infrastructure, networking, cloud computing and cyber security.
It would be great if you also have:
• Knowledge of DORA (the Digital Operational Resilience Act) and how it applies to our business.
• Practical experience of applying AI in audit, risk or compliance work, for example to speed up testing, analysis or reporting.
• Familiarity with other compliance frameworks such as ISO 27001, PCI-DSS, BACS, SWIFT, GDPR, SOC 2, Cyber Essentials and Cyber Essentials Plus.

This is an opportunity to apply your audit experience in a fintech business where governance, security and compliance are central to how we work. You’ll work across a broad range of teams and frameworks, with room to take the initiative and help shape our approach.

Alongside a supportive, collaborative team, we offer:

We are answering the urgent call to decarbonise construction globally, by developing the low-carbon and carbon-negative technologies and products needed, and the industrial ecosystem to deploy them fast, anywhere in the world. We firmly believe that our work is pivotal to achieve net zero by 2050.

If you’re curious by nature, thrive on solving complex technical challenges and want to see your expertise translate into tangible environmental impact, we’d love to hear from you.

Edinburgh, UK

Who We Are

Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1,500 firms in 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $10 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end-to-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and levels of complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, São Paulo, London, Edinburgh, Geneva, Warsaw, Dubai, Pune and Singapore.

The Role

We are currently seeking a Senior Software Engineer to join the Alternatives Data Management (ADM) team. Our team is building AI-powered data products and workflow solutions that unlock transparency, efficiency, and insight in private market investments. You’ll join a talented full-stack team of engineers and work on distributed services that are used across the entire ADM engineering stack.

Applicants must have, and maintain, the right to work in the United Kingdom from the first day of employment. Please note that visa sponsorship is not available for this role.

What You’ll Do

• Architect, implement, and maintain engineering solutions to solve complex problems; write well-designed, testable code.

• Independently deliver high-value projects from design through delivery.

• Collaborate with product managers on product requirements iterations, design feasibility and user feedback.

• Learn and promote best engineering practices.

• Document software functionality, system design, and project plans.

• Mentor junior engineers, provide clear and constructive guidance

• Collaborate with engineers and stakeholders from other teams to resolve technical issues or coordinate dependencies

Who You Are

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience

• Extensive software engineering experience

• Track record of leading technical initiatives from design through delivery

• Comfortable working independently, with a bias for action

• Strong ownership mentality and drive to solve the most important problems

• Excel at written and verbal communication

• Experience with financial services or wealth management operations

• Experience with object-oriented programming

• Experience with AWS or another cloud platform

• Experience with IaC (infrastructure as code), preferably Terraform

• Experience with gen AI for coding

Our Values 

• Act Like an Owner - Think and operate with intention, purpose and care. Own outcomes.

• Build Together - Collaborate to unlock the best solutions. Deliver lasting value. 

• Champion Our Clients - Exceed client expectations. Our clients’ success is our success. 

• Drive Innovation - Be bold and unconstrained in problem solving. Transform the industry. 

• Embrace Learning - Engage our community to broaden our perspective. Bring a growth mindset. 

In addition to our core values, Addepar is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We seek to bring together diverse ideas, experiences, skill sets, perspectives, backgrounds and identities to drive innovative solutions. We commit to promoting a welcoming environment where inclusion and belonging are held as a shared responsibility.

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

PHISHING SCAM WARNING: Addepar is among several companies recently made aware of a phishing scam involving con artists posing as hiring managers recruiting via email, text and social media. The imposters are creating misleading email accounts, conducting remote “interviews,” and making fake job offers in order to collect personal and financial information from unsuspecting individuals. Please be aware that no job offers will be made from Addepar without a formal interview process. Additionally, Addepar will not ask you to purchase equipment or supplies as part of your onboarding process. If you have any questions, please reach out to ta-operations@addepar.com.

Who We Are

Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1,500 firms in 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $10 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end-to-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and levels of complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, São Paulo, London, Edinburgh, Geneva, Warsaw, Dubai, Pune and Singapore.

The Role

The Applied AI team works embedded with Addepar's strategic clients to figure out where AI can change how they work and then build those capabilities from scratch. You'll spend time understanding a client's world, identify what's worth building, prototype it, prove it works, and then partner with core engineering teams to ship it as product for all customers.

As an Applied AI Engineer, you'll build agentic systems from idea through production. The work starts with understanding the problem well enough to know what to build, then moves fast through prototyping and iteration. You'll design agent behavior, wire up tool integrations, tune evaluations until the AI actually works in practice. You'll sit close to the people who use what you build, and that feedback loop is how both the product and your skills grow fast. The team is new. Your work shapes what we ship.

This role may require occasional work outside standard business hours to accommodate client time zones and up to 15% travel to client sites, including occasional overnight and multi-day engagements.

Applicants must have, and maintain, the right to work in the United Kingdom from the first day of employment. Please note that visa sponsorship is not available for this role.

What You'll Do

• Build AI-powered agents and tools end-to-end: identify the problem with clients and domain experts, prototype quickly, evaluate rigorously, and ship to production

• Design and implement LLM integrations including prompt engineering, function calling, structured outputs, and retrieval-augmented workflows

• Define evaluation criteria and build test harnesses for AI systems where correctness is ambiguous and domain-specific

• Work directly with clients to understand their workflows, validate AI behavior, and iterate toward production quality

• Partner with core engineering teams to generalize client-specific work into product features

• Contribute to shared AI infrastructure (agent frameworks, tool integrations, deployment pipelines)

• Monitor and maintain production AI systems with attention to reliability, cost, and performance

Who You Are

• Prior professional software engineering experience

• Professional experience with Python (the team's primary language)

• Experience working with LLM APIs (Claude, GPT, or similar) including function calling and structured outputs

• Comfort with SQL for data exploration and building data-grounded AI workflows

• Experience with AI-assisted development tools (Claude Code, Codex, or similar)

• You've built something from zero to one. You're drawn to figuring out what to build, not just building what's specified.

• A bias for action. You ship quickly, learn from feedback, and iterate.

• You see projects through from prototype to production and care about what the client experiences, not what the code does

• BS/MS in Computer Science, Mathematics, or another quantitative field, or equivalent experience

Nice to Have

• Experience building agentic systems (multi-step tool use, agent orchestration, durable workflows)

• Experience with additional backend languages (Java is valuable in our environment)

• Familiarity with financial data (portfolios, transactions, securities, accounting)

• Exposure to cloud infrastructure (AWS) and container-based deployments

• Experience with evaluation frameworks or methodologies for measuring AI system quality

Our Values 

• Act Like an Owner - Think and operate with intention, purpose and care. Own outcomes.

• Build Together - Collaborate to unlock the best solutions. Deliver lasting value. 

• Champion Our Clients - Exceed client expectations. Our clients’ success is our success. 

• Drive Innovation - Be bold and unconstrained in problem solving. Transform the industry. 

• Embrace Learning - Engage our community to broaden our perspective. Bring a growth mindset.

JOB APPLICANT PRIVACY/FAIR PROCESSING NOTICE

1. Introduction

1.1 In this Data Privacy Notice the terms the "Company", "we", "us" and "our" are references to Addepar UK Ltd., company number 13162730, having a registered address at Clifton House, Bunnian Place, Basingstoke, Hampshire, United Kingdom, RG21 7JE. 1.2 Addepar UK Ltd. will be the data controller of your personal data. In addition, where processing of personal data is undertaken by other associated companies of the Company for their own independent purposes, these associated companies may be co-controllers of your personal data.

1.3 We hold and process data on all current and former applicants and interview candidates ("applicants" or "you" or "your"), and third parties whose information you provide to us in connection with your application (e.g., next‑of‑kin, emergency contact information).

1.4 We take your data protection rights and our legal obligations seriously. Your personal data will be treated in a secure and confidential manner and only as set out below or otherwise notified to you in writing. 

1.5 Please read the following carefully to understand our views and practices regarding your personal data and how we treat it. The following Data Privacy Notice describes the categories of personal data we may process, how your personal data may be processed, for what purposes we process your data and how your privacy is safeguarded in the course of our relationship with you. It is intended to comply with our obligations to provide you with information about the Company's processing of your personal data under privacy laws. It does not form part of a contract of employment or engagement. 

1.6 If you have any questions about this Data Privacy Notice please contact privacy@addepar.com.

2. Responsibility for data privacy

2.1 The contact details of each of the Company's data controllers and, where applicable their representatives and relevant data protection contact, are Addepar UK Ltd. & Addepar, Inc., each of which can be reached at privacy@addepar.com.

2.2 If you have any questions regarding the processing of your personal data or if you believe your privacy rights have been violated, please contact Addepar’s People Team at people@addepar.com or privacy@addepar.com. 

3. What data do we process?

3.1 We collect various types of personal data about you for the purposes described in this Data Privacy Notice including:

(a) personal details: your title and name, birth name, preferred name, any additional names, gender, home contact details (e.g., address, telephone or mobile number, e‑mail), immigration and eligibility to work information, languages spoken, details of any disability and any reasonable adjustments required as a result;

(b) recruitment and selection data: skills and experience, qualifications, references, CV and application, record of interview, interview notes and assessment, vetting and verification information (e.g. results of credit reference check, financial sanction check and a basic disclosure criminal record check relating to unspent convictions where carried out and permitted by applicable law), right to work verification, information related to the outcome of your application, details of any offer made to you;

(c) equality and diversity data: where permitted by law and provided voluntarily, data regarding gender, race, nationality, and sexuality (stored anonymously for equal opportunities monitoring purposes); and

(d) any other personal data which you choose to disclose to Company personnel during the course of the application process whether verbally or in written form (for example in work emails).

3.2 Certain additional information will sometimes be collected where this is necessary and permitted by local applicable laws.

3.3 Some of the information collected by the Company and described above constitutes special category personal data. Special category personal data includes information relating to racial or ethnic origin, political opinions, religious or philosophical beliefs, health, trade union membership, sex life or sexual orientation, biometric or genetic information, and information relating to criminal records, offences or proceedings. The Company only collects personal data when permitted or required to do so by law, in circumstances described below.

4. How does the Company collect data?

4.1 The Company collects and records your personal data from a variety of sources, but mainly directly from you or from our service providers that handle applications on our behalf, such as Greenhouse. You will usually provide this information directly to us through your participation in the recruitment process, or you will provide it to our service providers, such as Greenhouse. 

4.2 We also obtain some information from third parties: for example, references from a previous employer, recruitment agencies or where we employ a third party to carry out a background check (where permitted by applicable law). 

4.3 Where we ask you to provide personal data to us on a mandatory basis, we will inform you of this at the time of collection. Failure to provide any mandatory information may mean that we cannot carry out our recruitment process. 

4.4 Apart from personal data relating to you, you may also provide the Company with personal data of third parties, such as contact information of individuals listed as referees in your application. Before you provide such third party personal data to the Company you must first inform these third parties of any such data which you intend to provide to the Company and of the processing to be carried out by the Company, as detailed in this Data Privacy Notice.

5. What are the purposes for which data are processed?

5.1 Your personal data are collected and processed for business purposes in accordance with applicable laws.

5.2 We collect and process your personal data for purposes including:

(a) recruitment and selection including:

(i) to assess your suitability to work for us including short listing, agreements and interviews;

(ii) to conduct pre‑employment checks including verification of your identity, checking your legal right to work and checking references;

(iii) to conduct a pre‑employment reference check, financial sanction check and a check in relation to suspect criminal activities in order to prevent crime and other unlawful acts and to protect the business and clients in the financial services industry from the risk of dishonesty, malpractice or improper conduct;

(iv) to compare you with other applicants and make a decision whether to offer you employment;

(v) to consider any reasonable adjustments either for the recruitment process or if you were to commence employment with us in the event you have a disability;

(vi) to make a job offer and provide a contract of employment;

(vii) to prepare to bring you on board as an employee where you accept an offer of employment from us. In this case we will customise to make sense of the information gathered during recruitment for the purpose of your employment and will transfer some of this to our employment systems and files;

(viii) to contact you if you are not successful should another potentially suitable vacancy arise during the six months following the completion of the recruitment process for the role you applied for; and

(ix) to deal with any query, challenge or request for feedback received in relation to our recruitment decision;

(b) protecting the private, confidential and proprietary information of the Company, its employees, its clients and third parties;

(c) monitoring programmes to ensure equality of opportunity and diversity with regard to personal characteristics protected under applicable anti‑discrimination laws;

(d) to enforce our legal rights and obligations, and for any purposes in connection with any legal claims made by, against or otherwise involving you;

(e) to comply with lawful requests by public authorities (including without limitation to meet national security or law enforcement requirements), discovery requests, or where otherwise required or permitted by applicable laws, court orders, government regulations, or regulatory authorities (including without limitation data protection, tax and employment), whether within or outside your country; and

(f) for other purposes permitted by applicable laws, including legitimate interests pursued by the Company where these are not overridden by the interests or fundamental rights and freedoms of applicants and where these have been explained to you before the relevant data is collected or the processing is carried out.

5.3 Special categories of data may be collected and processed by the Company for the following purposes:

(a) documentation such as work permits, details of residency, proof of citizenship will be processed to assess and review eligibility to work for the Company in the jurisdiction in which you work; and

(b) your racial or ethnic origin, sexual orientation or disability status may be used for the collection of statistical data subject to local laws, or where required to record such characteristics to comply with equality and diversity requirements of applicable local legislation or to keep the Company's commitment to equal opportunity under review.

5.4 Additional information regarding specific processing of personal data may be notified to you.

6. Legal bases for processing

6.1 Personal data

(a) Whenever the Company processes your personal data we do so on the basis of a lawful condition for processing. Processing of special categories of data is always justified on the basis of an additional lawful condition as described in section 6.2 below.

(b) In the majority of cases, the processing of your personal data will be justified on one of the following bases:

(i) we will process your data where the processing is necessary for the performance of a contract to which you are a party or in order to take steps at your request prior to entering into such a contract; or

(ii) where the above grounds do not apply we may process your personal data where the processing is necessary for the legitimate interests pursued by the Company (being those purposes described in the section above), except where such interests are overridden by your interests or fundamental rights and freedoms which require protection of personal data.

6.2 Special categories of data

(a) The special categories of personal data that may be processed by the Company are set out in this Data Privacy Notice. Where we process special categories of data it will be justified by a condition set out at paragraph 6.1(b) above and also by one of the following additional conditions:

(i) the processing is necessary for the purposes of carrying out the obligations and exercising the rights of you or the Company in the field of employment law, social security and social protection law, to the extent permissible under applicable laws;

(ii) the processing is necessary for the purposes of preventive or occupational medicine, for the assessment of your working capacity, medical diagnosis, the provision of health or social care or treatment or the management of health or social care systems and services, to the extent permitted by applicable laws;

(iii) the processing is necessary to protect your vital interests or of another person where you are physically or legally incapable of giving consent (for example in exceptional emergency situations, such as a medical emergency);

(iv) the processing is necessary for purposes authorised by applicable law. This includes:

(A) where the processing is necessary for the purposes of identifying or keeping under review the existence or absence of equality of opportunity or treatment; and

(B) where the processing is necessary for complying with regulatory requirements that involve taking steps to determine whether an individual has committed an unlawful act or has been involved in dishonesty, malpractice or other serious misconduct.

(v) the processing is necessary for the establishment, exercise or defence of legal claims.

6.3 Processing data relating to criminal convictions and offences

• 
Personal data relating to criminal convictions and offences will only be processed where authorised by applicable laws. For example, a criminal record check may be carried out on recruitment.

7. Retention of personal data

7.1 The Company retains personal data for as long as is required to satisfy the purpose for which it was collected by us or provided by you. This will usually be the period of the application process. We may keep some specific types of data, for example, your CV, for longer where we have a legitimate business reason to do so, such as to contact you for future opportunities. 

8. Disclosures of personal data

8.1 We share your personal data with Addepar, Inc., its affiliates and any of their employees where it is necessary to do so for any of the purposes described in this Privacy Notice.

8.2 The Company also shares personal data with service providers that perform services on our behalf, such as our recruitment platform provider, Greenhouse; background and education verification agencies; HR and recruitment service providers; accounting, payment and expense reimbursement providers; travel providers; and electronic signature providers. In accordance with applicable law, we have entered into legally binding agreements requiring our service providers to use and disclose personal data only as necessary to perform services on our behalf or to comply with applicable legal requirements.

8.3 In addition, we may disclose personal data about you (a) if we are required or permitted to do so by law or legal process, for example due to a court order or a request from a law enforcement agency, (b) when we believe disclosure is necessary or appropriate to prevent physical harm or financial loss, (c) in connection with an investigation of suspected or actual fraudulent or other illegal activity, and (d) in the event we sell or transfer all or a portion of our business or assets (including in the event of a reorganization, dissolution, or liquidation).

9.1 The Company is committed to protecting the security of the personal data you share with us. In support of this commitment, we have implemented appropriate technical, physical and organisational measures to ensure a level of security appropriate to the risk. The Company uses a variety of technical and organisational methods to secure your personal data in accordance with applicable laws.

(a) The country to which the personal data will be transferred has been recognised as providing an adequate level of protection for personal data; or

(b) We have put in place appropriate safeguards in respect of the transfer, for example the controller to controller or controller to processor Standard Contractual Clauses.

10.5 You may request a copy of the safeguards that we have put in place in respect of transfer of personal data by contacting privacy@addepar.com.

11. Your rights as a data subject

11.1 Subject to applicable law, you may have the right to request:

(a) confirmation of whether we process personal data relating to you and, if so, to request a copy of that personal data;

(b) that we rectify or update your personal data that is inaccurate, incomplete or outdated;

(f) withdrawal of your consent where you have given us consent to process your personal data; and

(g) that we provide a copy of your personal data to you in a structured, commonly used and machine readable format in certain circumstances.

11.2 If you wish to exercise any of your data protection rights or if you consider that we have processed your personal data in violation of applicable law, please contact Addepar’s People or Legal team at people@addepar.com or legal@addepar.com.

12. Notice of changes

(a) recruitment and selection including:

(ii) to conduct pre‑employment checks including verification of your identity, checking your legal right to work and checking references;

(iii) to conduct a pre‑employment reference check, financial sanction check and a check in relation to suspect criminal activities in order to prevent crime and other unlawful acts and to protect the business and clients in the financial services industry from the risk of dishonesty, malpractice or improper conduct;

(v) to consider any reasonable adjustments either for the recruitment process or if you were to commence employment with us in the event you have a disability;

(vi) to make a job offer and provide a contract of employment;
