(i) we will process your data where the processing is necessary for the performance of a contract to which you are a party or in order to take steps at your request prior to entering into such a contract; or

(ii) where the above grounds do not apply we may process your personal data where the processing is necessary for the legitimate interests pursued by the Company (being those purposes described in the section above), except where such interests are overridden by your interests or fundamental rights and freedoms which require protection of personal data.

6.2 Special categories of data

(a) The special categories of personal data that may be processed by the Company are set out in this Data Privacy Notice. Where we process special categories of data it will be justified by a condition set out at paragraph 6.1(b) above and also by one of the following additional conditions:

(i) the processing is necessary for the purposes of carrying out the obligations and exercising the rights of you or the Company in the field of employment law, social security and social protection law, to the extent permissible under applicable laws;

(ii) the processing is necessary for the purposes of preventive or occupational medicine, for the assessment of your working capacity, medical diagnosis, the provision of health or social care or treatment or the management of health or social care systems and services, to the extent permitted by applicable laws;

(iii) the processing is necessary to protect your vital interests or of another person where you are physically or legally incapable of giving consent (for example in exceptional emergency situations, such as a medical emergency);

(iv) the processing is necessary for purposes authorised by applicable law. This includes:

(A) where the processing is necessary for the purposes of identifying or keeping under review the existence or absence of equality of opportunity or treatment; and

(B) where the processing is necessary for complying with regulatory requirements that involve taking steps to determine whether an individual has committed an unlawful act or has been involved in dishonesty, malpractice or other serious misconduct.

(v) the processing is necessary for the establishment, exercise or defence of legal claims.

6.3 Processing data relating to criminal convictions and offences

• 
Personal data relating to criminal convictions and offences will only be processed where authorised by applicable laws. For example, a criminal record check may be carried out on recruitment.

7. Retention of personal data

7.1 The Company retains personal data for as long as is required to satisfy the purpose for which it was collected by us or provided by you. This will usually be the period of the application process. We may keep some specific types of data, for example, your CV, for longer where we have a legitimate business reason to do so, such as to contact you for future opportunities. 

8. Disclosures of personal data

8.1 We share your personal data with Addepar, Inc., its affiliates and any of their employees where it is necessary to do so for any of the purposes described in this Privacy Notice.

8.2 The Company also shares personal data with service providers that perform services on our behalf, such as our recruitment platform provider, Greenhouse; background and education verification agencies; HR and recruitment service providers; accounting, payment and expense reimbursement providers; travel providers; and electronic signature providers. In accordance with applicable law, we have entered into legally binding agreements requiring our service providers to use and disclose personal data only as necessary to perform services on our behalf or to comply with applicable legal requirements.

8.3 In addition, we may disclose personal data about you (a) if we are required or permitted to do so by law or legal process, for example due to a court order or a request from a law enforcement agency, (b) when we believe disclosure is necessary or appropriate to prevent physical harm or financial loss, (c) in connection with an investigation of suspected or actual fraudulent or other illegal activity, and (d) in the event we sell or transfer all or a portion of our business or assets (including in the event of a reorganization, dissolution, or liquidation).

9. Security of data

9.1 The Company is committed to protecting the security of the personal data you share with us. In support of this commitment, we have implemented appropriate technical, physical and organisational measures to ensure a level of security appropriate to the risk. The Company uses a variety of technical and organisational methods to secure your personal data in accordance with applicable laws.

10. INTERNATIONAL Transfer of Personal Data

10.1 From time to time your personal data (including special categories of personal data) will be transferred to associated companies of the Company to process for the purposes described in this Data Privacy Notice. This will be applicable for example where the relevant company or a manager from that company is responsible for conducting or approving the relevant process or the data is part of a global directory where other individuals need to have access. These associated companies or managers are located elsewhere in the world (for example, Addepar, Inc. located in the United States or Addepar Canada, Inc. located in Canada). 

10.2 Personal data may also be transferred to third parties (e.g. service providers, such as Greenhouse, as set out above), who may have systems or suppliers located outside the European Union. 

10.3 As a result, in some circumstances your personal data will be transferred to countries outside of the UK whose data protection laws may be less stringent than in the UK. 

10.4 In such, cases, the Company will comply with applicable legal requirements and will only transfer your personal data if:

(a) The country to which the personal data will be transferred has been recognised as providing an adequate level of protection for personal data; or

(b) We have put in place appropriate safeguards in respect of the transfer, for example the controller to controller or controller to processor Standard Contractual Clauses.

10.5 You may request a copy of the safeguards that we have put in place in respect of transfer of personal data by contacting privacy@addepar.com.

11. Your rights as a data subject

11.1 Subject to applicable law, you may have the right to request:

(a) confirmation of whether we process personal data relating to you and, if so, to request a copy of that personal data;

(b) that we rectify or update your personal data that is inaccurate, incomplete or outdated;

(c) that we cease to process certain personal data where you object to its use and we do not have an overriding legitimate interest in carrying out the processing and it is not necessary for the establishment, exercise or defence of legal claims;

(d) that we erase your personal data in certain circumstances, such as where we collected personal data on the basis of your consent and you withdraw that consent, or when you object to use of your personal data;

(e) that we restrict the use of your personal data in certain circumstances, such as while we consider another request that you have submitted, for example a request that we update your personal data;

(f) withdrawal of your consent where you have given us consent to process your personal data; and

(g) that we provide a copy of your personal data to you in a structured, commonly used and machine readable format in certain circumstances.

11.2 If you wish to exercise any of your data protection rights or if you consider that we have processed your personal data in violation of applicable law, please contact Addepar’s People or Legal team at people@addepar.com or legal@addepar.com.

12.2 Should we change our approach to data protection, you will be informed of these changes or made aware that we have updated the Data Privacy Notice so that you know which information we process and how we use this information.

Who We Are

Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1,500 firms in 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $10 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end-to-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and levels of complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, São Paulo, London, Edinburgh, Geneva, Warsaw, Dubai, Pune and Singapore.

The Role

We are seeking a Precompute Platform Lead to own and scale Addepar's precompute layer — the platform that pre-calculates financial analytics and transparently integrates precomputed and real-time results, delivering step-change improvements in query latency and concurrency for enterprise-scale wealth management firms.

The team operates on terabyte-scale datasets, leveraging vector-oriented programming and distributed systems to enable sub-second performance. You will lead the evolution of this capability from targeted use cases to a platform-wide performance layer — solving hard problems in incremental computation, vectorised processing, and distributed data architecture as you scale.

Applicants must have, and maintain, the right to work in the United Kingdom from the first day of employment. Please note that visa sponsorship is not available for this role.

What You’ll Do

• Own the precompute platform roadmap in partnership with Product and engineering leadership, defining and meeting aggressive performance KPIs for daily processing, incremental processing, and query latency across enterprise clients

• Architect, implement, and maintain engineering solutions to solve sophisticated problems; reduce complexity through the adoption of strategic data architecture and workflows

• Drive integration with core compute infrastructure, growing the share of query traffic served through the precompute layer

• Continue global region support, building a repeatable architecture that scales across Addepar's multi-region deployment

• Drive deeper vectorisation of the calculation layer, moving compute-intensive factor math from row-by-row execution into the columnar engine for step-change throughput improvements

• Improve team efficiency by engaging with operational partners

• Drive Data Governance outcomes by integrating Data Publisher Responsibilities into precompute data creation workflows and achieving Data Health indicators for precompute artifacts

Who You Are 

• B.S., M.S., or Ph.D. in Mathematics, Statistics, or similar numerate field (or equivalent practical experience).

• Extensive background in software engineering or data platform roles, with significant experience in performance engineering under large scale and high-concurrency systems

• A hands-on engineering leader with demonstrated experience in vector-based data processing

• Experience leading global, distributed engineering teams through production system transformation

• Strong cloud data infrastructure background — AWS, Databricks, Kubernetes

• Cross-team technical influence — demonstrated ability to facilitate constructive discussions around complex technical and organisational issues and drive architectural decisions across team boundaries

• Data-driven prioritisation mindset — you build and act on usage analytics and cost/performance/accuracy tradeoffs, not just receive them

• Data Governance experience — familiarity with publisher responsibilities, data health indicators, and building governance into engineering workflows

• Finance or wealth management domain knowledge is a plus but not required

• A confident and positive outlook with low ego; high degree of ingenuity, resourcefulness, and problem-solving skills

Our Values 

• Act Like an Owner - Think and operate with intention, purpose and care. Own outcomes.

• Build Together - Collaborate to unlock the best solutions. Deliver lasting value. 

• Champion Our Clients - Exceed client expectations. Our clients’ success is our success. 

• Drive Innovation - Be bold and unconstrained in problem solving. Transform the industry. 

• Embrace Learning - Engage our community to broaden our perspective. Bring a growth mindset. 

In addition to our core values, Addepar is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We seek to bring together diverse ideas, experiences, skill sets, perspectives, backgrounds and identities to drive innovative solutions. We commit to promoting a welcoming environment where inclusion and belonging are held as a shared responsibility.

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

The imposters are creating misleading email accounts, conducting remote “interviews,” and making fake job offers in order to collect personal and financial information from unsuspecting individuals. Please be aware that no job offers will be made from Addepar without a formal interview process. Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI-powered insights within investment and client workflows. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, São Paulo, London, Edinburgh, Geneva, Warsaw, Dubai, Pune and Singapore.

The Role

Part of the broader Addepar Data organisation, you will be the primary authority on the operational administration and integrity of market data. This is a transformative leadership mandate: we are looking for an architect to take full ownership of the role, build the team, and evolve our market data operations into a best-in-class function that supports $9T+ in platform assets.

• Pipeline Supervision: Oversee daily market data pipeline workflows to ensure the timely and accurate delivery of pricing and reference data feeds.

• Data Quality Ownership: Perform internal verification checks to ensure data integrity (FX rates, corporate actions) and resolve exceptions to maintain high-quality standards.

• Compliance Framework: Maintain a Rights Management framework to monitor data implementation and usage, ensuring all derived content follows vendor terms of use.

• KPI & Metrics: Define and report on key performance indicators (KPIs) through automated dashboards to demonstrate operational health and team growth.

• The Builder Mindset: Extensive experience in financial data operations with a proven track record of leading teams and building processes from the ground up.

• Domain Authority: Comprehensive knowledge of financial instruments, benchmarks, and market data feeds, paired with a nuanced understanding of global licensing requirements.

• Regulatory Acumen: Expert knowledge of redistribution scenarios, competitor restrictions, and the legal implications of client data usage.

• Technical Proficiency: Fluent in SQL and data analysis tools to monitor feeds and troubleshoot processing exceptions.

• Analytical Precision: Exceptional attention to detail with a proven track record of managing high-stakes audits and data validations.

Sr. Software Engineer - AI/ML - AI Platform (EDI)

Edinburgh, UK

Apply
Who We Are

Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1,500 firms in 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $10 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end-to-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and levels of complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, São Paulo, London, Edinburgh, Geneva, Warsaw, Dubai, Pune and Singapore.

The Role

We are seeking a Senior AI Engineer to join our AI Platform team. The AI Platform team is focused on enabling and building disruptive, innovative solutions to transform the wealth technology landscape with AI across our product suite and is growing quickly.

As a Senior AI Engineer, you will be responsible for architecting, leading, and driving the execution of the core AI capabilities that power our platform. This is a high-impact role for an engineer who thrives on the frontier of applied AI and maintains a relentless focus on shipping. You will not just work with LLMs and agentic frameworks; you will own the end-to-end delivery of AI-native products, ensuring that cutting-edge AI systems are hardened into robust, scalable, and high-performance production systems.

Applicants must have, and maintain, the right to work in the United Kingdom from the first day of employment. Please note that visa sponsorship is not available for this role.

What You’ll Do

• Drive the end-to-end execution and delivery of AI-native products, moving from initial prototype to scalable production services with high velocity

• Architect, build, and productionize core components of our AI platform – including:

• LLMs and the surrounding ecosystem (e.g., vector DBs, prompt tuning, etc.)

• Agentic frameworks

• Core agent capabilities like MCP/ cross-platform tool use, web browsing, computer use

• Enforce technical discipline and operational excellence for all of our AI products

• Rapidly iterate on AI products based on performance metrics and user feedback to drive continuous improvement

• Lead the evaluation and adoption of new AI technologies and frameworks to keep Addepar on the frontier of the industry

• Partner with product managers and other engineering teams to translate strategic goals into technical realities, abstracting AI complexity so they can iterate quickly

Who You Are

• Extensive professional experience in backend software engineering, with expertise in programming languages/technologies like Python, Golang, gRPC, AWS, and Kubernetes

• Proven track record of owning and shipping complex, production-grade systems.

• Proven experience shipping and maintaining AI-native products or features, or demonstrable passion through significant personal projects in AI

• Deep ownership mindset, seeing projects through to completion and raising the bar for execution across the team

• A strong bias for action, with a passion for shipping rapidly and iterating with feedback

• BS/MS in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or another quantitative field, or equivalent experience

• [Preferred] Specific experience with LLMs and agentic systems

• [Preferred] Hands-on experience with technologies in the modern AI/LLM ecosystem, such as Databricks, Langchain, or MLFlow

• [Preferred] Advanced understanding of the probabilistic systems underpinning modern LLMs

• [Preferred] Experience building AI products in highly accuracy-sensitive domains such as finance is a plus

Our Values 

• Act Like an Owner - Think and operate with intention, purpose and care. Own outcomes.

• Build Together - Collaborate to unlock the best solutions. Deliver lasting value. 

• Champion Our Clients - Exceed client expectations. Our clients’ success is our success. 

• Drive Innovation - Be bold and unconstrained in problem solving. Transform the industry. 

• Embrace Learning - Engage our community to broaden our perspective. Bring a growth mindset. 

In addition to our core values, Addepar is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We seek to bring together diverse ideas, experiences, skill sets, perspectives, backgrounds and identities to drive innovative solutions. We commit to promoting a welcoming environment where inclusion and belonging are held as a shared responsibility.

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

PHISHING SCAM WARNING: Addepar is among several companies recently made aware of a phishing scam involving con artists posing as hiring managers recruiting via email, text and social media. The imposters are creating misleading email accounts, conducting remote “interviews,” and making fake job offers in order to collect personal and financial information from unsuspecting individuals. Please be aware that no job offers will be made from Addepar without a formal interview process. Additionally, Addepar will not ask you to purchase equipment or supplies as part of your onboarding process. If you have any questions, please reach out to ta-operations@addepar.com.

Who We Are

Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1,500 firms in 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $10 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end-to-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and levels of complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, São Paulo, London, Edinburgh, Geneva, Warsaw, Dubai, Pune and Singapore.

The Role

The Applied AI team works embedded with Addepar's strategic clients to figure out where AI can change how they work and then build those capabilities from scratch. You'll spend time understanding a client's world, identify what's worth building, prototype it, prove it works, and then partner with core engineering teams to ship it as product for all customers.

As an Applied AI Engineer, you'll build agentic systems from idea through production. The work starts with understanding the problem well enough to know what to build, then moves fast through prototyping and iteration. You'll design agent behavior, wire up tool integrations, tune evaluations until the AI actually works in practice. You'll sit close to the people who use what you build, and that feedback loop is how both the product and your skills grow fast. The team is new. Your work shapes what we ship.

This role may require occasional work outside standard business hours to accommodate client time zones and up to 15% travel to client sites, including occasional overnight and multi-day engagements.

Applicants must have, and maintain, the right to work in the United Kingdom from the first day of employment. Please note that visa sponsorship is not available for this role.

What You'll Do

• Build AI-powered agents and tools end-to-end: identify the problem with clients and domain experts, prototype quickly, evaluate rigorously, and ship to production

• Design and implement LLM integrations including prompt engineering, function calling, structured outputs, and retrieval-augmented workflows

• Define evaluation criteria and build test harnesses for AI systems where correctness is ambiguous and domain-specific

• Work directly with clients to understand their workflows, validate AI behavior, and iterate toward production quality

• Partner with core engineering teams to generalize client-specific work into product features

• Contribute to shared AI infrastructure (agent frameworks, tool integrations, deployment pipelines)

• Monitor and maintain production AI systems with attention to reliability, cost, and performance

Who You Are

• Extensive professional software engineering experience

• Professional experience with Python (the team's primary language)

• Experience working with LLM APIs (Claude, GPT, or similar) including function calling and structured outputs

• Comfort with SQL for data exploration and building data-grounded AI workflows

• Experience with AI-assisted development tools (Claude Code, Codex, or similar)

• You've built something from zero to one. You're drawn to figuring out what to build, not just building what's specified.

• A bias for action. You ship quickly, learn from feedback, and iterate.

• You see projects through from prototype to production and care about what the client experiences, not what the code does

• BS/MS in Computer Science, Mathematics, or another quantitative field, or equivalent experience

Nice to Have

• Experience building agentic systems (multi-step tool use, agent orchestration, durable workflows)

• Experience with additional backend languages (Java is valuable in our environment)

• Familiarity with financial data (portfolios, transactions, securities, accounting)

• Exposure to cloud infrastructure (AWS) and container-based deployments

• Experience with evaluation frameworks or methodologies for measuring AI system quality

• Act Like an Owner - Think and operate with intention, purpose and care. Own outcomes.

• Build Together - Collaborate to unlock the best solutions. Deliver lasting value. 

• Champion Our Clients - Exceed client expectations. Our clients’ success is our success. 

• Drive Innovation - Be bold and unconstrained in problem solving. Transform the industry. 

• Embrace Learning - Engage our community to broaden our perspective. Bring a growth mindset.

Who We Are

Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1,500 firms in 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $10 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end-to-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and levels of complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, São Paulo, London, Edinburgh, Geneva, Warsaw, Dubai, Pune and Singapore.

The Role

The Applied AI team works embedded with Addepar's strategic clients to figure out where AI can change how they work and then build those capabilities from scratch. You'll spend time understanding a client's world, identify what's worth building, prototype it, prove it works, and then partner with core engineering teams to ship it as product for all customers.

As an Applied AI Engineer, you'll build agentic systems from idea through production. The work starts with understanding the problem well enough to know what to build, then moves fast through prototyping and iteration. You'll design agent behavior, wire up tool integrations, tune evaluations until the AI actually works in practice. You'll sit close to the people who use what you build, and that feedback loop is how both the product and your skills grow fast. The team is new. Your work shapes what we ship.

This role may require occasional work outside standard business hours to accommodate client time zones and up to 15% travel to client sites, including occasional overnight and multi-day engagements.

What You'll Do

• Build AI-powered agents and tools end-to-end: identify the problem with clients and domain experts, prototype quickly, evaluate rigorously, and ship to production

• Design and implement LLM integrations including prompt engineering, function calling, structured outputs, and retrieval-augmented workflows

• Define evaluation criteria and build test harnesses for AI systems where correctness is ambiguous and domain-specific

• Work directly with clients to understand their workflows, validate AI behavior, and iterate toward production quality

• Partner with core engineering teams to generalize client-specific work into product features

• Contribute to shared AI infrastructure (agent frameworks, tool integrations, deployment pipelines)

• Monitor and maintain production AI systems with attention to reliability, cost, and performance

Who You Are

• Extensive professional software engineering experience

• Professional experience with Python (the team's primary language)

• Experience working with LLM APIs (Claude, GPT, or similar) including function calling and structured outputs

• Comfort with SQL for data exploration and building data-grounded AI workflows

• Experience with AI-assisted development tools (Claude Code, Codex, or similar)

• You've built something from zero to one. You're drawn to figuring out what to build, not just building what's specified.

• A bias for action. You ship quickly, learn from feedback, and iterate.

• You see projects through from prototype to production and care about what the client experiences, not what the code does

• BS/MS in Computer Science, Mathematics, or another quantitative field, or equivalent experience

Nice to Have

• Experience building agentic systems (multi-step tool use, agent orchestration, durable workflows)

• Experience with additional backend languages (Java is valuable in our environment)

• Familiarity with financial data (portfolios, transactions, securities, accounting)

• Exposure to cloud infrastructure (AWS) and container-based deployments

• Experience with evaluation frameworks or methodologies for measuring AI system quality

Our Values 

• Act Like an Owner - Think and operate with intention, purpose and care. Own outcomes.

• Build Together - Collaborate to unlock the best solutions. Deliver lasting value. 

• Champion Our Clients - Exceed client expectations. Our clients’ success is our success. 

• Drive Innovation - Be bold and unconstrained in problem solving. Transform the industry. 

• Embrace Learning - Engage our community to broaden our perspective. Bring a growth mindset. 

In addition to our core values, Addepar is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We seek to bring together diverse ideas, experiences, skill sets, perspectives, backgrounds and identities to drive innovative solutions. We commit to promoting a welcoming environment where inclusion and belonging are held as a shared responsibility.

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

PHISHING SCAM WARNING: Addepar is among several companies recently made aware of a phishing scam involving con artists posing as hiring managers recruiting via email, text and social media. The imposters are creating misleading email accounts, conducting remote “interviews,” and making fake job offers in order to collect personal and financial information from unsuspecting individuals. Please be aware that no job offers will be made from Addepar without a formal interview process. Additionally, Addepar will not ask you to purchase equipment or supplies as part of your onboarding process. If you have any questions, please reach out to ta-operations@addepar.com.

1. Introduction

1.1 In this Data Privacy Notice the terms the "Company", "we", "us" and "our" are references to Addepar UK Ltd., company number 13162730, having a registered address at Clifton House, Bunnian Place, Basingstoke, Hampshire, United Kingdom, RG21 7JE. 1.4 We take your data protection rights and our legal obligations seriously. Your personal data will be treated in a secure and confidential manner and only as set out below or otherwise notified to you in writing. 

1.5 Please read the following carefully to understand our views and practices regarding your personal data and how we treat it. The following Data Privacy Notice describes the categories of personal data we may process, how your personal data may be processed, for what purposes we process your data and how your privacy is safeguarded in the course of our relationship with you. It is intended to comply with our obligations to provide you with information about the Company's processing of your personal data under privacy laws. It does not form part of a contract of employment or engagement. 

1.6 If you have any questions about this Data Privacy Notice please contact privacy@addepar.com.

2. Responsibility for data privacy

2.1 The contact details of each of the Company's data controllers and, where applicable their representatives and relevant data protection contact, are Addepar UK Ltd. & Addepar, Inc., each of which can be reached at privacy@addepar.com.

2.2 If you have any questions regarding the processing of your personal data or if you believe your privacy rights have been violated, please contact Addepar’s People Team at people@addepar.com or privacy@addepar.com. 

3. What data do we process?

3.1 We collect various types of personal data about you for the purposes described in this Data Privacy Notice including:

(a) personal details: your title and name, birth name, preferred name, any additional names, gender, home contact details (e.g., address, telephone or mobile number, e‑mail), immigration and eligibility to work information, languages spoken, details of any disability and any reasonable adjustments required as a result;

(b) recruitment and selection data: skills and experience, qualifications, references, CV and application, record of interview, interview notes and assessment, vetting and verification information (e.g. results of credit reference check, financial sanction check and a basic disclosure criminal record check relating to unspent convictions where carried out and permitted by applicable law), right to work verification, information related to the outcome of your application, details of any offer made to you;

(c) equality and diversity data: where permitted by law and provided voluntarily, data regarding gender, race, nationality, and sexuality (stored anonymously for equal opportunities monitoring purposes); and

(d) any other personal data which you choose to disclose to Company personnel during the course of the application process whether verbally or in written form (for example in work emails).

3.2 Certain additional information will sometimes be collected where this is necessary and permitted by local applicable laws.

3.3 Some of the information collected by the Company and described above constitutes special category personal data. Special category personal data includes information relating to racial or ethnic origin, political opinions, religious or philosophical beliefs, health, trade union membership, sex life or sexual orientation, biometric or genetic information, and information relating to criminal records, offences or proceedings. The Company only collects personal data when permitted or required to do so by law, in circumstances described below.

4. How does the Company collect data?

4.1 The Company collects and records your personal data from a variety of sources, but mainly directly from you or from our service providers that handle applications on our behalf, such as Greenhouse. You will usually provide this information directly to us through your participation in the recruitment process, or you will provide it to our service providers, such as Greenhouse. 

4.2 We also obtain some information from third parties: for example, references from a previous employer, recruitment agencies or where we employ a third party to carry out a background check (where permitted by applicable law). 

4.3 Where we ask you to provide personal data to us on a mandatory basis, we will inform you of this at the time of collection. Failure to provide any mandatory information may mean that we cannot carry out our recruitment process. 

4.4 Apart from personal data relating to you, you may also provide the Company with personal data of third parties, such as contact information of individuals listed as referees in your application. Before you provide such third party personal data to the Company you must first inform these third parties of any such data which you intend to provide to the Company and of the processing to be carried out by the Company, as detailed in this Data Privacy Notice.

5. What are the purposes for which data are processed?

5.1 Your personal data are collected and processed for business purposes in accordance with applicable laws.

5.2 We collect and process your personal data for purposes including:

(a) recruitment and selection including:

(i) to assess your suitability to work for us including short listing, agreements and interviews;

(ii) to conduct pre‑employment checks including verification of your identity, checking your legal right to work and checking references;

(iii) to conduct a pre‑employment reference check, financial sanction check and a check in relation to suspect criminal activities in order to prevent crime and other unlawful acts and to protect the business and clients in the financial services industry from the risk of dishonesty, malpractice or improper conduct;

(iv) to compare you with other applicants and make a decision whether to offer you employment;

(v) to consider any reasonable adjustments either for the recruitment process or if you were to commence employment with us in the event you have a disability;

(vi) to make a job offer and provide a contract of employment;

(vii) to prepare to bring you on board as an employee where you accept an offer of employment from us. In this case we will customise to make sense of the information gathered during recruitment for the purpose of your employment and will transfer some of this to our employment systems and files;

(viii) to contact you if you are not successful should another potentially suitable vacancy arise during the six months following the completion of the recruitment process for the role you applied for; and

(ix) to deal with any query, challenge or request for feedback received in relation to our recruitment decision;

(b) protecting the private, confidential and proprietary information of the Company, its employees, its clients and third parties;

(c) monitoring programmes to ensure equality of opportunity and diversity with regard to personal characteristics protected under applicable anti‑discrimination laws;

(d) to enforce our legal rights and obligations, and for any purposes in connection with any legal claims made by, against or otherwise involving you;

(e) to comply with lawful requests by public authorities (including without limitation to meet national security or law enforcement requirements), discovery requests, or where otherwise required or permitted by applicable laws, court orders, government regulations, or regulatory authorities (including without limitation data protection, tax and employment), whether within or outside your country; and

(f) for other purposes permitted by applicable laws, including legitimate interests pursued by the Company where these are not overridden by the interests or fundamental rights and freedoms of applicants and where these have been explained to you before the relevant data is collected or the processing is carried out.

5.3 Special categories of data may be collected and processed by the Company for the following purposes:

(b) your racial or ethnic origin, sexual orientation or disability status may be used for the collection of statistical data subject to local laws, or where required to record such characteristics to comply with equality and diversity requirements of applicable local legislation or to keep the Company's commitment to equal opportunity under review.

5.4 Additional information regarding specific processing of personal data may be notified to you.

6. Legal bases for processing

6.1 Personal data

(a) Whenever the Company processes your personal data we do so on the basis of a lawful condition for processing. Processing of special categories of data is always justified on the basis of an additional lawful condition as described in section 6.2 below.

(b) In the majority of cases, the processing of your personal data will be justified on one of the following bases:

(i) we will process your data where the processing is necessary for the performance of a contract to which you are a party or in order to take steps at your request prior to entering into such a contract; or

(ii) where the above grounds do not apply we may process your personal data where the processing is necessary for the legitimate interests pursued by the Company (being those purposes described in the section above), except where such interests are overridden by your interests or fundamental rights and freedoms which require protection of personal data.

6.2 Special categories of data

(a) The special categories of personal data that may be processed by the Company are set out in this Data Privacy Notice. Where we process special categories of data it will be justified by a condition set out at paragraph 6.1(b) above and also by one of the following additional conditions:

(i) the processing is necessary for the purposes of carrying out the obligations and exercising the rights of you or the Company in the field of employment law, social security and social protection law, to the extent permissible under applicable laws;

(ii) the processing is necessary for the purposes of preventive or occupational medicine, for the assessment of your working capacity, medical diagnosis, the provision of health or social care or treatment or the management of health or social care systems and services, to the extent permitted by applicable laws;

(iii) the processing is necessary to protect your vital interests or of another person where you are physically or legally incapable of giving consent (for example in exceptional emergency situations, such as a medical emergency);

(iv) the processing is necessary for purposes authorised by applicable law. This includes:

(A) where the processing is necessary for the purposes of identifying or keeping under review the existence or absence of equality of opportunity or treatment; and

(B) where the processing is necessary for complying with regulatory requirements that involve taking steps to determine whether an individual has committed an unlawful act or has been involved in dishonesty, malpractice or other serious misconduct.

(v) the processing is necessary for the establishment, exercise or defence of legal claims.

6.3 Processing data relating to criminal convictions and offences

• 
Personal data relating to criminal convictions and offences will only be processed where authorised by applicable laws. For example, a criminal record check may be carried out on recruitment.

7. Retention of personal data

7.1 The Company retains personal data for as long as is required to satisfy the purpose for which it was collected by us or provided by you. This will usually be the period of the application process. We may keep some specific types of data, for example, your CV, for longer where we have a legitimate business reason to do so, such as to contact you for future opportunities. 

8. Disclosures of personal data

8.1 We share your personal data with Addepar, Inc., its affiliates and any of their employees where it is necessary to do so for any of the purposes described in this Privacy Notice.

8.2 The Company also shares personal data with service providers that perform services on our behalf, such as our recruitment platform provider, Greenhouse; background and education verification agencies; HR and recruitment service providers; accounting, payment and expense reimbursement providers; travel providers; and electronic signature providers. In accordance with applicable law, we have entered into legally binding agreements requiring our service providers to use and disclose personal data only as necessary to perform services on our behalf or to comply with applicable legal requirements.

8.3 In addition, we may disclose personal data about you (a) if we are required or permitted to do so by law or legal process, for example due to a court order or a request from a law enforcement agency, (b) when we believe disclosure is necessary or appropriate to prevent physical harm or financial loss, (c) in connection with an investigation of suspected or actual fraudulent or other illegal activity, and (d) in the event we sell or transfer all or a portion of our business or assets (including in the event of a reorganization, dissolution, or liquidation).

(a) The country to which the personal data will be transferred has been recognised as providing an adequate level of protection for personal data; or

(b) We have put in place appropriate safeguards in respect of the transfer, for example the controller to controller or controller to processor Standard Contractual Clauses.

10.5 You may request a copy of the safeguards that we have put in place in respect of transfer of personal data by contacting privacy@addepar.com.

11. Your rights as a data subject

11.1 Subject to applicable law, you may have the right to request:

(a) confirmation of whether we process personal data relating to you and, if so, to request a copy of that personal data;

(b) that we rectify or update your personal data that is inaccurate, incomplete or outdated;

(c) that we cease to process certain personal data where you object to its use and we do not have an overriding legitimate interest in carrying out the processing and it is not necessary for the establishment, exercise or defence of legal claims;

(g) that we provide a copy of your personal data to you in a structured, commonly used and machine readable format in certain circumstances.

Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. We are currently seeking a Staff Software Engineer with AI/ML background to join our Reference Data team.

The reference data team at Addepar is responsible to manage the data reconciliation and curation process for market data providers to build a single source of truth and provide alignment across public and alternative investment data products for the client to manage their investment portfolio.

• Extensive software engineering experience

• Proven track record of owning and shipping complex, production-grade systems.

• Deep ownership mindset, seeing projects through to completion and raising the bar for execution across the team

• A strong bias for action, with a passion for shipping rapidly and iterating with feedback

• [Preferred] Specific experience with LLMs and agentic systems

• [Preferred] Hands-on experience with technologies in the modern AI/LLM ecosystem, such as Databricks, Langchain, or MLFlow

(d) any other personal data which you choose to disclose to Company personnel during the course of the application process whether verbally or in written form (for example in work emails).

3.2 Certain additional information will sometimes be collected where this is necessary and permitted by local applicable laws.

3.3 Some of the information collected by the Company and described above constitutes special category personal data. Special category personal data includes information relating to racial or ethnic origin, political opinions, religious or philosophical beliefs, health, trade union membership, sex life or sexual orientation, biometric or genetic information, and information relating to criminal records, offences or proceedings. The Company only collects personal data when permitted or required to do so by law, in circumstances described below.

4.1 The Company collects and records your personal data from a variety of sources, but mainly directly from you or from our service providers that handle applications on our behalf, such as Greenhouse. You will usually provide this information directly to us through your participation in the recruitment process, or you will provide it to our service providers, such as Greenhouse. 

4.2 We also obtain some information from third parties: for example, references from a previous employer, recruitment agencies or where we employ a third party to carry out a background check (where permitted by applicable law). 

4.3 Where we ask you to provide personal data to us on a mandatory basis, we will inform you of this at the time of collection. Failure to provide any mandatory information may mean that we cannot carry out our recruitment process. 

4.4 Apart from personal data relating to you, you may also provide the Company with personal data of third parties, such as contact information of individuals listed as referees in your application. Before you provide such third party personal data to the Company you must first inform these third parties of any such data which you intend to provide to the Company and of the processing to be carried out by the Company, as detailed in this Data Privacy Notice.

5.1 Your personal data are collected and processed for business purposes in accordance with applicable laws.

(a) recruitment and selection including:

(i) to assess your suitability to work for us including short listing, agreements and interviews;

(ii) to conduct pre‑employment checks including verification of your identity, checking your legal right to work and checking references;

(iii) to conduct a pre‑employment reference check, financial sanction check and a check in relation to suspect criminal activities in order to prevent crime and other unlawful acts and to protect the business and clients in the financial services industry from the risk of dishonesty, malpractice or improper conduct;

(iv) to compare you with other applicants and make a decision whether to offer you employment;

(v) to consider any reasonable adjustments either for the recruitment process or if you were to commence employment with us in the event you have a disability;

(vi) to make a job offer and provide a contract of employment;

(vii) to prepare to bring you on board as an employee where you accept an offer of employment from us. In this case we will customise to make sense of the information gathered during recruitment for the purpose of your employment and will transfer some of this to our employment systems and files;

(viii) to contact you if you are not successful should another potentially suitable vacancy arise during the six months following the completion of the recruitment process for the role you applied for; and

(ix) to deal with any query, challenge or request for feedback received in relation to our recruitment decision;

(b) protecting the private, confidential and proprietary information of the Company, its employees, its clients and third parties;

(c) monitoring programmes to ensure equality of opportunity and diversity with regard to personal characteristics protected under applicable anti‑discrimination laws;

(d) to enforce our legal rights and obligations, and for any purposes in connection with any legal claims made by, against or otherwise involving you;

(e) to comply with lawful requests by public authorities (including without limitation to meet national security or law enforcement requirements), discovery requests, or where otherwise required or permitted by applicable laws, court orders, government regulations, or regulatory authorities (including without limitation data protection, tax and employment), whether within or outside your country; and

(f) for other purposes permitted by applicable laws, including legitimate interests pursued by the Company where these are not overridden by the interests or fundamental rights and freedoms of applicants and where these have been explained to you before the relevant data is collected or the processing is carried out.

(a) documentation such as work permits, details of residency, proof of citizenship will be processed to assess and review eligibility to work for the Company in the jurisdiction in which you work; and

(b) your racial or ethnic origin, sexual orientation or disability status may be used for the collection of statistical data subject to local laws, or where required to record such characteristics to comply with equality and diversity requirements of applicable local legislation or to keep the Company's commitment to equal opportunity under review.

5.4 Additional information regarding specific processing of personal data may be notified to you.

6. Legal bases for processing

6.1 Personal data

(a) Whenever the Company processes your personal data we do so on the basis of a lawful condition for processing. Processing of special categories of data is always justified on the basis of an additional lawful condition as described in section 6.2 below.

(b) In the majority of cases, the processing of your personal data will be justified on one of the following bases:

(i) we will process your data where the processing is necessary for the performance of a contract to which you are a party or in order to take steps at your request prior to entering into such a contract; or

(ii) where the above grounds do not apply we may process your personal data where the processing is necessary for the legitimate interests pursued by the Company (being those purposes described in the section above), except where such interests are overridden by your interests or fundamental rights and freedoms which require protection of personal data.

6.2 Special categories of data

(a) The special categories of personal data that may be processed by the Company are set out in this Data Privacy Notice. Where we process special categories of data it will be justified by a condition set out at paragraph 6.1(b) above and also by one of the following additional conditions:

(i) the processing is necessary for the purposes of carrying out the obligations and exercising the rights of you or the Company in the field of employment law, social security and social protection law, to the extent permissible under applicable laws;

(ii) the processing is necessary for the purposes of preventive or occupational medicine, for the assessment of your working capacity, medical diagnosis, the provision of health or social care or treatment or the management of health or social care systems and services, to the extent permitted by applicable laws;

(iii) the processing is necessary to protect your vital interests or of another person where you are physically or legally incapable of giving consent (for example in exceptional emergency situations, such as a medical emergency);

(iv) the processing is necessary for purposes authorised by applicable law. This includes:

(A) where the processing is necessary for the purposes of identifying or keeping under review the existence or absence of equality of opportunity or treatment; and

(B) where the processing is necessary for complying with regulatory requirements that involve taking steps to determine whether an individual has committed an unlawful act or has been involved in dishonesty, malpractice or other serious misconduct.

(v) the processing is necessary for the establishment, exercise or defence of legal claims.

6.3 Processing data relating to criminal convictions and offences

• 
Personal data relating to criminal convictions and offences will only be processed where authorised by applicable laws. For example, a criminal record check may be carried out on recruitment.

7. Retention of personal data

7.1 The Company retains personal data for as long as is required to satisfy the purpose for which it was collected by us or provided by you. 8. Disclosures of personal data

8.1 We share your personal data with Addepar, Inc., its affiliates and any of their employees where it is necessary to do so for any of the purposes described in this Privacy Notice.

8.2 The Company also shares personal data with service providers that perform services on our behalf, such as our recruitment platform provider, Greenhouse; background and education verification agencies; HR and recruitment service providers; accounting, payment and expense reimbursement providers; travel providers; and electronic signature providers. In accordance with applicable law, we have entered into legally binding agreements requiring our service providers to use and disclose personal data only as necessary to perform services on our behalf or to comply with applicable legal requirements.

8.3 In addition, we may disclose personal data about you (a) if we are required or permitted to do so by law or legal process, for example due to a court order or a request from a law enforcement agency, (b) when we believe disclosure is necessary or appropriate to prevent physical harm or financial loss, (c) in connection with an investigation of suspected or actual fraudulent or other illegal activity, and (d) in the event we sell or transfer all or a portion of our business or assets (including in the event of a reorganization, dissolution, or liquidation).

9. Security of data

9.1 The Company is committed to protecting the security of the personal data you share with us. In support of this commitment, we have implemented appropriate technical, physical and organisational measures to ensure a level of security appropriate to the risk. The Company uses a variety of technical and organisational methods to secure your personal data in accordance with applicable laws.

10. INTERNATIONAL Transfer of Personal Data

10.1 From time to time your personal data (including special categories of personal data) will be transferred to associated companies of the Company to process for the purposes described in this Data Privacy Notice. This will be applicable for example where the relevant company or a manager from that company is responsible for conducting or approving the relevant process or the data is part of a global directory where other individuals need to have access. These associated companies or managers are located elsewhere in the world (for example, Addepar, Inc. located in the United States or Addepar Canada, Inc. located in Canada). 

10.2 Personal data may also be transferred to third parties (e.g. service providers, such as Greenhouse, as set out above), who may have systems or suppliers located outside the European Union. 

10.3 As a result, in some circumstances your personal data will be transferred to countries outside of the UK whose data protection laws may be less stringent than in the UK. 

10.4 In such, cases, the Company will comply with applicable legal requirements and will only transfer your personal data if:

(a) The country to which the personal data will be transferred has been recognised as providing an adequate level of protection for personal data; or

(b) We have put in place appropriate safeguards in respect of the transfer, for example the controller to controller or controller to processor Standard Contractual Clauses.

(b) that we rectify or update your personal data that is inaccurate, incomplete or outdated;

(c) that we cease to process certain personal data where you object to its use and we do not have an overriding legitimate interest in carrying out the processing and it is not necessary for the establishment, exercise or defence of legal claims;

(d) that we erase your personal data in certain circumstances, such as where we collected personal data on the basis of your consent and you withdraw that consent, or when you object to use of your personal data;

(e) that we restrict the use of your personal data in certain circumstances, such as while we consider another request that you have submitted, for example a request that we update your personal data;

(f) withdrawal of your consent where you have given us consent to process your personal data; and

(g) that we provide a copy of your personal data to you in a structured, commonly used and machine readable format in certain circumstances.

12.2 Should we change our approach to data protection, you will be informed of these changes or made aware that we have updated the Data Privacy Notice so that you know which information we process and how we use this information. 

12.3 This Data Privacy Notice was last updated and reviewed on September 25, 2023.

Staff Software Engineer, Alts Data Management

Edinburgh, UK

Apply
Who We Are

Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1,500 firms in 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $10 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end-to-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and levels of complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, São Paulo, London, Edinburgh, Geneva, Warsaw, Dubai, Pune and Singapore.

The Role

We are currently seeking a staff software engineer to join the Alternatives Data Management (ADM) team. Our team is building AI-powered data products and workflow solutions that unlock transparency, efficiency, and insight in private market investments. You’ll join a talented full-stack team of engineers and work on distributed services that are used across the entire ADM engineering stack.

Applicants must have, and maintain, the right to work in the United Kingdom from the first day of employment. Please note that visa sponsorship is not available for this role.

What You’ll Do

• Own the end-to-end delivery of complex, multi-month initiatives within ADM, including work that spans team boundaries. Anticipate risks and unblock dependencies before they become delivery blockers.

• Lead technical designs for new products and workflow solutions, aligned with ADM and Addepar’s longer-term strategy. Solicit feedback and build consensus.

• Write exemplary, highly performant, and scalable code and frameworks.

• Evangelize and promote best engineering practices.

• Serve as a primary technical point of contact. Initiate and lead collaboration with cross-functional teams to resolve complex application and infrastructure issues.

• Mentor engineers, identify skill gaps and help shape their technical development.

• Communicate technical strategy, trade-offs, and architectural direction clearly to both engineering and non-engineering stakeholders.

Who You Are

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience

• Extensive software engineering experience

• Track record of leading technical initiatives from design through delivery

• Comfortable working independently, with a bias for action

• Strong ownership mentality and drive to solve the most important problems

• Excel at written and verbal communication

• Experience with financial services or wealth management operations

• Experience with object-oriented programming

• Experience with AWS or another cloud platform

• Experience with IaC (infrastructure as code), preferably Terraform

• Experience with gen AI for coding

Our Values 

• Act Like an Owner - Think and operate with intention, purpose and care. Own outcomes.

• Build Together - Collaborate to unlock the best solutions. Deliver lasting value. 

• Champion Our Clients - Exceed client expectations. Our clients’ success is our success. 

• Drive Innovation - Be bold and unconstrained in problem solving. Transform the industry. 

• Embrace Learning - Engage our community to broaden our perspective. Bring a growth mindset. 

In addition to our core values, Addepar is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We seek to bring together diverse ideas, experiences, skill sets, perspectives, backgrounds and identities to drive innovative solutions. We commit to promoting a welcoming environment where inclusion and belonging are held as a shared responsibility.

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

PHISHING SCAM WARNING: Addepar is among several companies recently made aware of a phishing scam involving con artists posing as hiring managers recruiting via email, text and social media. The imposters are creating misleading email accounts, conducting remote “interviews,” and making fake job offers in order to collect personal and financial information from unsuspecting individuals. Please be aware that no job offers will be made from Addepar without a formal interview process. Additionally, Addepar will not ask you to purchase equipment or supplies as part of your onboarding process. If you have any questions, please reach out to ta-operations@addepar.com.

- Leverage your Salesforce platform configuration and development expertise to meet client solution challenges in line with the Aforza solution.

Making that work and delivering results requires the right people, structure, processes, partnerships, and evolving technology enablers. At the core of this team is AIGs Global Security Operations Center (GSOC), responsible for asset monitoring, strategic threat detection & reporting, travel risk management, and incident response. This team acts as our around-the-clock eyes and ears; when a risk or crises event emerges, the GSOC provides real time intelligence and enhances our ability to proactively understand and mitigate risks, while always maintaining a network of partners and qualified response solutions when needed. - Strong communication skills—translating technical findings into clear, helpful updates.
- A commitment to security-minded working—following processes, protecting customer data and escalating concerns appropriately.

- Working through problems methodically—checking assumptions, validating outcomes, and learning from every ticket.
- Taking pride in customer experience—because the best technical solution is the one the customer understands.
- Sharing knowledge with colleagues—improving our internal support resources so fewer issues become repeated pain.
- Staying flexible—support environments move fast, and priorities can shift based on customer needs.

This is an Abingdon-based role where you’ll be part of a supportive service desk team. You’ll handle escalations, work closely with colleagues across engineering and operations, and contribute to a culture where continuous improvement isn’t just encouraged—it’s expected.

# 2. Role Purpose

The Engineering Manager is accountable for the safe, compliant and cost-effective performance of the site’s engineering, maintenance, utilities and capital-project activities. The role leads the engineering team and develops a proactive asset-management and reliability strategy that improves equipment availability, reduces operational risk and loss, controls cost and supports delivery of the plant business plan.

Working closely with Operations, Environmental Health and Safety (EHS), Quality, Finance, Procurement and other functions, the Engineering Manager ensures that engineering standards, statutory obligations, maintenance systems and capital investments are effectively governed and delivered. The role promotes Amcor’s strategy, vision, mission and core values and helps build a high-performance, continuous-improvement culture.

# 3. Scope of Responsibility

- Leadership of the site engineering and maintenance function, including team capability, resource planning, objectives and performance.
- Ownership of the site engineering, maintenance and asset-reliability strategy.
- Governance of engineering safety, compliance, statutory inspections and technical standards.
- Management of the engineering operating budget, maintenance expenditure and assigned capital investment.
- Accountability for plant, equipment, utilities, facilities and supporting infrastructure within the agreed site scope.
- Oversight of maintenance planning, scheduling, breakdown response, engineering records, critical spares and contractor activity.
- Leadership of the site engineering capital programme and delivery of assigned capital projects.

# 4. Key Accountabilities

## Safety, Compliance and Engineering Governance

- Act as a visible safety leader and ensure that safety is the first consideration in all engineering decisions and activities.
- Work with the EHS Manager and operational leaders to maintain effective engineering policies, standards, risk controls and safe systems of work.
- Ensure robust controls for isolation, permit-to-work activities, contractor management, machinery safety, engineering modifications and management of change.
- Maintain compliance with applicable statutory inspection, equipment-safety and engineering requirements, ensuring actions are recorded and closed promptly.
- Ensure engineering work, plant modifications and capital installations are appropriately assessed, authorised, documented and handed over.

## Reliability and Maintenance

- Develop and deliver a risk-based asset-management and reliability strategy aligned with plant priorities.
- Establish an effective balance of preventive, predictive, condition-based and corrective maintenance to improve equipment reliability and availability.
- Own the maintenance planning and scheduling process, including backlog control, job quality, resource allocation and schedule compliance.
- Lead structured root-cause analysis for significant or recurring failures and ensure that corrective actions prevent recurrence.
- Maintain asset criticality assessments, lifecycle plans and obsolescence strategies for key plant and infrastructure.
- Ensure that the computerised maintenance management system and engineering records are accurate, complete and used to support effective decision-making.
- Develop critical-spares and engineering-stores strategies that balance operational risk, availability and working capital.
- Partner with Operations to strengthen equipment ownership and appropriate operator-care or autonomous-maintenance routines.

## People Leadership

- Lead, coach and develop the engineering and maintenance team, setting clear standards, objectives and accountabilities.
- Manage performance, attendance, development and succession in accordance with company policies and procedures.
- Assess current and future capability needs and implement training and development plans to close identified gaps.
- Plan resources and working arrangements to provide effective maintenance coverage and appropriate escalation support.
- Create a collaborative, inclusive and high-performance culture focused on safety, reliability, problem-solving and continuous improvement.

## Capital Projects and Technical Improvement

- Develop the site capital plan, identifying investment needs associated with safety, compliance, capacity, reliability, obsolescence, energy performance and technical advancement.
- Prepare capital-expenditure approval documentation and robust business cases for assigned investments.
- Lead assigned capital projects from concept and specification through procurement, installation, commissioning, handover and benefits realisation.
- Ensure projects are delivered safely, to agreed scope, quality, budget and programme, with risks and changes actively controlled.
- Coordinate internal specialists, suppliers, contractors and vendors to deliver sustainable technical solutions.

## Cost, Utilities and Sustainability

- Prepare and manage the annual engineering budget and control departmental expenditure within agreed limits.
- Monitor maintenance cost, utilities consumption and project spend; identify trends, risks and corrective actions.
- Develop and deliver cost, waste, energy and utilities improvement initiatives that support site and business objectives.
- Ensure financial controls, purchasing requirements and contractor governance are consistently applied.

## Cross-Functional Leadership and Continuous Improvement

- Work in partnership with Operations, EHS, Quality, Finance, Procurement and other functions to deliver the plant business plan.
- Use data, structured problem-solving and operational-excellence methods to improve safety, equipment effectiveness, quality, cost and service.
- Communicate engineering priorities, risks, performance and recovery plans clearly to relevant stakeholders.
- Maintain effective relationships with external technical resources, regulators, insurers, contractors and equipment suppliers as required.

# 5. Key Performance Indicators

Performance will be assessed through an appropriate combination of:

- Engineering safety, compliance, audit and statutory-inspection performance.
- Asset availability, reliability and overall equipment effectiveness.
- Planned versus reactive maintenance and completion of preventive-maintenance activities.
- Maintenance schedule compliance, backlog health and breakdown hours.
- Mean time between failures, mean time to repair and recurrence of significant failures.
- Engineering operating cost, maintenance cost and budget performance.
- Capital-project delivery to scope, budget, programme and agreed benefits.
- Utilities consumption, energy performance and delivery of improvement initiatives.
- Engineering team capability, training completion, succession and performance.

# 6. Qualifications and Experience

## Essential

- Degree in an Engineering / Technical field
- Significant engineering and/or manufacturing experience, including leadership of a multidisciplinary engineering or maintenance team.
- Strong mechanical and/or electrical engineering knowledge with an in-depth understanding of manufacturing processes and equipment.
- Demonstrable experience of maintenance strategy, asset reliability, structured problem-solving and continuous improvement.
- Experience of managing engineering budgets, contractors and capital projects.

## Desirable

- Experience of energy management, utilities optimisation and equipment-lifecycle planning.

# 7. Skills and Leadership Behaviours

- Visible, consistent and credible safety leadership.
- Ability to set direction, translate strategy into practical plans and deliver through others.
- Strong coaching, performance-management and team-development capability.
- Decisive, evidence-based judgement with effective risk awareness.
- Strong analytical, troubleshooting and structured problem-solving skills.
- Ability to lead complex, cross-functional and large-scale projects.
- Commercial and financial awareness, including budget and investment management.
- Clear written, verbal and presentation skills, with the ability to influence at all levels.

- Collaborative, flexible and results-focused approach.
- Commitment to Amcor’s core values and leadership expectations, including driving for results, customer focus and influencing others.

Our Managed Legal Services (MLS) team is growing rapidly, and we are recruiting a Data Assistant to support legal data related activities. 

Initially the data you would be handling would simply be documents and related information that form part of a legal case, with primary focus being data extraction and secure transfer to the correct parties. 

This involves extracting, organising, preparing, and securely transferring data safely and securely between systems, whilst also engaging with both internal and external clients.You will work with data from multiple sources such as shared drives, case management systems, and email exports, ensuring it is correctly structured and suitable for delivery. 

This role would suit someone with a tenacious and resilient approach to problem solving, who enjoys and works well in a fast-paced environment. You will have exposure to hands-on work from day one and will play a key role in a thriving team who always provide a high-quality service.

• Extracting and preparing data from digital and physical data repositories 
• Organising files into clear, consistent, and logical folder structures 
• Preparing files for secure transfer to clients or third parties 
• Checking files for accuracy, completeness, and consistency 
• Uploading files to secure platforms (e.g. WeTransfer, HighQ or equivalent) 
• Transferring files securely to internal and external clients
• Maintaining logs of processed and transferred files
• Managing multiple tasks simultaneously within defined deadlines
Your key duties will be:
• Extract, compile, and export data from different systems in line with regulatory requirements and business needs.
• Transfer data securely between systems, departments, and external parties, ensuring compliance with data protection standards.
• Maintain accurate records of data transfers and ensure appropriate audit trails are in place.
• Support the preparation of regulatory submissions, reports, and filings.
• Perform data validation and quality checks to ensure accuracy and completeness.
• Assist with organising and maintaining regulatory data repositories and document management systems.
• Collaborate with Legal, Compliance, and Regulatory teams to ensure data is handled appropriately.
• Respond to internal and external data requests in a timely and professional manner.
• Identify and escalate discrepancies, errors, or risks in data handling processes.
• Contribute to continuous improvement of data processes, controls, and documentation.

Essential 
• A strong educational background, and an interest in data and the legalities around using data e.g. GDPR etc.
• Previous experience in a data support or regulatory role is desirable, but not essential. 
• Strong attention to detail and a high level of accuracy.
• Experience organising, exporting and manipulating data (e.g., Excel, databases, reporting tools).
• Strong written and verbal communication skills 
• Excellent organisational and time-management skills, with the ability to handle multiple tasks concurrently and meet deadlines under pressure. 
• Trusted to handle sensitive information with discretion 
• Can work independently and collaborate as part of a team
• Proactive with a problem-solving mindset.
• Proficiency in Microsoft 365 tools, particularly Excel (e.g. filtering, sorting, pivot tables) 
• Awareness of secure file transfer platforms (e.g. WeTransfer, HighQ or similar) 
Desirable 
• Experience with data review platforms 
• Experience in a legal, regulatory, or professional services environment 
• Familiarity with case management systems and document management platforms 
• Exposure to eDiscovery or data review platforms (e.g. Relativity, Nuix or similar) 
• Use of tools such as SharePoint, Power BI, Power Automate, or Power Apps 
• Experience working with datasets (e.g. Excel, CSV files, file systems, or database exports) 
• Exposure to supporting data-heavy processes such as DSARs, litigation support, or regulatory reviews 
• Experience with analysing and inputting legal data.

Please note - This role will be based in one of our hubs in Sheffield or Birmingham.
