• Own and manage a pipeline of large, complex opportunities with long sales cycles and multiple senior stakeholders, from first meeting through to close.

• Deliver against an individual quota for new contributors and revenue.

• Build and maintain relationships with CROs, CCOs, Heads of Credit Risk and other senior decision-makers.

• Lead discussions and negotiations with prospective contributors, navigating complex institutional requirements and approval processes.

• Support and strengthen existing contributor relationships through senior-level engagement and strategic assistance.

• Identify opportunities to generate additional revenue from existing and prospective banking relationships through new use cases or lines of business.

• Collaborate with Sales, Product and Marketing to identify new use cases, develop compelling value propositions and execute targeted initiatives that drive contributor acquisition, deepen banking relationships and expand commercial opportunities.

• Prioritise face-to-face meetings with existing and prospective contributors, including regular travel across EMEA and APAC.

• Represent Credit Benchmark at senior industry forums and contribute to broader business strategy.

What we are looking for

Essential

• Significant institutional credit risk experience, ideally gained within a major commercial or investment bank.

• Strong commercial acumen and a demonstrated ability to develop business opportunities and deliver results.

• Proven track record as a quota carrier, consistently meeting or exceeding targets.

• Experience closing large, complex commercial agreements with financial institutions, working through risk, procurement, legal and compliance approvals.

• Solid quantitative aptitude, with a good understanding of internal credit ratings, probabilities of default and credit risk models.

• Ability to engage credibly with senior credit risk executives and quantitative risk professionals.

• Demonstrable experience of developing and managing senior institutional relationships.

• Entrepreneurial mindset, strong initiative and a collaborative working style, with exceptional communication and relationship-building skills.

• Willingness to travel internationally and a proactive, hands-on approach to building relationships in person.

Desirable

• Experience working within, or alongside, a contributed data model, such as a data-pooling or consortium-based business.

• Experience managing commercial relationships with large banks.

• Experience selling and delivering data products such as datasets, APIs and data feeds.

Salary

Competitive base salary, dependent on skills and experience + generous commission scheme.

Benefits

• Holidays: Competitive holiday package.

• Health and Wellbeing: Private health insurance, including mental health cover, and a healthy work-life balance.

• Pension: Opportunity to join the company pension scheme.

• Travel: Cycle-to-work scheme.

• Family-Friendly: Supportive environment and generous paid leave for new parents.

• Learning and Development: Professional development opportunities through seminars, conferences, training courses and internal mentorship.

• Community: Supportive, collaborative and social team environment.

Our commitment to diversity, equity and inclusion

At Credit Benchmark, we are deeply committed to diversity, equity and inclusion. This means celebrating who we are as individuals and as a team because our company and culture reflect the sum of our employees.

We strive to create a mindful and respectful environment that includes fairness, kindness and understanding. We empower each other to bring our authentic selves to work and champion our colleagues’ development and achievements. Our diversity brings a multitude of perspectives and ideas and is imperative to the success of our business.

We are dedicated to ensuring that principles of diversity, equity and inclusion are rooted in Credit Benchmark’s DNA. We continue to build on these principles as our company grows while retaining the progress we have made as a team.

Credit Benchmark is proud to be an equal opportunities employer. We believe no one should be at a professional disadvantage because of their background. We do not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic and are committed to fostering a working culture that is free of discrimination and harassment.

Credit Benchmark is also committed to making reasonable adjustments for disabled applicants and employees throughout our recruitment process and employment.

job_title: Financial Controller (12 month fixed term contract)
job_description:
We are Creditspring, a new way of borrowing that focuses on its members and provides them with safe and efficient short-term financial products.
We're a fast-growing FCA-regulated consumer credit company. We have members, not customers and we take a lot of pride in that!
As one of the UK’s only subscription finance company in the market, we truly have a unique value proposition. Our mission is very clear; to improve the financial stability and resilience of our members. We do this through the products we provide, the partnerships we have, and our educational content. We want our members, and everyone in the UK to be able to better manage their finances and steer them away from high-cost, unregulated credit options.
About the role
We’re looking for an experienced Financial Controller to join us on a 12 month fixed-term contract, covering maternity leave. This is a hybrid role based in our London office.
Reporting to the CFO, you’ll lead the month end close and own technical accounting, managing a team of two: a Senior Financial Accountant and an Assistant Financial Accountant. You’ll work closely with our Treasurer on lender reporting and cash, partner with FP&A, Legal, Data and Software on project work, and share month end results and cost visibility reporting with the CEO and wider Exco.
The ideal candidate is a hands-on, ACA qualified finance leader who is as comfortable reviewing reconciliations as writing a technical memo on expected credit losses. You’ll enjoy making processes faster, clearer and more resilient.
This role is competitively paid within the advertised salary band with an additional 10% completion bonus.
Responsibilities
• Lead the month end close, including managing and coaching the team, performing and documenting review controls, and planning cover across the team.

• Own source to ledger data integrity, leading the team to maintain reconciliations and checks through data platform changes.

• Drive process improvements, including faster time to close, more frequent prepayments and accruals postings, and timely, clearly labelled results for the CEO and ExCo.

• Own technical accounting, including accounting policies, technical memos and judgement areas such as expected credit losses, effective interest, loan modifications, share based payments and compound financial instruments.

• Support lender and facility reporting with the Treasurer and CFO. This means producing and reconciling the month end data that feeds covenant calculations and lender certificates, and maintaining the bridge between management accounts and audited IFRS accounts.

• Lead the annual audit with our external auditors, including project management, producing the annual IFRS accounts and disclosures, and preparing technical memos and audit evidence.

• Strengthen controls and resilience by documenting runbooks and training a deputy for each critical finance process, so that no process depends on one person.

• Support statutory and regulatory returns and system access governance, in line with the CFO’s allocation of ownership, and act as finance representative in incident management.

• Continue to optimise our GL package (iPlicit) and finance systems, including reporting and cost visibility, with support from the CFO.

What you'll need to succeed

Essential
• ACA qualified (or equivalent) with 6+ years’ experience, including managing a team.

• Strong IFRS knowledge, ideally including expected credit loss outputs and amortised cost accounting.

• Experience working with lender covenants and facility reporting.

• Confident working with external auditors.

Desirable
• Experience in fintech or consumer lending (strongly preferred).

• Experience building finance processes from scratch.

• Experience of audit or due diligence ahead of a funding or exit event.

# Job description

# Head of Product Management (7433)

As our new Head of Product Management, you’ll lead our product management function across a portfolio of product streams, bringing clarity, consistency and momentum to how we decide what to build and why. Reporting to the IT Director, you’ll ensure each product has a clear vision, strategy and roadmap connected to organisational goals, customer needs and measurable outcomes.

Working across IT and the wider business, you’ll directly manage and develop Product Owners and QA, provide functional direction across product, analysis and user interface development, and strengthen collaboration from discovery through build, testing and release. If you’re a strategic and hands-on product leader who can bring structure to complexity, align senior stakeholders and improve how teams make decisions, we’d love to hear from you.

**Some of your key responsibilities:**

- Set product direction across the portfolio, connecting product visions and strategies to organisational goals, customer needs and measurable outcomes.
- Shape and govern evidence-led product roadmaps and portfolio priorities, balancing strategic value, customer impact, risk, technical health, dependencies and available capacity.
- Lead capacity planning and investment sequencing with the IT Director, delivery leaders and Product Owners, making demand, constraints and dependencies visible early enough to support realistic decisions.
- Manage, coach and develop the Product Owners and QA team, while providing functional leadership and consistent standards across Product Owners, Business Analysts, User Interface Developers and QA.
- Establish and improve product management frameworks, processes, artefacts and governance across discovery, strategy, prioritisation, outcome tracking, build, testing and release.
- Build alignment with the Senior Leadership Team, business functions and IT peer group, measure product health and delivery confidence, and communicate clear portfolio-level progress and decisions.

**What do I need to be successful in this role?**

- Demonstrated experience leading product management across multiple products, platforms or product streams, connecting strategy, roadmaps and delivery decisions.
- Strong experience developing product visions and strategies and translating them into clear, outcome-focused roadmaps, with the ability to lead prioritisation and capacity-planning conversations involving competing demands and uncertainty.
- Experience directly managing, coaching or developing Product Owners and QA professionals, with a practical approach to improving capability, quality and collaboration across the product lifecycle.
- Sound judgement about product governance and operating models, with a strong understanding of iterative product development, customer or user needs, delivery practices and the relationship between product and technology.
- Excellent communication and influencing skills, including the ability to build alignment with senior stakeholders, explain complex trade-offs clearly and work effectively across business and technology teams.
- Experience in a complex IT, technology or enterprise change environment, ideally including product management maturity, portfolio measures, customer-facing or internal products, platforms or services, and regulated or operationally complex settings.

**What’s in it for me?**

- A competitive salary alongside inclusion into our company bonus scheme. Our Cromwell Incentive Plan reinforces our key principle of winning as one team and sharing in our success.
- Enhanced employer pension contribution.
- Our Private Medical Insurance offers eligible team members the ability to access a broad range of treatments quickly when they need it the most.
- 22 days annual leave entitlement plus Bank Holidays – Whilst this is common amongst businesses, we also offer the opportunity to purchase an additional annual leave in case you need a couple of extra days.

Cx App Foundations is a platform organisation within our global Cx organisation. Within this organisation, the Velocity team owns the paved road for consumer app development across mobile and web: shared SDKs and client foundations, integration patterns and multi-brand customisation, migration playbooks and reference implementations, and developer tooling that makes building on shared foundations fast and safe. Our mission is to reduce the cost, time, and risk of building consumer experiences across platforms and brands. Product teams own customer-facing experiences; our job is to make sure they can spend their time on delivering delightful experiences. The team is AI-native: AI is a default part of how we design, build, and ship software.

About the Role

As the Engineering Manager, you will lead a team of experienced engineers across mobile and web, collaborating closely with product teams, design, and adjacent platform organisations across three brands. Your primary responsibility will be owning the team's roadmap and delivery of shared client foundations, and driving their adoption across the organisation, so that product teams ship delightful customer experiences without rebuilding the foundations under them. • Set support conversation strategy across support journeys, connecting what people need in the moment, what the business can promise, and what operations can actually do. • Design and maintain conversation flows. Lead proactive guidance, chat and voice experiences from definition through launch, anticipating needs to prevent or resolve problems before people ask for help. Create and maintain multi-turn conversation specs covering context, interruptions, changing intent, clarification, error recovery, fallback paths and human handoffs without repetition.

• Prototype new conversational experiences. Invent and test new conversational patterns, interaction paradigms, personas, and support experiences. Use LLMs and code to explore how people could ask for help, act on options and move between chat, voice and other interfaces. Work with Engineering to shape the information, actions, and human judgement these experiences need, using working prototypes and user feedback to decide what to pursue.

• Shape voice, tone and behaviour. Set the editorial direction for support conversations across brands, markets and modalities. Write and iterate on system prompts and persona definitions that express this direction through model behaviour. Make deliberate choices about wording, pacing and tone, adapting to local voices, policies and access needs while keeping conversations useful and promises accurate.

• Build evaluation datasets and testing plans. Establish how teams evaluate conversation quality before and after launch. Create evaluation datasets, testing plans and scoring rubrics to test conversation flows and model behaviour. Define annotation guidelines and annotate conversations for evaluation and model training, calibrating judgments so teams assess quality consistently. Combine these evaluations with research, performance data and reviews of hundreds of transcripts to improve accuracy, resolution quality and customer effort, and influence what the team prioritises.

• Design conversational safeguards. Identify conversational risks and define, implement and test guardrails. Address hallucinations, harmful or biased responses, and requests outside the service’s scope. Define how conversations protect sensitive information, stay within the system’s authority to act, and acknowledge uncertainty or seek human judgement.

• Raise conversation design capability. Help the wider Studio develop technical fluency and conversational judgement through mentorship, education and shared tools. Build reusable prompt guidance, evaluation tools and working practices with design and cross-functional peers, and lead their adoption across teams to improve conversation quality and inform product priorities.

What You’ll Need to Thrive

• Work samples. Work samples showing strong editorial and conversational judgement, whether through conversational systems, content programmes or shipped products. • Strategic leadership. Experience setting direction across teams and influencing product priorities, with examples of resolving ambiguity and making trade-offs between user needs, commercial goals and technical constraints.

• Editorial judgement. A strong editorial point of view, backed by excellent writing and editing. You can explain why a conversation needs a particular message, sequence or tone, cut what gets in the way and give others specific feedback that improves the work. Your background may be in editorial, content design, linguistics, product design or another discipline; what matters is how you apply that judgement to interactive experiences.

• Evaluation and training experience. Experience developing conversation evaluations and annotating model-training data, with evidence of how qualitative and quantitative findings improved model behaviour and informed product decisions.

The Platform Core team owns and operates the AWS cloud environment the business relies on. The team sets the paved paths for Terraform and IaC (infrastructure as code), CI/CD, Edge using Cloudflare and the VPN running on Appgate. 

As an engineer on this team, you’ll be working on building for scale at a rapid pace, while driving improvements that help the wider engineering organisation ship faster and safer. You'll move fast, make real architectural decisions, and have genuine ownership. This isn't a ticket-closing role - you'll shape how we build and operate our platform.

Day to day, that means managing our infrastructure, helping other engineers move fast and self-serve, working on an ever-evolving threat on our CDN, and ensuring system health. You'd be hands-on with infrastructure-as-code, Cloudflare services, automation languages (python, golang), whilst also thinking about how your work reduces friction for the engineers who depend on the platform every day, and using various AI tools to move fast. 

The role blends deep infrastructure expertise with a product mindset - the team's "customers" are internal engineers, and success is measured by pipeline reliability, deployment speed, and developer sentiment, not just uptime.

• Empower and Mentor Developers: Empower developers to take ownership of the operation, performance, and availability of our services, providing guidance and mentorship as needed.
• Innovative Software Solutions: Design, write, and deliver software that enhances the lives of our engineers, improves scalability, and drives platform innovation.
• Cloud Infrastructure Excellence: Define, secure, and optimize the cloud infrastructure that supports our platform, ensuring high availability and performance.
• On-Call Participation: Take part in our on-call rota, providing critical support and ensuring service reliability.
• Edge Security Posture: Define, drive and build a strong edge networking posture for our domains. 
• Continuous Improvement: Drive a culture of continuous improvement—measure, automate, and iterate on processes and systems.
• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with cross-functional teams, including developers, platform engineers, and security experts, to align infrastructure with company goals and support seamless development and deployment of applications.
• Security and Compliance: Adhere to and promote security best practices and compliance standards across all infrastructure and processes.

• Experience with Cloud, (AWS preferred) with defining, securing, and optimising cloud infrastructure that supports our platform, ensuring high availability and performance.

• Partner with data platform engineers to integrate observability at every layer - ingestion, transformation, and consumption.

• Lead GDPR and privacy-by-design initiatives, ensuring compliance and traceability across all datasets.

• Define standards for metadata management, lineage tracking, and access control.

• Collaborate with analytics and product teams to ensure data definitions and quality metrics are consistent across domains.

• Mentor engineers and analysts, fostering a culture of data stewardship and accountability.

• Continuously improve data governance maturity through automation, documentation, and measurable quality KPIs.

• Deep knowledge of data observability frameworks (Monte Carlo, Soda, or equivalent) and data validation tools (Great Expectations, DBT tests, etc.).

• Deep understanding of data-as-a-product principles and experience applying them to improve data reliability and ownership.

• Experience designing and enforcing data contracts and quality SLAs in distributed data ecosystems.

• Proficiency in Python, Java, or Scala, and experience building pipelines with Databricks, Spark, or Kafka.

• Strong understanding of data governance principles, privacy regulations (GDPR, CCPA), and secure data handling practices.

• Experience leading projects and mentoring engineers or scientists, with a track record of fostering team growth and technical excellence.

• Excellent communication skills: able to bridge technical and non-technical stakeholders and influence decision making.

job_description:
About us

We are Digital Science and we are advancing the research ecosystem. 
We are a pioneering technology company, and our vision is of a future where a trusted and collaborative research ecosystem drives progress for all. We believe in better, open, collaborative and inclusive research. In creating the next generation of tools and working in partnership with the community we tackle some of the biggest challenges to research. In order to achieve our vision, we need innovative, inspiring and dynamic people to join our team. Want to join us?

Your new role 

Digital Science is dedicated to putting customers at the heart of everything we do. Our portfolio spans products at different stages of maturity — from Overleaf, our widely used scientific and technical writing platform that serves over 30 million researchers, students, and institutions worldwide, to Papers AI, one of our newest research software products, which launched on July 29, 2026 and is growing quickly. Our goal is to provide exceptional support, empower users through self-service resources, and continuously improve the experience across both products.

The Customer Support Specialist role is the connective tissue between two products within Digital Science: Overleaf, our mature, widely-used scientific and technical writing platform built around LaTeX and collaborative authoring, and Papers AI, our newest AI-powered research and writing
tool. You'll deliver hands-on, empathetic support to Overleaf's global base of researchers and institutions, and to Papers AI's early adopters, still shaping its support experience as it grows.

Please note - due to business need, we can only accept applications from candidates who reside in the UK where we have an established legal entity.

If you apply from outside of this area, your application will not be considered.

Please be aware that we may close this position early if we receive a high volume of applications, so we encourage you to apply promptly.

• Provide timely, professional, and empathetic email-based support to B2C and B2B users of both Overleaf and Papers AI.
• Handle billing inquiries for both products (e.g., Stripe-based subscriptions), escalating complex billing or account issues as needed.
• Maintain and improve Overleaf’s existing documentation and knowledge base, while building Papers AI’s user-facing help content largely from scratch as common issues emerge.
• Log bug reports to Product and Engineering with clear, reproducible detail.
• Adhere to and refine Overleaf’s established support processes, and help shape a first support playbook for Papers AI as ticket patterns emerge.
• Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Sales, Marketing, Customer Engagement, and Finance teams to support individual users, institutional clients, and enterprise customers across both products.
• Monitor support trends and user feedback across both products, and proactively surface patterns that show up.

Required Qualifications & Skills
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills for engaging with customers and internal teams.
• Fluency in English, with strong attention to detail and clarity.
• Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to troubleshoot technical issues efficiently, across products with different levels of process maturity.
• Comfort working through ambiguity — Papers AI is early-stage and doesn’t have a mature playbook yet, so some days will look more like building the answer than looking it up.
• Experience in a customer service or support role, preferably within a SaaS platform.
• Ability to quickly learn and explain technical subjects to users of varying expertise levels, across more than one product at a time.
• Comfortable working remotely and independently while collaborating with a distributed team.
Preferred Qualifications
• Familiarity with LaTeX, Overleaf, or similar markup languages and authoring tools.
• Familiarity with AI-assisted writing or research tools, or a general interest in AI-powered research software.
• Experience using Front or other customer service management systems.
• Knowledge of SaaS billing platforms such as Stripe.
• Experience working remotely in a distributed team environment.
• Understanding of academic publishing and the needs of researchers and institutions.
• Experience supporting more than one product at once, or building support documentation and processes from scratch for an early-stage product.
We're looking for people who are naturally curious about AI and comfortable exploring how it can improve the way we work — you don't need to be an AI expert, but an openness to experiment and adapt is important to us.

Don't worry if you don't meet every qualification—let us be the judge! Dizzion is seeking an experienced and proactive Security Engineer III to own and strengthen the day-to-day security posture of our cloud infrastructure, customer environments, and internal systems. This role carries hands-on accountability for identifying and addressing security risks, leading security incident response, driving vulnerability remediation, maintaining security controls, supporting compliance readiness, and continuously improving Dizzion's security program.

The Security Engineer III will work closely with Engineering, Product, Support, Compliance, Operations, and external technology partners. This is a senior individual contributor role for someone who can operate independently, exercise sound judgment, take ownership of security issues from identification through resolution, and translate security requirements into practical, measurable outcomes.

This role is also accountable for defined security KPIs, SLAs, scorecard metrics, and reporting. The successful candidate will not simply identify security issues, but will establish clear ownership, drive remediation, measure results, and communicate security performance and risk to company leadership. Given the nature of Dizzion's business and the customers we serve, this role requires strong attention to detail, self-direction, disciplined execution, and excellent communication.

Responsibilities

Security Operations & Infrastructure

• Own the monitoring and maintenance of security controls across Dizzion's cloud and corporate environments.
• Configure, administer, and continuously improve security technologies including SIEM, firewalls, IDS/IPS, WAF, endpoint protection, vulnerability management, and identity and access management tools.
• Identify security gaps, assess business impact, and proactively drive improvements to strengthen Dizzion's security posture.
• Own infrastructure hardening and secure configuration initiatives across cloud and production environments.
• Partner with Engineering and IT to incorporate security best practices into infrastructure and application environments.
• Establish and monitor operational security standards, including documented SOPs and SLAs, and ensure performance against those standards.

Incident Response & Threat Management

• Own the full incident response lifecycle, including detection, investigation, triage, containment, remediation, recovery, and post-incident review.
• Lead security incident response activities and coordinate internal teams and external partners as appropriate.
• Maintain and continuously improve security incident response playbooks, SOPs, runbooks, and escalation procedures.
• Perform root cause analysis and ensure corrective and preventative actions are assigned, tracked, and completed.
• Monitor emerging threats and assess their potential impact to Dizzion and its customers.
• Establish and report incident response metrics, including response times, remediation timelines, recurring issues, and completion of post-incident actions.
• Communicate clearly and consistently during security events, including status, impact, actions taken, risks, and next steps.

Vulnerability & Risk Management

• Own Dizzion's vulnerability management process across infrastructure, applications, endpoints, and cloud environments.
• Evaluate and prioritize vulnerabilities based on severity, exploitability, business impact, customer risk, and applicable compliance requirements.
• Drive remediation with Engineering, IT, and other internal teams and maintain clear ownership through resolution.
• Track remediation against established SLAs, monitor aging vulnerabilities, and escalate risks when deadlines or requirements are not met.
• Maintain accurate documentation of vulnerabilities, remediation activities, exceptions, and risk acceptance.
• Establish and report vulnerability KPIs, including remediation performance, critical and high-risk exposure, aging, backlog, and SLA compliance.

Security Engineering, Automation & Continuous Improvement

• Implement and improve security controls across cloud and corporate environments.
• Identify opportunities to automate repetitive security processes and improve operational efficiency, visibility, and response times.
• Develop scripts, tooling, and integrations that improve security monitoring, reporting, and response.
• Participate in security architecture reviews and secure implementation of new technologies.
• Evaluate security tools and technologies and make recommendations based on business and technical requirements.
• Maintain a security roadmap and track delivery of priority security initiatives against agreed timelines and KPIs.

Vendor & Platform Security Coordination

• Work closely with Omnissa on platform releases, security updates, vulnerabilities, and required remediation activities.
• Coordinate with internal teams to assess the security implications of platform and infrastructure changes.
• Partner with Product and Engineering to map security requirements and identified risks to the product roadmap.
• Support vendor security reviews and ensure security requirements are incorporated into technology evaluations and ongoing vendor relationships.
• Maintain clear documentation and follow-up on vendor-related security issues, commitments, remediation timelines, and SLAs.
• Maintain visibility into third-party security risks and ensure appropriate actions are tracked to completion.

Compliance & Security Assurance

• Own day-to-day technical support for Dizzion's security and compliance programs, including SOC 2, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, GDPR, and other applicable requirements.
• Maintain security policies, procedures, evidence, and technical documentation required for audits and compliance activities.
• Coordinate technical evidence collection and respond to internal and external audit requests.
• Identify gaps between security controls and compliance requirements and drive remediation with responsible teams.
• Monitor compliance-related security actions and ensure commitments are completed within established timelines.
• Maintain readiness for recurring audits and assessments rather than treating compliance as a point-in-time exercise.

Security KPIs, Scorecard & Reporting

• Own the security scorecard and maintain clear, accurate reporting on the health and performance of the security program.
• Define, track, and report agreed security KPIs and operational metrics to Engineering leadership and other stakeholders.
• Establish meaningful measures across incident response, vulnerability management, remediation SLAs, compliance readiness, security control coverage, and security initiatives.
• Identify trends, risks, and recurring issues in security metrics and translate findings into actionable recommendations.
• Escalate material risks and performance gaps with clear context, ownership, and recommended next steps.
• Use metrics to prioritize security work and demonstrate measurable improvement over time.

Cross Functional Partnership

• Work closely with Engineering, Product, Support, Operations, Compliance, and other internal teams to identify and address security risks.
• Serve as a senior security resource for technical teams and provide practical guidance on secure design and implementation.
• Communicate technical security concepts, risk, and business impact clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
• Build strong working relationships across teams to ensure security issues are addressed quickly and effectively.
• Establish clear ownership and follow-through for cross-functional security actions.
• Contribute to a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and shared responsibility for security.

Requirements

• Experience working in a cloud-based or SaaS environment.
• Demonstrated hands-on experience owning security monitoring, vulnerability management, incident response, and security controls.
• Working knowledge of cloud security principles across AWS, Azure, or GCP.
• Experience with security technologies such as SIEM, firewalls, IDS/IPS, WAF, endpoint protection, vulnerability scanners, or IAM.
• Strong understanding of common security threats, attack techniques, and mitigation strategies.
• Demonstrated ability to work independently, prioritize competing risks, and take ownership through resolution.
• Demonstrated experience tracking work against defined SLAs, KPIs, or operational metrics.

Preferred Qualifications

• Omnissa Horizon or VMware Horizon
• AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform

About the role 

​

The Managed Services Manager is accountable for building and leading a high-performing operation that delivers responsive support, field engineering, infrastructure management and advanced proactive engineering. The role combines service strategy, people leadership, operational control, technical service governance and direct client engagement.

​

​Reporting to the Head of Managed Services and working through the Service Desk and Third-Line Team Leaders while directly managing the Field Engineering team, you will set clear standards, establish strong day-to-day control, and ensure effective ownership of tickets, escalations, planned cadence activities and client improvements.

​

​You will be visible and credible with demanding clients, creating confidence through clear communication, disciplined execution and measurable improvement.

​

Role purpose and outcomes

- Set a clear direction for UK Managed Services that aligns service design, capability and investment with Doherty Associates’ business strategy.
- Create a consistently high-performing, customer-centred team with clear ownership, strong leadership coverage and effective coaching.
- Deliver reliable, responsive support across service desk, on-site field engineering and third-line technical escalation.
- Maintain operational control across ticket flow, priority incidents, aged work, problem themes, service risk and resource capacity.
- Develop the service from reactive support towards proactive management of client environments through standardised, automated and repeatable cadence activities.
- Own trusted operational client relationships and deliver world-class service experience to senior stakeholders with high expectations.
- Drive automation adoption, service standardisation and continual improvement that increase quality, efficiency, resilience and commercial value. 

​

Key responsibilities

Leadership, culture and capability 

​

- Lead approximately 25 staff across the Service Desk, Field Engineering and Third-Line Engineering teams.
- Develop and empower the Service Desk Team Leader and Third-Line Team Leader to control daily operations, priorities, escalations, cadence delivery and team performance.
- Manage the dedicated Field Engineering team
- Set clear expectations for professional behaviour, technical quality, client care, urgency, accountability and ownership.
- Build a coaching-led culture using structured one-to-ones, quality reviews, skills assessments, development plans and regular feedback.
- Own effective recruitment, onboarding, probation, performance management, succession planning and retention across the function.
- Create an inclusive, collaborative environment that encourages knowledge sharing and works seamlessly with the Malaysian operation. 

​

Operational service management 

​

- Own end-to-end performance across incident, request, problem and escalation management, ensuring disciplined triage, prioritisation, communication and resolution.
- Maintain strong daily control of queues, SLAs, aged tickets, reopened tickets, backlogs, major incidents, client escalations and engineer workload.

​

- Drive structured continual service improvement using trend analysis, problem management, client feedback, quality assurance and post-incident learning.
- Lead the adoption of automation, self-service, AI-enabled workflows and standard operating procedures that reduce avoidable demand and improve consistency.
- Be accountable for compliance with relevant policies and standards, including ISO 27001, ISO 9001 and Cyber Essentials Plus.
- Manage delivery within the agreed Managed Services budget, owning resource planning, cost control and utilisation while protecting service quality.

​

Qualification, experience and skills

​

Essential 

​

- Proven experience at senior manager level leading a multi-disciplinary support or managed services operation through team leaders or managers, ideally within an MSP serving high-expectation clients. 

- Effective people management experience across recruitment, coaching, development, wellbeing, employee relations and performance management.
- Demonstrable success in improving team performance, service quality, customer satisfaction and operational control.

​

Desirable 

​

- ITIL 4 Managing Professional or Strategic Leader certification (ITIL Foundation as a minimum).

- Experience designing or operating proactive technical cadence programmes, including Secure Score improvement and phishing simulation activities.
- Knowledge of ISO 27001, ISO 9001 and Cyber Essentials Plus operating environments.
- Experience of automation, self-service or AI-enabled service improvement within managed services.

​

Professional qualities

​

- Customer obsessed: sets an exacting standard for professionalism, responsiveness and quality.
- Visible leader: present, approachable and prepared to step into difficult situations while developing others to lead.
- Strategic thinker: sets direction and connects day-to-day delivery to longer-term business goals.
- Accountable: takes ownership, creates clarity and follows actions through to completion.
- Calm under pressure: communicates clearly and makes sound decisions during incidents and escalations.
- Commercially minded: understands how repeatability, automation, utilisation and quality contribute to sustainable value.
- Analytical and improvement focused: converts data and feedback into practical action.
- Collaborative: works across technical, security, project, commercial and international teams without creating silos.
- High integrity: handles sensitive client and people matters with discretion and sound judgement.

​

What we offer in return

- Basic salary plus performance bonus.
- 34 days of annual leave, including eight UK bank holidays and a day off on your birthday.
- Enhanced family-friendly benefit schemes, including company sick pay.
- Sponsored training and development and, where applicable, a technical exams incentive scheme.
- Private medical insurance and Employee Assistance Programme.
- Income protection, life insurance and company pension scheme.

# **About the role**

At Todoist, our mission is to empower people with simple yet powerful tools.

We're a multidisciplinary, fully-remote, team that's passionate about creating products, like [Todoist](https://www.todoist.com/) and Comms, that improve people's lives. We thrive on innovating new solutions to old productivity challenges and we seek to rethink how productivity tools are made.

# **Our Core Values**

They are few, but they are mighty. From creating processes to decision-making and recruiting, we build our four core values into nearly every single thing we do.

- **Ambition.** You aspire to put a dent in the universe. You set high standards for yourself and those around you. You solve issues that have a high impact on our customers and our company.

- **Mastery.** You care deeply about the quality of your work. You're continuously learning and pushing yourself to the limits of your ability. As a champion of your craft, you are also a champion of your well-being – you work intensely, then disconnect completely.

- **Independence.** Others can trust that you'll deliver on time. You keep your word and trust your teammates to do the same. You are proactive, take ownership, and remain accountable with little or no direction.

- **Communication.** Your communication is clear, concise, and engaging. You keep others in the loop and never go radio silent. You speak respectfully and foster warm relationships through your interactions. You're culturally and socially aware and can appropriately navigate social situations.

We invite you to [visit our blog](https://www.todoist.com/inspiration) to learn more about us, our values, and how we work.

# **Your Team & Role**

We're looking for an Apple Engineer to join the team that builds Todoist for iOS, iPadOS, and watchOS, and the iOS app for Comms, our team communication product. Millions of people open Todoist on their iPhone every day, and you'll be one of the engineers responsible for making that experience fast, reliable, and a pleasure to use.

The Apple team is seven engineers plus the Head of Apple Engineering, working fully remote and async-first. Rather than one architect deciding everything, each engineer is the Directly Responsible Individual (DRI) for an area they own and evolve: architecture, foundations, testing, performance, accessibility, integrations, and build configurations. You'd take on one of these areas as you settle in.

We're in the middle of modernizing a codebase that has been shipping since 2013. The storage layer is done: we moved from Realm to GRDB, and hundreds of persistence tests now run on Swift Testing. The work ahead is in the UI and concurrency layers. Most of our screens are still UIKit, and our asynchronous code mixes completion handlers, Combine, and async/await. We're moving both forward, to SwiftUI and Swift Concurrency, in an app that millions of people rely on every day. You'd join that work early enough to shape how it's done.

## **You will**

- Design, build, and ship features across Todoist and Comms on Apple platforms, from spec review through App Store release

- Own an area of the codebase as its DRI, setting its direction and raising its quality over time

- Move screens from UIKit to SwiftUI and legacy asynchronous code to Swift Concurrency, within an architecture that is MVVM-C with dependency injection today

- Investigate and fix the crashes and performance problems that reach us through Sentry and our Customer Experience team

- Keep the CI pipeline and tooling healthy, including the automations we've built to investigate CI failures

- Work in cross-functional squads with designers, backend engineers, and product managers, and take a turn on the Hero rotation supporting Customer Experience

## **Why this role exists**

This is a backfill on a team that has more modernization work planned than hands to do it. The move to SwiftUI and Swift Concurrency, the sync engine improvements, and the Comms iOS app all need engineers who can own a piece end to end. Without this hire, at least one of those slows down.

## **About the team**

You'll report to Jaime Azevedo, Head of Apple Engineering. The team values async-first communication, direct and frequent feedback, ownership of outcomes, and shipping in small, reviewable steps. We meet in person twice a year at company retreats.

## **About You**

It's important to us that the person we hire will thrive in this role. Here are the core things we believe will set you up for success:

**Technical skills**

- Professional experience designing, building, and maintaining production iOS apps in Swift, and following the language's evolution closely

- SwiftUI experience in production, and enough UIKit to work in and migrate an older codebase

- Hands-on Swift Concurrency: async/await, actors, and structured concurrency, including moving callback-based or Combine-based code to it

- Familiarity with common persistence approaches such as GRDB, SQLite, or Core Data, and with what it takes to migrate user data safely in an app people have used for years

- A working testing practice: unit and UI tests you'd be comfortable defending, and an opinion on what is worth testing

- Comfort with Git, pull-request-based workflows, and CI pipelines, and experience giving reviews that make other people's code better

- Familiarity with Apple's Human Interface Guidelines and with what each WWDC changes for us

**Mindset**

- You leverage AI tools effectively: you use code assistants and agents to move faster, while applying judgment to validate what they produce and catch their mistakes

- You thrive in a feedback-forward environment and treat direct feedback, given and received, as the normal way a team improves

- You want to be more than an executor: you look for ways to inform the direction of what you build and help sketch a plan that delivers value with the risk taken out early

- You take full ownership of your projects and deliver consistent, high-quality work on time without someone looking over your shoulder

- You write clearly in English and are comfortable making decisions in writing, since that is how most of our work happens

- You care about accessibility and security as part of building well, not as extras

**Nice to have**

- Experience with watchOS, widgets, or app extensions

- Experience in a large-scale codebase migration or a monorepo setup

- Experience working remotely across time zones

Apply soonest, as these roles don't come along often and we move fast.

Not sure the role is a good fit for you? If you think you meet at least half of the requirements, but not all of them, please consider applying.

# **Our Process**

Recruiter Screen → Interview 1 → Task → Interview 2 → Interview 3

Here's what the process looks like:

1. **Submit your complete application.** Attach a resume (or manually entered experience) and thoughtful responses to all the application questions. No cover letter needed!

2. **Application screening.** We read every application to understand your motivation, skills, and experience. Once your application has been reviewed, you'll receive a response regarding the status of your application.

3. **Salary transparency and Recruiter Screen.** If you're shortlisted, we'll calculate and share the salary range of your location up front. Then you'll schedule a 30-minute call with Scott Entwistle (Talent team) for a Recruiter Screen.

4. **Value-alignment interview** with Jaime (Head of Apple Engineering).

5. **Paid task assignment.** This will be your opportunity to showcase your role-specific skills, how you think and work.

6. **Role-alignment interview** with Paul (Apple Engineer).

7. **Culture-contribution interview** with Gonçalo (Chief Technology Officer).

8. Reference & Background checks.

9. Offer to the successful hire.

# **Benefits**

**Take a look at our** [**perks here**](https://doist.github.io/people-team-projects/perks/)**.** Our perks and benefits are designed to provide the freedom and support you need to grow personally and professionally. Here's what that looks like:

## **The basics**

- **Work from anywhere.** Todoisters can work from anywhere in the world. We never place restrictions on location.

- **Design your own schedule.** Work during the time of day that's best for you. Todoisters are encouraged to work 8-hour days and no more than 40 hours/week.

- **Competitive pay.** Our formula-based salaries are calculated based on industry-benchmarked skills and geographical location – no stressful negotiation required.

## **Expand your professional skills**

- **Continue your education.** You'll have a recurring budget to spend on attending conferences, taking courses, and purchasing books.

- **Collaborate in person at retreats.** Our team- and company-wide retreats are unforgettable. The connections that we make in person inspire us throughout the year.

## **Craft your ideal work environment**

- **Cozy up at a coworking space.** Find a coworking space that's right for you and Todoist will cover the expense.

- **Subscribe to apps and services.** You'll have a monthly budget to spend on services that help you do your job: home internet, work apps, music subscription, etc.

- **Purchase the hardware you need.** Every Todoister has access to a recurring budget to spend on work-related equipment.

## **Focus on your well-being**

- **Recharge with generous time off.** Todoisters get 8 weeks (40 days) of PTO per year to use as they wish on vacations and national holidays.

- **Spend time with your new baby.** New parents receive 5 weeks of paid parental leave in addition to 13 weeks of paid pregnancy-related medical leave.

- **Invest in your health and wellness.** Take care of yourself with a monthly budget for things like a gym membership, healthy snacks, massages, health insurance, etc.

We occasionally receive reports about hiring scams related to our roles. Please be aware that our team will not ask you to apply in any way other than via our application at [todoist.com/careers](http://todoist.com/careers).

About Us

Duco is on a mission to reduce the time spent on data-related work by 90%. Our enterprise data automation platform empowers teams to work more efficiently and meaningfully by giving them the ability to automate data controls with the latest technology, such as no-code, the cloud, and AI.

We help firms to start trusting their data, by giving them one intuitive platform to automate the front-to-back processing of all kinds of data (from structured Excels and RTFs to unstructured PDFs and emails). This eliminates the boring manual work across the data lifecycle and enables firms to act faster, work smarter, save money, reduce risk and comply with regulatory requirements.

We’re headquartered in London and have offices in New York, Wroclaw, Singapore, and Antwerp. We’re proud to call some of the largest global financial institutions our clients, including over 15 of the world’s largest international banks, as well as brokers, exchanges, asset managers, hedge funds, administrators, service providers and corporates.

The opportunity

We are seeking an experienced Senior Application Security Engineer to take ownership of security across our software development lifecycle (SDLC). In this role, you will establish secure delivery as the default for our engineering teams, from design and code through to the pipelines that release it.

You will own our Application Security Posture Management (ASPM) platform, Ox Security, and ensure its findings translate into effective remediation. This includes reducing noise, prioritising vulnerabilities that are genuinely exploitable and partnering closely with engineering teams to resolve them. You will also define our approach to threat modelling, security testing and the integration of security guardrails into our CI/CD pipelines.

You will join a small, collaborative Information Security team based across London and Wrocław, working alongside our Senior Security Engineer (Cloud & SecOps) and our Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC) function. You will work closely with our Engineering teams on a day-to-day basis and report to the Head of Information Security.

Key responsibilities

Secure SDLC and pipeline security

• Own security across our SDLC and CI/CD pipelines, embedding secure delivery as the default

• Build and maintain pipeline security guardrails, including static application security testing (SAST), software composition analysis (SCA), secrets scanning, and infrastructure-as-code (IaC) and container image scanning, with gating policies agreed with Engineering

• Strengthen software supply chain security, including dependency hygiene, software bills of materials (SBOMs) and build provenance

• Define pre-deployment cloud guardrails through policy-as-code, in partnership with our Senior Security Engineer (Cloud & SecOps)

Vulnerability management and remediation

• Own Ox Security as our ASPM platform, including policy tuning, noise reduction and the prioritisation of findings based on reachability and exploitability

• Drive remediation with engineering teams, agreeing remediation service level agreements (SLAs) with engineering leads and reporting clearly on progress

• Scope and coordinate application penetration testing, tracking findings through to remediation

Secure design and engineering enablement

• Lead threat modelling for new features and significant architectural changes

• Conduct secure design reviews and review high-risk code changes

• Promote secure coding practices through practical guidance, training and a security champions network across Engineering

Client assurance, reporting and threat awareness

• Represent our platform security with confidence in client security reviews and due diligence discussions, alongside the Head of Information Security

• Maintain and report application security metrics that inform risk reporting and key risk indicators (KRIs)

• Support audits and client assurance activities with clear evidence of our secure development and release practices

• Monitor emerging application and supply chain threats, including those affecting AI and agentic capabilities

Skills and experience

• Proven experience in an application security, product security or DevSecOps role, ideally within a SaaS environment

• Hands-on experience integrating security tooling into CI/CD pipelines

• A track record of converting SAST, SCA, secrets or ASPM findings into prioritised, remediated work rather than raw reporting

• Strong understanding of common vulnerability classes and the OWASP Top 10, with practical knowledge of how to remediate them

• The ability to read and review code in at least one of our core languages: Java, Ruby or Python

• Experience facilitating threat modelling with engineering teams

• Working knowledge of AWS and infrastructure-as-code

• Proficiency in Python or a comparable scripting language for automation

• Credibility with developers, with the ability to influence engineering teams and articulate risk in actionable terms

Desirable

• Container and Kubernetes security experience, including image scanning and admission controls

• Experience with policy-as-code tooling

• Experience establishing a security champions programme

• Experience securing large language model (LLM) or agentic AI capabilities, such as applying the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications

• Familiarity with financial services regulations and standards, such as the Digital Operational Resilience Act (DORA), ISO 27001 and SOC 2

• Relevant professional certifications, such as OSWE, GWAPT, CSSLP or AWS Certified Security – Specialty

AI-first campaign operations

Lead, Financial Systems & Strategy

Lead, Financial Systems & Strategy

This is a rare FP&A role — one where the work goes well beyond variance reporting and budget cycles. This role exists because financial systems architecture and reporting efficiency are both of the largest gaps and one of the highest-leverage investments the finance function could make. As the primary owner of Duetto's financial reporting platform and model, you'll own the infrastructure behind every number leadership and the board sees: the data model, the model architecture, and the AI-augmented workflows that make reporting fast and trustworthy. As with the rest of Duetto's finance team you'll be expected to bring AI into the workflow — using tools like Claude to automate reporting, accelerate close, and raise the analytical bar.

What Makes Us Different?

Duetto is the hospitality industry's leading revenue management platform, founded in 2012 by former Wynn Resorts executives who knew the industry needed better technology. We built the world's first Revenue & Profit Operating System — a suite of tools (GameChanger, ScoreBoard, BlockBuster, Advance and more) that goes beyond room pricing to give hotels, resorts and casinos a complete picture of their revenue and profitability. Trusted by clients ranging from independent boutique hotels to global chains, we've been named the #1 Revenue Management Software by HotelTechAwards four years running and the #1 Best Place to Work in Hotel Tech in 2025. Backed by GrowthCurve Capital since 2024, we're accelerating our investment in AI — and we're genuinely passionate about the industry we serve. We build products we're proud of, for customers we care about.

What You'll Be Doing

• You'll own Duetto's FP&A systems architecture — driving the data centralization and infrastructure that consolidates data from NetSuite, Salesforce, and departmental sources into a single source of truth.

• Own Duetto's core data model and platform governance in Abacum as it rolls out — architecting how department and consolidated views are structured, partnering with department analysts and the FP&A team on inputs and assumptions.

• You'll architect and maintain the integrated financial model — P&L, cash flow, and the reforecast/budget engine — ensuring it scales across departments and initiatives.

• Own the monthly and quarterly board/sponsor reporting package, translating department-level submissions into a single, defensible narrative for the CFO and board.

• Build scenario and sensitivity analyses to support leadership decision-making around growth, investment, liquidity, and other strategic initiatives.

• Partner with Accounting on accelerating the monthly close process.

• You'll own cash flow forecasting and covenant compliance monitoring — building the visibility that flags risk before it becomes a surprise.

• Define how modern FP&A is built — deploying AI-augmented workflows and agents, and setting the standard for what an AI-first finance operations function looks like.

• Own consolidated P&L variance analysis, partnering with FP&A team members to understand performance and trends across departments, and synthesize key drivers into departmental and company wide leadership-ready explanations.

• You'll partner with R&D and G&A leaders to provide data-based strategic recommendations for efficient productivity and growth.

What We're Looking For

You may be a good fit if you have:

• 6–10 years in FP&A or Financial Systems, with meaningful focus on executive reporting, financial processes, systems architecture, or data infrastructure in a SaaS environment

• A genuine orientation toward AI-augmented work — you've already thought about how LLMs, automation, and prompt-driven workflows change what finance can produce, and you're looking for a mandate to build that way.

• Demonstrated mastery of financial modelling and reporting — models that are accurate, scalable, and navigable by cross-functional audiences.

• Deep fluency in financial systems architecture: ERP platforms (NetSuite or equivalent), and FP&A platforms (Abacum, Adaptive Insights, OneStream, Pigment, or equivalent).

• Hands-on experience owning forecasting, scenario modeling, and covenant compliance.

• Experience partnering and collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders at all levels. 

• Proven ability to translate complex, multi-department data into a single, executive-level narrative

Strong candidates may also have:

• Experience in a private equity-backed or high-growth SaaS B2B environment

• Proficiency with Excel, Google Suite, NetSuite, and Salesforce in a finance context

• Familiarity with data visualisation or BI tools — Tableau, Looker, or equivalent

• Experience supporting SOX compliance or audit-readiness processes

• Hospitality technology industry experience

Why Duetto?

• Finance with genuine strategic influence. You'll own the infrastructure that determines whether leadership can trust the numbers — building the systems that make every other finance function possible.

• AI is already in the workflow. This role explicitly expects you to bring AI into how finance gets done — automating consolidation, accelerating close, building prompt-driven processes. If you've been wanting to do this and haven't had the mandate, you'll have it here.

• The problems are genuinely interesting. Multi-department consolidation and forecasting with real data complexity — the infrastructure challenges are foundational and the stakes are high.

• A seat at the table. You'll be presenting variance analysis and insights directly to the CFO and board, and setting the technical direction for how Duetto's finance stack scales.

• Growth-stage energy with market-leader credibility. Backed by GrowthCurve Capital since 2024, Duetto is accelerating — you'll be building the financial systems backbone during a period of genuine momentum.

The Details

• Location: Remote (Spain, United Kingdom, US)

• Department: Finance

• Reports to: VP FP&A

• You'll drive architecture decisions through design docs and RFCs, establishing patterns for schema evolution, contract testing, and observability across the platform — influencing technical direction without needing formal authority to do it.

• You'll mentor engineers across US and EU teams, raising the bar for code quality, system design, and technical standards in a globally distributed engineering organisation.

What We're Looking For

• 7+ years building production backend systems at scale

• Deep expertise in Java — Spring Framework, Gradle, and JVM performance tuning

• Production experience with event-driven architectures — AWS Kinesis, Kafka, or equivalent

• Strong system design fundamentals: domain decomposition, modularity, schema evolution

• AWS production experience across EKS/ECS, S3, SQS/SNS, and IAM

• A demonstrated track record of driving architecture decisions and authoring design docs without formal authority

Strong candidates may also have:

• Working proficiency in Python for tooling, automation, or data workflows

• Experience with MongoDB at scale — indexing, aggregation pipelines, sharding

• Hands-on experience with AI-assisted development: LLM coding agents, prompt engineering, or MCP tooling

• Experience evolving large monoliths toward modular or service-oriented architectures

• Familiarity with the hospitality domain — PMS/CRS systems, rate management, or demand forecasting

Why Duetto?

• Real platform ownership at scale. This is a Staff-level IC role with genuine architectural authority over a system processing millions of rate decisions daily — the scope and the stakes are real.

• AI-augmented engineering at the frontier. With Claude Code, Claude MPM, and 82+ in-house MCP tools already in production, you'll be pioneering what AI-first platform engineering looks like — not experimenting with it in isolation.

• A technically consequential modernisation. The monolith-to-microservices migration is live and the platform is in motion — you'll be making architectural decisions that shape how Duetto builds software for years.

• Cross-continental technical influence. You'll mentor and set standards across US and European engineering teams — Staff-level impact without the management overhead.

• Modern stack at real scale. Java/Spring, AWS Kinesis, MongoDB, OpenTelemetry, Terraform, Datadog — tools selected for the problem, used on systems that matter.

The Details

• Location: Remote (Croatia)

• Team: Dev Platform

DXC Technology is a leading global provider of core technology to the insurance industry, bringing together deep industry expertise, software and services to help insurers transform, modernise and grow.

Job Description:
Project Technical Authority (PTA)

Location: Farnborough, Hampshire
Work Pattern: Full-time, Onsite

About the Role

The Advanced Mission Planning Aid (AMPA) provides mission planning capabilities across a wide range of fixed-wing platforms and has a proven track record supporting both UK and international customers.
As a well-established product family, most development activity focuses on enhancing and evolving mature software components, delivering new capabilities and improvements to meet changing customer needs.
We're looking for a Project Technical Authority (PTA) to provide technical leadership across a portfolio of software change projects. You'll play a pivotal role in shaping technical solutions, guiding engineering teams and ensuring successful delivery from concept through to customer acceptance.
Working closely with Project Managers, Product Design Authorities and Subject Matter Experts, you'll take ownership of technical planning and delivery, helping to ensure that solutions meet both customer requirements and long-term product strategy.
This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced software or systems engineer who enjoys combining technical leadership, stakeholder engagement and hands-on problem-solving within a collaborative Agile environment.

What You'll Be Doing

As a PTA, you'll:

• Define and guide technical solutions from requirements through to delivery and customer acceptance.
• Break down complex technical scope into manageable work packages for Agile delivery teams.
• Create and maintain project engineering plans and technical backlogs.
• Work closely with Software, Systems and Operational SMEs to define requirements, acceptance criteria and delivery priorities.
• Ensure solutions align with product strategy and architectural direction.
• Support design reviews, technical decision-making and risk management activities.
• Provide technical leadership throughout the project lifecycle.
• Monitor project progress and communicate issues, risks and dependencies clearly to stakeholders.
• Support customer engagement activities alongside project and programme teams.
• Ensure appropriate verification and validation activities are completed to support qualification and acceptance.

What We're Looking For

Essential Skills & Experience

We're interested in people who can demonstrate:

• Experience leading technical activities across the software development lifecycle.
• Experience working within Agile delivery environments using Scrum and/or Kanban.
• Strong requirements gathering and analysis skills, including translating customer needs into detailed system and software requirements.
• The ability to estimate work, identify risks and manage technical dependencies.
• Experience in both Functional and Object-Oriented design.
• Strong review and assurance skills, including design reviews, code reviews and technical walkthroughs.
• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
• A collaborative approach with the ability to work effectively across multidisciplinary teams.
• Eligibility to meet UK Government and contractual personnel security requirements applicable to the role.

Desirable Skills & Experience

It would be advantageous if you have experience in any of the following:
• Software development within regulated or safety-critical environments.
• Software Safety and Security Standards.
• Military Aviation Authority (MAA) Regulatory Articles.
• C/C++ development on Linux platforms.
• System architecture, multi-threading, memory management and inter-process communication.
• Service-oriented or distributed systems.
• Geospatial Information Systems (GIS).
• Defence, aerospace or mission-critical engineering environments.
• Tools such as: Sparx Enterprise Architect DOORS HP ALM Rational ClearCase Rational ClearQuest

Why Join Us?
You'll have the opportunity to help shape the future of a mission-critical product used by defence customers around the world, working alongside experienced engineers in a collaborative and supportive environment.
We offer opportunities for professional development, technical growth and career progression while working on complex and meaningful engineering challenges.

Security Requirements
Due to the nature of the work and the customers we support, the successful candidate must be eligible to meet UK Government and contractual personnel security requirements, including the applicable residency requirements for the role, and have the right to work in the United Kingdom. Some roles may also be subject to nationality requirements where these are necessary to meet UK Government or contractual security obligations.

Dynamo AI builds the platform enterprises use to bring AI applications to production and keep them there. Our products cover risk assessment, evaluation, runtime guardrails and observability for generative AI and agentic systems. We work with enterprises in regulated industries, including financial services, insurance, healthcare and defense.

The Role
Our PMs each own a set of business problems, such as getting AI agents approved for production, reducing the effort legal and compliance teams spend on guardrails, or lowering the cost of running guardrails at scale. Almost every one of these problems depends on evidence: whether an approach works, how well, and at what cost. Product Analysts produce that evidence.
Working with the PM who owns a problem, you take a specific question within it and own the answer. You scope the question, design the experiment or prototype, define how success is measured, run the analysis, and come back with a recommendation the PM can act on. When building is faster than waiting, that includes standing up a quick tool with AI to test an idea. You may support several PMs as priorities shift.
Training and infrastructure code is handled by our engineering and research teams. Your contribution is experimental design, prototyping and analytical rigor.
What You Might Work On
• Guardrail creation and upkeep: design and curate the data used to train and accept custom guardrails, keep labeling consistent as datasets grow, and measure whether updates made from production errors improve performance without regressions.
• Control coverage: benchmark detection against new attack techniques, languages and modalities, and scope what closing each gap would take.
• Evaluation evidence: assess whether synthetic evaluation and red-teaming data is faithful and diverse enough for customers' approvers to trust, and research new ways to evaluate AI applications and agents.
• Cost and performance: compare guardrail and orchestration configurations on accuracy, latency and inference cost.
• Alerting: prototype ways to aggregate and prioritize guardrail alerts, and measure their effect on the workload of security analysts.
• Workflow prototypes: build and test prototypes of new workflows, such as how legal and compliance reviewers contribute to guardrail policies or how customers onboard an application on their own, and measure the time and effort they take.
• Rapid tooling: build small custom tools with AI to validate a hypothesis or unblock the team.
• Benchmarking and reporting: measure performance with standard classification metrics (FNR, FPR, precision, recall) and report what is working and what is not.
Growth Path
You will start on well-scoped questions and move to harder, more ambiguous ones. Over time you will build intuition for SLM training, guardrail orchestration, agent security and how controls fit into a full AI application, along with an understanding of how our customers make approval decisions. This is a track toward a Product Manager or senior technical product role.
Requirements
• A degree with strong quantitative or analytical content. We are especially interested in less common backgrounds, such as physics, information or data theory, and business, alongside solid data analysis experience.
• A clear, demonstrated framework for thinking through problems.
• Good instincts for data, ML concepts, and what makes an experiment or metric trustworthy.
• Python and pandas for working with data.
• Interest in AI security or safety, and in adversarial thinking.
• Attention to detail and clear writing, including the ability to turn results into a recommendation a PM can act on.
Nice to Have
• ML coursework, or coursework or projects in statistics or NLP.
• Reading or working proficiency in Japanese, Chinese or a European language.
• SQL.
• A habit of building small tools or scripts, including with AI assistants, to answer your own questions.
• Exposure to LLMs, AI agents, security tooling, experimental design or annotation work.
Why Join Us
• Produce the evidence behind product decisions across every Dynamo product.
• Work on AI security and governance problems that enterprises are facing for the first time.
• Grow toward a product role at a founder-led startup.
• Competitive compensation, equity and benefits.

Our products cover risk assessment, evaluation, runtime guardrails and observability for generative AI and agentic systems. We work with enterprises in regulated industries, including financial services, insurance, healthcare and defense.

The Role
Enterprises want to deploy AI agents that read internal data, call tools and take actions. Their security teams often lack the means to approve these agents with confidence. AgentWarden secures agents across that lifecycle, from risk assessment before deployment through runtime monitoring and incident response. As its Product Manager, you will own the problem of getting agents approved and operating safely in production. You will work with our engineering and research teams and directly with customers' security, platform and AI teams.
In your first months you will focus on agent risk assessment. This includes identifying risky combinations of tools and permissions, such as agents that pair access to private data with exposure to untrusted content and the ability to communicate externally. It also includes analyzing the third-party tools agents connect to and how agents behave when they run. You will spend significant time with customers as well: narrowing down which agent risks block their deployments, identifying economic buyers, and turning pilots into scoped product requirements.
What You'll Work On
• Pre-deployment risk assessment for agents: analysis of agent tools, permissions and runtime behavior, and the evidence security teams need to approve an agent.
• Red teaming for agents, covering multi-step attacks, tool misuse and indirect prompt injection.
• Runtime controls for agent actions and tool calls, kept current as new attack techniques are published.
• Alerting and investigation for agent incidents, where a single session can span many steps and systems.
Responsibilities
• Own the AgentWarden roadmap against a defined set of customer problems and success metrics.
• Lead customer discovery and pilot engagements with enterprise security and AI platform teams, and present to senior security stakeholders.
• For each deployment, identify the buyer, the approver and the operator, and shape pilots around what each of them needs in order to proceed.
• Write requirements that engineering and research can build and evaluate against, including test sets and acceptance criteria.
• Track agent frameworks, MCP, agent platforms and related threat research, and update the roadmap as they change.
• Work with the DynamoGuard and DynamoEval PMs on shared policies, evaluations and alerting.
Requirements
• 2 to 4 years of product management experience, preferably in security, developer tools, or AI/ML products sold to enterprises.
• Hands-on familiarity with how agents are built, including tool calling, MCP, and at least one agent framework such as LangGraph, the OpenAI Agents SDK or CrewAI. You should be able to build a simple agent yourself.
• Working knowledge of LLM and agent threats, such as prompt injection, excessive agency and data exfiltration, and of references such as the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications.
• Ability to read Python or TypeScript well enough to review scanner findings and discuss detection approaches with engineers.
• Experience running customer discovery with technical buyers and converting it into scoped requirements.
• Clear written and verbal communication, including presenting to enterprise security leaders.
• Willingness to spend 4 to 6 weeks per year at customer sites, and more during large contract engagements.
Nice to Have
• Background in security engineering, application security, red teaming or detection engineering.
• Experience with products that produce findings or alerts for SOC or AppSec teams.
• Experience deploying into financial services or other regulated industries.
Why Join Us
• Define how enterprises secure AI agents while the category is still forming.
• Work directly with Fortune 500 security teams on production deployments.
• Own a product line end to end at a founder-led startup.
• Competitive compensation, equity and benefits.
