## About Us

Flagsmith is on a mission to empower teams to ship faster and continuously improve their products. We're a profitable, bootstrapped company building an open source alternative to larger venture-backed competitors. Profitability and sustainability are how we stay in control of our destiny.

Our growth comes from helping larger teams take control of their release processes. We work across all industries but have the biggest impact in high-risk environments like financial services, healthcare, telecommunications, and high-tech manufacturing. Our net retention rates speak for themselves.

Our team spans multiple continents and is 100% remote, with deep roots in engineering and a strong focus on product quality, simplicity, and community. We are filled with team members who have been searching to have impact, and larger scope as opposed to being a cog at a large organisation!

## About the Role

Flagsmith is used by engineering teams who care deeply about the tools they choose, in high-stakes environments where getting a release wrong is costly. Our product earns their trust, but our marketing doesn't tell that story well enough yet. That's the job.

We're hiring a product marketer to own how Flagsmith is positioned and launched, from the public website all the way into the product. Today that work sits with the Head of Product. You'll take it, own it, and make it sharper than it's ever been.

This is a high-ownership role in a small, fully remote team. You won't be writing copy to someone else's brief or handing off a launch deck and moving on - you will own the narrative end to end: what we say, why a technical buyer should believe it, and how every launch lands. 

You'll be close to the product, close to customers, and in the room for decisions about what we build and how we take it to market. You won't do it alone! The team includes a designer, marketing automation, content, SEO, and social specialists to support - but the story is yours.

This role is fully remote, but the candidate should be based in a timezone between UTC-5 and UTC+5. This role reports directly to the Head of Product.

## What You'll Do

- **Own the positioning.** Define how Flagsmith shows up across the platform, in every tier, and position the experimentation capability we're bringing to market. Make it clear and credible enough that an engineering leader at a bank or a hospital can take it straight into a procurement process and turn it into assets sales can actually use.
- **Run every launch.** Own the launch playbook end to end and put each release through it: message, channels, collateral, metrics, retro. No silent launches, and constant improvements to our processes.
- **Own the website, outside-in.** Set the narrative and the conversion goals across the marketing site and into onboarding. Decide what it should say, what it should move, measure what's working, and fix what isn't.

## What You'll Bring

- **Zero-to-one launch experience.** You've taken products or features to market from nothing, and you can point to a launch you personally drove and the number it moved.
- **Positioning that lands with technical buyers.** You make complex, technical products clear and credible to engineers and the people who lead them - not just to a generic SaaS audience. You can read enough of how the product works to be dangerous, and you know what a developer actually cares about.
- **Range across the marketing stack.** You can own a website's message and conversion, brief a designer, shape content, and pull AI into your workflow to move faster. You don't need every craft skill yourself, but you do need the judgement to direct them.

## What We're Looking For

- You can articulate _why_ a piece of positioning works, not just that it reads well. You bring a point of view and back it up.
- You default to shipping over polishing. You know when a launch is good enough to learn from and when it needs more time.
- You build real relationships with technical buyers. You pick up on what they're actually optimising for, not just what they say they want.
- You set your own priorities and keep stakeholders in the loop without being chased. In a small team, that's how trust gets built.

## Nice to Haves

- Experience marketing developer tools, open source, or API/infrastructure products.
- Hands-on with a website or CMS (Webflow is a plus)
- Hands-on experience with feature flags, experimentation platforms, or progressive delivery.
- Comfort using AI across your marketing workflow.

## How to Apply

Send your CV and a couple of examples of launches or positioning work you've personally owned to [jobs@flagsmith.com](mailto:jobs@flagsmith.com). No recruiters please.

 Senior Production Manager

 Full Time

 Westcott Venture Park, near Bicester, UK

 Immediate

 £65,000 - £75,000 depending on experience (pro-rated)

 Apply

 About Flare Bright
Flare Bright is a fast-growing software company specialising in Flight Safety and GPS-free Navigation Systems for the Aerospace, Defence, and Urban Air Mobility sectors. With a team of around 30 professionals, we operate from Oxford/Bicester and White City, London. Our culture is professional, flexible, and inclusive, offering excellent benefits and a proven track record of success. This is a rare opportunity to join an expanding, cutting-edge team.
The Role
Reporting to Flare Bright’s Head of Engineering, the Production Manager will be responsible for developing and running Flarebright’s new manufacturing capability to deliver complex flight safety and navigation products on time, to budget and in-line with Flarebright’s existing ISO-9001:2015 quality standards.
Key Responsibilities
• Lead the development of Flarebright’s new production facility to ensure all products are delivered in line with existing ISO-9001:2015 quality accreditation.

• Develop and execute production schedules to meet delivery milestones within budget.

• Take responsibility for supplier selection, vetting and engagement, coordinating procurement to ensure supply chain resilience for production as well as in support of wider product development.

• Maintain accurate stock forecasts to guide procurement and commercial decisions.

• Lead Flarebright’s Quality function and set the foundations for AS9100 certification at the appropriate time.

• Foster a ‘safety first’ culture as a key part of Flarebright’s Health and Safety leadership team.

• Identify bottlenecks in the manufacturing process and implement improvements to reduce cost and delivery timelines.

• Recruit, train and mentor Flarebright’s growing production team.

Requirements
You must be comfortable working within the defence industry. A Baseline Personnel Security Standard check will be undertaken before an offer is made, and you must be willing and eligible for (or already have) at least UK SC clearance. References will be checked.
Skills and Experience
Qualifications
• Knowledge of ISO-9001:2015 and/or AS9100 standards.

• Degree in Aerospace, Mechanical or Manufacturing Engineering (or related field) is desirable.

Experience
• 5+ years of leading electronic component production within an ISO-9001:2015 and/or AS9100 accredited organisation, ideally in the aerospace sector.

• 5+ years in a line management role with proven experience of building individuals and teams.

• Demonstrable experience of supplier management and manufacturing process improvement.

• Ideally, familiarity with product compliance testing and certification, including CE/UKCA marking or aerospace environmental standards like DO160.

General
• You must be highly organised, reliable and process-oriented with excellent written and spoken English and clear communications.

• You must be strongly computer literate particularly with documents, spreadsheets, presentations, and cloud drives.

• Must not be subject to restrictions under any non-UK export laws (such as US ITAR)

Location:
• You will be based at our Head Office in Westcott Venture Park (15 minutes drive from Bicester or Aylesbury, 30-minute drive NE of Oxford). There is provision for flexible working where necessary, but this is an onsite position.

Why Join Us?
• Be part of a rapidly growing company at the forefront of cutting-edge technology in the defence sector.

• Enjoy a flexible, professional, and inclusive work culture.

• Work with a talented team shaping the future of Autonomous Aviation, Machine Learning & Digital Twin technology.

• Competitive pro rata salary and benefits.

• 33 days annual holiday (pro rata), Employee Assistance Programme, cycle to work scheme and support for Continuous Professional Development

We work in defence as well as commercial and ‘blue light’ sectors, so you must be comfortable working within the defence industry, and be eligible to work in the UK. We have a preference for those who will be able to work on sensitive defence projects due to nationality (typically UK, NATO or Five Eyes). Due to the security classification on the work we do, we will undertake a routine Baseline Personnel Security Standard check on the successful applicant. This is a standard process which includes references and career history checks.

RECRUITMENT AGENCIES: Please do not contact us about this role.

 Software Engineer

 Full Time

 Westcott Venture Park, near Bicester, UK

 Immediate Start

 £39,000 - £49,000

 Apply

 About Flare Bright
Flare Bright is a fast-growing software company specialising in Flight Safety and GPS-free Navigation Systems for the Aerospace, Defence, and Urban Air Mobility sectors. With a team of around 30 professionals, we operate from Oxford/Bicester and White City, London. Our culture is professional, flexible, and inclusive, offering excellent benefits and a proven track record of success. This is a rare opportunity to join an expanding, cutting-edge team.
The Role
Reporting to the Senior Engineering Manager, the Software Engineer will contribute towards the complete development lifecycle, from concept and algorithm design to system integration, testing and troubleshooting. You will collaborate with a multidisciplinary team to deliver high-performance flight safety and navigation solutions, maintaining excellence through thorough design documentation and technical reports.
Key Responsibilities
• Concept, algorithm design and coding implementation of complex alternative navigation, autonomy and safety-critical software solutions for the uncrewed autonomous market across aerial and other domains, using C/C++, in line with aerospace standards.

• Independently test, troubleshoot, upgrade and maintain high quality code. 

• Support development of software and hardware in the loop test capabilities.

• Contribute to novel algorithm idea generation to solve autonomy challenges using low size, weight, power and cost solutions.

• Analyse simulation and physical test data, and support active flight test activities. 

• Follow and improve engineering processes, design methodologies, and software libraries to increase development efficiency and product quality.

• Produce comprehensive, high-quality documentation. This specifically includes well-articulated design documentation and test reports.

• Collaborate effectively with fellow engineers and technicians to achieve and deliver complete, operational solutions.

• Engage with customers to translate key user requirements to design requirements and to support customer integration and project engagements.

Skills and Experience
• Qualifications: 2.1 or higher Degree in Software Engineering (or equivalent) in a related discipline which included programming.

• Required Experience: 
• A minimum of 3 years of professional experience focused on the design, development, and testing of real-time embedded software algorithms.

• A strong and demonstrable grasp of C++, real-time systems, event-driven execution, object oriented programming, formal design methods, verification techniques and test-driven development.

• Specific expertise in at least one of the following disciplines:
• PNT techniques.

• Real-time operating systems.

• Machine Learning techniques.

• Practical experience of software engineering best practices including design, change control, coding standards, documentation, code review, source control management, build processes, releases and testing.

• Able to write well-structured, efficient, documented and tested software to high quality standards following coding conventions.

Desirable Experience
• Experience with uncrewed aerial system flight controllers, such as Ardupilot.

• Familiarity with DO-178C aerospace design standards.

• Knowledge of python/bash scripting and HTML5/JavaScript UI development.

• Good knowledge of and ability to apply modern AI and ML technologies.

Location:
• This is an onsite position at our Head Office & Workshop in Westcott Venture Park (15 minutes drive from Bicester or Aylesbury, 30 minute drive NE of Oxford).

• This is not a remote position, although hybrid working may be considered.

Why Join Us?
• Be part of a rapidly growing company at the forefront of cutting-edge technology in the defence sector.

• Enjoy a flexible, professional, and inclusive work culture.

• Work with a talented team shaping the future of Autonomous Aviation, Machine Learning & Digital Twin technology.

• Competitive pro rata salary and benefits.

• Competitive pro rata salary and benefits including; 33 days annual holiday (pro rata), Employee Assistance Programme, Health Cash Plan, Cycle to Work Scheme, Company Discounts and Rewards, Technology Salary Sacrifice Scheme, Pension Salary Sacrifice Scheme, Company Paid Flu Jabs, Gym Discounts, Enhanced Maternity Leave, Company Paid Sick Leave, Paid Jury Service, support for Continuous Professional Development.

We work in defence as well as commercial and ‘blue light’ sectors, so you must be comfortable working within the defence industry, and be eligible to work in the UK.

RECRUITMENT AGENCIES: Please do not contact us about this role.

We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do.  - Turn every network fault from a mystery into a closed ticket: link diagnostics across router-router and NIC-to-router paths, remote command execution across the fleet, and repair visualization that shows exactly what's broken and why. At this scale, debugging has to be systematic, not artisanal.

 - Build the network repair pipeline that runs itself: from automated fault detection through RMA initiation, ticket integration, transceiver lifecycle tracking, and return to service, across DC fabric, edge, and host-to-network layers. When a new site comes online every six months, manual repair doesn't keep up.

 - Build the network monitoring platform for a fleet that never stops growing: define requirements, alerting lifecycle, and health dashboards from scratch, for infrastructure spanning multiple hyperscale sites today and 10s to 100s of GWs ahead. It doesn't exist yet. We're building it.

 - Turn repair into a pipeline, not a procedure. Build the automation that takes a network failure from detection through parts management and return to service. Ticket integration, repair lifecycle pipelines, transceiver and optics tracking — owned, not improvised.

 Customer Relationship & Activation

• Problem-Solving Skills: Ability to thrive in ambiguous environments and translate complex regulatory/operational realities into simple, actionable steps for clients.

• Experience handling complex, high-volume employee transfers (TUPE, M&A transitions, or enterprise-wide migrations).

• International work experience across EMEA, LATAM, or APAC regions.

• Stakeholder Orchestration: Keeping clients, local ops, and CSMs aligned on timeline and scope.

• Operational Agility: Unblocking localized compliance hurdles quickly without compromising governance.

• Time-to-Activation / Speed-to-Onboard: Minimizing the cycle time from contract signing to employee active state.

Location: Coventry (Hybrid Working)
Business Unit: Environment
Division: Infrastructure
About Us
Galliford Try is one of the UK's leading construction and infrastructure businesses, delivering innovative engineering and environmental solutions that make a lasting difference to communities across the UK.
Our Environment Division is a market leader in the UK water sector, delivering major infrastructure and asset management projects for water companies nationwide. Supporting this growing business is a high-performing Finance team that plays a critical role in providing the financial insight, controls and reporting required to drive business performance.
Purpose of the Role
We are seeking a motivated and detail-oriented Management Accountant to join our Environment Division Finance team.
Reporting to a Finance Manager and working as part of a finance team of approximately 17 colleagues, you will support up to two business units and provide financial information, analysis and insight to stakeholders across the wider Environment business.
This role is ideal for a qualified accountant who enjoys working in a fast-paced environment, partnering with operational teams and delivering accurate financial reporting that supports business decision-making.
What You'll Be Doing
As a Management Accountant, you will:
• Prepare and deliver month-end management accounts and reporting packs.
• Support the production of weekly cash flow forecasts and monitor cash receipts.
• Analyse financial performance and investigate variances against budgets and forecasts.
• Attend monthly review meetings with Finance Managers and support performance reporting.
• Prepare cost journals, accruals and general ledger adjustments.
• Review payroll allocations and cost-to-employ calculations.
• Monitor and report on cost recovery performance.
• Prepare and review balance sheet reconciliations and supporting analysis.
• Maintain project information and financial data within company systems.
• Review VAT returns and ensure compliance with reporting requirements.
• Respond to finance queries from operational and commercial teams.
• Support and supervise Finance Assistants where required.
• Contribute to process improvements and financial control initiatives across the business.
Key Responsibilities
Financial Reporting & Analysis
• Produce accurate and timely monthly management accounts.
• Prepare balance sheet packs and reconciliations.
• Analyse financial results and identify trends, risks and opportunities.
• Investigate and explain variances to support business decision-making.
• Ensure all period-end reporting deadlines are achieved.
Cash Flow & Controls
• Prepare weekly cash forecasts and monitor working capital performance.
• Support accurate accruals, journal postings and ledger maintenance.
• Monitor cost recovery across projects and business units.
• Support financial governance and compliance activities.
Business Partnering
• Build strong relationships with operational, commercial and project teams.
• Provide financial insight and support across assigned business units.
• Assist stakeholders in understanding financial performance and reporting requirements.
• Respond to day-to-day finance queries in a professional and timely manner.
About You
We're looking for a proactive finance professional who combines strong technical accounting skills with excellent attention to detail and a collaborative approach.
You will be comfortable working to regular deadlines, analysing financial data and supporting stakeholders across different areas of the business.
Essential Skills & Experience
• Experience working in a Management Accountant or similar finance role.
• Strong understanding of management accounting principles.
• Excellent organisational and time management skills.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving ability.
• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
• High attention to detail and accuracy.
• Proactive and adaptable approach to work.
• Experience supervising or supporting junior team members.
• Strong numerical and literacy skills.
• Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment and meet weekly and monthly deadlines.
Qualifications & Technical Knowledge
• Qualified accountant (CIMA, ACCA or equivalent) or qualified through relevant experience.
• Advanced Microsoft Excel skills.
• Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office applications.
• Experience using Oracle, Sage 200 or similar financial systems is desirable but not essential.
• Experience of financial reporting, reconciliations and forecasting processes.
What Success Looks Like
Success in this role will be measured through:
• Delivery of accurate and timely management accounts.
• High-quality balance sheet reconciliations and supporting analysis.
• Reliable weekly cash forecasting.
• Effective variance analysis and financial insight.
• Strong stakeholder relationships across the business.
• Consistent achievement of monthly and weekly reporting deadlines.
• Maintenance of high levels of financial accuracy and control.
Why Join Us?
This is an excellent opportunity to join a supportive and collaborative finance team within one of the UK's leading infrastructure businesses.
You'll gain exposure to major projects, work closely with operational teams and play a key role in supporting business performance, while developing your own career within a growing and successful organisation.
What We Can Offer in Return
With a strong order book and long-term framework opportunities across the UK, Galliford Try offers stability, career development and the opportunity to contribute to projects that improve lives and protect the environment.
We are committed to maintaining the physical and mental wellbeing of our people through our Be Well programme, offering support, advice and wellbeing resources across a range of areas.
We invest heavily in professional development and provide clear career pathways to help our people realise their potential.
Our Agile Working programme provides flexibility in how, when and where you work, where business requirements allow.
Our Benefits
We put our people first and our benefits package reflects that by offering a comprehensive range of attractive options alongside a competitive salary.
• 28 days holiday plus bank holidays, increasing with length of service, with the opportunity to purchase additional leave
• Annual bonus opportunities
• A wide range of corporate discounts
• Cycle to Work scheme

On routine (Tier 3) projects, the region works independently and the COE reviews key milestones.

 Project Execution
• Lead the cybersecurity workstream on Tier 1 projects end to end: requirements review, security architecture, detailed design, build, configuration, FAT, SAT, commissioning and handover.
• Produce the project security deliverables: security plan, zone and conduit model, risk assessment, hardening records, test procedures and reports, and the security handover package.
• Map customer requirements to contract scope early, flag deviations as they arise, and give project managers the technical basis for change orders.
 Execution Standards & Toolkit
• Act as the technical owner (Expert) for an assigned set of COE competencies. Set the reference configuration for each and keep it current with product and partner releases.
• Build the GA execution toolkit as a by-product of delivery: reference architectures, configuration baselines, build checklists, PowerShell scripts, how-to guides, test procedures and templates.
Automation

About the Role

GE Vernova is executing its most significant engineering talent transformation in a generation. Engineer 2030 is GE Vernova's strategy to double engineering productivity while ensuring the company has the deep domain expertise and skills needed to scale the company while embracing the world's most consequential energy challenges.

This is a program architect role for someone who can hold strategy and execution simultaneously to leverage the existing talent ecosystem to build engineering-specific solutions and drive adoption across businesses to build capabilities. Summary:
Genesys is looking for a passionate Senior Technical Revenue Accountant to join our growing team! The Senior Technical Revenue Accountant will support complex contract reviews, technical accounting assessments, and revenue recognition matters across Genesys’ product and service offerings.

This is not a typical revenue accounting role. The position requires strong technical accounting skills, critical thinking, and the ability to adapt quickly to changing priorities. The Senior Technical Revenue Accountant will perform ad hoc analyses, evaluate complex contract terms and deal structures, and partner closely with Deal Desk, Sales, Legal, Finance, and other cross-functional teams to determine the appropriate revenue accounting treatment. The ideal candidate will play an important role in ensuring accurate revenue recognition while helping the business navigate complex and evolving commercial arrangements. The role requires the ability to translate technical accounting conclusions into practical guidance that supports business objectives while maintaining compliance with Company policy.

Key Responsibilities:
The primary responsibilities for this role include (but are not limited to); 
Technical Revenue:
• Review complex customer contracts, amendments, and non-standard transactions to determine the appropriate revenue recognition treatment under ASC 606 and Company policy.
• Research technical accounting guidance and prepare clear, well-supported accounting assessments and memoranda for complex or judgmental transactions.
• Evaluate new and evolving products, pricing models, and commercial arrangements to determine revenue recognition implications.
• Exercise independent judgment in analyzing complex or novel transactions, develop well-supported accounting conclusions, and escalate significant or highly judgmental matters as appropriate.
• Support the development, documentation, and consistent application of revenue recognition policies and accounting positions. 
Deal Desk, Sales, and Customer Success Management Support:
• Partner closely with Deal Desk, Sales, Legal, Finance, Order Management, and other cross-functional teams to provide revenue recognition guidance throughout the contracting process.
• Review proposed deal structures, contract terms, and non-standard provisions prior to execution, identify potential accounting implications, and recommend solutions that balance business objectives with revenue recognition requirements.
• Serve as a technical revenue resource to business partners, clearly communicating complex accounting concepts and helping stakeholders understand the revenue implications of proposed arrangements.
• Support timely resolution of complex and urgent deal-related questions in a fast-paced environment with changing priorities. 
Policy, Projects & Compliance
• Assist with the development and delivery of ASC 606 policies, guidance, tools, and training for Revenue and cross-functional stakeholders.
• Participate in strategic and ad hoc initiatives, including new product launches, new pricing and consumption models, acquisitions, process improvements, and other evolving business needs.
• Prepare and maintain appropriate documentation supporting significant revenue accounting conclusions, internal controls, and external audit requirements.
• Partner with Revenue Operations and other teams on system or process changes where technical revenue accounting requirements or conclusions need to be incorporated into implementation.
• Translate technical accounting conclusions into practical guidance and process documentation to support consistent application of Company policy across the business.
• Support external audit requests and quarterly reviews by preparing documentation and explaining the accounting conclusions underlying complex transactions.
Requirements:
• Minimum 3 years of related Revenue Recognition (ASC 606) experience.
• Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience. CPA, CA, ACCA, or equivalent professional accounting qualification (or progress toward qualification) preferred.
• Experience with ChatGPT, Claude, and other AI tools.
• Ability to interact effectively with sales and product teams, functional peer groups and subordinates and to gain cooperation from others, especially those in other departments, as well as with outside auditors and outside legal counsel.
• Ability to work independently and take ownership of multiple concurrent and diversified tasks, while working with deadlines.
• Ability to stay energized with shifting priorities and comfortable in identifying and escalating issues timely.
• Confidence and proven record to communicate both orally and written, including the dissemination of technical information.
• Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
• Highly organized, with great attention to detail.
• Problem solver: The candidate should be a strong, analytical problem solver with a common sense and practical solutions orientation.

Desirable Skills:
• Experience with contract lifecycle management (CLM), Salesforce, revenue recognition systems (e.g., RevPro), or ERP systems (e.g., Workday) preferred.
• Experience in revenue accounting within a software, SaaS, or technology environment preferred.
• Big 4 experience.
• Advanced in Excel.

About GiveDirectly 
 What if the most effective way to fight poverty was also the simplest: give people money and trust them to decide what they need?
 Since 2011, GiveDirectly has proven that idea at scale. We’ve delivered more than $1B in cash directly to 2+ million people living in poverty and crisis across 15 countries, and rigorous research shows the results: healthier kids, stronger businesses, sturdier homes, and more resilient families and local economies. Cash is now widely recognized as one of the most scalable, cost-effective, and dignified forms of aid.
 Our ambition goes beyond our own programs. We want cash to become the benchmark for aid, much as the index fund became the benchmark for investing, so that every aid dollar is held to one question: is this doing more good than giving the money directly to people living in poverty?
 We’re growing fast, and this is a rare and important moment to join.
 We expect to hit $1B in revenue in 2026 with significant growth forecast for 2027. At the same time we are building a new technology stack and operating model designed for a roughly 10x change in scale, and we are actively pursuing partnerships with major funders to move even more money in bigger ways, to people who need it. We are known for our extensive integration of technology into field processes; our quantitative approach to performance measurement; and our commitment to rigorous, independent, experimental evaluation of our impact, with multiple Randomized Control Trials completed and others in progress.
 How we work
 Our team spans 20+ countries and 69 languages. Our culture is candid, analytical, and non-hierarchical. We expect high ownership and give people real responsibility early. Our values are central to how we hire, work, and grow, and they are deliberately opinionated:
 • Recipients first. Recipients’ preferences come before those of donors or ourselves.
 • Team next. We optimize for organizational success, not individual success.
 • Be proactively candid. We say what we believe and share information openly.
 • Create positive energy. We aim to be a source of energy for colleagues, not a drain.
 • Think rigorously; act quickly. We reason from first principles, then act rather than debate.
 • Know yourself and grow. We own our imperfections and seek feedback to grow.
 • Accept reality. Propose solutions. We focus on what can change and bring solutions, not just problems.
 • Be productively ambitious. We take risks for step-change impact, not incremental progress.
 If they describe how you like to work and they energize you, this could be a great fit.
 Want to learn more? Read and listen:
 We are one of Time100’s Most Influential Companies of 2026, and our work has been covered by The Economist, NPR, TED, and The Washington Post. We're now preparing to deliver billions of dollars a year to people in extreme poverty, if funding allows. Read our CEO's essay on what that will take.

About this role
GiveDirectly gives cash directly to people living in poverty and in emergencies. Both depend on the same question: did this person live in this place, at this time? We ask it when we target the poorest households, and when a disaster displaces a community overnight. Location records held by Mobile Network Operators (MNO) can help us estimate an answer to this question at scale. We work with MNOs so they can infer, from their own records, whether a subscriber was resident in a target area over a defined period. Robust residence location inference from MNO data requires in-depth analytical work, and the methods we design have to run on an operator's systems - most often implemented by their engineers - under strict data protection and confidentiality rules. 
We are hiring a Senior Data Scientist to progress our work on location inference from MNO data, and to make it repeatable. Your job is to improve and extend our library of method templates, adapt them to each new operator and setting, and design new elements when an intervention requires it. You'll assess what can be inferred from a given operator's data, specify the analysis clearly enough for their data engineers to implement, then test it with them remotely or on site. You'll support introductory meetings with MNOs, describing methodologies at a high level, and inform the work of data privacy and cybersecurity teams to ensure only necessary data are shared securely. You'll also help colleagues across GiveDirectly understand the strengths and limitations of this data source, so we design programs around questions it can best answer.
This work is live in several countries, and we're expanding it across the countries where we have offices and to low- and middle-income countries anywhere in the world when a crisis hits. 
Reports to: Senior Product Manager - MNO data
Level: Senior Manager
Location: At this stage of GiveDirectly’s growth and scale, we’re prioritizing hiring in the countries below, where we can employ you through a GD entity or an established employer of record: Cameroon, Canada, Colombia, DRC, Germany, Ghana, Kenya, Malawi, Mozambique, Netherlands, Nigeria, Poland, Portugal, Rwanda, South Africa, Spain, Turkey, Uganda, United Kingdom, and United States. This list reflects where our employment infrastructure is established today, and may evolve as we grow. If you’re based elsewhere and not open to relocation, we may not be able to consider your application for this role right now, but we’d encourage you to check back. Please note that we are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of employment Visas in the U.S. or U.K. at this time.
Travel Requirement: Substantial international travel, roughly 25 to 50% of your time depending on emergencies, sometimes at short notice - for workshops with operators to support programs and emergency responses.
What you’ll do:
 • Improve and extend our library of analytical method templates for establishing where people live from MNO data, and depending on circumstances, for detecting displacement or estimating poverty. Design novel methods when an intervention requires it.
 • Support colleagues in technical conversations with operators, bringing clarity on the data we need and why, and steering discussions toward technical designs that make the analysis workable.
 • Assess the information that can be inferred from each operator's data given data types and sparsity, and for each geography and targeted area. Support intervention design to account for data quality.
 • Write tests and method specifications for MNO data engineers to implement: steps, parameters, pseudocode, validation criteria. 
 • Guide operator engineering teams through implementation, in writing and in person. Adapt methods to accommodate large data volume and computational constraints, balancing accuracy and operational needs.
 • Run in-country workshops with operators to support the set-up of new analyses and - where feasible - tune parameters based on statistical tests and distributions. 
 • Feed every new analytical and implementation element back into standard templates, so the next country or intervention starts from a better position than the last.
 • Design for privacy from the start, so that as little data as possible has to be shared: aggregation, minimization, and where useful, privacy-enhancing technologies such as private set intersection or homomorphic encryption.
 • Protect the confidentiality of what operators share with us and improve internal data security processes and tools as we grow.
 • Build internal training material so that our technical and non-technical teams understand the strengths and limits of this data, and design interventions accordingly.
 What you’ll bring:
 • Exceptional alignment with GiveDirectly Values and active demonstration of our core competencies: emotional intelligence, problem solving, project management, follow-through, and fostering inclusivity. We welcome and strongly encourage applications from candidates who have personal or professional experience in the low-income and/or historically marginalized communities that we serve.
 • Strong mathematical modeling, machine learning and statistics. You choose methods for the question rather than for their sophistication, and you value being able to explain a result over squeezing out the last point of performance.
 • Deep comfort with spatio-temporal data: temporal filtering, GIS, probability distributions, combinatorial reasoning, and working with sparse, irregular observations. Direct experience with Call Detail Records (CDRs) or latching data is a strong plus. Comparable experience with mobility, transport, sensor or remote-sensing data counts.
 • The ability to reason without ground truth. Much of this work has no validated answer to check against, and you're comfortable setting parameters by reading the shape of the data and defending that choice.
 • Pragmatism about the trade-off between accuracy and implementability. You've deliberately simplified a method to fit an operational constraint, and you can say what it cost you.
 • Excellent communication and relationship-building skills. You can explain a method and its limitations to an operator's engineers, to their data protection officer, to their leadership and to colleagues with or without technical background. You write well and are comfortable presenting to these multiple audiences. You build trust with counterparts you don’t manage, and they want to work with you again. 
 • Experience writing technical specifications that other teams implemented, clear enough that people you don't manage could follow them correctly.
 • Able to read and review SQL and Python written by others, and to find the logical error in someone else's query. Writing production-quality code yourself is welcome but not required. Enough understanding of large data volumes and databases to judge when analytical simplification is required.
 • Commitment to privacy by design as a foundational value and starting point rather than a compliance step: designing analyses so that less personal data has to be shared. Familiarity with privacy-enhancing technologies for shared computation (private set intersection, secure multi-party computation, homomorphic encryption) is a strong plus.
 • Commitment to confidentiality. You've handled a partner's commercially sensitive data and can describe the habits you built around it, not just the clause you signed.
 • Experience designing training material that changed how non-specialist colleagues used a data source.
 • Comfort in fast-moving contexts where the brief may often shift, and where your technical expertise and understanding may not be shared by other stakeholders.
 • Additional desirable experience may include: poverty modeling; familiarity with survey data and survey instruments; experience inside a mobile network operator or working closely with one; open-source contributions in the mobility estimation space.
 • Comfortable with travel to fragile and post-disaster contexts.

## Operations Manager (Birmingham)

**Do you thrive when people are at the centre?** If you’re driven by practical improvement, confident in leading teams, and passionate about delivering safe, high-quality care that helps people live independently, we’d love to hear from you.

At GreenSquareAccord, we believe everything we do is about people – whether that’s providing a good quality, safe home or care that enables independence. Colleagues genuinely live and breathe this social purpose. To strengthen the way we deliver, we’re looking for an **Operations Manager** to help shape day-to-day operations, support frontline teams, and ensure our services consistently meet the highest standards.

### What you’ll do

As Operations Manager, you’ll turn vision into results. You’ll oversee operational performance across the Birmingham area, driving quality, safety, and continuity of service. You’ll also bring structure, clarity and momentum to how we work – so colleagues can focus on what matters most: delivering excellent support to the people we serve.

- **Lead operational delivery** by coordinating day-to-day service needs, ensuring plans translate into real outcomes for customers and colleagues.
- **Drive quality and compliance** through active monitoring, audits, continuous improvement and effective issue management.
- **Strengthen safe, effective care** by supporting care standards, risk management, and escalation processes where required.
- **Develop and support teams** coaching managers and frontline colleagues, improving practice, and building capability across the operation.
- **Use data to improve performance**, tracking key operational metrics (for example: quality indicators, service delivery performance, workforce capacity and incident trends).
- **Maintain strong partnerships**, working collaboratively with stakeholders to remove barriers and support consistent service delivery.
- **Manage operational governance** by chairing or contributing to operational meetings, ensuring actions are followed through and learning is embedded.
- **Ensure robust communication** across the operational chain. Clear priorities, timely updates and transparent decision-making.

### What we’re looking for

You’ll likely have experience in operations management, service management, domiciliary/regional leadership, or a related environment where quality, safeguarding, and continuous improvement are core. You’ll be comfortable juggling competing priorities while maintaining a calm, solution-focused approach.

- **Proven leadership** in an operational setting; able to motivate teams, set standards and support performance improvement.
- **Strong understanding of quality and governance** confident with audit, continuous improvement, incident management and compliance expectations.
- **Sound judgement and professionalism** you make decisions grounded in safety, ethics and the needs of customers.
- **Excellent communication skills** you can explain, influence and align people at all levels.
- **Ability to manage complexity** balancing workforce capacity, service demand and operational risk.
- **Collaborative mindset** you work with others to create momentum, not just manage tasks.

### Why this role matters

This isn’t a back of house job. Your work will directly affect how safe, consistent and person-centred support feels day to day. When you strengthen operational processes, reduce avoidable friction, and support colleagues to do the right thing confidently, the impact is immediate on quality of care, on customer outcomes, and on the wellbeing of the workforce.

We’re looking for someone who can bring both **people leadership** and **operational experience**. Someone who understands social housing and the importance of the work we do.

### Location and working pattern

This position is based in **Birmingham**. The role involves regular operational engagement, including supporting teams, reviewing service delivery and participating in governance activities across the area.

### What you can expect from us

- **A mission-led environment** where colleagues are proud of the social purpose behind their work.
- **Support to succeed** clear ways of working, collaborative leadership and opportunities to improve.
- **Investment in continuous improvement** you’ll have the space to identify, test and embed better ways of delivering.
- **Respect for colleagues** we aim to build a culture where high standards and people wellbeing go together.

### Ready to make a difference in operations?

If you want to lead from the front of operational delivery, raise quality standards and help people live independently with confidence, we would welcome your application.

**Apply now** to join GreenSquareAccord and help keep our services safe, effective and person-centred.

_GreenSquareAccord welcomes applications from people of all backgrounds. We are committed to building teams that reflect the communities we serve._

**To learn more about our careers and culture, visit:** [https://greensquareaccordcareers.co.uk/](https://greensquareaccordcareers.co.uk/)

About the opportunity

Are you an experienced Technical Systems Analyst looking for an opportunity to make an immediate impact within a busy Digital Services team?

At **GreenSquareAccord (GSA)**, we're looking for a Senior Technical Systems Analyst to join us on a 6-month fixed-term contract, supporting the delivery, maintenance and improvement of our business-critical systems.

This is a fantastic opportunity for someone who enjoys solving complex technical challenges, supporting system improvements and working collaboratively with stakeholders across a business.

You'll play an important role in ensuring our systems remain reliable, efficient and aligned with business needs, while supporting ongoing projects, system upgrades and service improvements.

### What will you be doing?

- Providing specialist technical support and acting as a subject matter expert for business-critical systems and applications.

- Managing and resolving technical issues, identifying root causes and implementing long-term solutions.

- Supporting the delivery of system upgrades, patches, software releases and new functionality.

- Working closely with internal stakeholders to understand business requirements and translate these into technical solutions.

- Supporting system testing, including User Acceptance Testing (UAT), to ensure changes are successfully implemented.

- Managing technical changes in line with established change management processes.

- Maintaining system documentation, technical procedures and configuration records.

- Working collaboratively with the Service Desk, Infrastructure teams and external software providers to resolve issues.

- Supporting service transition activities, ensuring new and updated systems are ready for operational use.

- Identifying opportunities to improve system performance, reliability and business processes.

### What are we looking for?

We're looking for a proactive and technically confident individual who can quickly get up to speed with our systems and make a positive contribution from day one.

Ideally, you'll bring:

- A minimum of **3 years' experience** in Service Transition, Application Support or a technical systems analysis role.

- Experience working within an **ITIL / IT Service Management (ITSM) environment**.

- Strong technical knowledge of **SQL, SQL Server Management Studio (SSMS) and SQL Server Reporting Services (SSRS)**.

- Experience supporting business-critical applications and troubleshooting complex technical issues.

- Good working knowledge of Microsoft 365 and cloud-based software.

- Experience working with test environments and an understanding of software release lifecycles.

- Knowledge of systems architecture, integrations and technical dependencies.

- Excellent analytical, problem-solving and stakeholder management skills.

- The ability to manage competing priorities and work independently in a fast-paced environment.

**It would also be great if you have:**

- Previous experience supporting Housing Management systems or applications.

- Experience coordinating system upgrades, technical projects or UAT activities.

- Familiarity with Microsoft Azure services.

- Experience with Power BI.

- ITIL Foundation or relevant Microsoft technology certifications.

- Experience delivering continuous service improvements.

### Why join GreenSquareAccord?

At GSA, we're passionate about providing homes and services that make a positive difference to people's lives.

You'll be joining a collaborative Digital Services team, where your technical expertise will directly contribute to maintaining essential systems, supporting colleagues and improving the services we deliver to our customers.

This 6-month opportunity offers the chance to get involved in meaningful technical projects, work with a range of business systems and make a real impact within an organisation with a strong social purpose.

**If you're an experienced Technical Systems Analyst who enjoys problem-solving, improving systems and delivering results, we'd love to hear from you.**

Apply today and become part of the GreenSquareAccord team.

 Director - Partnership Sales, Microsoft 

 London, United Kingdom

 Apply

 Grid Dynamics is looking for a Director - Partnership Sales, Microsoft to build and grow our joint business with Microsoft across the UK and Europe. This is a hands-on, individual-contributor role: you will develop GD's presence inside Microsoft's field organisation, drive co-sell pipeline alongside Microsoft sellers, and build the joint go-to-market engine between GD and Microsoft, with a focus on Azure, data platforms, and AI. The right person knows how Microsoft works from the inside and has a track record of turning partner relationships into pipeline and closed sales.

 Essential functions

 • Develop and grow joint business between Grid Dynamics and Microsoft — build GD's profile and credibility inside Microsoft's field organisation so GD becomes a go-to co-sell partner for Azure, data platforms and AI engagements.

• Own the co-sell pipeline in the UK/Europe: identify and register joint opportunities, manage deal progression alongside Microsoft field sellers, and drive Microsoft-sourced revenue to Grid Dynamics.

• Microsoft related new logo partner sales in UK/Europe

• Enable Microsoft UK field teams (ATUs, STUs) to understand and confidently position Grid Dynamics — develop briefing materials, capability narratives, and reference examples that make it easy for Microsoft sellers to bring Grid Dynamics into client conversations.

• Define and execute the UK and Europe GTM plan with Microsoft

• Build senior relationships across Microsoft and channel partners; represent Grid Dynamics at Microsoft partner forums, QBRs, field days, and regional events

• Drive joint value propositions with Microsoft, co‑selling motions, event participation and pipeline growth

• Lead partner enablement across technical, sales, and delivery teams

• Support Grid Dynamics account management teams in identifying and progressing joint opportunities

• Establish offerings and services aligned to partner plays

• Contributing to Grid Dynamics’ global Cloud GTM build‑out

 Qualifications

 • Proven experience in a partner development, channel, and business development role within or working closely with Microsoft's partner ecosystem.

• Demonstrated ability to develop joint business with Microsoft — driving co-sell pipeline and building presence with Microsoft field teams, not just managing the relationship.

• Strong working knowledge of Microsoft's GTM structure: ATUs, STUs, PDM organisation, co-sell motion, and Microsoft AI Cloud Partner Programme.

• Track record of building trust and influencing outcomes through sustained relationships — this role generates pipeline by making Microsoft sellers want to bring GD into their deals.

• Hands-on individual contributor — comfortable owning the full partner development cycle end-to-end from partner relationship management, to co-sell motions and the closing of deals.

• Familiar with Azure, cloud transformation, data platform and AI services; credible in technical conversations with Microsoft and client stakeholders.

• Strong communication and stakeholder engagement skills; credible at senior level and at Microsoft partner forums.

• Right to work in the UK required.

 Would be a plus

 • Prior experience inside Microsoft (PDM, ATU, or STU roles).

• Existing relationships within Microsoft UK field teams.

• Experience in retail & CPG, financial services, manufacturing, or technology & media.

 We offer

 • Entrepreneurial environment.

• Compensation and benefits at par with industry standards.

• Flexible hybrid working.

• Cohesive local and global team with ample opportunities to grow.

• Corporate social events

• Professional development opportunities

• Well-equipped office

 About us

 Grid Dynamics (NASDAQ: GDYN) is a leading provider of technology consulting, platform and product engineering, AI,
 and advanced analytics services. Fusing technical vision with business acumen, we solve the most pressing technical
 challenges and enable positive business outcomes for enterprise companies undergoing business transformation.
 A key differentiator for Grid Dynamics is our 8 years of experience and leadership in
 enterprise AI, supported by profound expertise and ongoing investment in
 data,
 analytics,
 cloud & DevOps,
 application modernization
 and customer experience.
 Founded in 2006, Grid Dynamics is headquartered in Silicon Valley with offices across the Americas, Europe, and India.

 Full Stack Developer - Java + React 

 London, United Kingdom

 Apply

 We are looking for a Senior Full-Stack Engineer to join our global Investment Banking client. You will be responsible for the development and overall implementation of AI-enabled web applications in a complex, critical and large cross-departmental and multi-disciplinary area.
The role is part of a multi-year transformation journey that will require a successful candidate to establish best practices, motivate and promote a cultural shift that will ensure a successful adoption of Engineering Principles and Practices within Production Management.
The role requires a comprehensive understanding of multiple areas within a function and how they interact to achieve the objectives of the function. Applies in-depth understanding of the business impact of technical contributions. Accountable for delivery of a full range of end-to-end projects.
Great chance to build high-quality projects with low tech debt from the start. You'll be working with cutting-edge AI/LLM capabilities, working with the internal AI platform team to integrate some of the latest agentic AI techniques into the apps you build.

 Essential functions

 • Demonstrates an in-depth understanding of Software Development Lifecycle and how it integrates within the overall technology landscape to deliver scalable, reliable and resilient applications.

• Ability to operate in a global environment with on-/near-/off-shore matrix reporting structures.

• Operates into a highly regulated environment that requires in-depth understanding of the regulatory requirements and the industry implications for our technologies.

• Improve the service level the team provides to our end users, which includes maximizing operational efficiencies, strengthening incident management, problem management and knowledge sharing practices.

• Drives Continuous Delivery and Automation efforts across the supported applications by means of Root Cause Analysis reviews, Knowledge management, Performance tuning, and user training.

• Fosters a culture that promotes transparency and innovation for increased team productivity.

• Coaching members of the team and outside the immediate reporting line about the best practices and recognises anti-patterns that are quickly addressed.

• Implements the Agile Framework through one of its implementations like SCRUM or Kanban and ensures it integrates with overall organisation processes.

 Qualifications

 • Polyglot full-stack developer - Java + React

• Excellent understanding of Software Engineering concepts like Software Development Life Cycle and GitOps

• Excellent debugging and analytical skills: ability to isolate root cause across networking/infrastructure, application and database stacks

• Operational experience of deploying and running services at scale on top of Docker/Kubernetes stack and a service mesh, like Istio, is highly desirable

• Operational experience with orchestration tools for CI/CD and Infrastructure-as-Code tooling (Terraform, Cloud Formation, etc.) is a highly desirable

 We offer

 • Opportunity to work on bleeding-edge projects

• Work with a highly motivated and dedicated team

• Competitive salary

• Flexible schedule

• Benefits package - medical insurance, sports

• Corporate social events

• Professional development opportunities

• Well-equipped office

 About us

 Grid Dynamics (NASDAQ: GDYN) is a leading provider of technology consulting, platform and product engineering, AI, and advanced analytics services. Fusing technical vision with business acumen, we solve the most pressing technical challenges and enable positive business outcomes for enterprise companies undergoing business transformation. A key differentiator for Grid Dynamics is our 8 years of experience and leadership in enterprise AI, supported by profound expertise and ongoing investment in data, analytics, cloud & DevOps, application modernization and customer experience. Founded in 2006, Grid Dynamics is headquartered in Silicon Valley with offices across the Americas, Europe, and India.

 Golang Engineer – Infrastructure Automation | Financial Services 

 London, United Kingdom

 Apply

 We’re hiring several Golang engineers at mid/senior and principal level, to help accelerate automation across a large-scale, physical infrastructure platform. This is an opportunity to contribute to a cutting-edge, high-performance tech environment that operates with startup-style agility and the stability of a well-established organisation in the hedge-fund space. 
You’ll be part of a high-calibre engineering team known for technical excellence, autonomy, and fast iteration cycles. Expect real ownership, complex systems, and the chance to ship meaningful code from day one.

 Essential functions

 • Build and expand Golang-based workflows for provisioning bare-metal servers at scale.

• Use the OpenStack Ironic Golang SDK to manage OS image deployments to physical machines.

• Write clean, testable, production-ready Go code that integrates into a wider automation stack.

• Solve deep systems challenges across hardware, networking, and orchestration layers.

• Collaborate with platform and infrastructure teams while working with high independence.

 Qualifications

 • Have expert-level proficiency in Golang, especially in systems or infrastructure-focused environments.

• Can quickly get up to speed with unfamiliar codebases and start contributing with minimal hand-holding.

• Have strong knowledge of APIs, concurrency, and infrastructure-as-code principles.

• Communicate clearly and confidently across tech and non-tech stakeholders.

 Would be a plus

 • OpenStack Ironic or other provisioning platforms.

• Terraform, Vault, Ansible, or similar tooling.

• CI/CD pipelines (GitLab preferred).

• Temporal or Cadence for orchestrating workflows.

 We offer

 This role offers a rare combination of technical challenge, autonomy, and impact—plus access to excellent perks in a modern central London office (including free daily lunch, stocked snacks and drinks, and an on-site gym). The team is lean, sharp, and moves fast. This is also a fantastic opportunity to break into financial services, with no prior experience needed. You’ll gain invaluable hedge-fund domain expertise and will have the chance to interact and collaborate with business users often. 
We’re looking for problem-solvers, self-starters, and engineers who want their code to matter. If that’s you, we’d love to speak.
Benefits 
• 25 days holiday (excluding bank holidays), increasing with length of service

• Industry-leading Aviva Pension Scheme, with matched pension contributions up to 10% 

• Life assurance - 2 x annual salary 

• The best level of BUPA private healthcare cover available, covering preexisting conditions and the option to add a spouse and children for free 

• State-of-the-art work equipment upon starting to create your perfect WFH set-up

• Enhanced maternity and paternity leave 

• Unlimited training and learning budget 

• Fantastic team and office culture, with premium expensed company and team-building events, as well as the chance to participate in (or even organise yourself!) monthly fully expensed social events

Please note: This role is based in central London, with a requirement to work in the office 3 days per week. Candidates must have the right to work in the UK without sponsorship and live within a commutable distance to London. 

 About us

 Grid Dynamics (NASDAQ: GDYN) is a leading provider of technology consulting, platform and product engineering, AI,
 and advanced analytics services. Fusing technical vision with business acumen, we solve the most pressing technical
 challenges and enable positive business outcomes for enterprise companies undergoing business transformation.
 A key differentiator for Grid Dynamics is our 8 years of experience and leadership in
 enterprise AI, supported by profound expertise and ongoing investment in
 data,
 analytics,
 cloud & DevOps,
 application modernization
 and customer experience.
 Founded in 2006, Grid Dynamics is headquartered in Silicon Valley with offices across the Americas, Europe, and India.

 Senior Front End Developer 

 London, United Kingdom

 Apply

 We are seeking a talented senior developer to work with our teams in a leading global Tier 1 investment bank to join its London-based Equity Derivatives Pre-Trade Technology team.

 Essential functions

 • Develop high-quality, scalable software following engineering best practices.

• Partner directly with traders, sales teams and quants to deliver innovative front-office solutions.

• Drive architecture, technical direction and system enhancements across the platform.

• Mentor developers and contribute to a high-performance engineering culture.

• Champion observability, automated testing and CI/CD best practices.

• Work within an agile, fast-paced environment delivering frequent releases.

 Qualifications

 • Extensive experience as a Senior Developer or Technical Lead.

• Strong front-end development expertise, particularly JavaScript and React.

• Proven experience building production-grade applications and distributed systems.

• Strong understanding of APIs, microservices and modern software architecture.

• Experience with automated testing, monitoring, observability and CI/CD pipelines.

• Excellent communication skills with the ability to engage directly with business stakeholders.

 Would be a plus

 • Experience within Equity Derivatives, Delta One, Electronic Trading or Front Office technology.

• Development of applications handling real-time market data, orders or trading workflows.

• Experience with cloud-native and containerised environments.

• Exposure to Kubernetes and microservices architectures.

• Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools and LLM-powered engineering workflows.

 We offer

 • Opportunity to work on bleeding-edge projects

• Work with a highly motivated and dedicated team

• Competitive salary

• Flexible schedule

• Benefits package - medical insurance, sports

• Corporate social events

• Professional development opportunities

• Well-equipped office

 Grid Dynamics (NASDAQ: GDYN) is a leading provider of technology consulting, platform and product engineering, AI, and advanced analytics services.  Senior Full Stack Engineer - Java/Kotlin - Equity Accelerator, Prime Finance 

 London, United Kingdom

 Apply

 This is a chance to help rebuild the technology backbone of a global Prime Finance business.
JUXT is partnering with a Tier 1 investment bank on its Equity Accelerator program, a multi-year, high-visibility initiative to modernize the Prime Finance Equities platform. The program is re-engineering core trading systems, building brand-new data and market-expansion platforms, and launching advanced client features such as cross-margining and credit financing. Legacy architecture is being replaced with event-driven, cloud-native systems built for institutional-grade stability, throughput, and extensibility. The engineers on this team are the ones modernising systems and making things happen.
This is not a greenfield build. You’ll work directly within a complex, financially significant production system, assessing system behavior and data integrity in live market conditions, shaping architectural decisions, and operating with real autonomy alongside an experienced, high-caliber engineering group. This is not general-purpose Java delivery: the domain is deep, the standards are high, and the impact is immediate.

 Essential functions

 What you’ll work on
• Building features end-to-end: event-driven JVM services (Kotlin and Java) on the backend, and modern React/TypeScript applications on the front.

• Delivering user-facing surfaces for advanced client features such as cross-margining and credit financing, including real-time data over WebSockets.

• Re-engineering core trading and post-trade systems into event-driven, cloud-native services, and modernising legacy components while keeping a live platform stable.

• Designing for the realities of event-driven systems: failure handling, ordering guarantees, replay semantics, and data integrity under market pressure.

• Frontend engineering done properly: state management (Redux), performance, security best practice (token-based auth, XSS prevention), and automated testing.

• Practising TDD and shift-left testing as the default across the whole stack. Local-first testing, fast feedback loops, and owning the quality of your deliverables end-to-end rather than handing it to a QA group.

• Delivering iteratively: trunk-based development, CI/CD, and frequent (weekly or better) production releases during business hours with no service interruption.

• Engaging directly with business stakeholders and upstream/downstream teams to build your own domain knowledge, rather than relying on Business Analysts to hold it for you.

• Using AI-assisted and agentic development tooling as a genuine accelerator for analysis of legacy code, test generation, prototyping and refactoring.

 Qualifications

 Requirements for the candidate
Essential
• Strong JVM engineer (Java, with Kotlin experience or an interest to learn) and senior-level modern React and TypeScript, with a track record of shipping production frontends for demanding users.

• Practical experience designing and building event-driven systems on message-passing and event-sourcing patterns, including failure handling, ordering guarantees and replay semantics.

• Solid frontend architecture instincts: complex state management (Redux or similar), consuming real-time data (WebSockets), robust API integration, and web performance and security awareness.

• Test-Driven Development as a practice, not an aspiration, across both halves of the stack (unit, integration and E2E (Jest/Cypress/Playwright)). You own quality end-to-end and design for testability. This is assessed at interview.

• Hands-on experience in or alongside a capital markets trading or post-trade environment: the trade lifecycle, trade booking and position management, and post-trade operations such as cashflow calculation, settlement and wires, client reporting, and accounting principles. You should be able to back this up with concrete examples, not high-level familiarity.

• A track record in genuine iterative delivery incl. short feedback loops, trunk-based development, CI/CD, and regular zero-downtime production releases. No waterfall projects labelled as agile.

• Senior-level autonomy: you contribute to design discussions, push back constructively on technical decisions, and operate with minimal supervision in a complex production environment.

 Would be a plus

 Highly valued but not essential
• Understanding of Prime Brokerage, Synthetic (Swap) or Cash Equity operational flows is a significant advantage.

• Familiarity with corporate actions, regulatory reporting obligations (e.g. 871(m), EMIR, MiFID), and integrating with risk/valuation systems in an equities context.

• Proven ability to analyse, refactor and modernise large-scale legacy systems while maintaining stability.

• Frontend architecture at scale: micro-frontends, monorepos, Core Web Vitals and rendering performance, CSP and security hardening.

• Strong SQL Server skills, MongoDB, and Kafka (or comparable event-streaming platforms).

• Kubernetes/OpenShift deployment and cloud-native operational practices, with observability via OpenTelemetry, ELK and Grafana.

• Demonstrated AI-first development experience: agentic coding workflows for legacy analysis, refactoring and test generation, with a clear-eyed view of where the tools help and where they don’t.

Who this role suits
This is a senior, delivery-focused engagement on a strategic multi-year programme. It suits a genuine all-rounder who is as comfortable reasoning about event ordering in a Kafka topology as about state management in a React app, is proactive about building deep domain knowledge, and holds themselves to high engineering standards without needing an external quality gate.

 Senior Full Stack Java Engineer (Java / Node.js / React) 

 London, United Kingdom

 Apply

 Join a high-performing engineering team building the next generation of workflow automation platforms within a global investment banking environment.
This team is focused on transforming complex, manual post-trade processes into intelligent, automated workflows. By combining modern software engineering, workflow orchestration and AI-powered document matching, they're delivering solutions that reduce operational risk, improve efficiency and have a direct impact on the business.
You'll become part of a collaborative team of experienced engineers working closely with business stakeholders to solve real-world problems. This is an opportunity to build software that matters, influence technical direction and work with modern technologies in a fast-paced engineering environment.

 Essential functions

 This isn't a traditional development role where requirements arrive fully documented.
Instead, you'll work directly with traders, operations teams and subject matter experts to understand business processes, investigate existing systems and design practical technical solutions. Success comes from curiosity, communication and engineering judgement just as much as coding ability.
Java is the primary development language, but this is a genuinely full-stack opportunity. You'll also contribute to Node.js services, React applications and workflow automation as the platform evolves.
What You'll Be Doing
• Design, develop and maintain enterprise Java applications using Spring.

• Build scalable REST APIs and distributed microservices.

• Develop internal web applications using React and TypeScript.

• Contribute to Node.js services responsible for asynchronous processing and business logic.

• Build workflow-driven applications using Camunda (experience not required).

• Integrate multiple internal platforms through REST and HTTP APIs.

• Deploy and support applications running on OpenShift and Kubernetes.

• Collaborate directly with business stakeholders to understand requirements and validate solutions.

• Participate in architecture discussions, code reviews and technical design.

• Deliver clean, maintainable and well-tested software following modern engineering best practices.

 Qualifications

 Skills & Experience
Essential
• Strong commercial Java development experience.

• Excellent knowledge of Spring Framework and the JVM ecosystem.

• Experience building REST APIs and microservices.

• Commercial React and TypeScript development experience.

• Experience with Node.js or willingness to work across both Java and Node.

• Experience working with Docker, Kubernetes or OpenShift.

• Strong understanding of distributed systems and API integration.

• SQL database experience.

• Excellent communication skills and the confidence to engage directly with business stakeholders.

• Comfortable working in Agile environments.

Technology Stack
Java • Spring • Node.js • TypeScript • React • Camunda • OpenShift • Kubernetes • REST APIs • HTTP/JSON • Docker • Python
Who We're Looking For
We're looking for engineers who enjoy understanding problems before writing code.
You'll thrive if you:
• Enjoy working without detailed specifications.

• Are naturally curious and ask questions.

• Like collaborating directly with business users.

• Take ownership and solve problems proactively.

• Enjoy working across multiple technologies.

• Can balance technical excellence with pragmatic delivery.

• Enjoy continuous learning and adapting to new challenges.

Why Join?
• Build software that removes significant manual effort from critical business processes.

• Work on AI-enabled workflow automation and intelligent document processing.

• Join a small, highly collaborative engineering team with genuine technical ownership.

• Gain experience across Java, Node.js, React, Camunda and OpenShift in a modern engineering environment.

• Work directly with end users and influence both product and technical direction.

• Hybrid working in Central London.

 Senior Golang Engineer - Generative AI Platform 

 London, United Kingdom

 Apply

 We are seeking a Senior Golang Engineer to join a growing team focused on building enterprise-scale Generative AI platforms and developer tooling.
This is an opportunity to work at the intersection of cloud-native engineering, distributed systems, and AI, helping deliver the next generation of AI-enabled capabilities within a global financial services environment.
We're looking for strong T-shaped engineers with deep expertise in Golang and broad engineering capability across Kubernetes, platform engineering, DevOps, scalability, and distributed systems. Commercial AI experience is not required, but a genuine interest in Generative AI and emerging technologies is essential.

 Essential functions

 • Design, develop and operate scalable backend services using Golang.

• Build cloud-native platforms supporting Generative AI and LLM-powered applications.

• Develop reusable libraries, frameworks and internal developer tooling.

• Design and implement distributed systems with a focus on reliability, performance and scalability.

• Collaborate with platform, infrastructure and AI engineering teams.

• Drive engineering best practices, observability, automation and operational excellence.

• Mentor engineers and contribute to technical leadership across the team.

 Qualifications

 • Strong commercial experience developing software in Golang.

• Deep understanding of distributed systems and backend architecture.

• Strong Kubernetes knowledge and experience running applications in production.

• Experience with microservices, APIs, event-driven architectures and cloud-native technologies.

• Strong understanding of CI/CD, DevOps and platform engineering principles.

• Experience building highly scalable, resilient systems.

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

Kubernetes
Candidates should possess a strong understanding of Kubernetes concepts equivalent to the core topics covered in Chapters 1–6 of:
Kubernetes in Action
Including:
• Pods, Deployments and ReplicaSets

• Services and Networking

• ConfigMaps and Secrets

• Resource Management

• Health Checks and Application Lifecycle

• Namespaces and Workload Management

• Kubernetes Architecture and Operational Concepts

 Would be a plus

 Generative AI
Commercial AI experience is not required.
However, candidates should demonstrate:
• Strong interest in Generative AI and LLM technologies.

• Understanding of modern AI tooling and frameworks.

• Experience experimenting with AI-assisted development tools.

• Curiosity around agentic systems, RAG architectures, and enterprise AI adoption.

Desirable Skills
• Experience with AI/ML platforms or developer productivity tooling.

• AWS, Azure or GCP experience.

• Experience with Kafka, messaging systems or event-driven architectures.

• Financial services or regulated industry experience.

• Platform Engineering or Internal Developer Platform experience.

 We offer

 • Opportunity to work on bleeding-edge projects

• Work with a highly motivated and dedicated team

• Competitive salary

• Flexible schedule

• Benefits package - medical insurance, sports

• Corporate social events

• Professional development opportunities

• Well-equipped office

We cannot offer Sponsorship for this role

 About us

 Grid Dynamics (NASDAQ: GDYN) is a leading provider of technology consulting, platform and product engineering, AI,
 and advanced analytics services. Fusing technical vision with business acumen, we solve the most pressing technical
 challenges and enable positive business outcomes for enterprise companies undergoing business transformation.
 A key differentiator for Grid Dynamics is our 8 years of experience and leadership in
 enterprise AI, supported by profound expertise and ongoing investment in
 data,
 analytics,
 cloud & DevOps,
 application modernization
 and customer experience.
 Founded in 2006, Grid Dynamics is headquartered in Silicon Valley with offices across the Americas, Europe, and India.
