 Senior Linux DevOps Engineer 

 London, United Kingdom

 Apply

 We are seeking a talented Linux DevOps Engineer for a Global Tier 1 bank client to join its growing technology organisation in London. This is an opportunity to work on large-scale, business-critical infrastructure supporting cloud platforms, AI-enabled services, and enterprise applications used across the bank.
You'll be part of a high-performing engineering team focused on automation, platform reliability, security, and operational excellence.

 Essential functions

 Key Responsibilities
• Design, build and support Linux-based infrastructure platforms.

• Develop and maintain automation solutions using Python, Bash, or similar scripting languages.

• Implement and manage Infrastructure as Code using tools such as Terraform and Ansible.

• Build and enhance CI/CD pipelines to improve software delivery and operational efficiency.

• Support containerised environments using Docker and Kubernetes.

• Collaborate with development, platform and security teams to deliver resilient, scalable solutions.

• Drive platform reliability, monitoring and continuous improvement initiatives.

 Qualifications

 Required Skills & Experience
• Strong Linux/Unix administration and troubleshooting experience.

• Proficiency in Python, Bash, Perl or similar scripting languages.

• Hands-on experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Ansible, CloudFormation or equivalent).

• Experience with container technologies including Docker and Kubernetes.

• Knowledge of CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, Bitbucket, GitLab or similar.

• Understanding of cloud-native architectures and modern DevOps practices.

• Strong problem-solving and communication skills.

 Would be a plus

 Desirable Skills
• Public cloud experience (AWS, Azure or GCP).

• Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) experience.

• Infrastructure security and compliance knowledge.

• Experience supporting AI/ML platforms.

• Financial services or regulated industry experience.

 We offer

• Opportunity to work on bleeding-edge projects

• Work with a highly motivated and dedicated team

• Competitive salary

• Flexible schedule

• Benefits package - medical insurance, sports

• Corporate social events

• Professional development opportunities

• Well-equipped office

 About us

 Grid Dynamics (NASDAQ: GDYN) is a leading provider of technology consulting, platform and product engineering, AI,
 and advanced analytics services. Fusing technical vision with business acumen, we solve the most pressing technical
 challenges and enable positive business outcomes for enterprise companies undergoing business transformation.
 A key differentiator for Grid Dynamics is our 8 years of experience and leadership in
 enterprise AI, supported by profound expertise and ongoing investment in
 data,
 analytics,
 cloud & DevOps,
 application modernization
 and customer experience.
 Founded in 2006, Grid Dynamics is headquartered in Silicon Valley with offices across the Americas, Europe, and India.

 Senior React Engineer 

 London, United Kingdom

 Apply

 We are seeking a highly skilled Senior React Engineer to join a front-office technology team responsible for building next-generation electronic trading and market data applications.
This is an opportunity to work on highly performant, real-time systems used by traders and sales teams globally. You'll be responsible for building responsive, data-intensive user interfaces that process and visualise large volumes of streaming market data while maintaining exceptional user experience and performance.

 Essential functions

 As a Senior React Engineer, you will work closely with frontend, backend and business stakeholders to deliver mission-critical trading applications. You'll play a key role in designing frontend architecture, optimising performance, and ensuring applications remain responsive under heavy data loads.
This position is ideal for engineers who enjoy solving complex performance challenges and building sophisticated products in low-latency environments.
Key Responsibilities
• Design and develop high-performance web applications using React and TypeScript.

• Build and maintain real-time user interfaces consuming large volumes of streaming market data.

• Optimise browser performance, rendering pipelines, memory usage and application responsiveness.

• Work closely with backend engineering teams to integrate low-latency data services.

• Contribute to frontend architecture, technical standards and engineering best practices.

• Develop robust testing strategies and maintain high levels of application quality.

• Participate in system design discussions and performance tuning initiatives.

• Support the evolution of trading and market data platforms used globally.

 Qualifications

 Essential Skills & Experience
• Strong commercial experience developing applications using React and TypeScript.

• Experience delivering production-grade frontend systems in trading, market data, financial services or other high-throughput environments.

• Deep understanding of browser internals, rendering performance, virtualisation, memory management and frontend optimisation techniques.

• Experience consuming and managing real-time data feeds using WebSockets, pub/sub messaging or similar technologies.

• Understanding of concepts such as backpressure, reconnection handling, snapshots and state recovery.

• Strong understanding of software engineering best practices, testing and code quality.

• Experience with Playwright, Cypress, Selenium or similar testing frameworks.

• Ability to understand and troubleshoot backend services, particularly Java-based systems.

 Would be a plus

 Desirable Experience
• Experience migrating Angular or AngularJS applications to React.

• Knowledge of low-latency messaging platforms such as Solace, Tibco EMS, Kafka or Aeron.

• Familiarity with binary protocols and wire formats including SBE, FlatBuffers or Protobuf.

• Experience with AG Grid or similar enterprise-grade data grid frameworks.

• Exposure to containerised deployment environments and cloud-native architectures.

• Experience building applications for electronic trading, order management, market making, RFQ/RFS workflows or single dealer platforms.

Domain Knowledge
Experience within financial markets is highly desirable, particularly in:
• Foreign Exchange (FX)

• Spot and Forward Trading

• FX Options

• Pricing and Market Making

• Transaction Cost Analysis (TCA)

• Market Data Platforms

• Work with a highly motivated and dedicated team

• Competitive salary

• Flexible schedule

• Benefits package - medical insurance, sports

• Corporate social events

• Professional development opportunities

• Well-equipped office

 Senior Service Designer - CSS/HTML, Figma Make, and Claude - Investment Bank 

 London, United Kingdom

 Apply

 Grid Dynamics/JUXT is partnering with a Tier 1 investment bank, within its Production Management organisation, seeking a Senior Service Designer to create outstanding user-centred experiences. You’ll provide journey maps and service blueprints that put the user at the heart of the solution, lead the design effort, and promote cultural change across the organisation, managing stakeholder relationships and the overall user journey and elevating design standards and frameworks into the engineering teams’ workflows.

 Essential functions

 Senior Service Designer – Production Management 

 London, United Kingdom

 Apply

 The Opportunity
JUXT is partnering with a Tier 1 investment bank within its Production Management organisation to appoint a Senior Service Designer who can put user-centred design at the heart of complex technology and production services.
This is a hands-on service design role focused on understanding users, mapping end-to-end journeys and translating complex, ambiguous requirements into intuitive and effective experiences.
You will lead design activities across the programme, work closely with engineering and business stakeholders, and help embed stronger service design practices into the organisation's technology delivery processes.
About the Role
As a Senior Service Designer, you will own and shape the overall user journey, ensuring that user needs remain central from discovery through to implementation.
You will use service design techniques including journey mapping, service blueprints, personas, user research, prototyping and usability testing to understand problems and develop practical solutions.
You will also play an important role in influencing the organisation's design culture, helping engineering teams adopt stronger user-centred design principles, frameworks and practices.

 Essential functions

 Key Responsibilities
• Lead service design activities across complex technology and Production Management initiatives.

• Create detailed journey maps and service blueprints that connect business requirements to clear user experiences.

• Develop personas and user journeys to establish a cohesive understanding of user needs.

• Create intuitive wireframes, prototypes and mock-ups using Figma.

• Facilitate design-thinking workshops with business, technology and engineering stakeholders.

• Run both in-person and remote workshops, capturing outcomes and translating them into actionable design decisions.

• Conduct user research and usability testing to validate designs and understand user behaviour.

• Gather and incorporate feedback throughout the design and implementation lifecycle.

• Collaborate closely with development and engineering teams to ensure technical implementation meets user needs.

• Present design concepts, strategies, research findings and recommendations to stakeholders at all levels.

• Communicate complex design concepts clearly to both technical audiences and senior leadership.

• Manage stakeholder relationships across a complex enterprise environment.

• Build networks across internal teams and leverage external resources where appropriate.

• Champion user-centred design principles across engineering and delivery teams.

• Help establish and embed service design frameworks and standards into engineering workflows.

• Identify opportunities to improve the overall service and remove friction from user journeys.

• Stay current with service design trends and introduce innovative approaches where they can create measurable value.

 Qualifications

 Essential Experience
Service Design
• Proven experience working as a Service Designer within complex organisations.

• Demonstrable experience delivering business outcomes through innovative, user-centred design.

• Experience working closely with development teams, engineers and business stakeholders.

• Strong experience creating:
• Journey maps

• Service blueprints

• Personas

• Wireframes

• Prototypes

• User journeys

• Ability to take large, ambiguous requirements and translate them into a coherent persona and service narrative.

Figma
Strong practical experience with Figma, including:
• Clickable prototypes

• Wireframes

• Mock-ups

• Collaborative design

• Presenting design concepts

• Supporting workshops and stakeholder engagement

Research & Testing
• Experience conducting user research and usability testing.

• Ability to gather qualitative and quantitative feedback.

• Experience using feedback to iterate and improve designs.

• Ability to ensure that both design and technical implementation remain aligned with user needs.

Stakeholder Management
• Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.

• Comfortable presenting to audiences ranging from technical specialists to senior leadership.

• Ability to explain complex design concepts in a clear and compelling way.

• Proven ability to influence stakeholders and drive decisions.

• Experience navigating complex enterprise structures and building relationships across multiple teams.

Service Design Methodologies
Strong knowledge of established service design approaches, including practical experience with frameworks such as the Double Diamond.
You should be able to apply service design methodology pragmatically rather than treating frameworks as a rigid process.

 Would be a plus

 Desirable Skills
The following would be advantageous:
• HTML / CSS knowledge.

• Figma Make.

• Claude or other AI-assisted design/development tools.

• Experience working in financial services or another highly regulated environment.

• Experience with large-scale enterprise technology programmes.

• Experience embedding service design practices into engineering teams.

• Experience driving organisational or cultural change.

The Environment
You will work within the Production Management organisation of a Tier 1 global investment bank.
The organisation supports business-critical production and technology services across a demanding regulated environment, working to high standards across engineering, operational resilience and delivery.
You will work closely with engineering, architecture, business and senior leadership teams, helping ensure that user needs are properly understood and reflected throughout the delivery lifecycle.
Why Join?
This is an opportunity to put user-centred design at the heart of production and reporting systems within a Tier 1 investment bank.
You will have genuine scope to influence how services are designed, delivered and experienced, while helping drive cultural change and raise service design standards across engineering teams.

 Senior/Principal Java Developer - Low Latency - Financial Services 

 London, United Kingdom

 Apply

 We are looking for low-latency Java Developers to join our clients FX eTrading team. The developers will be on a low-latency drive, finding and eliminating sources of long-tail latency and developing zero-gc solutions and code. Some domain knowledge of FX is valuable though not essential.

 Essential functions

 In this role you will:
-You will build and maintain Java applications in areas of banking and trading that require the highest levels of performance.
-Build and maintain testing and benchmarking code.
-Use systematic approaches to find and eliminate bottlenecks to improve the performance.

 Qualifications

 What we are looking for in a candidate:
-Proven track record in implementing high performance and low latency systems on the JVM have a deep knowledge of JVM internals (including garbage collection, concurrency, locking, etc) and is an expert in the Java language.

 Would be a plus

 Java (low-latency, high-performance, zero-gc), Ambrosia, Grafana, KDB, FX or trading experience is a plus.

 We offer

• Opportunity to work on bleeding-edge projects

• Work with a highly motivated and dedicated team

• Competitive salary

• Flexible schedule

• Benefits package - medical insurance, sports

• Corporate social events

• Professional development opportunities

• Well-equipped office

 About us

 Grid Dynamics (NASDAQ: GDYN) is a leading provider of technology consulting, platform and product engineering, AI,
 and advanced analytics services. Fusing technical vision with business acumen, we solve the most pressing technical
 challenges and enable positive business outcomes for enterprise companies undergoing business transformation.
 A key differentiator for Grid Dynamics is our 8 years of experience and leadership in
 enterprise AI, supported by profound expertise and ongoing investment in
 data,
 analytics,
 cloud & DevOps,
 application modernization
 and customer experience.
 Founded in 2006, Grid Dynamics is headquartered in Silicon Valley with offices across the Americas, Europe, and India.

 Senior/Principal Java Engineer - Low Latency 

 London, United Kingdom

 Apply

 We're looking for Senior and Principal Java Developers with a strong background in low-latency systems to join us on a high-performance trading and real-time data project, for a major financial institution.
You'll be joining an environment where good software engineering truly matters 6 where clean design, measurable performance, and deep system understanding are valued. This is an opportunity to work alongside recognised low-latency specialists, elevate your expertise, and contribute to systems that demand precision and technical excellence.
We're looking for developers who are technically exceptional, but also pragmatic 6 engineers who love to understand how things work under the hood, measure performance precisely, and continuously refine their craft.

 Essential functions

 You'll work on mission-critical applications where performance, scalability, and reliability truly matter 6 the kind of systems that power global trading platforms and require a deep understanding of how the JVM and Linux really work. This is an opportunity to bring world-class engineering principles to projects at the very heart of modern finance.
Your work will focus on writing and tuning high-performance Java frameworks, improving throughput and latency, and applying event-driven, microservice-based architectures. You'll collaborate closely with other talented engineers, helping to shape elegant solutions to complex, performance-sensitive problems.

 Qualifications

 Core Skills
• Strong Java skills with deep knowledge of the JVM

• Proven experience building or optimising low-latency systems

• Familiarity with performance tuning and profiling tools (e.g. JMH, async-profiler, Flight Recorder)

• Solid understanding of multithreading, concurrency, and memory management

• Experience with microservice architectures and event-driven systems

• Strong Linux fundamentals and comfort with performance diagnostics

• Clear communication skills and ability to articulate design and performance decisions

 Would be a plus

Nice To Have
• Experience with high-performance messaging (Chronicle Queue/Wire, Aeron, ZeroMQ, Kafka tuning)

• Familiarity with off-heap or direct memory structures (Chronicle Map, VarHandles, DirectByteBuffers)

• Networking/I/O frameworks such as Netty or custom FIX engines

• Exposure to OpenHFT, LMAX Disruptor, or similar performance-focused frameworks

• Prior experience in trading, financial markets, or real-time data systems

• Ability to produce clear, lightweight documentation or UML diagrams when needed

 We offer

 • Opportunity to work on bleeding-edge projects

• Work with a highly motivated and dedicated team

• Competitive salary

• Flexible schedule

• Benefits package - medical insurance, sports

• Corporate social events

• Professional development opportunities

• Well-equipped office

 About us

 Grid Dynamics (NASDAQ: GDYN) is a leading provider of technology consulting, platform and product engineering, AI, and advanced analytics services. Fusing technical vision with business acumen, we solve the most pressing technical challenges and enable positive business outcomes for enterprise companies undergoing business transformation. A key differentiator for Grid Dynamics is our 8 years of experience and leadership in enterprise AI, supported by profound expertise and ongoing investment in data, analytics, cloud & DevOps, application modernization and customer experience. Founded in 2006, Grid Dynamics is headquartered in Silicon Valley with offices across the Americas, Europe, and India.

What You Will Do: 

 The Managed Care Contracting and Performance Advisor is responsible for strategic management, evaluation, negotiation, implementation, and ongoing performance monitoring of managed care contracts. This role partners closely with Finance, Revenue Cycle, Operations, Physician Services, and payer organizations to optimize reimbursement, mitigate contractual risk, improve operational performance, and maximize revenue opportunities across hospital and physician service lines.

The position serves as a subject matter expert in managed care reimbursement methodologies, contract language interpretation, payer negotiations, and contract compliance, while driving initiatives that improve financial outcomes and payer relationships.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

Contract Evaluation and Analysis:

• Conduct comprehensive reviews and audits of existing managed care contracts to identify opportunities for reimbursement improvement, contract optimization, and renegotiation.
• Perform financial modeling and reimbursement analyses to assess the impact of proposed rate changes, contract amendments, and new payer arrangements.
• Evaluate contract language to identify operational, financial, and compliance risks.
• Assess reimbursement methodologies, payment policies, authorization requirements, carve-outs, and contractual obligations to ensure alignment with organizational objectives.
• Develop business cases and executive-level recommendations to support contract strategy decisions.

Payer Negotiation and Relationship Management:

• Develop and execute strategic negotiation plans for commercial, Medicare Advantage, Managed Medicaid, and other managed care payers.
• Support payer negotiations involving reimbursement rates, contract language, payment methodologies, revenue protection provisions, and operational requirements.
• Analyze payer proposals and prepare counterproposals supported by financial and operational data.
• Maintain ongoing communication with payer representatives to resolve negotiation issues and facilitate contract execution.
• Build and maintain productive payer relationships that support long-term organizational goals.

Contract Implementation and Operational Support:

• Coordinate implementation activities related to new or amended managed care agreements.
• Collaborate with Finance, Revenue Cycle, Patient Access, Case Management, and Physician Services teams to ensure operational readiness.
• Develop and maintain contract summaries, reimbursement guides, and reference materials that translate contract terms into operational requirements.
• Support payer configuration, billing implementation, reimbursement validation, and operational education following contract execution.
• Serve as a liaison between internal stakeholders and payer organizations to resolve contract interpretation questions and post-implementation issues.

Performance Monitoring and Revenue Improvement:

• Establish and monitor key performance indicators related to managed care contract performance, including reimbursement accuracy, denial trends, payment timeliness, underpayment activity, and revenue yield.
• Partner with Revenue Cycle leadership to interpret contractual intent and support operational compliance with contract terms.
• Investigate, escalate, and assist in resolving complex underpayment, denial, and reimbursement disputes.
• Analyze payer performance trends and identify opportunities for revenue recovery and contract compliance improvements.
• Prepare executive-level reports and presentations summarizing contract performance, negotiation progress, financial impact, and strategic recommendations.

Strategic Initiatives:

• Identify and evaluate new payer, IPA, medical group, and physician contracting opportunities.
• Support physician network and medical group contracting strategies designed to expand patient access and referral opportunities.
• Assist with value-based care, risk-based contracting, and alternative payment model initiatives as appropriate.
• Contribute to the development of managed care strategies that support organizational growth, financial sustainability, and market expansion.

Success in this role will be measured by:

• Improved managed care reimbursement rates and contract terms.
• Successful implementation of negotiated agreements.
• Reduction in underpayments, denials, and payment variances.
• Increased contract compliance and operational effectiveness.
• Positive financial impact from payer negotiations and contract optimization efforts.
• Timely resolution of payer disputes and reimbursement issues.
• Strong collaborative relationships with internal stakeholders and payer partners.

What You Will Need:

• Requires a bachelor's degree and a minimum 6-8+ years or an AA degree and 8-10+ years of prior relevant experience. (Relevant experience may be substituted for formal education or advanced degree.)
• Relevant experience coming from a healthcare provider, central business office environment, managed care, contracting, healthcare finance, payer relations, related healthcare administrative roles or revenue cycle outsourcing company.

What Would Be Nice To Have: 

• Demonstrated experience negotiating managed care agreements with commercial and government-sponsored health plans.
• Experience performing reimbursement analyses, financial modeling, and contract reviews.
• Knowledge of hospital and physician reimbursement methodologies, including Medicare, Medicaid/Medi-Cal, DRG, APC, fee schedules, capitation, and value-based payment models.
• Strong understanding of managed care contract language and reimbursement structures.
• Advanced analytical and financial modeling skills.
• Ability to interpret complex contractual and reimbursement provisions.
• Negotiation, communication, and relationship-management skills.
• Ability to work effectively across multiple departments and levels of the organization.
• Strong project management and organizational skills.
• Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and healthcare financial analytics tools.

80% of the world’s supply chain depends upon H&C’s data science. We deliver solutions in a diverse range of domains, including offshore wind turbine optimisation, minimising environmental impact of Railways, improving resilience of global shipping lanes, and reducing the amount of timber required by the world’s largest pallet network. ## The role

We make innovative use of simulation, network science and game theory. Our models generate synthetic data which is analysed using bayesian and frequentist statistical techniques. The analysis is delivered in digital interactive portals, as well written reports. The data scientist role will contribute to all aspects of this process, although there will be opportunities to specialise according to interest and aptitude.

You will be working in small agile project teams of exceptional people. Your primary duties will include coding simulation logic and the analysis of synthetic data. All members of the team are encouraged to contribute creative ideas and help formulate research questions. We value experimentation and are quick to embrace new ideas and techniques if they seem promising. You will have the opportunity to help shape our approach to new research, and will be expected to actively contribute to discussions.

We are Havas Market, part of the Havas Media Network. We believe in in the fusion of commerce and performance to drive limitless performance. We break down barriers between commerce and performance to build cohesive multichannel purchase experiences, that powerfully combine tech and human flair. 
Havas Market expertise spans four core specialist services: paid media (PPC, paid social, shopping international), owned (SEO, CRO, content, creative, localisation), commerce (Amazon, Marketplaces, Retail Media, social commerce) and earned (digital PR, social).

We help clients to: 

• Connect with the human behind the click ​– we harness human-led planning and technology to create experiences that connect more deeply and drive superior digital performance.​ 

• Capture meaningful metrics that matter – we focus on meaningful results that drive business impact, not just superficial metrics, ensuring client strategy delivers real commercial success. 

• Combine curious minds and powerful technology – we turn data into actionable insights, all powered and delivered by cutting-edge technology, giving clients a competitive edge in market.

THE ROLE:

As a Paid Performance Director, you will be a performance specialist with extensive search management experience and client facing skills. You will drive the strategy and lead on the implementation of innovative, new solutions for your clients. 

In this role, you will lead an exciting portfolio of the UK’s biggest retailers. These clients are well loved, household brands, specialising in Health and Beauty with multi-million-pound budgets. You will be responsible for the search product, service delivery and would be a senior client contact for all client stakeholders. There will be a heavy client facing element to this role, as you’ll lead the overall client relationship for search performance and strategy for your clients.

A principal element of the role will be to lead a team of paid performance specialists, including Paid Performance Managers and Paid Performance Executives, to deliver paid search performance according to client requirements and targets. You will have autonomy in this role to lead and develop your team, so it’s essential you have a proactive attitude and a real hunger for success. 

Additionally, as Paid Performance Director, you will be heavily involved in new business – leading research, strategy, output and ultimately representing the agency successfully and professionally in pitches.

Capability (leadership, specialism) 
• Oversee optimisation of campaigns through utilisation of bid management tools to deliver on-going paid performance.
• Drive best practice throughout not just your team, but the wider paid search team too; specifically improving the quality of campaign delivery, innovation, and automation. 
• Be a digital leader, not only supporting Havas Market, but engaging in knowledge sharing with your peers across the Paid Performance network. 
• Complete and manage the forecast/ plan of monthly budgets in-line with client objectives and targets.
• Assist and lead the managers with development and planning of search marketing strategy.
• Work closely with other Havas teams to enhance cross-channel integration, in terms of strategy, execution and measurement while also ensuring consistent approach for clients.
• Continuously look for opportunities to drive commerciality for the agency through cross sell of other Havas Market and Havas Media Network services. Having an in-depth knowledge and understanding of these services is critical.
• Identify opportunities to develop new solutions for clients or productise existing capabilities to new streams of agency revenues.
• Contribute to new business prospecting and business development meetings for Havas Market, and where relevant, the Network.

Management (people and development)

• Ensure direct reports have timely appraisals, logged into the TalentSpace HR portal. 
• Develop paid search expertise, tech knowledge, and all-round skill set of all your direct reports.

• Client facing presentations on strategy, campaign recommendations, and subsequent results.

• Bridge relationships across the paid team, ensuring close working collaboration across all pods within Paid Performance.

job_description:
Ready to revolutionize healthcare, making it faster and more accessible than ever before? 

How we started:

Founded in 2013 by Dwayne D’Souza, HeliosX was built on a simple but powerful idea: healthcare should be easier to access, faster to receive, and centred around the individual. From day one, we’ve grown without external funding; scaling profitably through technology, disciplined execution, and deep medical expertise. What started as a challenger idea has become one of the most significant healthcare platforms operating globally today.

Where we are now:

We’ve earned the trust of millions of people worldwide through category-leading products and well-known brands, including MedExpress, Dermatica, ZipHealth, RocketRX, and Levity. A key driver of our success is vertical integration; we operate our own manufacturing and proprietary products, led by in-house medical teams, researchers, and pharmacists at the top of their fields.

In 2025, HeliosX treated more than 1.7 million patients globally and reached £781m in revenue, representing +337% year-on-year growth and cementing our position as the clear market leader in the UK. That growth translates into real-world outcomes: our weight-loss treatments helped patients lose 8.5 million kilograms of excess weight in 2025 alone, contributing to an estimated 1,300 fewer cardiac events. This is growth with measurable, life-changing impact at scale.

Today, we operate across four international markets, with successful launches in Germany and Canada and continued expansion in the US. We were also recently recognised in the Sunday Times Top 100 fastest-growing tech companies, further validation of both our momentum and our ambition.

Where we’re going:

2026 is another significant year for HeliosX. Our ambition is to surpass £1.1bn in revenue, continue expanding thoughtfully into new international markets and broaden our condition and treatment portfolio. As we scale, we're focused on building the technology, operational excellence and clinical capabilities that will support sustainable long-term growth. Joining HeliosX now means helping shape the systems, teams and products that will define the next chapter of digital healthcare. You'll be solving complex problems at pace, working alongside exceptional people and building products that genuinely improve lives at scale.

There’s never been a more exciting time to join HeliosX. Come be a part of making our dream of easier and faster healthcare a reality!

The Opportunity

We're looking for a HR Business Partner (or an Advisor looking to step into a partnering role) for a 12 month maternity cover to support our operations hub of around c. 140 people, split across physical operations and clinical roles. By understanding the unique needs of fast-paced, operational environments, they will shape and deliver people strategies that build managerial capability, strengthen culture, and enable teams to thrive. This role is pivotal in supporting leaders to develop their teams, foster motivation and wellbeing, and deliver sustainable growth outcomes across HeliosX's physical operations.

What You'll Do

• Partner with leaders in our operational hub to shape and deliver people strategies that enhance performance and capability

• Coach managers to set clear expectations, give effective feedback, and differentiate performance confidently

• Embed performance frameworks that balance pace, creativity, and wellbeing to build high-performing teams

• Use people insight and data to identify risks and opportunities, supporting engagement, retention, and sustainable culture

• Lead initiatives that strengthen team motivation, wellbeing, and collaboration

• Advise on workforce planning and capability development to enable scaling and growth

• Support leaders through change with clarity, consistency, and care for their teams

• Provide pragmatic, people-focused HR advice that reflects the realities of a busy operational environment

What You'll Bring to HeliosX

• Experience in business partnering experience in fast-paced environments, or experience supporting and working closely with Business Partners

• Experience in an operational environment (e.g. manufacturing, retail, or a scale-up with a warehouse or physical operations component)

• You want a standalone role, and can comfortably shift between operational and strategic work

• Can coach managers to improve performance, accountability, and team effectiveness

• Able senior stakeholders in fast-moving, high-pressure settings

• Ability to balance performance expectations with wellbeing and sustainable culture

• Emotionally intelligent, adaptable, and credible with high-performing teams

• Comfortable using people data to inform decisions and shape proactive strategies

• Genuine energy for engagement and culture-building work

Life at HeliosX

At HeliosX, we want to improve healthcare for everyone, and to do this we need a team of brilliant people who share that ambition. We are currently a diverse team of engineers, scientists, clinical researchers, physicians, pharmacists, marketeers, and customer care specialists committed to our mission - but we need more talented folks to join us if we want to achieve our global ambitions!

Overview: 20 Hrs per week, Monday to Thursday (2pm to 7pm)

The position of Operations Assistant covers all jobs and work in the warehouse relating to the receipt, locating, replenishing, counting, picking, checking, packing and despatch of goods; the accurate and timely processing of customer sales orders and returns.

Job Responsibilities:
The role holder will be expected to be responsible for the following:
• Accept deliveries inbound. Record purchase order details onto the daily log.
• Unpack, check and put received goods to correct warehouse locations.
• Complete stock replenishments as directed. Ensure accurate and timely stock movement reporting to maintain the highest possible levels of location accuracy.
• Undertake cyclical stock counts as directed.
• Select goods for customer sales orders from their designated ‘Fixed’ stock locations. Securely pack sales orders in appropriate transit packaging & attach the customer’s address label.
• Carry out 100% checks on all picked orders.
• Process customer returned goods as per written instructions.
• To maintain the highest standards of Housekeeping by adhering to cleaning plans as per instruction from your Team Leader.
• To fully comply with all Health and Safety requirements and instruction given.
• Cover other duties as may be requested from time to time by any member of the Operations Dept. Management Team.
Job Skills & Experience Required:

To succeed in this role, you’ll need the following:
Qualifications:
• Basic literacy and numeracy are essential for covering the core duties of the role.

Skill & Experience:
• Experience working in fast paced environment
• Ability to work under pressure and to time constraints
• Reach Truck and Order Picker certification desirable 

Person Specification: 
We believe the type of person best suited to this role will be:
• Flexibility of working hours and the ability to work overtime when required are essential.
• The ability to work as a team member within the group and to co-operate with other departments is a necessary requirement for this position.

• Bring your experience and enthusiasm to our engineering culture.

• Participate in planning sessions, retrospectives, stand-ups and demos

• You’re excited about understanding the real problems working people come up against and fixing them with technology

• Python on the server side, using Django Rest Framework for our API and PostgreSQL for our database

• GitHub, Codeship and Heroku for seamless code review, integration and deployment

• AWS S3, CloudFront and Lambda for storage and content delivery

job_title: Junior Business Analyst and Project Analyst
job_description:
About DUAL

Working across 21 countries, DUAL has built a reputation as a specialist underwriting group and the market of choice for insurance intermediaries around the world. That’s how we have become one of the world’s largest international underwriting agencies (or MGAs) with US$3.4bn GWP.

DUAL is part of Howden, a leading global insurance group with employee ownership at its heart. Founded in 1994, it provides insurance, reinsurance and underwriting services to clients ranging from private individuals to the largest multinational companies. The Group operates in 57 countries, employs over 24,000 people and manages premiums totalling US$50bn on behalf of its clients.

ROLE OVERVIEW

We are seeking a proactive and highly organised Junior Business Analyst and Project Analyst to support the delivery of multiple business, reporting and automation projects. This is an excellent opportunity for an ambitious individual looking to develop a career in business analysis, project coordination, data analytics and process improvement.
The successful candidate will work with business stakeholders and the MI team to maintain project governance, document requirements, support executive reporting, produce management pack slides and contribute to technology-enabled process improvements.

CORE CAPABILITY MIX

Expected Contribution

Business Analysis
Requirements gathering, process mapping, user stories, functional specifications and UAT support.
Project Administration
Action logs, RAID logs, meeting packs, minutes, governance tracking and deadline follow-up.
Management Packs
Monthly and quarterly PowerPoint packs, executive summaries, KPI narratives and visual presentation of performance.
Data and Reporting
Excel analysis, data validation, reconciliation, Power BI support and data quality investigation.
Process Improvement
Identification of manual pain points, documentation of controls and support for automation opportunities.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Business Analysis
• Gather and document business requirements from stakeholders.

• Assist with workshops, discovery sessions and requirement gathering activities.

• Produce process maps, workflow diagrams and functional specifications.

• Document current-state and future-state processes.

• Support User Acceptance Testing, including test scripts, defect tracking and issue follow-up.

• Maintain requirements documentation throughout the project lifecycle.

• Help translate business requirements into practical reporting, process or automation solutions.

Project Administration and Governance
• Provide administrative support across multiple projects and business change initiatives.

• Maintain project plans, action logs, RAID logs, decision registers and status trackers.

• Track project milestones, deliverables, deadlines and dependencies.

• Coordinate project meetings, workshops and stakeholder forums.

• Prepare agendas, meeting packs and supporting presentation material.

• Produce accurate meeting minutes and clearly summarise actions, owners and due dates.

• Follow up with stakeholders to ensure actions are progressed and governance records remain current.

• Support project reporting, resource planning and work allocation activities.

Management Information and Executive Reporting
• Support the production of monthly and quarterly management information packs.

• Produce high-quality PowerPoint slides for leadership, executive and committee meetings.

• Collate reporting inputs from multiple stakeholders, systems and data sources.

• Create charts, visualisations, KPI summaries and concise narrative updates.

• Ensure reporting packs are accurate, consistent, professional and delivered to agreed deadlines.

• Support the continuous improvement of management pack formats, templates and production processes.

• Assist with the preparation of steering committee updates, project summaries and business review materials.

Data Analysis and Reporting
• Analyse business data to identify trends, risks, issues and opportunities.

• Support the production and maintenance of Power BI reporting solutions.

• Produce ad-hoc analysis and regular management reports.

• Investigate data issues and reporting discrepancies.

• Perform data validation, reconciliation and quality assurance activity.

• Support data cleansing, migration and documentation exercises where required.

• Help maintain reporting documentation, business definitions and data quality controls.

Process Improvement and Automation
• Review existing manual processes and identify opportunities for simplification, control or automation.

• Document recommended improvements, risks, dependencies and benefits.

• Support business automation initiatives using modern Microsoft technologies.

• Assist with the implementation and adoption of new systems, reports and processes.

• Contribute to continuous improvement activities across the MI function.

• Help monitor benefits realisation following completed process improvements.

Stakeholder Engagement
• Build positive working relationships with stakeholders across the business.

• Communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical audiences.

• Support project communications, progress updates and stakeholder follow-up.

• Assist with managing expectations throughout project delivery.

• Work collaboratively with business teams to understand operational requirements and reporting needs.

ABOUT HYPEREXPONENTIAL (HX)

At hyperexponential, we're building the AI-powered platform that enables the world's most critical decisions in a $7 trillion industry - which risks to take, and how to price them. These are the decisions that shape real-world outcomes: whether rockets successfully launch into space, autonomous vehicles make it to market, or communities recover after major storms.

Until now, insurance has been making billion-dollar decisions using outdated tools. We're changing that. Our platform brings together data, AI, and human expertise to give insurers the fastest path from submission to decision - helping them move faster, act smarter, and take on more risk with confidence.

Backed by a16z, Highland Europe, and Battery Ventures, we're scaling globally - already trusted by nearly 50 of the world's largest insurers, with zero churn and billions in premiums flowing through hx.

What began as a single product in one market has rapidly evolved into a multi-product, multi-territory platform powering every stage of pricing and underwriting. AI is at the core of what we do - from building the world's first domain-specific AI peer programmer for insurance (think GitHub Copilot with a PhD in actuarial science) to shaping agentic workflows that reinvent how this industry operates.

What makes hx different is the people who build it. Here, impact isn't tied to title or tenure; it's defined by the challenges you take on and the discipline you bring. Surrounded by peers who stretch you, you'll do the best, hardest work of your life in a company engineered to endure.

If that sounds like you, join us in building what comes next.




ABOUT THE ENGINEERING TEAM

At hyperexponential, engineering is at the heart of our mission to transform the insurance industry. Our engineers build and scale, enabling insurers to model complex risks and make smarter pricing decisions at speed. By combining deep technical expertise with creativity, the team pushes the boundaries of what’s possible in insurance technology.

Within engineering, our product teams are cross-functional, pairing frontend and backend engineers with designers and product managers. This enables end-to-end ownership of features, with engineers contributing across design, architecture, implementation, and testing. Collaboration is a core part of how we work, ensuring that every release is both technically sound and valuable to our users.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Underwriters at the world's largest insurers still do much of their work in spreadsheets, email threads, and systems that were never designed for the decisions they are making. We are rebuilding that from the ground up.

You will join the Workflow Underwriting stream, building the next generation of our underwriting platform. This is not a platform with AI features bolted on. We are designing it around the agents we build, which means the architecture, the domain model, and the interaction patterns are all genuinely open questions. You will help answer them.

You will contribute at code, architecture, and domain level from your first weeks, and you will talk directly to the underwriters who use what you build.

 


WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

 - Design, build, and operate backend services in Kotlin or Java, and own them in production.

 - Turn ambiguous underwriting problems into simple, reliable software. Much of the work is deciding what to build, not just building it.

 - Shape architectural decisions: APIs, domain models, persistence, reliability, observability, and how the platform evolves without collapsing under its own weight.

 - Build real depth in the underwriting domain, to the point where you can challenge a requirement rather than only implement it.

 - Design and build agent-assisted workflows, and make judgement calls about where an agent should act, where it should advise, and where a human must stay in control.

 - Use AI coding tools, including Claude, as a core part of how you work. You delegate substantial work to them and you remain accountable for the quality, security, and correctness of everything you ship.

 - Work across boundaries with frontend engineers, product partners, and client-facing teams, and step outside your specialism when the problem demands it.

 - Give and take direct feedback, and raise the engineering bar around you.

 


WHAT YOU’LL NEED TO HAVE DONE

 - Strong professional experience building and running backend systems in Kotlin, Java, or another JVM language.

 - Judgement in architecture and system design: a feel for what to build now, what to defer, and what will hurt in two years.

 - Evidence of shipping software that solved a real customer or business problem, ideally something you owned end to end.

 - A self-starting approach. You find the highest-value problem rather than waiting for a ticket.

 - Clear communication. You can hold the same conversation with an underwriter, an executive, and an engineer, and adjust for each.

 - Genuine appetite for problems with no known answer, and comfort working without a precedent to copy.

 - Confident, responsible use of AI coding tools, with a critical eye on their output.

 - Receptiveness to feedback. We give it directly and often, and we expect you to give it back.

 


HELPFUL, NOT REQUIRED

 - Experience in insurance, underwriting, or another complex regulated domain. We will teach you the domain. We cannot teach curiosity about it.

 - Experience across both backend and frontend.

 - Experience building workflow, decision-support, or agent-assisted products.

 - Experience working directly with enterprise clients.

 


YOU’RE UNLIKELY TO THRIVE HERE IF

 - You prefer following detailed instructions rather than experimenting and finding your own approach.

 - You are uncomfortable working directly with non-technical stakeholders to understand their challenges.

 - You avoid tackling ambiguous or open-ended problems where the solution isn’t obvious.

If reading our Culture Document https://hx.wiki/ leaves you feeling neutral rather than energised, hx may not be the place where you’ll do your best work. We’re building something that asks for commitment and conviction, and we want you to feel excited by the opportunity to grow with us.

 


COMPENSATION

At hx, we’re committed to salary transparency. You’ll always have clarity on pay early in the process - our Talent Partner will share details with you during initial conversations - and we’re working towards publishing salary information for all roles globally.

Because we’re building at the intersection of technology/SaaS and insurance, our roles don’t always map neatly onto traditional benchmarks. Our approach is to design compensation that’s competitive in the market, fair across teams, and aligned with the impact our people make.




BENEFITS

£5,000 training and conference budget for individual and group development.

25 days of holiday plus 8 bank holidays (33 days total).

Company pension scheme via Penfold.

Mental health support and therapy via Spectrum.life http://Spectrum.life.

Individual wellbeing allowance via Juno.

Private healthcare insurance through AXA.

Income protection and Life Insurance.

Cycle to Work Scheme.

 


ADDITIONAL PERKS

Top-spec equipment (laptop, screens, adjustable desks, etc.).

Regular remote and in-person hackathons, lunch and learns, socials, and game nights.

Team breakfasts and lunches, snacks, drinks fridge, and a fun office at The Ministry.

Exceptional opportunities for personal development and growth as we build something remarkable together.

 


INTERVIEW PROCESS

 1. Initial chat with our Talent team

 2. Manager Interview

 3. Technical Assessment (e.g., code review, system design)

 4. Values Interview

 5. Meet the CEO

 6. We offer!

 


OUR COMMITMENT TO DIVERSITY

hxers are at the centre of everything we build. We know that progress depends on diverse perspectives, and we are committed to creating an environment where everyone can thrive, grow, and make an impact. We recognise there is always more to do, and we take responsibility for shaping a workplace that is not only diverse but genuinely inclusive.

Diversity is not just the right thing to do, it is key to solving the complex challenges we choose to take on. By welcoming people from all backgrounds and experiences, we strengthen our ability to question assumptions, push boundaries, and design solutions that endure.

If you're energised by complexity and motivated to grow, we encourage you to apply and join our global team.

 


NEXT STEPS

If this opportunity resonates with you, we encourage you to apply or share it with your connections! Our dedicated talent team reviews all applications, and we promise to provide feedback regardless of the outcome.

For more information about applying and to view other opportunities, you can visit our careers page.

About Hyperlayer
Hyperlayer is a B2B product company, building a platform to revolutionise the world of payments. Hyperlayer transforms digital wallets into smart wallets that change the way people, and businesses, spend money.  Wallets powered by Hyperlayer let consumers withdraw money from multiple accounts with a single tap, for a specific purpose. 

Our platform enables capabilities such as connecting specific accounts with targeted brand spending, it gives merchants and customers access to cutting-edge rewards, and since spending is social, Hyperlayer supports group saving, sharing and spending. All in one platform.

Hyperlayer is working with large retailers and financial institutions. Our product introduces innovation to these industries to create solutions: helping consumers, families, and groups improve their financial wellbeing by making their money go further.
About the Role
We are building out our Client Implementation function and hiring two Client Implementation Managers to own the post-sale technical delivery experience end-to-end - from contract signature through integration, UAT, go-live and into steady-state BAU.

This is not a coordination role. You will be the technically credible face of Hyperlayer's delivery to Tier 1 financial institutions - expected to lead technical discussions, challenge engineering plans constructively, and hold your own in rooms with senior client architects, integration engineers, and operations leads.

You will join at the formation of the function, shape how we implement clients at scale, and work closely with our internal Tech Delivery and Engineering teams. If you thrive on complexity, move fast, and can build structure where none yet exists - this is the role.

What You'll Do
Client Delivery Ownership
• Own end-to-end delivery of client implementations - kick-off, technical integration, UAT, go-live, and handover to BAU - across multiple concurrent programmes.
• Act as primary point of contact for client technical and operational stakeholders at Tier 1 institutions, translating complex requirements into clear internal deliverables.
• Build trusted-advisor relationships with client tech leads, integration engineers, and operations counterparts - credible enough to push back on unrealistic asks and pragmatic enough to find a path through.
• Support pre-sales activity where needed - scoping calls, technical Q&A, and implementation timelines for prospective clients.

Technical Leadership
• Lead technical discovery and integration planning sessions with client engineering teams, covering API integration patterns, authentication, data flows, and environment sequencing.
• Review and interrogate API specifications, integration designs, and release dependencies - identifying gaps and risks before they become problems.
• Coordinate releases with our internal Tech Delivery and Engineering teams, sequencing client-impacting changes and ensuring nothing reaches a client before it is ready.
• Apply working knowledge of cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP or Azure), containerised services, and API-driven integration to hold technically credible conversations with both client and internal engineering teams.
• Leverage AI tooling actively in your day-to-day delivery - whether for status synthesis, risk analysis, documentation generation, or client communication - and contribute to how we embed AI into our implementation practice as we scale.

Governance & Programme Discipline
• Run disciplined project governance across all active engagements: RAID logs, status reporting, change control, scope management, and escalation paths.
• Partner with Tech POs to ensure client-driven requirements are well-defined, tracked through engineering delivery, and clearly communicated back to the client.
• Continuously improve our implementation playbook, templates, and tooling as the function scales.

What We're Looking For
Essential
• 10+ years managing complex, technical, client-facing delivery programmes in payments, banking, fintech, or B2B SaaS integrations.
• Proven track record of delivery to Tier 1 financial institutions or major regulated clients - you know what it means to manage a relationship with a large bank's technology and operations teams.
• Demonstrably technically strong: comfortable reading and interrogating API specifications, understanding integration patterns (REST, OAuth, webhooks, event-driven architectures), sequencing release dependencies, and challenging engineering plans constructively. You do not need to code, but you need to keep up - and contribute - in the room.
• Practical familiarity with cloud environments (AWS, GCP, or Azure) - understanding how containerised services, managed infrastructure, and cloud-native integrations work in a production payments context.
• Active, demonstrable use of AI tools in a professional delivery context - this could be for documentation, risk synthesis, client communication, status reporting, or tooling automation. We are building an AI-native delivery function and expect our team to lead by example.
• Excellent written and verbal communication - able to write a status update a CISO will read, run a steerco with a difficult Tier 1 client, and translate engineering nuance into plain language and back again.
• Proven ability to run several concurrent complex client programmes simultaneously - strong personal organisation, pragmatic prioritisation, and the resilience to maintain momentum when plans change at short notice.
• Track record of partnering with Product and Engineering as equals - shaping requirements, not just relaying them.
• Comfort with startup realities: imperfect tooling, evolving processes, and the expectation that you will help fix what is broken rather than wait for someone else to.

Desirable
• Direct experience with payments rails, card schemes (Visa, Mastercard), BIN sponsorship, digital wallet provisioning (Apple Pay, Google Pay), or card processor platforms such as Marqeta.
• Experience standing up an implementation function or delivery playbook from scratch.
• Exposure to regulated environments - FCA, EMI, banking partner governance - and the constraints they bring to release windows and change management.
• Formal project or programme certifications (PMP, PRINCE2, ITIL) - useful context but secondary to how you actually operate.
• Hands-on with Jira, Confluence, Rootly, Datadog, or equivalent modern delivery and observability tooling.

What Sets the Right Candidate Apart
We have interviewed candidates with strong governance discipline but no technical depth, and candidates with domain knowledge but no client-facing credibility. We are looking for the rare person who has all three - and who brings the startup energy to build something that doesn't yet exist.
The strongest candidates will be able to demonstrate:
• A specific example of leading a technically complex integration discussion with a senior client engineering team - and what they personally contributed beyond facilitation.
• How they have used AI tooling to materially change how they work, not just as a novelty.
• What they built, created, or improved in a previous role that didn't exist before they arrived.
• A track record of delivery in environments where the stakes were real - live production systems, regulated clients, money movement, or critical infrastructure.

How to apply  

Please click on the ‘Apply’ button, you will be asked to provide an updated CV and answer some questions.  For further information about this vacancy, you can contact us at: recruitment@hyperlayer.com.  

We will not be offering UK work visa sponsorship for these roles. Candidates will need an existing non-sponsored right to work in the UK. 

Working at Hyperlayer    

At Hyperlayer we are proud of our in-office culture.  It makes a real difference to the working atmosphere and maximises collaboration in and across teams.  This is critical to how we work and learn.  Also, we think it makes for a great workplace!

We value our team and are proud to offer some great benefits:  
• A performance-based employee bonus scheme.
• 25 days annual leave plus bank holidays, a day off on your birthday, and an additional day per year of tenure to a maximum of 30.
• Critical illness and life insurance cover.
• AXA PPP Health Insurance, including gym offers.
• Cycle-to-work scheme.
• Referral bonus scheme. 
• Workplace nursery scheme

Equity, diversity, and inclusion  

Hyperlayer’s mission is to make a positive impact on people’s lives, making it easier for everyone to manage their money.  

Hyperlayer’s commitment to equity, diversity, and inclusion is a key part of this; it helps us better serve our customers, employees, and business partners from every background.   

We are constantly learning and striving to do better, and we expect all staff to actively take part in this process.

We are committed to being transparent about how we collect and use this data and to meeting our data protection obligations.  To read more click here.

We are creating the category every bank in the world will need: programmable, governed, agent-ready smart accounts. Your job is to make our audiences understand it, and then believe it.

About the role
• As we scale our client base of financial institutions across the UK, US and Asia-Pacific, we are looking for an experienced, commercially minded Head of Marketing to build and own Hyperlayer’s marketing function.
• The marketing function today is a fractional CMO, one Growth Marketing Manager and one Business Development Representative. It will grow, with several more marketing roles in the pipeline for 2026. You will report to the Chief Commercial Officer and work closely with regional and vertical sales leads, each of whom runs their own named-account pipeline as a mini-P&L.
• Hyperlayer’s go-to-market model is deliberately account-based, not volume-based: every marketing activity is built around named accounts and tagged to a specific vertical sales pod before it launches. This is not a role for someone looking to run broad demand-generation campaigns or own funnel metrics independently. Success here is measured by the pipeline and named-account penetration you help sales pods create.
Builder, not broker
For at least the first twelve months, this is a building role, not a managing role. You are the marketing function as much as you are its leader. You will write the words, build the pages, brief the analysts and run the moments yourself. If your instinct on picking up a brief is to find an agency, this is the wrong job for you.
In practice:
• You write the positioning, messaging, website copy, one-pagers and analyst briefing material yourself, first draft to final draft. Not a brief for someone else to write against.
• You build and ship the assets: landing pages, email sequences, LinkedIn copy, webinar and event decks. You are competent in the CMS, the marketing automation platform and the CRM, and you pull your own numbers.
• You sit on client and prospect calls, and you take the language you hear there straight back into the copy.
• You brief analysts personally. No intermediary on a Celent, Chartis, Gartner or Forrester call.
• You are the interim Product Marketing function until that hire lands, and you will do that work to a standard the sales pods will actually use.
• You are an events co-ordinator, working with teams to identify and organise the best events to get the pipeline
Our position on agencies: we buy external suppliers for defined production work with a fixed output, for example design execution, video, wire distribution and event stand build. We do not outsource strategy, positioning, messaging, content or analyst relations. 
What you'll do
GTM strategy and vertical enablement
• Own and evolve the central "kits" model: campaign and content packages built around real frictions banks face today, for example core-system bottlenecks and ungoverned agentic execution, for vertical sales pods to deploy against their own named accounts.
• Ensure every marketing activity is tagged to a vertical pod and named account before it launches. No bulk cold outreach.
• Work day to day with regional and vertical sales leads across US Tier 1, Tier 2 and Credit Unions, UK and Europe, and APAC and Middle East, so that marketing activity supports their account plans rather than duplicating or cutting across them.
Analyst relations
• Build and run the analyst relations programme yourself, securing appropriate validation of client-facing claims before anything is published externally.
• Set direction on SEO and LLM-discoverability as an emerging channel.
• Work closely with the Comms team on PR strategy and timing, including aligning releases to client go-lives.
Product marketing
• Translate the platform’s solution areas, including wallets, loyalty and rewards, lending, disbursements and behavioural data insights, into positioning, messaging and sales content the pods can pick up and use unaided.
• Work with the BizOps team to create the assets
Events
• Curate a selective events calendar, gating attendance on pre-booked meetings and one flagship content moment per event.
• Manage the events budget with explicit trade-offs, for example funding higher-converting formats by de-prioritising lower-performing ones.
Team building and budget ownership
• Build the function out from its current base, prioritising the open Vertical Growth Marketing and Product Marketing hires.
• Hire people who also make the work themselves. We are not building a team of brief-writers.
• Own the marketing budget and report spend against pipeline created and named-account penetration, rather than volume or brand-awareness metrics.
Governance and compliance
• Establish a clear sign-off process with Legal for any public reference to named financial institution clients, respecting client-specific contractual restrictions on case studies, testimonials and press.
• Ensure marketing and product-marketing content, particularly around data-driven personalisation and rewards use cases, complies with data privacy and financial promotion requirements in each market we operate in.
Qualifications
• 8+ years leading B2B marketing in enterprise, complex-sales environments with long sales cycles of twelve months or more, ideally in fintech, payments or another regulated B2B category. This is not a fit for candidates from consumer or PLG marketing backgrounds.
• Recent operating experience at a company shaped like ours: a B2B fintech or banking-technology vendor selling platform or infrastructure software to Tier 1 and Tier 2 financial institutions, at roughly Series A to Series C scale, where the marketing team was fewer than five people and you were one of the people producing the work. Think Thought Machine, Mambu, Zafin, Form3, 10x, ClearBank, Personetics, or Backbase and nCino at an earlier stage.
• Writing as a core, current skill. You will be asked for a piece of external-facing writing you personally produced in the last twelve months.
• A proven track record running account-based marketing as the primary go-to-market model, supporting named-account sales pods rather than volume-based demand generation.
• Direct experience building a marketing function from near-zero headcount at a scale-up, including hiring the initial team.
• Hands-on analyst relations experience, including niche technology analyst firms such as Celent and Chartis alongside Gartner and Forrester. Hands-on means you wrote the briefing and led the call.
• Comfort operating as an enabler of sales-owned pipeline targets, rather than owning brand or funnel metrics independently.
• Experience translating technical or platform products into market-facing positioning across multiple solution areas.
• A track record of budget discipline and ROI-based prioritisation, including examples of reallocating spend from lower to higher-converting activities.
Preferred, not required
• Working knowledge of SEO and LLM-discoverability as an emerging marketing channel.
• Familiarity with client reference and case-study governance processes in regulated industries.
• The ability to use AI to help make processes more efficient.

We will not be offering UK work visa sponsorship for these roles. Candidates will need an existing non-sponsored right to work in the UK.

At Hyperlayer we are proud of our in-office culture. It makes a real difference to the working atmosphere and maximises collaboration in and across teams. This is critical to how we work and learn. Also, we think it makes for a great workplace.
We value our team and are proud to offer some great benefits:
• A performance-based employee bonus scheme.
• 25 days annual leave plus bank holidays, a day off on your birthday, and an additional day per year of tenure to a maximum of 30.
• Critical illness and life insurance cover.
• AXA PPP Health Insurance, including gym offers.
• Cycle-to-work scheme.
• Referral bonus scheme.
• Workplace nursery scheme.
Equity, diversity, and inclusion
Hyperlayer’s mission is to make a positive impact on people’s lives, making it easier for everyone to manage their money.
Hyperlayer’s commitment to equity, diversity, and inclusion is a key part of this. It helps us better serve our customers, employees, and business partners from every background.

Hyperlayer is the intelligent banking platform built for the agentic economy: the financial control layer that sits above banks' existing cores, enabling next-generation Smart Accounts, without ripping anything out. From a single integration, we give financial institutions a secure rules and orchestration engine that lets them design, launch and scale hyper-personalised products in weeks while preserving stability, compliance and control. And there's nothing like us anywhere in the world.
Hyperlayer works with Tier 1 and Tier 2 FIs across the UK, US, EMEA and Hong Kong, with an award-winning UK consumer app (HyperJar) sitting in the group. We're creating the fintech category that every bank in the world needs: programmable, governed, agent-ready accounts. Your job is to make sure our audiences know that.

About the role
• We're hiring a Product Manager (Product Builder) to take end-to-end ownership of one of three product surfaces: Wealth & Asset Management, Core Banking, or Payments. This is a hands-on, AI-native role — you'll move from concept to working prototype quickly, using AI-assisted tooling to accelerate discovery and delivery, rather than relying on lengthy specs and roadmap reviews. You'll work as part of a small, senior product team with direct access to engineering, customers and the founding team, and as the team grows, there's real scope to deepen your ownership of your chosen product surface's strategy.
• This is an office-based role, with regular in-person collaboration in the office.
What you'll do
• Own end-to-end product outcomes for your chosen surface — Wealth & Asset Management, Core Banking, or Payments — from discovery through to production
• Move quickly from concept to working prototype, using AI-assisted tooling to test ideas rather than only writing specification
• Design and govern AI agents within your product surface, defining what they can and cannot do, and holding the quality bar for their outputs.
• Build systems that surface customer and market insight on demand, synthesising support data, user behaviour and market signals.
• Make system-level product judgements — API design, data models and integration patterns — not just feature decisions.
• Connect product decisions to measurable business and customer impact, and stay close to what's live through monitoring and evaluation.
• Work directly with customers, engineering and the founding team, with no approval layers in between.
Qualifications
• A demonstrable track record of shipping products in complex, regulated environments — not just owning a roadmap.
• Practical experience using AI tools to prototype, generate insight, or build product surfaces, beyond writing or admin tasks.
• Strong technical depth — you're comfortable reading an API spec, interrogating a data model, and challenging an engineering design.
• A commercial understanding of how your domain generates and loses margin, and how product decisions affect that.
• Comfort working with ambiguity and pace, without an established playbook.
• Deep domain expertise in at least one of the areas below (please let us know which when you apply):
◦ Wealth & Asset Management — experience from inside a private bank, wealth platform, asset manager, or fintech serving this space, with regulatory depth across MiFID II, COBS, PRIIPs and suitability frameworks.
◦ Core Banking — experience from inside a bank, a cloud-native core banking platform, or a fintech built on top of one, with knowledge of GL architecture, product parameters, and PRA/FCA/Basel III requirements.
◦ Payments — experience from inside a bank, payment processor, scheme operator, or fintech payments platform, with fluency across Faster Payments, SEPA, SWIFT, ISO 20022 and sanctions/compliance requirements.

Nice-to-haves
• Experience spanning more than one of the domains above.
• Familiarity with model governance and explainability requirements in a regulated context.
• Experience defining evaluation criteria for AI-driven features in production.

Using AI at Hyperlayer
Hyperlayer is hyper-focused on making the most of AI across every workstream, and this role is no exception — AI fluency is the baseline here, not a bonus. 
Day to day, you'll use AI-assisted tooling to move from concept to working prototype in days rather than weeks, and to synthesize customer support data, user behaviour and market signals into continuous product insight. 
You'll also design and govern AI agents as part of your product surface, defining evaluation criteria and owning the quality of their outputs in production.

Working at Hyperlayer
We value our team and are proud to offer some great benefits:
• A performance-based employee bonus scheme.
• 25 days annual leave plus bank holidays, a day off on your birthday, and an additional day per year of tenure to a maximum of 30.
• Critical illness and life insurance cover.
• AXA PPP Health Insurance, including gym offers.
• Cycle-to-work scheme.
• Referral bonus scheme.
• Workplace nursery scheme.
Right to work
Applicants must have the right to work in the UK. We are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role unless stated otherwise.
How to apply
Please click on the 'Apply' button, you will be asked to provide an updated CV and answer some questions. For further information about this vacancy, you can contact us at people@hyperlayer.com.
Equity, diversity and inclusion
Hyperlayer's mission is to make a positive impact on people's lives, making it easier for everyone to manage their money.
Hyperlayer's commitment to equity, diversity, and inclusion is a key part of this; it helps us better serve our customers, employees, and business partners from every background.
We are constantly learning and striving to do better, and we expect all staff to actively take part in this process.
Data Privacy
As part of our recruitment process, Hyperlayer collects and processes personal data relating to job applicants.
We are committed to being transparent about how we collect and use this data and to meeting our data protection obligations. To read more click here.
