You'll work directly with AI-assisted engineering day to day, defining evaluation criteria for AI-generated outputs and monitoring what's live rather than running sprint ceremonies.
• This is an office-based role, with regular in-person collaboration in the office.
What you'll do
• Own a specific feature surface within your domain — Wealth & Asset Management, Core Banking, or Payments — from defined intent through to live in production.
• Define clear, testable evaluation criteria for AI-generated outputs, covering precision, edge case coverage and failure modes.
• Work directly alongside AI-assisted engineering, reviewing outputs, defining constraints, and catching what AI misses.
• Monitor feature behaviour in production using data, AI agents and evaluation pipelines, and own the quality of what is live.
• Ship continuously, iterating in days and intervening quickly when something drifts, rather than working to sprint cycles.
• Build and refine the prompts and evaluation criteria that govern automated work in your feature area.
• Work closely with the Product Manager (Product Builder) for your domain, who sets direction, while you own execution and quality.
Qualifications
• A track record of shipping features in complex, regulated, mission-critical environments — not just managing tickets. The ability to define clear, testable outcomes for AI-generated work — you know what good looks like before a line of code is written.
• Strong technical depth — you can read code output, interrogate a data model, review an API contract, and catch edge cases that AI misses.
• Precision under pressure — you understand that in financial services, data errors and compliance gaps have real consequences.
• A fast iteration mindset, comfortable shipping, monitoring, learning and adjusting in days rather than planning in quarters.
• Deep domain expertise in at least one of the areas below, at a feature implementation level (please let us know which when you apply):
◦ Wealth & Asset Management — hands-on knowledge from inside a platform, private bank, or fintech serving this space, including how a portfolio accounting calculation works and what a suitability report must contain under MiFID II, COBS and PRIIPs.
◦ Core Banking — hands-on knowledge from inside a bank, a cloud-native core banking platform, or a fintech built on top of one, including how a general ledger posting works and PRA/FCA/Basel III requirements at the feature level.
◦ Payments — hands-on knowledge from inside a bank, payment processor, scheme operator, or fintech payments platform, including how a Faster Payment message flows end-to-end and PSD2/3 and OFAC/HMT screening obligations.

Nice-to-haves
• Experience spanning more than one of the domains above.
• Experience monitoring AI feature behaviour in production, catching drift or regression before it affects customers.
• Developer empathy — an understanding of what makes an API or integration good to work with, such as error handling and clear documentation.
Using AI at Hyperlayer
Hyperlayer is hyper-focused on making the most of AI across every workstream, and this role sits right at that intersection. Day to day, you'll define evaluation criteria for AI-generated outputs, review AI-written code and features before they ship, and use AI agents and eval pipelines to monitor what's live in production. 

You'll work directly in AI-assisted tooling alongside engineering, catching what AI misses and improving the prompts and guardrails that govern automated work in your feature area.

Working at Hyperlayer
We value our team and are proud to offer some great benefits:
• A performance-based employee bonus scheme.
• 25 days annual leave plus bank holidays, a day off on your birthday, and an additional day per year of tenure to a maximum of 30.
• Critical illness and life insurance cover.
• AXA PPP Health Insurance, including gym offers.
• Cycle-to-work scheme.
• Referral bonus scheme.
• Workplace nursery scheme.
Right to work
Applicants must have the right to work in the UK. We are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role unless stated otherwise.
How to apply
Please click on the 'Apply' button, you will be asked to provide an updated CV and answer some questions. For further information about this vacancy, you can contact us at people@hyperlayer.com.

Hyperlayer's mission is to make a positive impact on people's lives, making it easier for everyone to manage their money.
Hyperlayer's commitment to equity, diversity, and inclusion is a key part of this; it helps us better serve our customers, employees, and business partners from every background.
We are constantly learning and striving to do better, and we expect all staff to actively take part in this process.

Hyperlayer is the intelligent banking platform built for the agentic economy: the financial control layer that sits above banks' existing cores, enabling next-generation Smart Accounts, without ripping anything out. From a single integration, we give financial institutions a secure rules and orchestration engine that lets them design, launch and scale hyper-personalised products in weeks while preserving stability, compliance and control. And there's nothing like us anywhere in the world.
Hyperlayer works with Tier 1 and Tier 2 FIs across the UK, US, EMEA and Hong Kong, with an award-winning UK consumer app (HyperJar) sitting in the group. We're creating the fintech category that every bank in the world needs: programmable, governed, agent-ready accounts. Your job is to make sure our audiences know that.

About the role
• We're hiring a Senior Quality Engineer to lead security testing across Hyperlayer: our platform and
orchestration engine, the APIs banks integrate with, and HyperJar, our consumer app.
• Banks and financial institutions rely on us to keep their customers' money and data safe. Many banks share
one platform, and our accounts are agent-ready, so access control, tenant isolation and delegated
permissions have to be right every time.
• You'll make security testing a routine part of how we build and release: finding issues early, automating
checks in our pipelines, and turning every finding into a regression test.
• You'll bring strong API testing and automation skills in Java and REST Assured, so security tests sit alongside
our functional suites rather than in a separate silo.
• You'll report into the Head of Solution Architecture & QA and work closely with engineering, DevOps, our
Principal Quality Engineer and external penetration testers.
• This role is predominantly office-based in Paddington, London.
What you'll do
• Test our APIs and apps against the OWASP API Security Top 10 and OWASP Top 10, with a focus on
authentication, authorisation and data exposure.
• Make sure one bank can never see or change another bank's data, with automated tenant-isolation checks
for every endpoint.
• Test agent-ready accounts: delegated permissions, spending limits, revocation and the audit trail for every
agent action.
• Build automated security tests in Java and REST Assured, and turn every confirmed finding into a regression
test.
• Add security checks to our CI/CD pipelines, such as DAST (e.g. OWASP ZAP), fuzzing (e.g. ffuf), SAST and
dependency scanning, tuned so they don't create noise.
• Join design reviews and threat modelling for new features, and turn abuse cases into test cases.
• Prepare for external penetration tests, triage their findings with engineering, and verify fixes.
• Test HyperJar's mobile security, including secure storage, authentication and API usage, against OWASP
MASVS.
• Report security risk clearly to inform release go/no-go decisions.
• Help other quality engineers add security checks to their own pods, using AI tools where they help and
keeping client data out of them.Qualifications
Essential
• 5+ years in QA, quality engineering or application security, including at least 3 years of hands-on security
testing of APIs and web applications.
• Strong practical knowledge of the OWASP API Security Top 10 and OWASP Top 10, with real findings you
can talk about.
• Hands-on experience with security testing tools such as OWASP ZAP or Burp Suite.
• Solid understanding of authentication and authorisation: OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, JWT, session
handling and role-based access control.
• Strong API testing skills, with experience automating tests in Java (or another JVM language) using REST
Assured or similar.
• Experience adding security testing to CI/CD pipelines (e.g. Jenkins, Bitbucket Pipelines, GitHub Actions) and
triaging scanner findings.
• Ability to explain risk and severity clearly to engineers and non-specialists.
• Comfortable in a fast-moving startup environment, balancing speed with the rigour needed when testing
financial systems.
• Willing and able to be in our London office four days per week.
Desirable
• Experience in banking, payments or another regulated financial services environment, and awareness of
expectations such as FCA rules, DORA or PCI DSS.
• Security certifications such as OSCP, OSWE, eWPT or CREST, or a background in penetration testing.
• Threat modelling experience (e.g. STRIDE).
• Mobile application security testing (OWASP MASVS, MobSF), ideally including Flutter apps.
• Experience testing multi-tenant SaaS platforms or services written in Go.
• Awareness of security risks in AI and agent-based systems, such as the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications.
• Cloud and container security experience (AWS, Docker, Kubernetes).

right to work in the UK.
Working at Hyperlayer
At Hyperlayer we are proud of our in-office culture. It makes a real difference to the working atmosphere and
maximises collaboration in and across teams. This is critical to how we work and learn. Also, we think it makes for
a great workplace!
We value our team and are proud to offer some great benefits:
• A performance-based employee bonus scheme.
• 25 days annual leave plus bank holidays, a day off on your birthday, and an additional day per year of
tenure to a maximum of 30.

• AXA PPP Health Insurance, including gym offers.
• Cycle-to-work scheme.
• Referral bonus scheme.
• Workplace nursery scheme.

customers, employees, and business partners from every background.
We are constantly learning and striving to do better, and we expect all staff to actively take part in this process.

applicants.

Hyperlayer is the intelligent banking platform built for the agentic economy: the financial control layer that sits above banks’ existing cores, enabling next-generation Smart Accounts, without ripping anything out. From a single integration, we give financial institutions a secure rules and orchestration engine that lets them design, launch and scale hyper-personalised products in weeks while preserving stability, compliance and control. Hyperlayer works with Tier 1 and Tier 2 FIs across the UK, US, EMEA and Hong Kong, with an award-winning UK consumer app (HyperJar) sitting in the group. We’re creating the fintech category that every bank in the world needs: programmable, governed, agent-ready accounts. Your job is to make sure our audiences know that.

About the role
• This is an office-based role, with regular in-person collaboration in the office.
• As a small, agile company, we thrive on collaboration, innovation, and accountability. We’re now looking for a Solution Architect to help shape and scale our technology landscape as we enter our next phase of growth.
• You’ll play a pivotal role in designing and delivering robust, scalable, and secure payment and banking-infrastructure solutions. You’ll work closely with both internal teams and external clients, translating business needs into end-to-end technical designs that balance innovation, practicality, and regulatory compliance.
• This role suits someone who combines deep technical expertise with strong client-facing skills — you’ll enjoy collaborating with customers to understand their requirements, designing solutions that meet their goals, and guiding them through technical delivery. We’re looking for a minimum of 8 years’ experience, ideally split across software engineering and architecture.
What you'll do
• Design scalable, secure, and compliant payment and banking solutions spanning card processing, payments, and open banking.
• Engage directly with external clients to understand their business and technical needs, translate them into feasible architectures, and present solution proposals.
• Collaborate with product, engineering, and compliance teams to align business goals with technical solutions.
• Lead client solution workshops, technical discovery sessions, and architecture reviews.
• Evaluate and solution for third-party APIs and payment gateways, ensuring interoperability, resilience, and compliance.
• Develop and maintain architecture documentation, diagrams, and standards (e.g., APIs, microservices, cloud infrastructure).
• Provide technical leadership through delivery, ensuring solutions follow architectural principles and industry best practice.
• Support pre-sales activity, including RFP responses and technical input on client proposals.
Qualifications

Requirements
• Proven experience as a Solution Architect or Software Architect, ideally in fintech or payments, with a strong understanding of payments infrastructure (card acquiring, open banking, faster payments, settlement, reconciliation).
• Experience working directly with external clients or partners in a technical or pre-sales capacity.
• Hands-on experience with cloud-native or cloud-agnostic architectures (AWS, Azure, or GCP), and expertise in API design, microservices, and event-driven systems.
• Familiarity with security and compliance requirements in financial services (e.g., encryption, PCI-DSS).
• Strong communication and presentation skills — able to translate complex technical concepts for non-technical audiences.
• Comfort working in agile, DevOps, or product-driven environments.
• Confidence using AI tools (such as Claude or GitHub Copilot) as part of your daily workflow — for example, drafting architecture documentation, accelerating technical discovery, or supporting RFP and proposal writing.
Nice-to-haves
• Previous experience in a start-up or scale-up fintech.
• Exposure to ISO 20022, Open Banking APIs, or card scheme integrations.
• Experience with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, CloudFormation).
• Background in software engineering (e.g., Java, Golang, Kotlin, Node.js, Python).
• Experience supporting sales or business development teams with technical input.

Using AI at Hyperlayer
Hyperlayer is hyper-focused on making the most of AI across every workstream, and Solution Architecture is no exception. You’ll be expected to use tools like Claude as part of how you work day to day — for example, drafting and refining architecture documentation and diagrams, accelerating technical discovery ahead of client workshops, or speeding up RFP and proposal responses. We see this as an opportunity to spend more time on design judgement and client conversations, not less.
Working at Hyperlayer
We value our team and are proud to offer some great benefits:
• A performance-based employee bonus scheme.
• 25 days annual leave plus bank holidays, a day off on your birthday, and an additional day per year of tenure to a maximum of 30.
• Critical illness and life insurance cover.
• AXA PPP Health Insurance, including gym offers.
• Cycle-to-work scheme.
• Referral bonus scheme.
• Workplace nursery scheme.
Right to work
Applicants must have the right to work in the UK. We are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role unless stated otherwise.

Please click on the ‘Apply’ button, you will be asked to provide an updated CV and answer some questions. For further information about this vacancy, you can contact us at people@hyperlayer.com.
Equity, diversity and inclusion
Hyperlayer’s mission is to make a positive impact on people’s lives, making it easier for everyone to manage their money.
Hyperlayer’s commitment to equity, diversity, and inclusion is a key part of this; it helps us better serve our customers, employees, and business partners from every background.

Hypervision Surgical (“Hypervision”) is a spin-out from King’s College London, founded by clinicians and experts in medical imaging and artificial intelligence. Using safe light alone, our mission is to equip surgeons with real-time, AI-driven tissue intelligence to improve precision and patient safety.

We are pioneering the world’s first regulatory-cleared real-time intraoperative spectral imaging platform, combining on-chip spectral sensing with high-speed AI analytics at over 60 frames per second. Seamlessly integrating into existing surgical vision systems, our technology transforms standard cameras into intelligent, data-rich tools, revealing anatomical, physiological, and pathological information beyond human vision.

Certified for both open and minimally invasive surgery, our platform achieved UKCA certification and FDA clearance in 2025 under a newly established AI/ML product code, and was admitted into the FDA’s Safer Technology Program. With multi-centre clinical evaluations underway and strategic partnerships with world-leading technology and surgical manufactures, including imec and ZEISS Ventures, Hypervision is shaping the future of data-driven surgery.

Hypervision Surgical process all personal data in accordance with the UK GDPR and Data Protection Act 2018. For further information on how we collect, use and protect your data, please refer to our Applicant Privacy Notice.

About the role
We have a regulatory-cleared surgical imaging technology that surgeons find compelling. We now need to turn it into a product that hospitals buy and use routinely. 

As our first Product Manager:
• You will build the product process that turns customer insight into prioritised work for our development team and own the product roadmap for our surgical display and cloud platform. 
• You will sharpen which users, procedures and clinical problems we focus on first, shape what the product needs to look like to win there, and lead how we position it commercially.
• You will spend real time in operating rooms with surgeons and OR teams, and turn what you see into clear requirements, prototypes and decisions. Internally, you will work closely with Technology, Cloud Platform, Commercial, Compliance and Clinical Development.
• This is a founding role. You will build product management at Hypervision from the ground up.
• It will involve travel to customer sites across the UK, Europe and the United States.

What you'll do
In your first year, your priorities are to build the product process with our development team, shape the product, and set the roadmap. Everything below supports those three.

Build the product process
• Set up a lightweight product process from discovery through to delivery, suited to a regulated medical device company.
• Own a prioritised backlog for the software team, and work with its lead on sprint planning, scope and trade-offs.
• Write clear user stories and requirements with acceptance criteria, so the team knows what to build and why.
• Review what is delivered against user needs and close the loop with users and stakeholders.
Shape the product
• Spend time in operating rooms to understand surgical workflows, where our technology adds value, and where it gets in the way.
• Separate genuine adoption drivers from clinical curiosity, and deepen our understanding of users, buyers and what drives their decisions.
• Test willingness to pay and build an evidence base of clinical value and workflow impact across sites.
Own the roadmap and requirements
• Own the product roadmap for the surgical display and cloud platform, agreed with leadership.
• Turn real-world findings into clear user needs and product requirements and prioritise them based on the strength of the evidence.
• Keep the roadmap aligned with regulatory and clinical plans, including flagging changes that may need a new submission.
Lead UX and design
• Map clinical workflows and turn them into user journeys, wireframes and interactive prototypes (e.g. in Figma).
• Test designs early and often with surgeons and OR teams and iterate quickly.
• Set the UX direction for the surgical display and cloud platform, and work with external designers on visual UI design where needed.
Shape positioning
• Own product positioning, target customers and the value proposition.
• Work with Commercial on messaging and provide input to pricing, keeping all claims within our cleared intended use and indications.
• Build strong relationships with early-adopter surgeons and key opinion leaders.
Work across the business
• Share field and usability insights with Clinical Development, who own clinical studies and post-market clinical follow-up.
• Make sure field observations that may be complaints, adverse events or use errors are escalated promptly into our quality management system.

Qualifications
About you: You have taken a product from early stage to market before, and you want to do it again with technology that could change surgery. You are at home in ambiguity, comfortable challenging assumptions, and able to make a clear recommendation when the evidence is incomplete. You are as comfortable in an operating theatre as in a roadmap review.

You bring:
• 5+ years in product management, ideally in MedTech, health tech or another regulated industry.
• Experience taking a product from prototype or early stage to market (0-to-1).
• Comfort working in clinical environments, including operating theatres, and building credibility with surgeons.
• Strong UX skills: workflow mapping, usability studies, wireframes and interactive prototypes.
• A track record of turning qualitative user insight into requirements and roadmap decisions.
• Experience running a product backlog with software teams, and influencing across engineering, clinical and commercial teams.
• An understanding of what working in a regulated environment involves, including when to escalate safety issues.
Desirable:
• Time spent in surgical or interventional environments, working directly with surgeons and OR teams.
• Working knowledge of medical device development (e.g. ISO 13485, design controls).
• Visual UI design skills.
• Experience with usability engineering or human factors (IEC 62366-1).
• Experience with surgical imaging, endoscopy, robotics or AI-enabled clinical products.
• Experience with cloud-enabled or software products in hospitals, including IT and procurement processes.
• Experience with pricing or willingness-to-pay research in healthcare. 

Bonus points if you bring a special talent, interest, language, or unique life experience to the team.

What We Offer
• The opportunity to define a new surgical product and make a direct contribution to patient care
• Access to state-of-the-art surgical development facilities at St Thomas’ MedTech Hub, including hospitals, operating rooms, labs, and computational resources, with offices located at the London Institute for Healthcare Engineering
• Competitive salary
• Equity participation via share option scheme
• 25 days of annual leave plus bank holidays
• Private medical insurance 
• Company pension scheme (up to 5% matched contribution)
• Hybrid working arrangements, tailored with your manager to suit the needs of the role
• Employee Assistance Programme for wellbeing, legal, and financial support
• Cycle to Work Scheme and Workplace Nursery Benefits
• £150 annual tech stipend for productivity and office essentials
• Complimentary office snacks and drinks
• Monthly team socials in an inclusive, collaborative culture

HYPR, the Identity Assurance Company, helps organizations create trust in the identity lifecycle. We are a community of bold thinkers and energetic doers who imagined a brand new approach to identity security and, at the same time, are eliminating a pervasive and persistent 60-year old problem – the password. Since being founded in 2014, the company has grown to be the premium provider of authentication security to marquee brands around the globe and are quickly becoming the recognized leader in Identity Assurance. We are looking for exceptional people with the ambition and the will to positively change the world. If that sounds like you, join us on our mission to create a passwordless world and secure the identity lifecycle.

Your Role and Impact

HYPR, The Identity Assurance Company, is currently seeking a Senior Solution Architect to join our growing team. The world’s largest organizations deploy HYPR to eliminate fraud, phishing and credential reuse – all while enhancing customer and employee experiences.

This role requires a multifaceted individual who can ensure successful implantation plans and deployments in production environments. The role demands that you are objective oriented and able work across complex and shifting environments.

A Senior Solution Architect should have demonstrated experience in collaborative communication environments with both internal and external teams. The role provides architecture leadership & subject matter expertise to client engagements focusing on Passwordless implementation and adoption.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop solution plans intended to support business investment decisions which means they must hold the appropriate balance between costs, risks and quality of the product
  • The solution architect creates innovative and practical designs that account for the end-to-end technical solution of a system, in line with the business strategy and objectives and within the context of HYPR
  • Oversee and lead the successful implementation of these designs and architectures by managing expectations and risks, ensuring appropriate organizational structures, principles, tools and responsibilities are in place

Required Qualifications

  • Minimum of 8+ years in a solution or technical architect role deploying Linux based on-premise and hosted solutions such as private/public cloud IaaS, PaaS and SaaS platforms
  • Experience with authentication protocols (SAML/OAuth/OIDC), Multi Factor Authentication, Identity Providers (Entra, Okta, PingFederate, ForgeRock or others)
  • Knowledge of enterprise architecture including load balancing, application firewalls, SIEM, etc.

We are the logistics and cargo brand of International Airlines Group (Aer Lingus, British Airways, Iberia, Level and Vueling). About the role
• Line manage 1-2 graduates/Project Executives, supporting effective development and performance management of these individuals

• Ensure effective communication to all project stakeholders and to other parts and levels of the organisation, including for more complex projects

It's all about you

• Experience of planning and delivering business change activities at a project level, including on more complex projects

• Experience of owning and driving effective identification and mitigation of risks, issues and dependencies at project level, including on more complex projects

We’ll treat you right

Diversity and Inclusion

Who we are 🌍

We’re IAG Loyalty - one organisation with two ambitious, growing divisions across Loyalty and Holidays. Each has its own goals, strategy and team, but together we’re united by a shared vision to create a more rewarding world of travel and experiences.
Our Loyalty division is home to Avios, the global loyalty currency, enabling millions of members to collect and spend rewards across travel, retail and financial services.
Our Holidays division including British Airways Holidays and Iberia Vacaciones, brings together trusted brands, connecting customers to thousands of destinations worldwide through seamless, end-to-end travel experiences.

We’re on an exciting journey of growth and transformation – we’re going places.

The opportunity ✨

We’re looking for an AI & Automation Manager to help shape how we use emerging technology to create better experiences for our customers, colleagues and wider Customer Contact operation.

From conversational AI and agent-assist tools to workflow automation and smarter ways of working, there’s huge potential to transform how we support our customers across the Avios ecosystem. You’ll play a key role in identifying where AI and automation can make a real difference, turning operational challenges and customer needs into meaningful opportunities for improvement.

As our AI and automation subject-matter expert, you’ll explore new technologies, evaluate opportunities and help shape solutions that deliver genuine customer and business value. You’ll work closely with teams across Customer Experience, Operational Delivery, Product and Technology, bringing together insight, expertise and practical thinking to influence what we prioritise and how we move forward.

This is an opportunity for someone who is curious about what technology can do, but equally passionate about making sure it solves the right problems. You’ll have the space to challenge existing thinking, influence decisions and help shape the future of customer servicing at IAG Loyalty.

What you’ll be doing 🚀

• Identify and evaluate opportunities to use AI and automation across frontline and back-office customer servicing, improving customer outcomes, colleague experience and operational efficiency.
• Explore technologies including conversational AI, agent-assist, workflow automation and emerging capabilities, understanding how they could improve our customer journeys and ways of working.
• Work closely with Customer Experience and Operational Delivery teams to understand customer and colleague challenges, translating these into practical automation opportunities.
• Assess the potential value, feasibility, risks and dependencies of proposed AI and automation solutions, using customer, operational and commercial insight to inform recommendations.
• Act as the subject-matter expert for AI and automation within Customer Contact, providing guidance, expertise and constructive challenge to stakeholders.
• Partner with Product and Technology teams to shape solution options, influence product roadmaps and support prioritisation and investment decisions.
• Support the development and implementation of AI and automation initiatives, ensuring solutions remain grounded in real customer needs and operational requirements.
• Challenge proposed solutions where the value isn't clear, exploring alternative approaches that could deliver better outcomes.
• Identify and manage potential risks associated with automation, considering responsible AI principles, governance and the impact on customers and colleagues.
• Keep up to date with emerging technologies and industry developments, identifying opportunities that could shape the future of customer servicing.
• Build understanding and confidence in AI and automation across Customer Contact, sharing knowledge and encouraging curiosity, innovation and new ways of thinking.
• Work with internal teams and external technology partners to understand capabilities, explore solutions and help bring opportunities to life.

What we need from you ⚡

• Strong experience in AI, automation, digital transformation or technology-enabled customer operations, with an understanding of how technology can improve customer servicing.
• Experience identifying, evaluating and shaping automation opportunities across customer journeys, operational processes or service environments.
• Good knowledge of AI and automation technologies, including conversational AI, agent-assist, workflow automation or similar emerging capabilities.
• Strong analytical and commercial thinking, with the ability to assess potential value, feasibility, risks and operational impact.
• Experience working with Product, Technology, Customer Experience or Operational teams to develop and implement technology-enabled improvements.
• An understanding of customer contact operations, including the challenges and opportunities across frontline and back-office servicing.
• Excellent stakeholder management and influencing skills, with the confidence to build relationships, challenge thinking and bring people together around shared priorities.
• The ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear, practical recommendations that non-technical stakeholders can understand and act on.
• Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills, with the ability to balance customer needs, colleague experience, technical considerations and business objectives.
• An understanding of AI governance, risk management and responsible use of emerging technologies.
• A proactive and curious mindset, with the confidence to explore new ideas, challenge existing approaches and identify opportunities for meaningful improvement.

We might not be right for you if:

• You only want to focus on your to-do list; we’re a small, high-performing team, we help each other to succeed.
• You value perfection over fast iteration and progress; IAG Loyalty moves fast, we learn and iterate as we go; our environment isn’t right for everyone.
• You’re looking to create but not build; this is an end-to-end role, you need to be comfortable owning your space, from ideation through to delivery and review.

If you think you have what it takes but don't meet every single point above, please do still apply. We'd love to chat and see if you could be a great fit.

The Blend 📍

This role will work as part of our Loyalty Division and is based out of our Warrington office. We call our approach to hybrid working The Blend - it’s about giving you the flexibility to choose where you do your best work, while staying connected with your team and the wider business.

This means you will be required to spend at least two days per week in the office, with the rest of the time working from home. You may also be required to work from one of our other office or partner locations, based on your role and 'to do' list.

📌 Please note: We may close this vacancy early if we receive a high volume of applications or if business priorities change.
Diversity and Inclusion 

Our vision is to create a more rewarding world of travel and experiences. Delivering that requires diverse thinking and inclusive leadership.

We are committed to building a workplace where people feel they belong and are valued for their perspective. Inclusion drives better decisions, stronger performance and more innovative outcomes.

We actively encourage applications from people with different experiences and backgrounds, and are committed to ensuring our recruitment process is fair, inclusive and accessible.

The Mission
We believe games and interactive media are on the verge of a fundamental shift.
Today’s experiences are largely scripted, characters follow predefined paths, and player choice is limited. We’re building systems that change that: digital actors that can think, communicate, and take action in real time.
Our goal is to create worlds that are truly alive—where stories emerge from interaction, and every player experience is unique.
Recent advances in AI make this possible for the first time. The challenge now is turning that potential into real, scalable systems that people can play.
OUR DESIGN TEAM
The Design Team is a multi-disciplinary group dedicated to crafting compelling player experiences, from initial concept through to final implementation. • Partner with research to build innovative experiences with cutting edge technology
• Maintain design documentation and be a major contributor to the ideation process
• Solicit feedback from a multi-disciplinary team of designers, artists, engineers and scientists
• Take ownership of features throughout their development, and act as an ambassador for the features you own
• Ensure the final delivery of features are fun, engaging, and meeting the expectations of our fanbase
• Develop feature prototypes to test and iterate on ideas early
• Ensure productive playtesting, fix reported bugs, and secure Director validation
• Iterate upon live experiences using direct player data and community sentiment

• Proven game design experience on a high-profile console or PC title
• Experience working in a cross-discipline team to provide high quality features and content to players
• Experience prototyping game features
• A passionate gamer, with an ability to analyse game features and understand what makes them work
• A highly collaborative developer
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills are essential
• Experience working with player data to improve game content

• Build at the frontier of AI and interactive entertainment
• High ownership and direct impact in a small team
• Work on technically challenging, meaningful problems
• Help shape how shape how characters and animation behave in a new kind of interactive system
• London-based team with in-person collaboration

We’re building digital actors: AI-driven characters that don’t just talk, but act; shaping the world, responding to the player, and driving stories that evolve through both words and actions.
The Mission:
We believe games and interactive media are on the verge of a fundamental shift.
Today’s experiences are largely scripted, characters follow predefined paths, and player choice is limited. We’re building systems that change that: digital actors that can think, communicate, and take action in real time.
Our goal is to create worlds that are truly alive—where stories emerge from interaction, and every player experience is unique.
Recent advances in AI make this possible for the first time. The challenge now is turning that potential into real, scalable systems that people can play.
The Role:
We’re looking for a Software Engineer to help build the systems powering our digital actors and interactive worlds.
This is a highly hands-on role working across gameplay systems, AI infrastructure, tools, runtime systems, and product features. You’ll collaborate closely with engineers, researchers, designers, and artists to help turn emerging AI capabilities into real player experiences.
This is not just an implementation role. You’ll be contributing to the foundations of a new kind of interactive medium helping shape how intelligent characters behave, respond, and interact with players in real time.
A background in games is not required, but a strong interest in games, simulation, and interactive systems is essential.

• Design, build, and maintain production systems across multiple areas of the stack
• Contribute directly to gameplay systems, AI integrations, runtime infrastructure, and developer tooling
• Collaborate with researchers to help bring experimental systems into real products
• Work closely with product and design to build compelling interactive experiences
• Write clean, maintainable, and performant production code
• Help improve engineering practices, tooling, and workflows as the team grows
• Contribute ideas and experimentation around how AI can create new forms of gameplay and interaction
What We’re Looking For:
• Strong software engineering fundamentals
• Experience building and shipping production software
• Comfortable working across different languages, tools, and systems
• Strong problem-solving ability and willingness to learn new technologies quickly
• Interest in AI systems and how they can be applied to games and interactive experiences
• Interest in games, simulation, or emergent systems
• Collaborative mindset and comfort working in cross-functional teams
• Strong understanding of engineering quality and maintainability
Nice to Have:
• Experience with game engines (Unity, Unreal, or similar)
• Experience working on gameplay systems or real-time applications
• Familiarity with AI/ML systems, APIs, or tooling
• Experience in startups or small, fast-moving teams
• Personal projects, mods, prototypes, or game jams
Why Join Us
Be a foundational member of a team innovating at the intersection of AI, art, and storytelling. You'll help shape the research direction, culture, and technical foundations of a company building toward something genuinely new.

• Competitive salary and equity compensation
• 25 days annual leave + bank holidays
• Private healthcare
• Based in London with hybrid work

job_description:
About the role
We're one of the fastest-growing divisions in a well-established global payments business and we're looking for a high-performing, motivated superstar to help shape what comes next.

This is a front-line, client-facing role. You'll win new corporate clients, build lasting relationships with CFOs and treasurers, and act as a trusted adviser on FX strategy, currency risk, and international payments. If you're energised by targets and genuinely enjoy the hunt for new business, you'll fit right in.

Win new business
• Prospect, cold-call, and network your way to a strong pipeline of qualified corporate leads.
• Build relationships with senior finance stakeholders — CFOs, treasurers, and finance directors — and understand their FX needs well enough to deliver solutions that actually work.
• Take deals from first conversation to signed contract, managing objections and adapting proposals along the way.
• Support a smooth client onboarding onto our platform.
Think strategically
• Identify target markets, track the competitive landscape, and stay sharp on industry developments that affect us.
• Work with marketing and product to make sure your sales approach and theirs are pulling in the same direction.
Own your numbers
• Hit weekly, monthly, and annual revenue targets through disciplined pipeline management.
• Keep CRM records accurate and up to date — and use the data to course-correct, not just report.
• Track conversion rates and pipeline health; flag issues early.
Stay compliant
• Keep up with regulatory requirements through ongoing training.
• Conduct due diligence on prospective clients to manage credit and operational risk.
What we'll measure
• FX revenue against monthly and annual targets
• New clients onboarded and meetings generated
• Pipeline quality and conversion rates

• A proven track record of winning new business in the deliverable FX market — and hitting or exceeding targets.
• Knowledge of currency markets, hedging products, and international payments.
• A consultative approach: you listen first, then sell.
• Experience managing complex sales cycles from cold outreach to close.
• Strong communication skills — you're as confident in a boardroom as you are on the phone.
• Comfortable with CRM tools and sales reporting.
• Self-motivated, competitive, and resilient under pressure.
• Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
• A true team player with a winning mentality and strong work ethic committed to continuous improvement and high performance.
• Adaptable, tenacious and flexible who can perform under pressure.

We believe great people do their best work when they feel supported, rewarded, and empowered to grow. That’s why we offer a benefits package designed to support your career, wellbeing, finances, and life outside of work.
• 🌴 Time to Recharge
• 25 days’ annual leave, plus bank holidays 
• An extra day off for your birthday 
• Holiday loyalty scheme rewarding long-term service 
• Work abroad scheme for added flexibility 

• 💰 Financial Wellbeing
• Competitive pension scheme via salary exchange 
• Financial education, planning & coaching platform 
• Interest-free Season Ticket Loan for London travel 
• Salary exchange nursery fee scheme 

• 🩺 Health & Wellbeing
• London office gym 
• Life Insurance 
• Healthcare platform including: • Cashback on dental, optical & physio 
• Virtual GP access 
• Mental health and stress support helplines 
• Additional wellbeing resources 

• 👶 Family & Lifestyle Support
• Enhanced parental leave 
• Cycle to work scheme 
• Flexible benefits that support everyday life 

• 🚀 Growth & Career Development
• Career development and progression tools 
• Opportunities to grow within a fast-scaling international business 
• Training Sponsorships 

• 🎉 A Great Team Culture

From sporting events and pub nights to seasonal celebrations and socials, we make time to connect and celebrate together.

Diversity & Inclusion
We believe that diversity and inclusion are essential to our success. We are committed to fostering a culture where everyone feels valued and respected, regardless of their background, identity or experiences. By embracing diverse perspectives and promoting equity, we aim to create an environment where all employees can perform and reach their full potential. 

What’s next?
• We will review your application and come back to you as soon as possible.
• You must be eligible to work in the UK to be considered for this position.
• Full background checks will be carried out on all successful candidates.

Overview of the role
• This role leads the Banking and FX tribe, which owns payment processing, FX pricing and trading, the ledger, reconciliation, bank integrations, FIX engine connectivity, payment compliance, and the client portal.
• You will manage six to eight engineers and own the tribe's delivery and OKRs. You'd work with product, design and stakeholders across the
business to turn client problems into things we actually ship and support.
• This is not a fully hands-on role, but you need to be technical enough to help your team when they need it, review code, and break the tie when a decision has to be made.

• Own delivery and OKRs for the tribe. Forecast it, sequence it, and say early when something is slipping.
• Work with product, design and stakeholders to turn client problems into shipped software. Push past the first solution someone offers to
the problem underneath it.
• Take the parts of agile that create real agility: small changes, short feedback loops, and being able to change direction when a client
need does. Drop the parts that are just ceremony.
• Manage up. Keep leadership and the people who need to know informed early, especially when the news isn't good.
• Lead a team of six to eight engineers, covering one-on-ones, progression and performance, plus hiring and onboarding as the team changes.
• Set a high bar and grow people into it. Mentoring, honest feedback, design and code review. Challenge people because you want them
to be better, not to win the point.
• Set the tone on urgency and ownership by doing it yourself. Progress over perfection, and finish what the tribe starts.
• Share technical direction with the senior engineers. Run the discussion, break the tie when there is one, and make sure the decision gets written down.
• Hold the line on quality and testing standards. We'd rather do it right than do it twice.
• Improve the team's security posture. Who can reach what, and how quickly we shut things down when something surfaces.
• Run the tribe's services in production. Client money moves through them, so incident response, on-call health and observability are
yours. Reviews are blameless, and what we learn has to change something.
• Decide how the team uses AI. We use Claude Code every day and want a manager with a view on where it helps and where it's quietly
making a mess.
• Work with compliance and risk so changes to how money moves carry evidence. Where a process gets in the way of good engineering, argue for changing it.

• Experience leading and managing engineers, including the hard parts: hiring, performance, and the conversations nobody enjoys.

Being a Cloud Security Engineer at incident means being the person who keeps the one thing customers rely on when their systems are on fire both up and safe, turning “is this secure?” into “yes, and here’s the proof.”

What that looks like day to day

As a Cloud Security Engineer at incident, you own the security of the cloud infrastructure that runs our platform: how it’s built, hardened, monitored and defended. It’s a genuinely varied role. One day you’re tightening IAM across our Google Cloud projects, the next you’re building a Terraform guardrail so engineers get a safe path instead of a ticket, the next you’re leading an investigation into something odd in the audit logs.

You’ll own cloud posture and hardening across GCP and GKE, identity and access, security as code in our Terraform and CI/CD pipelines, detection and response, isolation of customer data in our multi-tenant platform, and the cloud-side controls around our AI features.

We formed our security team this year and there are three of us. We’re hiring a Cloud Security Engineer to give the team real depth in cloud, which means little process, no approval chains, and your fingerprints on everything. We say yes wherever we genuinely can, and you’ll have the authority to block a release when it matters.

We run on Google Cloud and AWS, with Kubernetes, Terraform, Go, Postgres and TypeScript/React. We lean on Claude and other LLMs to move faster.

Who you are

 - You’ve got deep, hands-on cloud security experience, ideally on Google Cloud. Strong AWS or Azure depth that transfers is fine.

 - You design least-privilege IAM properly, and you’ve secured Kubernetes or container platforms in production.

 - You write code to fix problems, not just report them. Terraform is second nature.

 - You’ve built cloud detection or investigated cloud incidents, and you enjoy following the thread until you find the answer.

 - You can give hard feedback to an engineer and have them thank you for it.

Job Description:
We're seeking a Senior Sales Enablement Specialist who is fundamentally a master facilitator with extreme ownership of field team success. Reporting to the Sr. Manager, Sales Enablement & Programs, you'll design and personally deliver world-class enablement experiences—both in-person and virtual—directly supporting enterprise and mid-market sales teams selling EPM and equity services solutions. Beyond training delivery, you'll architect and build all go-to-market collateral (battle cards, playbooks, demo flows, discovery guides, use case narratives, competitive positioning)—and own the sales lift these assets generate. You'll be data-obsessed about what works, ruthlessly measure enablement ROI, and take personal accountability for your sellers' productivity and quota attainment. 

Key Responsibilities 

• Partner with the Sr. Manager on enablement strategy; execute the vision across all field-facing initiatives including training design, collateral development, and ongoing coaching 

• Design and personally deliver exceptional facilitated training experiences—in-person workshops, Microsoft Teams virtual bootcamps and coaching sessions, and ongoing field support—for enterprise and mid-market sales teams; adapt delivery style and pacing to audience in real-time 

• Build all go-to-market collateral from scratch: MEDDPICC and Value Selling-aligned discovery guides, EPM/equity services battle cards, competitive positioning frameworks, playbooks, demo flows, use case narratives, ROI calculators, and value justification templates—and maintain them as the market evolves 

• Own field enablement end-to-end: support sellers before deals (training, collateral access), during deals (coaching, objection handling, complex scenario guidance), and after deals (win/loss analysis, continuous improvement insights) 

• Measure enablement effectiveness obsessively: track ramp time, time-to-first-deal, average deal size, win rates, and quota attainment by rep and cohort; correlate training/collateral usage to outcomes and iterate based on data 

• Serve as a subject matter expert on EPM platforms (planning, budgeting, analytics, forecasting) and equity services solutions; translate technical features into business impact sellers can articulate to buyers 

• Partner with sales managers and reps to diagnose capability gaps; coach underperforming reps individually and guide the team through behavioral change 

• Lead new hire onboarding programs; design and deliver bootcamps, field ride-alongs, and progression frameworks that accelerate ramp and set new reps up to hit quota in year one 

• Own major sales moments: lead or personally deliver Sales Kickoffs, product launch training, competitive response programs, and regional training events 

• Leverage Claude AI strategically to automate collateral drafts, personalize coaching feedback, analyze win/loss data at scale, and generate dynamic sales scenarios—but own quality and appropriateness of every output 

• Track and present enablement metrics to the Sr. Manager and sales leadership: ramp time, quota attainment by cohort, win rate correlation to training, and collateral usage—with clear business impact and recommendations 

• Collaborate with the Sr. Manager on enablement platform maintenance (LMS, collateral management, Salesforce reporting, Claude integration) and ensure sellers can access resources when they need them 

Required Qualifications 

• 5+ years of progressive Sales Enablement, Sales Training, Sales Operations, or Sales Coaching experience in enterprise software or B2B SaaS; experience supporting both enterprise and mid-market sales teams required 

• Experience selling or supporting sales of equity services, employee ownership solutions, or related financial services; strong understanding of buy-side finance personas and their pain points 

• Exceptional facilitation and training delivery skills: natural presence, ability to command virtual and in-person rooms, adapt content on the fly, handle difficult questions with poise, and inspire behavioral change 

• Track record building comprehensive GTM collateral from scratch: sales playbooks, battle cards, discovery guides, competitive positioning documents, case studies, demo flows, and ROI/value calculators 

• Demonstrated mastery of MEDDPICC and Value Selling frameworks; proven ability to teach both methodologies and coach reps through complex, multi-stakeholder deals; ability to integrate both frameworks into collateral and coaching 

• Data-driven mindset: comfortable with analytics, SQL, dashboards, or Salesforce reporting; ability to establish KPIs, measure program ROI, and communicate findings to leadership 

• Extreme ownership mentality: take personal accountability for field team productivity; celebrate reps' wins as your wins; measure yourself by their quota attainment and deal velocity, not training completion 

• Practical experience with Claude AI or similar LLMs for content generation, win/loss analysis, scenario simulation, or workflow automation; ability to evaluate AI outputs critically 

• Excellent written communication: ability to create clear, persuasive sales collateral and distill complex topics into simple, buyer-friendly narratives 

Preferred Qualifications 

• Prior experience at an EPM software vendor (Anaplan, Jedox, Vena) in sales, solutions consulting, or sales enablement roles 

• Background selling enterprise software to CFO, VP Finance, or Controller personas; understanding of financial planning and analysis (FP&A) workflows 

• Experience in equity services, employee stock ownership plans (ESOPs), cap table management, or fintech; strong knowledge of buyer personas and their compliance/reporting requirements 

• Hands-on experience with Salesforce reporting, Tableau, Looker, or similar analytics tools; ability to pull and analyze sales productivity data 

• Experience designing and running Sales Kickoffs, product launch programs, or regional sales events with 100+ attendees 

• Familiarity with sales enablement platforms (Seismic, Showpad, Highspot) and/or LMS systems; ability to manage content libraries and optimize asset discoverability 

• Track record coaching and developing other enablement professionals or sales trainers 

• Published thought leadership, conference speaking, or content creation on sales enablement, MEDDPICC, Value Selling, or AI in sales 

Core Competencies & Values 

• Master Facilitation – exceptional presence, adaptability, emotional intelligence; ability to engage diverse audiences and inspire change 

• Extreme Ownership – personal accountability for field team success; measure yourself by seller productivity and quota attainment, not completion metrics 

• Data-Driven Decision Making – obsessive about measurement; establish KPIs, analyze performance, iterate based on evidence 

• GTM Collateral Excellence – ability to build comprehensive, polished, seller-ready assets; attention to detail and consistency across all materials 

• Domain Expertise – deep knowledge of EPM platforms and equity services; credibility with both sellers and sophisticated buyers 

• Sales Acumen – fluency in enterprise and mid-market deal dynamics; ability to diagnose what's blocking a deal and coach a rep to unblock it 

• Sales Methodology Mastery – deep expertise in MEDDPICC and Value Selling frameworks; ability to teach, coach, and integrate both into training and collateral 

• AI-Augmented Thinking – strategic use of Claude and tools to scale impact; quality control mindset 

• Resilience & Adaptability – comfortable in a fast-moving, high-pressure environment; willing to learn and iterate quickly 

What We're Looking For 

• You are fundamentally a facilitator—someone who lights up in front of a room or on a Microsoft Teams call. You know how to read an audience, adapt your delivery, handle curveballs with grace, and leave people inspired and equipped. You're skilled at making Teams calls engaging (not just talking heads), and you're equally confident running in-person workshops. You've spent 5+ years doing this, and you're genuinely excellent at it. 

• You are fluent in both MEDDPICC and Value Selling frameworks. You don't just know them—you can teach them, coach reps through them, and integrate them into battle cards and playbooks. You understand how to help reps move from discovery (MEDDPICC) into value articulation and justification (Value Selling) seamlessly within complex deals. 

• You have deep expertise in EPM platforms and/or equity services. You've either sold them, supported sellers who sell them, or worked at a vendor. You understand the buyer—CFOs, VPs of Finance, Controllers—and their pain points. You can explain why an EPM platform matters in a way that resonates with business leaders. 

• You've built comprehensive GTM collateral—not borrowed from competitors, but crafted thoughtfully for your market. Battle cards, playbooks, discovery guides, ROI models. You own the quality and continuity of these assets and update them as the market changes. 

• You are obsessed with data. You know your sellers' ramp times, win rates, and average deal sizes—and you track how enablement moves these needles. You present quarterly insights to leadership and iterate your programs based on evidence, not opinion. 

• You take extreme ownership of your sellers' success. You don't just run training and hand off—you know your team, their gaps, their wins. You're in the field regularly, coaching reps one-on-one, riding deals, and solving problems. You celebrate their quota attainment as your success. 

• You're already using Claude AI to scale your work—drafting collateral, analyzing data, coaching. You think strategically about where AI makes you faster without compromising quality. 

• You're resourceful, resilient, and driven. You thrive in dynamic environments and bring positive energy to your team.

We're looking for one data engineer who loves getting under the skin of data, and who is excited about what agents now make possible.
Agents have made data-driven development possible where it wasn't before. Messy real-world data needs ground truth and evaluations, and building them used to be very expensive. Now evaluation harnesses, with agents developing against them in a loop, can take the processing of such data to a precision and recall that wasn't possible before. What this needs is someone who understands what the data means, models it properly, and builds the harnesses that tell agents what right looks like.
IPRally is building a new generation of AI powered tools for understanding patents and technical knowledge, and everything our product does depends on patent data. Offices around the world publish it, each in its own format and language, and some of it exists only as scans of paper. Today it reaches us through data providers, and we expect to get more of it straight from the source.
Our users should see the right data in the right way. Your part of that is getting the data right and delivering it into the stores and APIs our product is built on. From there, product engineers, designers and product managers turn it into what users see. Doing your part well takes taste, and a feel for how the whole system fits together, from the sources to the product.
You'll join our data engineering team of three engineers and work closely with the other engineering teams and the rest of IPRally.
What you'll do
You'll learn what our data means, find where it falls short, and model it so that it reflects how patents, research papers and the companies behind them relate to each other.
You'll build the harness and evaluations that let agents fix data problems on their own, and judge when their results are good enough.
You'll build and run the pipelines that take data from our sources into the stores and APIs the product reads from. They're written in Python, run with Dagster, and monitored with data quality checks that show when something has gone wrong.
You'll work with the product teams on what data they need and in what form, and with the ML team on how we use machine learning in our processing steps.
You'll explore what new sources could give us, including data straight from patent offices, and help decide what's worth adding. With agents, we can try out a new source quickly before committing to it.
When a source stops delivering or falls short, you'll find out why and help work out what other sources could fill the gap.
What we're looking for
This role could be a strong fit if you:
• Have built and run production pipelines on large, noisy real-world data, or worked with such data in statistics or ML.

• Are comfortable deciding what to build when there's no fixed definition of correct and every tool is imperfect, and build statistical evaluations and measurable targets into your work from the start.

• Build agent harnesses that develop our data processing systems on the same basis, so that we can be confident in the quality of both the data and the code.

• Are curious about the real world behind the data: how it came to be, what it means, and how to represent it in the systems that process it.

• Can work out what right data looks like when everything around it is imperfect, from who uses it, what they use it for.

• Like working directly with the people who use the data, inside and outside engineering, to decide what's worth doing.

Experience with patent or other document data, distributed processing such as Ray, or running ML models over large datasets is an advantage, but isn't required.
How we build
Our engineers aren't measured by how much code they personally type. We're much more interested in whether you can understand the data and what people need from it, make good decisions, and use the tools available to turn those decisions into reliable pipelines.
AI agents are already a normal part of how we build at IPRally, and we're still working out what they change in data work. You'll have considerable room to experiment and help shape how the data team works with agents.
Our data stack includes Python, Dagster, Ray, Polars, Postgres, Vespa, Kubernetes and GCP. You don't need to know all of it, or anything about patents: we're much more interested in your judgment and ability to learn.
The salary range for the role is €5,500–7,000/month, with equity on top.
Ideally you're based in Helsinki, but elsewhere in Europe can work for the right person.
Along with your CV, write half a page answering this question: What's the most interesting dataset you've worked with, and what did it take before you could trust it? There's no right answer. We want to see how you think.

Finance Operations Associate
Job Title: Finance Operations Associate
Location: Hybrid our Cape Town office. Also open to candidates in London.

Salary: Competitive, subject to experience
Experience Level: Associate. Newly qualified CA(SA) (up to 2 years post-articles), or
completed SAICA/ACCA/SAIPA articles, with 1 - 2 years’ hands-on experience in
reconciliations, management accounts or financial/ investment operations
Start Date: As soon as possible
Job Type: Full-time, permanent
About Us
IslamicFinanceGuru (IFG) is one of the world’s most prominent Islamic fintechs dedicated to
empowering Muslims to make smarter financial decisions. With a global reach of over 4 million
people every month, we’re addressing a significant societal challenge, helping to bridge the
wealth gap experienced by many in our community.

Our investment arm, Cur8 Capital, is a cutting-edge, Sharia-compliant asset manager offering a
multi-asset class approach that includes cash management, fixed income, real estate, private
equity, and venture capital. We’re breaking AUM records every quarter as we drive forward our
ambitious mission to build a brighter financial future for Muslims worldwide.

We’re not your typical asset manager. We don’t do suits, face time or internal politics. We care
about our mission and work together to achieve it.

Every one of those investments depends on money moving accurately: into deals, out to
investors, and back again as distributions. That’s where you come in.

About the Role
We’re looking for a Finance Operations Associate to join our Ops team, making sure every
investor’s money is handled with care and accuracy.

You’ll be at the centre of how Cur8 operates, running deployments (investor funds going into
investments), investment and fee disbursements, liquidations and scheduled dividend
distributions across a range of funds and asset classes. You’ll report directly to the Operations
Director and work closely with our Investments, Investor Relations and Exco teams, across both
the Cape Town and London offices.

This role is about more than checking that totals match. When something doesn’t reconcile,
you’ll find out why, fix it or escalate it, and communicate accordingly.

This isn’t a graduate role. We’re looking for someone with a solid, practically tested finance-
based foundation who can take ownership quickly, with mentoring from senior management and
is keen to grow alongside the business.

What You’ll Be Doing
Run Accurate Fund Operations
● 	Execute deployments, investment and fee disbursements, liquidations and
scheduled dividend distributions across multiple fund types and asset classes.

● 	Make sure every figure reconciles back to source not just at the total level.

● 	Help make sure our compliance obligations are met and key controls are followed every
time.

● 	Ensure accurate and timely payments are made to investors in line with established
processes.

Reconcile, Investigate & Resolve
● 	Carry out daily reconciliations required for regulatory compliance.

● 	Identify genuine discrepancies, trace them to their root cause, and resolve them yourself
wherever you reasonably can.

● 	Clearly document your findings and reasoning, not just the outcome, as part of our audit
and compliance record.

Support the Wider Business
● 	Handle ad-hoc data requests and queries from the Investor Relations, Investments and
Exco teams.

● 	Spot opportunities to improve and actively streamline existing processes as the
business grows and make things scaleable.

What We’re Looking For
Qualifications & experience
● 	A Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or Finance from a highly reputable institution.

● 	A newly-qualified Chartered Accountant with up to 2 years’ post-articles experience at a
Big 4 firm, or
● 	Completed SAICA, ACCA or UK-equivalent articles at a reputable firm with 1 - 2 years’
hands-on experience in reconciliations, management accounts, and/ or investment
operations.

Skills
● 	Excellent attention to detail. You care about getting the right answer every time, and a
problem isn’t closed until it’s genuinely resolved. Ensuring outputs are accurate and
complete though self-review and checks in place to minimise risk of errors.

● 	An analytical, curious mindset. Strong problem-solving skills, and the ability to draw
logical, well-reasoned conclusions. You are likely to be someone that is inherently
curious and ask the question “why” until full clarity has been obtained.

● 	Strong written and verbal communication. You can clearly explain the reasoning
behind a decision, judgement call or escalation, and you’re comfortable engaging both in
person in Cape Town and online with London-based colleagues.

● 	Independent problem-solving. You investigate and resolve issues yourself wherever
possible, and escalate once you’ve done what you reasonably can.

● 	Excellent prioritisation and time management. You can juggle competing deadlines
in a changing environment without letting speed compromise accuracy.

● 	Proactive and an independent problem solver. The ability to identify and report
issues effectively, while being comfortable investigating and resolving issues yourself
wherever possible and knowing when to escalate.

● 	Customer focused. being aware that our investors are at the heart of everything
● 	we do, and the key stakeholders we serve as part of our mission.

● 	Have a growth mindset. Constantly seeking out opportunities to grow and push your
boundaries, both personally and professionally. In the workplace, this can also look like
improving and streamlining existing processes, while growing alongside the business.

● 	Tech literate. Confidence in adapting to new systems and tools.

Preferred skills and experience:
● 	Prior industry experience within financial services, investments, or another highly
regulated environment (e.g. audit of regulated entities, insurance, or a regulated
fund/asset manager)
● 	A genuine interest in using AI tools to work smarter and build efficiencies into how we
operate.

Most importantly, we want someone who can explain:
What didn’t add up? How did you find out? What did you do about it? Who did you tell? And how
can you make sure it doesn’t happen again?

Personal attributes
● 	Proactive, with a growth mindset, always looking to push your boundaries personally and
professionally.

● 	Reliable and organised, the kind of person others trust with investors’ money.

● 	Collaborative and comfortable working with colleagues in Cape Town, London and
elsewhere.

● 	Passionate about IFG and Cur8’s mission and excited to play a part in helping Muslims
build wealth.

What You’ll Get
● 	Competitive salary with progression as the role and business grow
● 	Mentoring from senior management and a tailored growth path, with real routes to
greater responsibility and seniority for high performers
● 	Hands-on exposure to every part of finance operations across multiple asset classes in a
fast-growing asset management and fintech business
● 	Real ownership of work that directly affects thousands of investors
● 	Hybrid working, with 2 or 3 days a week from home (office-dependent)
● 	Unlimited holidays and a supportive, mission-driven team culture
● 	The chance to help grow businesses that genuinely improve people’s lives
Location & Working Style
This is a full-time, permanent role based in Cape Town. It’s a hybrid role with 3 days per week in
our Century City office. For candidates based elsewhere in the UK, a similar hybrid structure in
our London office.

We’re an equal opportunity employer and a diverse team, united by our mission.

Application Process
To apply, please email your CV to careers@islamicfinanceguru with the subject line “Finance
Operations Associate”.

campaigns who can hit the ground running

IslamicFinanceGuru (IFG) is one of the world’s most prominent Islamic fintechs dedicated to
empowering Muslims to make smarter financial decisions. With a global reach of over 4 million
people every month, we’re addressing a significant societal challenge, helping to bridge the

multi-asset class approach that includes cash management, fixed income, real estate, private

ambitious mission to build a brighter financial future for Muslims worldwide.

As our portfolio grows, we want to do more than simply invest capital into great businesses. We
want to actively help them grow.

That’s where you come in.

About the Role
We’re looking for a Performance Marketing Manager to work across our portfolio companies,
helping them acquire customers and scale through paid advertising.

You’ll initially work closely with businesses across a range of sectors, including healthcare,
financial services, and technology, whilst being deeply embedded with our core content
team, with plenty of support, feedback and collaboration from experienced marketing
professionals.

Rather than spending years advertising the same product to the same audience, you’ll get to
solve growth problems across different businesses, industries, markets, and customer types.

You’ll be responsible for the full paid acquisition cycle: understanding the business and its
customers, developing campaign strategy, launching ads, working with the content team on
creative, measuring performance, and continuously improving results.

This isn't an entry-level role. We’re looking for someone who already knows their way around
paid advertising and can come in, take ownership, and start making an impact quickly.

What You’ll Be Doing
Run & Scale Paid Campaigns
● Own paid acquisition across selected portfolio companies, primarily through Meta and
Google Ads.

● Plan, launch, manage, and optimise campaigns against each business’s commercial
objectives.

● Manage budgets, understand the unit economics behind your campaigns, and scale
what works while maintaining healthy acquisition costs.

● Understand each company’s customer, offer, and funnel so you can develop the right
paid strategy for that business.

Develop Winning Creative
● Work closely with our content team to develop and test new ad concepts, hooks,
angles, offers, and formats.

● Use campaign performance to understand why certain creatives work and turn those
insights into clear briefs for the next round of content.

● Build a structured testing process that helps us continuously improve creative
performance.

Measure, Learn & Improve
● Design and run structured experiments across creative, audiences, offers, and
campaigns, with clear hypotheses and measures of success.
