job_title: Technical Product Manager, Product Data & Revenue Platforms
job_description:
Lyst is a global fashion shopping platform founded in London in 2010 and catering to over 160M shoppers per year. We offer our customers the largest assortment of premium and luxury fashion products in one place, curating pieces from 27,000 of the world's leading brands and stores. In 2025, Lyst joined Zozo, operators of Zozotown, the leading fashion e-commerce platform in Japan. This partnership marks a bold new era for Lyst, as we accelerate our vision and work together to transform the future of fashion shopping through AI and technology.

At Lyst, we obsess over the customer, providing a search and discovery experience which offers inspiration, fulfilment, and personalisation. We believe that fashion is amazing but shopping for fashion often isn't, and we use our technology, data and creativity to bring more joy, greater choice and fewer fails. Our mission is to help fashion shoppers make better decisions and help fashion partners find better audiences as the category-leading destination for every fashion shopper.

**Role**

Product data, and the systems used to transform and enrich it, sit at the heart of how Lyst serves customers and grows revenue. We are looking for a technically strong Product Manager to lead the direction and delivery of the platforms that support our affiliate operations, paid marketing and product-data enrichment.

You will work across two connected missions. The first is helping our commercial teams launch and improve high-value capabilities such as channel integrations, product feeds, conversion and cost data, attribution, reporting and ROAS optimisation. The second is improving the quality, reliability and discoverability of Lyst's product catalogue through internal tooling, product data enrichment, merging and deduplication, leveraging our partnership with our Data Science team in New Zealand.

This is not a conventional consumer-facing Product Manager role. Many requests will arrive with a clear commercial goal and a proposed solution. Your job is to use judgement: move quickly when the problem and solution are well understood; challenge, simplify or productise the request when that will create more value; and make the trade-offs visible when BAU, reliability, technical debt and roadmap work compete for the same capacity.

**What you'll do**

- Own the joined-up roadmap for the Affiliate Operations team, Commercial Enablement and Product-Data Enrichment, with clear outcomes, sequencing and measures of success.
- Turn commercial priorities into well-shaped technical work, partnering with stakeholders who may already have a strong view of the solution.
- Decide when a request should be delivered directly, when assumptions need testing, and when repeated one-off work should become a reusable platform capability.
- Partner with the Engineering Lead and team to clarify scope, dependencies and acceptance criteria, maintain a healthy backlog and improve delivery predictability.
- Lead planning and communication across Paid Marketing, Partnerships, Operations, Data Science and Product & Technology, making trade-offs and capacity constraints explicit.
- Act as the primary Lyst product contact for the NZ-based Data Science team, aligning roadmaps and turning research outputs into secure, observable and supportable production capabilities.
- Define and track outcomes across commercial performance, data quality, platform reliability and operational efficiency.

**What you'll work on**

- **Paid-channel enablement:** product feeds (e.g. for Google Merchant Center), conversion APIs, cost APIs, attribution, reporting and integrations for channels such as Pinterest and Reddit.
- **Reusable commercial capabilities:** common services, data contracts and self-service tooling that reduce duplicated work across channels and campaigns.
- **ROAS and optimisation:** productionising bidding, measurement and optimisation models with the controls, monitoring and feedback loops needed to operate them safely.
- **Partner and affiliate platforms:** partner feed ingestion and validation, merchant tooling and the services that connect catalogue and commercial workflows.
- **Product-data quality:** enrichment, merging, deduplication, entity resolution, taxonomy and measurable improvements to catalogue completeness and coherence.
- **ZOZO collaboration:** joint milestones, experiments, data contracts, technical workshops and clear handovers across time zones.
- **Platform health:** SLAs, observability, runbooks, incident follow-up, peak readiness, BAU and a pragmatic technical roadmap across services such as Minion, Plasma, Merchant Uploader and Affiliate Service.
- **Portfolio management:** an effective intake process, transparent capacity allocation and clear communication of progress, risk and trade-offs.

## Requirements

- Experience in product management for technical, data or platform products; we expect this will usually mean at least four years in relevant roles.
- Experience working on a MarTech team and/or with marketing and commercial stakeholders
- Enough technical depth to work confidently with APIs, schemas, data contracts, ETL or ingestion pipelines, event flows and production systems.
- A track record of turning ambiguous or fragmented stakeholder needs into coherent, deliverable roadmaps without adding process for its own sake.
- Excellent delivery judgement: you can distinguish discovery from execution, define the right level of product work and keep teams moving.
- Experience balancing planned roadmap work with operational demand, technical debt, incidents and reliability improvements.
- Confidence working with commercially accountable stakeholders, including constructively challenging a proposed solution when the evidence supports it.
- Experience working with engineers and data scientists to take models, pipelines or data products from research or prototype into production.
- A practical, low-ego approach. You care about outcomes, dependable delivery and the long-term health of the systems behind them.

The Role: 

Data and AI are at the heart of how we plan to grow our Asset Management business. We are modernising how data is sourced, engineered and consumed across the firm. The goal is trusted, reusable data products that support investment decisions, client reporting, regulatory submissions and a growing range of AI use cases. 

As Head of Data Engineering, you will report to the Director of Data, AI & Analytics and lead a growing data engineering team across London and India. You will own how we ingest, transform, and deliver data. You will be moving us from fragmented, pipeline-by-pipeline delivery to a modern, governed architecture built around data products. 

This is a data engineering leadership role, not a general engineering management role. We want a practitioner who has built modern data platforms hands-on. You should know how to use modern data technologies to design scalable solutions that deliver real business outcomes. 

What You will Do: 

Shape a modern data platform 
• Own the design, build and optimisation of ingestion, transformation and data provisioning on our Snowflake-centric platform. 
• Implement a medallion architecture, with clear standards for promoting data from raw to curated to consumption-ready layers. 
• Set data engineering standards for ELT patterns, orchestration, data modelling, testing, DataOps, CI/CD for data pipelines and observability. 
• Build reusable ingestion, transformation and consumption patterns that speed up access to new data for the business, whether through BI, APIs, data sharing or AI. 
• Take a pragmatic, outcome-led approach, balancing the right data architecture with early business value. 

Deliver governed, trusted data products 
• Make data cataloguing, data quality, lineage and data observability core parts of how every data product is built and run, rather than controls added after delivery. 
• Include data contracts, metadata and certification standards in every data product, so each one is discoverable, trusted and auditable. 
• Ensure data products and pipelines are secure and compliant by design, embedding identity and role-based access control, secrets management, encryption, data classification, retention and privacy controls into engineering standards. 

Build and lead a high-performing data engineering team 
• Lead, inspire and mentor data engineers across the UK and India, and set the standard for how we deliver. 
• Develop the team through regular coaching, clear career pathways and meaningful opportunities to build technical and leadership capability. 
• Shift the team's focus from building individual pipelines to delivering reusable data products, underpinned by strong data modelling, data quality and lineage practices. 

Build AI-ready data and bring AI into data engineering 
• Partner with Data Product, Analytics and AI teams to implement semantic models, ensuring business definitions and relationships are consistently represented in the engineered data products. 
• Apply AI across data engineering, from data quality monitoring and anomaly detection to automated documentation and AI-assisted code, with appropriate human oversight. 

Simplify the estate and retire legacy platforms 
• Lead the technical migration from legacy data platforms and point-to-point data feeds onto the strategic platform. 
• Consolidate duplicated pipelines and fragmented data stores into a smaller set of trusted, reusable data products. 
• Reduce technical debt and keep the data estate simple, supportable and cost-efficient. 
• Build cost awareness into data engineering by designing efficient pipelines and data products and by optimising compute and storage costs as core part of delivery. 

What You will Bring:

• Significant experience in data engineering, including experience leading data engineering teams within Asset Management or Financial Services. 
• Hands-on experience leading Snowflake platform implementation, ideally in an asset management setting. 
• Deep technical knowledge of modern data platform architecture, including medallion and lakehouse patterns, ELT and dimensional or domain data modelling. 
• A track record of designing and delivering data products, including semantic layer implementation for AI and analytics use. 
• Practical experience embedding data governance tooling into delivery, covering data catalogue, data quality, lineage and data observability. 
• Strong understanding of cloud security, data privacy, access management and regulatory control requirements. 
• Track record of collaborating and building effective relationships with colleagues across data and wider technology function. You should be able to share ownership, manage dependencies and agree joint priorities. 
• Experience leading and developing offshore engineering teams as an integrated part of the function, building capability, consistent standards and a one-team culture. 
• Experience working in data mesh or hub-and-spoke data operating models. 
• Good understanding of investment data, such as instruments, portfolios, positions and performance, with deeper asset management experience a strong advantage 
• Experience leading complex data platform migrations and the controlled retirement of legacy platforms while maintaining service continuity. 

Technical toolkit:

• Snowflake, including Snowpipe, Streams and Tasks, Dynamic Tables and Snowpark

• Advanced SQL and Python 
• Data transformation frameworks such as dbt 
• Data pipeline orchestration and DataOps / CI/CD for data

• API, data sharing and consumption patterns

job_title: Full Stack Developer, Python / React / Typescript
job_description:
Across Commodities and Global Markets, data is fundamental to how we trade, price, manage risk and make decisions. It flows through market feeds, cloud platforms and specialist systems, each serving different needs across the business. But having sophisticated data platforms is only part of the equation. When decisions are time-sensitive and carry significant financial and operational consequences, understanding what data is available, what it means, where it came from, how reliable and current it is, and who is entitled to use it becomes just as important. As the scale and complexity of our data estate grow, we want to make it easier for people and applications to find, understand and use the right data with confidence, without the complexity of the underlying systems standing in the way.

We already use established solutions to manage and govern our data, but we believe there is an opportunity to go further. We’re building our own Data Control Plane from the ground up, designed around the needs of our business and the platforms that support it. Rather than replacing the systems that store and process data, it will provide a more consistent way to discover, understand and securely access information across our data estate. Starting with catalogue, metadata, lineage and discovery, we’re laying the foundations for more connected, transparent and effective governance, making it easier to put data to work without compromising control. As AI-enabled applications and agents become increasingly important, that foundation will be critical to enabling them to discover and interact with data in a secure, reliable and governed way.

Building this platform brings together sophisticated application development and the challenges of engineering at scale. From intuitive interfaces that make complex data easy to explore, to high-performance APIs and services that connect securely across distributed systems, every layer needs to be designed for reliability, scalability and long-term evolution.

We are a global financial services group operating in 30 markets with 57 years of unbroken profitability. At Macquarie, you’re empowered to shape a career that is fulfilling and creates value. You will bring your insights and expertise to the task at hand and feel supported as you make your own kind of impact for a better future.

What role will you play?

As a Full Stack Software Engineer, you’ll help shape and build the Data Control Plane from the ground up. You’ll work across the product, from the experiences people interact with to the services and cloud infrastructure behind them. Using React and TypeScript, Python and AWS, you’ll build capabilities that make complex data easier to discover, understand and use.

On the frontend, you’ll create intuitive experiences for exploring and interacting with data. You’ll develop features including catalogue browsing, search, data-rich grids, visualisations and workflow-driven functionality, working with reusable components, design systems and complex application state. As the product grows, you’ll also tackle the performance and usability challenges that come with increasingly rich applications and larger volumes of data.

Beyond the frontend, you’ll design, build and operate the APIs and backend services that power these experiences. Working with Python and frameworks such as FastAPI, you’ll develop secure, high-performing services using SQL and relational data models. You’ll work across areas such as asynchronous processing, validation, pagination, caching, versioning and error handling to create APIs that can evolve reliably as the platform grows.

Security and access will be built into the platform from the outset. You’ll integrate with identity and access-management services, developing authentication and role-based authorisation that allow people and applications to access data appropriately and securely.

You’ll have the opportunity to work across the engineering lifecycle, taking new capabilities from design and development through to deployment and production. Using CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code and observability practices, you’ll help ensure the platform can be released reliably, operated effectively and continually improved as it grows on AWS.

Because this is a greenfield build, you’ll have the opportunity to influence how the product develops as well as what we build. You’ll contribute to architectural decisions, technical direction and the engineering standards that will support the platform as it grows, applying strong software engineering principles across testing, security, scalability, resilience and maintainability. You’ll also develop AI-enabled capabilities that create new ways for people to discover and understand data. This could include natural-language catalogue search, metadata enrichment and intelligent assistant-style features. You’ll integrate managed large language model services and apply appropriate evaluation, safeguards and responsible AI practices to make these capabilities useful, reliable and secure.

What you offer

- Full stack software engineering experience, with a track record of building and launching new products or platforms from the ground up.
- Strong Python backend development experience, including designing and building production APIs using frameworks such as FastAPI.
- Strong React and TypeScript experience.
- Hands-on experience building and deploying applications in the cloud, ideally AWS, using modern approaches such as containers or serverless technologies.
- Experience with CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code and Git-based development, with a strong understanding of testing, observability, security and maintainability.
- Ability to contribute to architecture and technical design decisions, including explaining engineering choices and trade-offs.
- Experience using AI-assisted development tools and integrating large language model or other AI services into applications. Exposure to AWS AI technologies such as Amazon Bedrock and AgentCore, as well as familiarity with agent frameworks such as LangGraph, are a plus.

We are looking for inquisitive problem solvers to join our team as a Graduate Engineer

Mako is a leading options market maker with a global trading footprint. It has been at the forefront of options market making for over 20 years, from the open outcry trading pits to screen trading and automated algorithmic execution strategies that are driving the future of the industry.

From offices in London, Amsterdam, Dublin, Singapore, Sydney, Brisbane and Chengdu, Mako offers the best in class liquidity solutions across Equities, Fixed Income, Commodities and FX derivatives markets and prides itself in its entrepreneurial, collaborative and philanthropic culture.

 

A Unique Programme for Aspiring Engineer

Mako’s Graduate Engineer Programme is an immersive and structured programme specially designed to give our graduates the opportunity to develop in-depth knowledge and experience of the industry. As a graduate, you will be part of a structured training programme designed to provide you with hands-on experience and early exposure to production-relevant work within our Software team, alongside formal training and development opportunities.

What we need from you

Most of our engineers have a degree in a STEM subject and what they all have in common is having a pragmatic, problem-solving mind-set and strong quantitative skills. Additionally, we are looking for:

• A strong understanding of algorithms and data structures

• Knowledge of at least one mainstream OOP language such as C++, C#, Java, JavaScript or Go

• Working knowledge of C++, as our live coding interviews are conducted in C++

• An upper second class degree in an STEM based subject or equivalent.

• An interest in financial markets

It would be excellent if you had:

• Experience of asynchronous and multi-threaded programming

• An appreciation for clean, readable, testable code

• A good understanding of networks and network programming

• An understanding of computer architecture and how it relates to the performance of your code

Experience with the following tools and languages is beneficial:

• Python, shell scripting, CMake, Jenkins, PCAP/Wireshark, C, static analysers, a range of compilers.

 

We are Mako

At Mako, we are welcoming, inclusive and collaborative. We work fast and smart in a supportive and dress-down environment that allows colleagues to be themselves and achieve great things. We uphold the principles of a flat structure that offers unrivalled engagement with senior leadership and career development opportunities. We have a comprehensive benefits package, including:

• Flexible leave and flexible working policies

• Private health and dental insurance

• Generous pension scheme

• Free access to the Mako gym

• Employee wellbeing guidance and support

• Opportunity to become involved in the rewarding work of the Mako Foundation

 

PROGRAMME HIGHLIGHTS

Work in a Fast Paced Real-Time Engineer Environment

From the outset, Graduate Engineers are introduced to the team and its duties. Our low latency derivatives trading system is written in-house. It is implemented in C++ and runs on Linux.

The Front Office engineering team is responsible for designing and implementing all aspects of Mako’s proprietary trading system. This includes algorithms, pricing models, user interfaces and connectivity to most major derivatives venues and third-party trading platforms.

Learn From Highly Experienced Engineers

As a Graduate Engineer, you will be mentored by some of the most experienced professionals in the business, working in pragmatic, self-organising teams that collaborate closely with traders, hardware engineers, and support staff.

Our teams use an Agile development model to deliver tangible business value. By leveraging modern software practices and continuous integration pipelines, our engineers rapidly transform trading ideas into profitable automated strategies.

We provide graduates with dedicated mentorship and comprehensive training in both technical and soft skills, preparing you to partner effectively with stakeholders and solve complex trading challenges. Technology is central to everything we do, and our teams are composed of knowledgeable, motivated, and friendly problem-solvers who thrive in Mako's highly supportive and collaborative culture.

 

Recruitment Process

At Mako, we want you to have the best possible experience, so we've outlined what to expect from our recruitment process to help you prepare for each stage.

• Initial Online Assessment
Shortly after you apply, you'll receive an online test. We recommend completing it promptly in a calm, focused environment.

• Technical Coding Test
If your assessment is successful and your profile aligns with the role; you’ll be invited to complete an online technical coding assessment.

• Live Coding Interviews
Next, you'll participate in two rounds of live coding interviews, conducted in C++.

• Final Panel Interview
If you progress past the live coding stage, we’ll schedule a final interview with a panel of our Senior Engineers and HR. Again, please check your email (including spam folders) for scheduling details.

• Offer Stage
Once all interviews are completed, offers will be made to successful candidates.

 

If you require any support or adjustments with the application process or have any questions about the application process, please contact hr@mako.com .

Mars is a family-owned business that has been making products for people and their pets for more than 100 years. About the role: As a Customer Development Executive, you will drive sales growth, brand advocacy, and recommendations within your territory. By building trusted relationships with veterinary professionals, pet specialty retailers, and agricultural partners, you will champion better health outcomes for pets through science-backed nutrition. This dynamic role merges commercial excellence, relationship management, education, and strategic territory planning to deliver exceptional value to our customers and bring the Royal Canin purpose to life.

• Develop and maintain long-term relationships with veterinary clinics, pet specialty retailers, and agricultural partners to establish Royal Canin as their preferred nutritional brand.
• Achieve territory sales, distribution, and new product introduction (NPD) objectives by executing tailored customer growth plans and account strategies.
• Lead engaging education sessions, in-clinic training, and presentations to help partners understand the vital role of nutrition in disease management and preventative care.
• Analyze territory sales data and performance metrics to identify high-potential business opportunities and proactively manage risks.
• Efficiently plan daily travel, manage budgets, and prioritize customer touchpoints based on strategic segmentation to maximize coverage.
• Keep highly accurate, up-to-date customer records and activity reports within CRM systems to track engagement and support territory continuity.
• Act as a proud ambassador for Royal Canin’s purpose (A Better World for Pets), sharing market insights and collaborating with cross-functional scientific and sales teams.

Your unique ingredients: 
• Experienced in field sales, territory management, or customer-facing roles with a track record of meeting commercial objectives. 
• Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with a natural ability to build long-term trust with diverse customer groups.

• Strong commercial acumen with the ability to analyze sales data to identify business opportunities and risks.

• Experience in Food, CPG, FMCG, manufacturing or another asset-intensive global organisation.

• Experience with Mars technology governance, Enterprise Architecture, Cybersecurity, GDO transition, ServiceNow or PMX.

• Experience balancing global technology standards with regional, market and factory requirements.

Here’s what you’ll be doing:
• Lead the design and delivery of scalable, resilient data pipelines into BigQuery, integrating data from a wide range of internal systems, APIs, databases, files, webhooks and event streams. 
• Shape the engineering approach across Google Cloud Platform (GCP), working with technologies including BigQuery, Cloud Storage, Pub/Sub, Datastream and Cloud Composer/Airflow, alongside Terraform and infrastructure-as-code. 
• Set and champion high engineering standards across data modelling, dbt (data build tool) transformations, testing, monitoring, documentation, deployment, version control and cost optimisation.

• Help shape the Innovation Team roadmap, prioritising strategic, repeatable platforms and solutions that can deliver value across the firm rather than one-off fixes.

We’re looking for an experienced and curious data professional who combines strong technical expertise with a practical, people-focused approach. You’ll be comfortable taking ownership, making sound technical decisions and bringing others with you; whether you’re mentoring colleagues, partnering with stakeholders or turning a complex business challenge into a scalable solution.

You don’t need to tick every box. We’re interested in people who can bring the right mix of experience, technical capability and ambition to help us continue developing our data and innovation capability.

What you’ll bring
• Strong hands-on experience in data engineering, analytics engineering or data platform roles, typically gained over 5+ years, with experience operating at a senior or leadership level. 
• Advanced SQL and Python skills and experience using them to build reliable, production-ready data solutions. 
• Strong experience with cloud data warehouses, ideally BigQuery, and a good working knowledge of the wider Google Cloud Platform (GCP) ecosystem. 
• Experience with modern data engineering tools and practices such as Airflow/Cloud Composer, dbt, Git/GitHub, CI/CD and Terraform or other infrastructure-as-code tooling. 
• A solid understanding of data modelling, dimensional modelling, orchestration, testing, data quality and operational monitoring, with a focus on building solutions that are scalable and maintainable. 
• Experience designing and operating production-grade data pipelines, integrating data from sources such as APIs, databases, flat files, webhooks and message queues. 
• A strong appreciation of data security and governance, including GDPR, role-based access, secrets management and the responsible handling of sensitive information. 
• The ability to take an ambiguous business challenge and turn it into a clear, pragmatic technical solution, balancing immediate needs with longer-term value. 
• Strong communication and stakeholder skills, with the confidence to make complex technical concepts accessible to non-technical audiences and influence decisions at different levels. 
• A collaborative leadership style, with a genuine interest in coaching others, sharing knowledge and raising engineering standards across the team. 

Qualifications & experience
A degree or equivalent experience in computer science, data engineering, software engineering, mathematics, statistics or a related technical discipline would be beneficial. Google Cloud, dbt or other relevant data engineering certifications are also welcomed, although practical experience and demonstrable expertise are just as important to us.

Experience within professional services, finance, accounting, legal, tax, audit or another regulated environment would be an advantage, but it isn’t essential.

Above all, we’re looking for someone who brings ownership, sound judgement and a delivery mindset. You’ll enjoy solving problems, challenging how things are done and finding better ways of working, while maintaining a strong focus on quality, security and risk.

The role may involve occasional travel to other Menzies offices for workshops, discovery sessions, implementation support and team meetings.

BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT MANAGER – Lighting

• Well‑maintained West Midlands and Mid Wales territory worth over £1M with strong existing relationships.

• Selling high‑quality commercial LED lighting through wholesalers, contractors, architects and M&E consultants.

• £55,000 base salary with £30,000 performance‑linked bonus potential. OTE £85,000 + Benefits 

• Premium package: Tesla Electric company car or £500 monthly car allowance.

• 7% employer pension contribution plus 28 days’ holiday for a strong overall benefits package.

• Autonomous, field‑based Business Development Manager role reporting to a Regional Sales Manager with clear growth potential.

• Territory/Postcodes: SY, B, WR, WS, TF, DY, CV, WV (West Midlands & Mid Wales)

• Travel Expectations of 3-4 Days on the road, rare overnight stays (3-4 Times/Year) 

This is an exciting opportunity for a driven Business Development Manager to take on a well‑maintained, high‑value territory worth over £1M across the West Midlands and Mid Wales with a leading UK commercial lighting business.

The Opportunity

A growing LED lighting manufacturer is looking for a Business Development Manager to drive sustainable sales growth across an established West Midlands and Mid Wales territory with a sales value in excess of £1M. You will sell through electrical wholesale, contractors, architects and consultants, creating further demand while ensuring key wholesalers continue to stock the company’s products for day‑to‑day ex‑stock business.

What you will do

• Develop and deliver a strategic territory sales plan to hit and exceed annual sales targets for both the business and your £1M+ area.

• Build strong relationships with electrical wholesalers, contractors, architects, consultants, end users and specifiers to grow market share and maximise project opportunities.

• Use your technical product knowledge to provide value‑engineered lighting solutions that win projects and generate repeat business.

• Use your commercial acumen to optimise pricing within agreed guidelines and secure profitable orders.

• Analyse wins and losses, track your pipeline and provide clear monthly reports on activities, results and trends.

• Work closely with internal teams (quoting, projects, customer service, product engineering) to ensure a seamless customer experience and aligned go‑to‑market activity.

What we’re looking for

• Proven success in sales and business development within the electrical or lighting sector, ideally through wholesale and project sales.

• Strong track record of delivering business growth, building a robust pipeline and exceeding KPIs.

• Ability to understand technical customer requirements and translate them into the right product and system solutions.

• Excellent negotiation, influencing and communication skills, with confidence engaging senior stakeholders including contractors, architects and consultants.

• Results‑driven, commercially minded and comfortable working autonomously to plan, prioritise and execute your territory strategy.

Package and benefits

• £55,000 base salary per annum.

• £30,000 annual bonus opportunity linked to performance.

• Choice of Tesla company car or £500 per month car allowance.

• 7% employer pension contribution.

• 28 days’ holiday, plus bank holidays if applicable.

Reporting and location

You will report to a Regional Sales Manager, working remotely in the field with regular customer visits and team interaction as required. The role covers a well‑maintained West Midlands and Mid Wales territory worth over £1M, with strong existing relationships and clear growth potential through wholesalers, contractors, architects and consultants.

For more details, contact Charlie Austin @ Mercury Hampton.

Business Development Manager – UK & Europe – Data Centre Infrastructure

Business Development Manager / UK & Europe

Data Centre & Telecom Infrastructure 

100,000 + OTE 

London (Hybrid) – European Coverage + Car Allowance + Bonus

Help Shape the Future of Europe’s Data Centre Infrastructure

We’re partnering with a global leader in fibre optic and connectivity solutions that is investing heavily in the European data centre market. As demand from hyperscalers, colocation providers, and enterprise operators continues to accelerate, we’re seeking an ambitious Sales Manager / Key Account Manager to drive growth across the UK and wider European region.

This is an outstanding opportunity for a commercially minded sales professional who understands the data centre ecosystem and enjoys winning complex, high-value projects. You’ll be at the forefront of major infrastructure developments, working with some of the industry’s most influential operators, developers, EPC contractors, consultants, and system integrators.

The Opportunity

You’ll take ownership of developing strategic customer relationships and securing project-based business across the rapidly expanding data centre sector. From early-stage specification through to project delivery, you’ll play a pivotal role in influencing designs, winning framework agreements, and delivering commercial success.

The role offers significant autonomy, exposure to some of Europe’s largest data centre projects, and the backing of a well-established international manufacturer with a reputation for innovation and technical excellence.

What You’ll Be Doing

New Business & Market Development

• Identify and win new opportunities with hyperscalers, colocation providers, enterprise operators, developers, EPC contractors, MEP consultants, and system integrators.

• Develop relationships across the data centre ecosystem to build a strong and sustainable pipeline.

• Drive product specification and secure long-term framework agreements on major construction and expansion programmes.

• Position innovative fibre optic connectivity and cabling solutions within high-growth data centre environments.

Strategic Account Management

• Build trusted relationships with senior decision-makers and key stakeholders.

• Create and execute account plans aligned to customer growth and infrastructure roadmaps.

• Manage opportunities from concept and design stage through installation, commissioning, and handover.

• Strengthen partner networks across contractors, distributors, installers, and technology providers.

Commercial & Project Leadership

• Lead complex tenders, RFQs, and RFP processes from initial qualification through to contract award.

• Coordinate technical, operational, and commercial stakeholders to deliver winning proposals.

• Maintain accurate forecasting and pipeline management.

• Track market activity, investment trends, and emerging opportunities across key European data centre hubs.

Products & Solutions

You’ll represent a comprehensive portfolio of industry-leading solutions including:

• High-density fibre optic connectivity systems

• Ultra-high fibre count cabling

• Pre-terminated fibre assemblies

• Structured cabling solutions

• Fibre management systems

• LSZH and fire-performance cable solutions

• Data centre backbone and white-space connectivity infrastructure

What We’re Looking For

Essential Experience

• Proven B2B sales, business development, or key account management experience within:

• Data centre infrastructure

• Structured cabling

• Fibre optic connectivity

• Critical infrastructure

• Telecommunications infrastructure

• Track record of winning project-led business and managing complex sales cycles.

• Strong understanding of data centre design, construction, and physical infrastructure environments.

• Existing relationships across data centre operators, hyperscalers, colocation providers, contractors, consultants, or integrators.

• Experience managing technical and commercial negotiations.

• Strong commercial acumen and project management capability.

• Fluent English communication skills.

Desirable

• Technical qualification in Electrical Engineering, Telecommunications, or a related discipline.

• Knowledge of data centre specifications, cable regulations, and fire-performance standards.

• Experience using CRM, SAP ERP, or similar forecasting and pipeline management tools.

Contact Gareth Symms to find out more!

job_description:
Key Account Manager – Major Infrastructure Account

£50,000 – £60,000 + Car + Bonus

Heathrow Airport/Slough/Hounslow/Hayes/Harlington/Longford/Staines-upon-Thames/London Borough of Hillingdon

Airside Operations Environment

A leading provider of equipment, site services and procurement solutions is looking to appoint a commercially focused Key Account Manager to support a high-profile infrastructure and operational environment in West London.

This is a unique opportunity for someone who understands the demands of working within complex operational sites and can build trusted relationships with stakeholders across project delivery, operations and procurement functions.

The Role

• Manage and develop a strategically important customer account operating in a safety-critical environment.

• Act as the key interface between operational teams, suppliers and customer stakeholders.

• Coordinate equipment, materials and service requirements across multiple workstreams.

• Support project mobilisation, forecasting and ongoing account development.

• Drive service excellence, operational performance and continuous improvement initiatives.

• Identify opportunities for account growth and increased customer value.

What We’re Looking For

• Experience within construction, plant hire, infrastructure, logistics, facilities management or industrial services.

• Strong account management and stakeholder engagement skills.

• Commercially astute with a proactive, solutions-led approach.

• Ability to work effectively across multiple projects and operational teams.

• Experience managing complex or high-profile customer accounts.

Essential Requirement

• Must hold a current Heathrow Airside Pass or have very recent Heathrow Airside experience and be eligible for immediate airside clearance.

• Knowledge of Heathrow operations and working within a secure airport environment is highly desirable.

Why Consider This Opportunity?

• Opportunity to work on one of the UK’s most significant operational environments.

• High-profile customer exposure with genuine strategic account responsibility.

• Broad solution offering covering equipment, procurement and operational services.

• Joining a growing business that is investing heavily in customer experience and operational excellence.

• Significant scope for career progression and personal impact.

• Increase market share and elevate brand presence worldwide

• Win new business and grow key accounts

About Us
MeshAI.io was founded in 2018 by academics, scientists, and engineers in Canada with
decades of experience in optimization and healthcare systems. A near-death experience for one
of our founders—caused by fatigue from an error in scheduling—turned our research on
burnout, inefficiency, and lost wellness into a personal mission. That work led us to create a new
category of staff scheduling called “collaborative scheduling.” As a category leader, Mesh AI’s
mission is to design intelligent, fair, and transparent schedules so clinicians can rest, feel
respected, and focus on what matters most: caring for patients, not fighting with spreadsheets
and call calendars.

● Carry out administrative tasks as requested.

ABOUT MISTRAL

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.




THE TEAM

Mistral is building a sovereign AI cloud for Europe. Our customers in finance, healthcare, and the public sector run frontier models on European-jurisdiction infrastructure, and the Cloud Platform team builds the systems that make that possible — compute orchestration, Kubernetes, bare metal, storage, networking, and the datacenter fleet that runs it all.

European Compute Units let enterprises commit to multi-year capacity on that infrastructure, and we are scaling toward a gigawatt of compute across Europe by 2030. You will design and ship the layer every sovereign AI deployment depends on and shape the team building it.




THE ROLE

A datacenter is not a cloud until software makes it one. You will lead the team that turns arriving hardware into accepted clusters.

Cabling validation, burn-in, firmware, deployment validation, software stack install — all of it automated, none of it click-ops. Your KPI is time to acceptance: the hours between a rack being physically installed and it serving customer workloads. Across the industry that number is measured in weeks. You will drive it toward days, then hours, as we scale toward a gigawatt of compute across Europe.

This is a founding leadership role at the intersection of hardware and software. Early on it is deliberately hands-on: most of your time in the code and the architecture, some of it on datacenter floors, because the automation has to survive contact with the machines it runs on.

But the job is building and leading a team from day one — hiring your first engineers, coaching them, setting their growth paths, and running the rituals that keep quality high. As the team grows, the balance shifts toward people leadership, and you decide how fast. You shape this new team's charter and set the standard for how every future Mistral datacenter comes online.




WHAT YOU WILL DO

 - Build the delivery pipeline in Go: provisioning, configuration, validation, burn-in, network bring-up, software stack install.

 - Build the team from scratch: make the first hires, onboard and coach them, own their performance and growth paths — and set the tooling standards and the playbook every future site reuses.

 - Own time-to-acceptance and drive it down relentlessly — measure it, break it down, kill the slowest step first.

 - Work shoulder-to-shoulder with Hardware Design and Fleet Health — reliability starts at delivery.

 - Handle GPU fleets at scale: H100 and GB200-class nodes, InfiniBand and RoCE fabrics, and the failure modes they bring.

 - Partner with Product Managers and the datacenter org to plan delivery waves against capacity commitments.




WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Experience with digital media data is highly beneficial.

Responsibilities:
• Own and extend the end-to-end data pipeline from Cloud Function ingestion through dbt transformation (staging → intermediate → marts) to analysis-ready tables in BigQuery.
• Develop and maintain dbt macros, Jinja templates, and platform YAML definitions that auto-generate models across 26+ ad platforms.
• Manage and improve GCP infrastructure (BigQuery, Cloud Run, Cloud Functions, Cloud Scheduler, Pub/Sub) provisioned via Terraform.
• Build and maintain the Python CLI tooling that orchestrates client onboarding, config compilation, and pipeline execution.
• Mentor the team of data engineers, driving best practices in DataOps, code review, testing, and documentation.
• Proactively review existing processes to identify opportunities to automate manual work, optimise data delivery, and re-design infrastructure for greater scalability.
• Collaborate with analysts, data scientists, and BI teams (PowerBI, Looker Studio, Tableau, etc.) to maximise the value delivered from data models.
• Contribute to CI/CD pipelines (Cloud Build), testing (pytest, dbt tests), and documentation (MkDocs, etc.).

About You

Required:
• Strong experience with dbt - macros, Jinja templating, incremental models, seeds, testing, and packages.
• Proficient in Python 3.11+ building CLI tools, data processing, and automation.
• Proficient in SQL, ideally BigQuery dialect.

Quality

• Partner with Quality and Cell Teams to identify and reduce quality-related losses. 

Technical Documentation & Obsolescence 
• Maintain up-to-date technical documentation for all section equipment, incorporating every improvement or modification. 
• Manage equipment obsolescence in your area — develop the replacement roadmap, drive masterplan actions, and prepare CAPEX proposals. 

Projects & Cost Management

This is a foundations role. You build the system that pricing and packaging decisions run on, rather than running price experiments yourself. To do so, here are your core responsibilities:



OWN THE LICENSING & BILLING STRATEGY & ROADMAP

 - Define and communicate the product strategy and roadmap for Licensing & Billing in partnership with Engineering, Product leadership, Finance, and go-to-market.

 - Introduce "account" as a first-class product primitive (accounts, purchases, license keys, activations) and expose it as the API contract our customer-facing console and multi-instance management are built on.

 - Productize the deal-to-entitlement flow so a closed deal in Salesforce creates or updates entitlements without manual steps.



METERING & BILLING PLATFORM

 - Own usage metering and billing for Cloud and Enterprise, including subscription billing: what counts as a billable execution, quota consumption, and overage charging.

 - Lead the migration off Paddle Classic and unify Cloud and Enterprise billing into one platform.

 - Build the mechanics for usage-based enterprise billing and reliable overage charging.



CROSS-ORG ALIGNMENT

 - Make the architecture and mechanism decisions (entitlement model, billing platform, enterprise invoicing path) and align closely with Finance and go-to-market on each of them. Every decision here touches money; you bring people along rather than inform them afterwards.

 - Hold clear boundaries with adjacent teams: the customer console, execution limits, and access control live elsewhere; you own the data and mechanics they rely on.

Must-haves

 - Systems and data-model depth: You can design or critique an entity model, reason about reconciliation and idempotency in a sync, read an API contract, and explain why two systems reading the same events end up with different numbers.

 - Attention to detail: You know that if the billing data is wrong, everything built on it inherits the error, and you sequence work accordingly.

 - Prioritization under ambiguity: You make trade-offs explicit and connect foundational or data-quality work to commercial outcomes.

 - Ownership and autonomy: You grab problems without being asked, fix what you see broken, and drive outcomes without waiting for direction.

 - Exceptional communication: You're equally at home with engineers, the Finance team, and Sales, and you can make billing trade-offs legible to all of them.

 - Enterprise reality: You understand what self-hosted, air-gapped, and OEM deployments mean for licensing and metering.



Nice-to-haves

 - Usage-based billing: You've owned usage-based or hybrid (subscription plus usage) billing.

 - Vendor billing stacks: You've worked hands-on with Paddle, Stripe, Chargebee, Zuora or similar, and know where they break at enterprise contract volume.

 - Migration experience: You've run a billing-provider migration.

 - Hands-on ability: You can read code, query data, or prototype, even if you're not shipping it.

 - CRM integration: You've worked on Salesforce or CRM-to-billing integrations.

 - Domain familiarity: You know workflow automation, agent orchestration, or open-source / developer-community products.

Your work directly shapes how n8n makes money and how easily customers can buy, grow, and trust what they pay for, from self-serve Cloud to air-gapped and OEM deployments.

You'll join one of Europe's fastest growing startups at the sweet spot: small enough to have real impact and be empowered, big enough that your work already reaches massive scale and serious enterprise customers. job_title: Business Operations & Improvement Development Programme - People
job_description:
## Job description

### Good things this way

If you're ambitious, curious and enjoy working with people, our Business Operations & Improvement Development Programme, People provides a structured route into a rewarding career in HR.

Help create a great colleague experience while developing the commercial, people and problem-solving skills needed for a future HR career.

You'll gain broad exposure across our People function, building an understanding of how different HR specialisms work together to help colleagues perform at their best and support Nationwide's business goals.

Whether you're a graduate ready to make an impact, or a career changer looking for a new challenge, you'll gain hands-on experience, develop future-ready skills, and contribute to projects that deliver banking that's fairer, more rewarding, and for the good of society.

We'll support your development through structured learning, personalised development and hands-on experience, helping you grow with confidence.

Looking for a rewarding career in banking? Good things this way.

### Where you’ll be working

You'll join our People function, where teams work together to create a great colleague experience and help Nationwide and its people thrive.

The programme provides broad exposure across the function, with opportunities to experience areas such as Talent Management & Inclusion, Development, Learning & Skills, People & Culture, People Chief Operating Office and Business Operations.

Much of your work will connect to priorities shaping the future of Nationwide, including business transformation, integration, technology, digital enablement, learning and skills.

Working across different teams will also help you build relationships with experienced HR professionals and understand how people practices support business performance.

### Location

At Nationwide we offer hybrid working wherever possible. More rewarding relationships are supported through our hybrid approach, bringing colleagues together across our UK wide estate, whilst also supporting generous access to home working. We value our time in the office to solve problems, to learn, and to feel connected.

For this job you'll spend at least two days per week, based at our Swindon office.

If we receive a high volume of relevant applications, we may close the advert earlier than the advertised date, so please apply as soon as you can.  

### What you'll be doing on our Business Operations & Improvement Development Programme, People

Our Business Operations & Improvement Development Programme begins on 6th September 2027.

Over two years, you'll complete rotations across different teams within our People function. Each placement will introduce new HR disciplines, business challenges and ways of working.

As your experience grows, you'll take on increasingly complex work and greater responsibility. Regular feedback and development conversations will help you understand your strengths, build new skills and take ownership of your development.

Alongside your placements, you'll benefit from role-specific technical training and structured development experiences. There will also be opportunities to attend external conferences and events and receive support towards a **CIPD qualification**.

People are at the heart of Nationwide's success. Through this programme, you'll gain first-hand experience of how HR helps colleagues develop their careers, perform at their best and deliver great outcomes for customers.

No two days are the same. One day could involve analysing people data and preparing insight for a leadership discussion. Another could see you meeting stakeholders, supporting a People initiative or working on a project designed to improve the colleague experience.

You'll also gain exposure to the technologies changing HR. This could include Microsoft 365, collaboration platforms, People systems, reporting tools and emerging technologies such as AI.

Throughout the programme, you'll develop skills in:

- Business and commercial awareness

- Stakeholder engagement and relationship management

- Consulting and influencing

- Critical thinking and problem solving

- Data literacy and insight generation

- Project and change management

- Ethics and professional judgement

- Digital working and emerging technology

The breadth of the programme means you'll encounter unfamiliar topics, new stakeholders and changing priorities. You'll learn how to work through ambiguity, balance competing demands and build confidence where there isn't always a straightforward answer.

This isn't a programme spent watching from the sidelines. You'll work on meaningful projects, contribute to decisions that affect colleagues across Nationwide and build practical experience from the start.

### Who we’re looking for on our Business Operations & Improvement Development Programme, People

We're looking for driven, curious people with high standards and a genuine interest in building a career in HR.

You don't need previous HR experience or an HR-related degree. What matters more is your curiosity about people and organisations, your willingness to learn and your motivation to make a positive difference.

To succeed on our Business Operations & Improvement Development Programme, you'll need to show:

- Curiosity about how people, culture and HR contribute to business success.

- Confidence analysing information and using insight to support decisions

- An interest in solving people and business challenges through practical solutions

- The ambition to keep growing, take on new challenges and build towards your next career step
- A logical, methodical approach, with the ability to understand both the detail and the bigger picture 

- The confidence to build relationships and work with colleagues across the business 

- Drive, high performance and a commitment to learning from feedback and setbacks 

- A determination to push for better and put customers first in the decisions you make

Our customer first behaviours put customers and members at the heart of how we work together. They are the set of behaviours that every colleague needs to display, in every role:

- **Feel what customers feel** - We step into our customers’ shoes, using their feedback and insights to empathise with them and to understand their needs, so that every decision we make starts and finishes with our customers in mind
- **Say it straight** - We are brave in speaking out and saying what we think – we’re honest and direct with good intent, openly sharing diverse perspectives to reach the best conclusions and using language everyone can understand
- **Push for better** - We don’t settle for mediocrity, we challenge the status quo, taking responsibility for continuous improvement and personal development
- **Get it done** - We prioritise what will have the greatest impact, we are decisive, and we take accountability for delivering brilliant customer outcomes.

### The extras you’ll get

High performing and purpose-driven colleagues deserve a rewarding career and competitive benefits to match. We offer you:

- Structured learning, personalised development and hands-on experience to help you build future-ready skills and progress your career in banking
- 25 days holiday each year, which increases over time to 30. Plus, you can ‘buy’ up to 10 extra days 
- The opportunity to earn an annual bonus based on your performance
- Private medical insurance to help you access additional healthcare when you need it
- Wellhub access to a range of free and paid fitness and wellbeing options, plus free on-site gyms at selected locations
- A highly competitive pension to help you start building your financial future 
- A great selection of additional benefits through our salary sacrifice scheme
- Up to 14 paid hours each year to volunteer for a cause that matters to you
- Life assurance to provide additional peace of mind for you and the people who matter to you

### Banking – but fairer, more rewarding, and for the good of society

We forge our own path at Nationwide.

As a mutual, we’re owned by our members - those customers who bank, save or have a mortgage with us. We challenge the financial sector status quo. We don’t see customers as the engine of our own profit. We share our profits with them and put their needs first. Always there when they need us. Supporting them and their lives.

If you’re inspired by fairer finances, passionate about making a meaningful impact, and truly care about our customers, you’re one of us.

At Nationwide, you are challenged to grow and rewarded for doing so. Valued. Recognised. Inspired to be your best. As a community we want our working lives to count. As a team, we celebrate what we achieve. As a standard-setter, we work for the good of customers, communities, and broader society.

We are purpose-driven. Uncompromisingly customer. Unstoppably Nationwide.

### What to do next

If this role is for you, please click the ‘Apply Now’ button, where you’ll be asked to answer a few quick questions for us.  

 We’ll send you our online assessments to complete and there will also be a short video interview to find out more about you. If you are successful, you could be selected to attend one of our assessment centres which run from January 2027.

### Visa sponsorship information

As a UK Visas and Immigration (UKVI) approved sponsor, we have a responsibility to comply with the applicable Immigration Rules and guidance (which are subject to change). The Skilled Worker route has specific requirements relating to skill level of the role and minimum salary expectations. As such, our ability to employ individuals who require sponsorship for immigration purposes is limited or may not be possible for some programmes.  

**VISA Sponsorship cannot be offered on this programme.**  

All successful applicants with need to demonstrate their right to work in the UK on commencement of employment and for the duration of the programme applied for without requiring sponsorship.  

If you have any further questions, please contact us at Early.Careers@nationwide.co.uk

About Nava

Nava is a consultancy and public benefit corporation working to make government services simple and effective. Since 2015, federal, state, and local agencies have trusted Nava to help solve highly scrutinized technology modernization challenges.

 

As a client services company, we guide agencies constrained by legacy systems to a future with sharp user experiences built on secure, reliable, fault-tolerant cloud infrastructure. We bill for our time, offering our expertise and problem-solving approach to help our government partners enhance their digital products and services. People are at the heart of our work, from members of the public who rely on benefit programs to government agency staff. Through human-centered design and modern engineering best practices, we help our government partners understand user needs and deliver on their missions more effectively. This focus gives everyone at Nava the opportunity to do work that is meaningful, impactful, and deeply connected to public good.

 

Please note: the level of the role will be determined by Nava leadership based on experience and skillset.

Position summary 

Nava is at the forefront of reimagining how our government serves its people, and we’re looking for a Senior Product Manager to drive our vision forward.

 

You'll help us execute our mission of reimagining the digital services our government provides. Working directly with government partners and across Nava’s engineering, design, and business teams, you’ll create experiences that improve the lives of millions of Americans. You care deeply about end users and are passionate about crafting simple and usable solutions. 

 

You'll work with government partners and cross-functional teams of engineers, designers, and project managers to set direction, scope product features, remove obstacles and barriers, and assess the business impact on a government contract.

 

You will be uniquely positioned and empowered to make a huge impact on Nava's mission to reimagine how our government serves its people.

 

You think holistically and take pride in working through highly ambiguous situations to deliver value to users. You have a strong bias towards action when faced with incomplete information and communicate transparently to build consensus internally and externally. 

 

 

What you'll do

• Define the vision, goals, and measures of success for the products and services you manage

• Work with designers, business analysts, and technical leads to discover and synthesize market research, user needs, business requirements, and technical approaches

• Define the direction, scope, and priority of projects, from high-level initiatives to specific features, user stories, and business metrics

• Work closely with cross-functional teams to develop and ship projects

• Proactively socialize, iterate on, and build buy-in for product initiatives with the team, government partners, and other contractors

• Collaborate with the project management team to prioritize roadmaps and inbound units of work

• Represent Nava’s outcome-centric and user-centric approach in discovery meetings with agencies and contractors

• Understand and communicate the needs of end users and population segments we serve and government partners we work with

• Measure product progress toward business goals or user needs and translate data insights into action

• Make tactical decisions to improve the design, define requirements, and generate stakeholder buy-in for our desired path forward

Required skills

• At least 10 years of experience as a Product Manager of a cross-functional team

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience

We run a large-scale GPU cloud and AI infrastructure platform. Fraud and abuse — stolen payment cards, fake sign-ups, compute mining, credential abuse, and coordinated free-tier exploitation — directly threaten platform economics, capacity availability for legitimate customers, and our standing with payment providers and cloud partners.

• Own the manual review and case-management experience for the Trust & Safety operations team, including queues, evidence views, and action workflows (block, limit, step-up verification, release). 

• Own customer-facing friction points — verification flows, step-up challenges, and appeals — designed to minimize false positives and protect the legitimate user experience. 

• Identify fraud and abuse incidents early — define the signals, alerts, and thresholds that surface incidents before they scale, and own the detection surface that flags them. 

• Participate in incident reviews and post-mortems, capturing root causes and turning each finding into concrete improvements to detection rules, models, and the roadmap. 

• Ensure timely response to active incidents — drive fast triage, clear ownership, and mitigation, working alongside Trust & Safety, Engineering, and Data Science to contain impact. 

• Write clear PRDs and specs that translate fuzzy risk problems into shippable engineering and data-science work. 

• Partner with Analytics team on detection models — defining the problem, labels, and success criteria, and deciding where rules vs. ML are the right tool. 

• Run experiments and monitor rollouts, watching both fraud-catch metrics and false-positive / customer-friction impact. 

• Work with Legal/Compliance to keep detection and enforcement aligned with payment-network rules, KYC/AML expectations, and data-privacy requirements. 

• Track and report on fraud loss, chargeback rate, false-positive rate, review throughput, and time-to-detection.

• Proven product management experience in fraud, risk, trust & safety, or payments. 

• Strong analytical skills — comfortable with data, SQL or equivalent, and reasoning about precision/recall trade-offs and metrics. 

• Ability to make decisions under ambiguity and to balance security, business, and customer-experience priorities. 

• Solid collaboration with engineering and data science; you can hold a technical conversation about signals, features, and model behavior. 

• Exposure to cloud, SaaS, marketplace, fintech, or infrastructure products. 

• Understanding payment fraud, chargebacks, KYC/AML, or device/network signals (fingerprinting, velocity, IP reputation).

• Collaborate with customers and Solution Engineers to turn real-world requirements into scalable features.

• Contribute to operational excellence: runbooks, release processes, observability, and reproducible dev environments.

• Experience designing software for performance, scalability, and predictable cost on cloud infrastructure.

• Hands-on experience with Snowflake, especially Native Apps, Snowpark Container Services, or building stored procedures and UDFs at scale.

• Understanding of graph theory and graph algorithms (centrality, community detection, pathfinding, embeddings), or strong curiosity to learn them.

• GCP, Azure and AWS

Job Summary

NetApp’s Solutions Engineering and Solution Architect organization across EMEA and LATAM is a diverse, international team of more than 200 people across 20+ countries. The organization supports customers and partners across three key solution areas: AI, cyber resilience, and migration and modernization.
We are looking for an experienced Executive Assistant to support the CTO and VP of Sales Engineering for EMEA and LATAM, as well as a small number of leaders within the leadership team.
This is a highly visible role that goes beyond traditional administrative support. You will manage complex calendars, international travel, meetings and day-to-day operations, while developing a strong understanding of the organization’s priorities. You will be trusted to anticipate needs, exercise sound judgment and help ensure that leaders can focus their time on what matters most.
If you enjoy working in an international environment, building strong relationships and bringing structure to a fast-moving organization, we would love to hear from you.
Key Responsibilities:

An AI business analyst connects business needs to AI solutions — spotting where AI adds value, working with data, gathering requirements, and translating AI output into terms stakeholders can act on. They make sure the technology actually serves the business goal.

A traditional business analyst gathers requirements and maps processes; an AI business analyst adds the ability to judge AI feasibility, assess data quality, and work with the basics of how models behave. The core skill — translating between business and technical teams — now includes AI.

You need data fluency more than deep programming. SQL and comfort with data are expected, and many teams use no-code and low-code tools; writing production software generally isn't part of the job. Understanding data is the real requirement.

Requirements gathering, data analysis, and clear communication, plus SQL, familiarity with data and analytics tools, and a working grasp of how AI models produce results. The differentiator is being able to judge whether an AI solution genuinely fits the business need.

About Norstella:

Norstella is a premier and critical global life sciences data and AI solutions provider dedicated to improving patient access to life-saving therapies. Norstella supports pharmaceutical and biotech companies across the full drug development lifecycle — from pipeline to patient. Our mission is simple: to help our clients bring therapies to market faster and more efficiently, ultimately impacting patient lives. 

Norstella unites market-leading brands - Citeline, Evaluate, MMIT, Panalgo, Skipta and The Dedham Group and delivers must-have answers and insights, leveraging AI, for critical strategic, clinical, and commercial decision-making. We help our clients:  

- Accelerate the drug development cycle 
- Assess competition and bring the right drugs to market  
- Make data driven commercial and financial decisions 
- Match and recruit patients for clinical trials 
- Identify and address barriers to therapies

Norstella serves most pharmaceutical and biotech companies around the world, along with regulators like the FDA, and payers. By providing critical proprietary data supporting AI-driven workflows, Norstella helps clients make decisions faster and with greater confidence.  Norstella’s investments in AI are transforming how data is consumed and decisions are made, disrupting inefficient legacy workflows and helping the industry become more efficient, innovative, and responsive to patient needs.  

Job Description:

- As a Senior Life Sciences Analyst for Model Trainer at Norstella, you will sit at the intersection of deep clinical and scientific domain expertise and applied AI development.
- This role will be embedded within a group of life science thought leaders, but will interface across cross-functional teams of data scientists, machine learning engineers and data engineers.
- Your work centers on the preference and judgment layer of model development — through scoring and ranking outputs, you will calibrate models on dimensions of quality, accuracy and clinical reasoning such that they are able to handshake with persona use cases.
- Your judgment becomes the signal that bridges a capable model and a genuinely useful one, and will play a critical role in our efforts to deliver predictive analytics and insights across clients.  
- Travel:  None required.

Responsibilities:

- Evaluate model outputs across clinical, regulatory, and life sciences tasks by rating individual responses, ranking pairs and lists, and rewriting outputs to demonstrate the preferred response.
- Define and maintain evaluation rubrics, preference dimensions, and quality criteria (factual accuracy, clinical reasoning quality, etc) that govern model outputs and preference alignment.
- Act as an expert-in-the-loop for how life science models are commercialized with clients, including ongoing support for implementation. 
- Advise and assist with interpretation of model behavior, bridging the desired behavior back to the dataflow inflection point, working with the relevant teams to adjust as needed. 
- Partner with data scientists and MLEs to walk feedback into data collection pipelines. 
- Conduct red-team and adversarial evaluation of models, surfacing subtle failure modes — hallucinations, citation errors, unsupported clinical claims, regulatory missteps -that automated metrics cannot reliably catch.
- Analyze preference data and model behavior to identify systematic gaps, then partner with the fine-tuning SMEs and the data science team to decide how each gap is addressed through preference data.
- Conduct new proofs of concept for novel domain capabilities.
- Contribute to Norstella’s knowledge graph and taxonomy work and help design new agentic workflows based on domain-grounded language models.

Qualifications:

- Graduate degree in life sciences, medical sciences, computer science or equivalent professional experience.  
- At least 3 years of professional experience in production-grade life science datasets, including with AI-enabled applications.  
- Experience working with structured publishing platforms and data tools; comfort with automation concepts
- Experience working with and statistically analysing large and complex data sets, including data cleaning and preprocessing.
- Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently.
- Excellent communication skills, especially between technical and non-technical teams.

Preferred:

- Experience working with Generative AI, especially LLMs, including agents, throughout the entire software development lifecycle (SDLC).
- Experience creating MCPs and consuming them into Agentic workflows.
- Experience in fast-paced, novel product development.

- Integrity, Truth, Reality 
- Kindness, Empathy, Grace 
- Resilience, Mettle, Perseverance 
- Humility, Gratitude, Learning

## Role Summary

As QA Automation Engineer at Notify, you will be a core part of a small, focused QA team responsible for ensuring the quality and reliability of our product suite – a multi-tenant SaaS platform used by organisations worldwide to manage health, safety and compliance.

Working alongside a QA Lead and a Manual Software Tester, you will own and evolve Notify’s QA Automation Solution – building, maintaining and expanding an automated test suite that covers our web application (.NET 8.0 / Angular) and React Native mobile apps (iOS and Android). You will work closely with the development team to integrate automation into our CI/CD pipeline, and ensure that automated testing provides fast, reliable feedback at every stage of the delivery cycle.

We are looking for someone who takes genuine pride in the quality of their code, thinks critically about what should and shouldn’t be automated, and is motivated to continuously improve. You should be curious, proactive and open to embracing AI-assisted tools and new approaches to test automation.

The ideal candidate will understand not only how to write and execute tests, but also how to think critically about quality, identify risks, anticipate edge cases and advocate for robust processes.

## Job Purpose

To design, build and maintain a high-quality automation solution that validates Notify’s web, API and mobile applications efficiently and reliably. You will work hand-in-hand with the QA Lead and development team to ensure automation is well-integrated into the development lifecycle, contributes to a culture of quality, and keeps pace with a continuously evolving product.

## Key Responsibilities

### Automation Solution Maintenance

- Keep the QA Automation Solution up to date as the product evolves – ensuring existing tests remain accurate, reliable and continue to execute correctly following changes to functionality or the underlying technology.
- Proactively identify and fix failing, flaky or outdated tests, maintaining a high standard of automation quality at all times.
- Ensure the automation codebase adheres to Notify’s coding standards, guidelines and best practices, and actively look for opportunities to improve its structure, readability and performance.
- Conduct regular reviews of the automation solution to identify areas for refactoring, optimisation or modernisation.

### Automation Solution Expansion

- Extend the QA Automation Solution to cover new features and changed functionality as they are introduced to the product.
- Write clean, high-quality automation scripts that thoroughly validate product behaviour and are easy to understand and maintain.
- Identify specific test cases that are good candidates for automation – discussing your approach with the Manual Tester and QA Lead to ensure coverage decisions are well-reasoned.
- Create and maintain a test coverage plan that clearly documents what has been automated, what is in progress, and what test cases remain to be automated.

### Test Execution & Reporting

- Execute daily automated test runs and share results with the team in a clear, prioritised report that enables fast decision-making.
- Monitor and investigate test failures, distinguishing between genuine defects and automation issues, and acting on findings promptly.
- Log and document defects discovered through automated testing in Notify’s bug tracking system, with clear reproduction steps, expected vs actual behaviour and relevant supporting information.
- Contribute to quality metrics and reporting, providing the QA Lead with visibility of automation coverage, test run stability and defect trends.

### CI/CD Integration & Collaboration with Development

- Work closely with the development team to integrate and maintain the QA Automation Solution within Notify’s CI/CD pipeline, ensuring automated tests run reliably as part of every build and deployment cycle.
- Collaborate with developers to identify ways in which automation can support and improve product development, and explore how product development practices can better support test automation.
- Participate in sprint ceremonies – standups, planning, reviews and retrospectives – contributing a QA automation perspective at every stage.
- Communicate clearly and proactively with colleagues about automation progress, issues and upcoming changes that may affect the test suite.

### Learning & Innovation

- Stay on the leading edge of QA automation development practices, tools and technologies – bringing relevant ideas and recommendations back to the team.
- Embrace AI-assisted testing tools as they are introduced, using them to enhance the efficiency, intelligence and coverage of the automation solution.
- Share knowledge and learning with colleagues, contributing to a culture where quality and continuous improvement are shared values.
- Seek feedback and take advantage of mentoring and coaching from the QA Lead and wider engineering team.

## Key Deliverables / Success Measures

Within the role, success will typically include:

- A well-maintained, reliable QA Automation Solution that keeps pace with product changes and executes correctly at all times
- Consistent expansion of automated coverage, supported by a clear and up-to-date test coverage plan
- Daily test execution with timely, well-structured reporting that gives the team clear visibility of product quality
- Clean, high-quality automation scripts that meet Notify’s coding standards and are easy for others to understand and build upon
- Strong collaboration with the development team, with positive feedback on integration, communication and shared quality ownership
- Visible adoption of new tools, practices and approaches that improve the capability and efficiency of the QA Automation Solution
