• Familiarity with AI-enabled products or data-driven software platforms. 
• Experience working with product analytics tools. 
• Experience collaborating with distributed engineering teams. 
• Understanding of UX research and experimentation techniques. 

You’ll thrive here if…
• You’re relentlessly curious about customers and how they work.

• You enjoy balancing strategic thinking with hands-on delivery.

Senior Project Manager (Banking & Software Delivery)
About the Role
We are looking for a highly organized, analytical Project Manager with banking experience to support and drive key initiatives across the organization.
The ideal candidate combines strong banking and project management experience with excellent data and technology skills. They are comfortable working in Jira, Excel, and PowerPoint, can navigate large volumes of data, and are confident using AI tools to improve analysis, reporting, and productivity. Python experience is a strong asset, as is experience working with software development and technology delivery teams.

Key Responsibilities
• Manage projects from planning through execution, including timelines, milestones, dependencies, risks, and deliverables.
• Manage project activities and workflows in Jira and coordinate across teams and stakeholders.
• Support software and technology delivery initiatives, working closely with engineering, product, QA, infrastructure, and other technical teams.
• Coordinate requirements, development, testing, UAT, releases, and implementation activities across the software delivery lifecycle.
• Analyze large volumes of data using Excel and other tools to identify trends, issues, and insights.
• Prepare clear, executive-ready PowerPoint presentations, reports, and project updates.
• Use AI tools to accelerate research, analysis, reporting, documentation, and process improvement.
• Identify opportunities to automate repetitive work and improve operational efficiency.
• Work closely with business, technology, and other stakeholders to keep initiatives on track.
• Translate complex technical and business information into clear recommendations and actionable next steps.

Preferred Qualifications
• 7+ years of experience in project management, program management, operations, or a related role within banking / financial services.
• Strong understanding of banking environments, processes, and stakeholders.
• Proven experience managing projects and multiple priorities, including technology or software delivery projects.
• Strong Jira, Excel, and PowerPoint skills.
• Experience working with Agile / Scrum teams and familiarity with the software development lifecycle (SDLC).
• Highly analytical with the ability to work through large datasets and complex information.
• Strong AI literacy and practical experience using AI tools.
• Python experience is an asset, particularly for data analysis and automation.
• Experience working with technical teams, software development, systems integration, APIs, databases, or cloud technologies is an asset.
• Excellent communication, organization, and problem-solving skills.
• Comfortable working in a fast-paced, evolving environment with a high degree of ownership.

Key Responsibilities:
• Serve as a trusted advisor to banking stakeholders, aligning business objectives with technology delivery.
• Lead analysis, requirements gathering, and solution design for strategic initiatives.
• Provide oversight of software delivery projects, ensuring alignment with business priorities and compliance standards.
• Facilitate release planning and readiness reviews in collaboration with product, development, QA, and operations teams.
• Develop project governance frameworks, including reporting, risk management, and stakeholder communication.
• Conduct impact assessments for new initiatives, identifying dependencies and regulatory implications.
• Support post-release evaluations, ensuring lessons learned are captured and continuous improvement is applied.

Required Skills and Experience:
• Proven experience as a Business Consultant, Business Analyst, or Project Manager within the banking or financial services industry.
• Strong knowledge of banking operations, compliance requirements, and technology-driven change programs.
• Deep understanding of the software development lifecycle (SDLC) and product lifecycle.
• Demonstrated ability to manage cross-functional teams and engage stakeholders at all levels.
• Excellent analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills.
• Familiarity with project management and collaboration tools (e.g., Jira, Confluence, ServiceNow, Azure DevOps).

Preferred Qualifications:
• Professional certifications such as PMP, Agile, Scrum, or CBAP.
• Experience with regulatory, compliance, or risk-related initiatives in banking.
• Technical background or familiarity with software architecture and integration concepts.

 Readdle is a pioneering force in the personal productivity space on Apple devices, having shaped the landscape since 2007. Our mission is to empower individuals and teams with innovative technology, enhancing their efficiency and creativity. We are dedicated to crafting exceptional mobile and desktop experiences for those who aspire to achieve more.

PDF Expert, our flagship product, is more than just a PDF editor. It’s one of the most loved PDF apps, trusted by over 30 million people worldwide to read, edit, annotate, and manage PDFs across Mac, iPad, and iPhone. Recognized as “App of the Year,” an “Apple Editor’s Choice,” and a Red Dot Design Award winner, PDF Expert sets the standard for effortless document workflows.

As a Senior Product Designer, you’ll own and improve the core experience of PDF Expert across our iOS, iPadOS, and macOS apps, from how people open, navigate, and organize documents to the editing and annotation tools they use every day. You’ll find the problems that matter most to our users, come up with new product ideas, and turn them into well-crafted solutions. You’ll also help level up our design system and shape how our team designs with AI.

Our Design Approach:

We design with a clear focus on impact, whether that’s a better user experience, stronger product performance, or meaningful business outcomes. Our approach is shaped by five guiding principles:

• Lead by design. Design is the driving force behind our product’s evolution. We take the initiative to shape the future of PDF Expert, lead cross-functional collaboration, and work on projects that directly influence the direction of the product.

• High craft. We care about precision and detail, because quality is what users notice and remember.

• Data informed. From user insights to product analytics, our decisions are backed by evidence, so our solutions meet both user needs and business goals.

• Customer obsessed. Our users are at the heart of everything we do. We continuously gather feedback and conduct research to understand their needs, behaviors, and pain points.

• Impact driven. We design for measurable results, whether that’s higher engagement, better product performance, or direct contribution to company growth.

In this role, you will:

• Own the core PDF Expert experience, end to end. The reading, annotating, and document editing workflows that millions of people rely on every day are yours to shape. You’ll make them clearer, faster and more consistent, and you’ll be accountable for the engagement and retention gains that follow.

• Decide what matters, then make it happen. Use research, analytics, and user feedback to find the biggest opportunities, explore bold ideas to solve them, and bring the strongest to life. You have an opportunity to set the direction instead of waiting for a brief.

• Raise the bar for the product experience. Lead a systematic effort to fix long-standing usability issues and inconsistencies across key user journeys, with a direct, measurable impact on core product metrics.

• Level up the design system with Engineering. Build scalable patterns for complex, power-user workflows, and raise the bar on quality and adoption across the product

• Help define the product’s long-term direction. Look beyond the current roadmap, spot where the market and user needs are heading, and turn that into a design vision that guides what we build over the next years.

About you:

• Your work has made a real impact. 6+ years in product design, with experience designing complex products. Your portfolio includes detailed case studies showing your process and the results you delivered.

• Your craft stands out. Outstanding visual and interaction design is your baseline, and you keep looking for ways to level it up.

• You love hard problems. Complex challenges are where your product thinking and creativity shine, and where you find the solutions that actually move the product forward.

• You’ve built systems that scale. Creating or scaling a design system in close partnership with Engineering is something you’ve done before.

• You know Apple platforms inside out. Having designed native apps for iOS and/or macOS, you know when to follow platform conventions and when to push further.

• AI is part of how you work. Fluent with AI tools, you keep finding new ways to improve your process and enjoy helping others do the same.

We are seeking a dynamic Client Services Engineer to join our expanding team, focusing on implementing data modelling solutions in financial markets. We are building the future of data and reporting for financial markets, and we are taking all industry stakeholders with us.

- You will join a rapidly expanding team helping our clients to address complex data modelling challenges for financial products, financial transactions, and associated regulatory reporting obligations
- Work with team members to build, test and release data models for products, events and regulatory rules for Securities, Derivatives, Commodities and FX

What we're looking for

- A genuine interest (evidenced through professional experience, academic achievement or personal activities) for capital markets and financial products and an eagerness to learn the domain
- An analytical mind with strong attention to detail
- Strong communication and presentation skills; ability to write clearly and concisely
- Proactivity and a genuine desire for taking ownership

- Experience in software engineering using Java

Our Technology

Our technology combines cutting-edge cloud-computing and the power of open source software. It enables firms to collaborate to build and share data pipelines across the industry.

So that clients can use Rosetta with their language of choice, we can automatically code generate into Java or Python or Scala or GoLang or Javascript or … well you get the idea.

Our cloud-native platform is being used by financial institutions to embed these open-source data models into their own production reporting systems. Key to compliance applications is to give transparency to users over their data pipelines. Preferring flexibility, we favour best-in-class technologies - the right tools for the right job. This means we try to keep our work flexible, too.

About the Role
This is a working people-leader role, not a pure oversight seat. You'll set the day-to-day standard for how your team triages and resolves complaints, while also carrying your own caseload of the most complex and escalated cases — motor and property disputes, regulatory escalations, and the investigations that need a steady, experienced hand. As the team grows and eventually splits by region, expect this role to shift more toward pure people leadership.
You'll be a good fit if you're comfortable moving between the granular (one escalated complaint, one claim file) and the systemic (the pattern behind nine of them) — and if you'd rather build the process that prevents the next complaint than just close out the one in front of you.

Duties & Responsibilities
Team Leadership & Development: Lead a team of two Complaints Handlers spanning US and UK — set the day-to-day standard for how complaints get triaged, worked, and closed, and coach your team on investigation technique and regulatory requirements. As volumes grow and the team splits into dedicated US and UK functions, you'll help build the leadership bench for what comes next.

Complaint Investigation & Resolution: Own the most complex and escalated complaints yourself — motor and property claims disputes, coverage and liability questions, and the handling/timing issues that make up the bulk of what we see. Dig into claim files, policy documents, and correspondence to figure out what actually happened, then deliver a clear, professional resolution to the customer.

Regulatory & Escalation Management: Be the primary point of contact when a complaint escalates to the Financial Ombudsman Service in the UK or a state Department of Insurance in the US. Every escalation carries both enforcement risk and carrier/MGA relationship risk — you're the one making sure it's handled by the book and doesn't become a bigger problem than it needs to be.

Root Cause Analysis & Reporting: Look past the individual complaint to the pattern underneath it — repeat filers, timing gaps between settlement and payment, systems issues that miscategorize claims — and turn what you find into findings claims leaders and the Risk Council can actually act on.

Cross-Functional Partnership: Work closely with Claims, Product/Engineering, QA, and Compliance to close the loop on what complaints are telling us. When the fix is a process or a system — not a person — you're the one who flags it and pushes it through.

Program & Quality Standards: Build and maintain the complaint-handling standards, records, and processes that keep us audit-ready — from FCA reporting fields to the documentation an external auditor will ask you to defend. Champion a culture where complaints are caught early and closed fairly.

Requirements
• 5+ years handling complex or escalated complaints, ideally within insurance claims — motor and property experience is directly relevant here
• Direct experience with regulatory complaint frameworks — FOS, FCA, state DOI processes, or some combination
• 2+ years of people-leadership experience
• Proven track record building and delivering executive-level communications
• Strong investigative instincts — comfortable digging into claim files, policy documents, and correspondence to find the real story, not just the surface issue
• Ability to manage a live portfolio of complex complaints under deadline pressure
• An adjuster license is not required — this is about complaint resolution and regulatory judgment, not claims adjusting
• Bachelor's degree (lack of one shouldn't stop you from applying if you have all the other qualifications)
Benefits
• Generous health-insurance package with nationwide coverage, vision, & dental
• 401(k) retirement plan with employer matching
• Competitive PTO policy – we want our employees fresh, healthy, happy, and energized!
• Generous family leave policy after 8 months of continuous work
• Work from anywhere to facilitate your work life balance
• Apple laptop, large second monitor, and other quality-of-life equipment you may want. Technology is something that should make your life easier, not harder!

Reserv is an insurtech creating and incubating cutting-edge AI and automation technology to bring efficiency and simplicity to claims. Founded by insurtech veterans with deep experience in SaaS and digital claims, Reserv is venture-backed by Bain Capital and Altai Ventures and began operations in May 2022. We are focused on automating highly manual tasks to tackle long-standing problems in claims and set a new standard for TPAs, insurance technology providers, and adjusters alike. We have ambitious (but attainable!) goals and need people who can work in an evolving environment. If building a leading TPA and the prospect of tackling the long-standing challenges of the claims role sounds exciting, we can't wait to meet you.

Location Requirement
Candidates must reside in an eligible U.S. state throughout employment. We are unable to hire candidates residing in California, Alaska, Hawaii, U.S. territories, or outside the United States.

About the role
We are looking for an HR Business Partner to create a seamless and supportive experience for every employee at Reserv in the UK. In this role, you will manage key processes throughout the employee lifecycle — from onboarding to day-to-day HR support — while serving as a trusted partner to both team members and leadership. You will bring empathy, organization, and sharp problem-solving skills to a fast- paced, fully remote environment where we value initiative, clear communication, and continuous improvement. If you are excited about building thoughtful people processes, supporting a growing team, and shaping the future of HR at an ambitious insurtech, we would love to connect with you.

What you'll do
Strategic partner
• Act as a trusted advisor and sounding partner to managers and team leads, providing guidance on team dynamics, performance management, and workforce planning.
• Develop and execute people strategies that drive business performance, retention, and engagement — translating organizational goals into tangible people initiatives.
• Lead on end-to-end recruitment activity for the UK, partnering with hiring managers to attract and retain top talent while maintaining a consistent, positive candidate experience.
• Drive culture change and organizational development initiatives, holding leaders and managers accountable for adoption and embedding change effectively across teams.
• Develop, own, and continuously improve HR policies from inception through to implementation, ensuring they are fit for purpose, legally compliant, and aligned with the company’s values and growth trajectory.
Employee relations
• Serve as the primary point of contact for all UK employee relations matters, managing a high volume of cases end-to-end — including performance management, disciplinaries, grievances, and occupational health referrals — with minimal escalation.
• Bring proven experience managing complex, long-running cases including long-term sickness absence, reasonable adjustments, and occupational health-led processes, ideally gained in operational or high-volume frontline environments.
• Negotiate and manage Settlement Agreements (formerly Compromise Agreements), including liaison with legal counsel where required, ensuring commercial and legal risk is appropriately managed.
• Balance empathy with compliance in line with UK employment law (Employment Rights Act 1996, Equality Act 2010, and related legislation), escalating matters to the VP, People Operations only where necessary.
• Help leaders proactively identify and address team health concerns and interpersonal conflict before they reach formal process stage.
• Support investigations, policy interpretation, disciplinary, and grievance procedures in accordance with ACAS Codes of Practice and internal policy.
• Help foster an inclusive, equitable, and engaging remote-first culture using data and employee feedback to make evidence-based recommendations.
Performance & talent management
• Manage the performance review cycle, lead calibration sessions, and coach managers on delivering constructive feedback and meaningful development conversations.
• Collaborate with the VP, People Operations to roll out talent development programs, promotion frameworks, and career pathways that scale with the company.
HR programming
• Design, implement, and continuously improve HR programs, policies, and workflows spanning the full employee lifecycle, with a focus on scalability and automation.
• Lead the development and delivery of the company’s EDI (Equality, Diversity & Inclusion) strategy, building programs and initiatives that foster a culture of belonging, psychological safety, and equitable opportunity across the UKworkforce.
• Drive employee engagement through structured listening programs (e.g. surveys, focus groups), translating findings into actionable recommendations for leadership.
• Leverage data and employee feedback to recommend improvements to People Ops processes that increase efficiency and impact.
• Support employee recognition, onboarding, and retention initiatives.
Operations & compliance
• Maintain an up-to-date working knowledge of UK employment law, proactively monitoring legislative changes and implementing updated policies and practices ahead of new laws coming into effect.
• Oversee right-to-work checks and ensure ongoing compliance with UK immigration and employment eligibility requirements.
• Uphold UK GDPR and data privacy obligations, ensuring employee data is handled with appropriate confidentiality and in accordance with ICO guidance.
• Serve as a secondary point of contact for employee questions requiring a nuanced or strategic response.
Analytics & reporting
• Analyze HR data and trends (turnover, engagement, headcount, etc.) and deliver insights to leadership to shape people strategies. 
• Develop reporting mechanisms that support business leaders in making data-informed decisions.
Qualifications
• CIPD Level 7 qualified (or equivalent experience), operating at a strategic HR level with the confidence to work autonomously and advise senior stakeholders.
• 4–6+ years of experience in HR advisory / People Operations, with at least 2 years in a Business Partner or advisory capacity.
• 2+ years of end-to-end payroll management experience for a workforce of up to 200 employees, including pension administration (auto-enrollment and ongoing scheme management).
• 2+ years of experience in a high-growth startup, scale-up, or fast-paced operational environment — you know how to balance ambiguity, pace, and flexibility.
• Solid, hands-on knowledge of UK employment law, including the Employment
• Rights Act, Equality Act 2010, ACAS Codes of Practice, and UK GDPR.
• Demonstrable experience managing a high volume and wide range of ER cases end-to-end, including Settlement Agreements, long-term sickness, and occupational health processes.
• Experience with UK benefits administration is desirable but not essential, including auto-enrollment pensions, private health insurance, and statutory entitlements (SSP, SMP, SPP, etc.).
• Proficient with HR systems; experience with Rippling is a bonus.
• High emotional and social intelligence, with the confidence and composure to navigate highly sensitive or contentious situations with care and professionalism.
• Strong interpersonal skills, good intuition, and the ability to communicate effectively at all levels of the organization.
• Able to manage multiple ongoing projects independently with excellent attention to detail and organization.
• A decisive problem solver with a “get it done” attitude who thrives in a fast- paced, sometimes ambiguous environment.
• Exceptional standards of confidentiality and ethics when handling sensitive people information.
• A genuine growth mindset — keen to continue learning and developing as the company scales.
• Comfortable working fully remotely and with a geographically distributed team.
• Proficient with standard tech tools — Apple Mac, Google Workspace, and
• Slack — and comfortable picking up new technology quickly.
Benefits
• Generous health-insurance package with nationwide coverage, vision, & dental
• 401(k) retirement plan with employer matching
• Competitive PTO policy – we want our employees fresh, healthy, happy, and energized!
• Generous family leave policy after 8 months of continuous work
• Work from anywhere to facilitate your work life balance
• Apple laptop, large second monitor, and other quality-of-life equipment you may want. Technology is something that should make your life easier, not harder!

At Reserv, we value diversity in backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences and believe that diversity in viewpoints and critical thinking drives innovation, first-principles thinking, and success. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and encourage those from all walks of life to apply. If you believe you are a good fit for this role, we would love to hear from you!

RevenueCat gives app businesses the infrastructure and tools to build, run, and improve their monetization. Since graduating from YC's S18 batch, we've grown into the default monetization platform for mobile. 

We're in 50%+ of newly shipped subscription apps, we process $16B+ in annual purchase volume, and we help everyone from a solo developer to the OpenAI mobile team understand and grow their revenue.

We're a remote-first team of 150+ people across 25+ countries, guided by values we actually practice: Customer Obsession, Always Be Shipping, Own It, and Balance. 

This isn't the right fit for everyone. The systems you’ll build here manage billions of dollars and touch hundreds of millions of end users, and we don’t take that lightly. You'll be expected to work hard and hold a high bar for what you ship, alongside some of the sharpest, most driven people you've worked with. If that sounds energizing rather than exhausting, keep reading.


THE ROLE

We are looking for a Senior Product Data Scientist who is deeply product-minded and highly proactive.

This is not a role for someone who waits for perfectly defined questions or works in isolation. We are looking for someone who actively looks at our data, understands our customers’ pain points, identifies opportunities, and pushes ideas forward.

You will work closely with Product, Engineering, and Analytics to shape what we build, why we build it, and how we measure success. Your work will directly power customer-facing features such as LTV prediction, experimentation and statistical significance, benchmarking, and entirely new data-driven products we have not built yet.

You will be expected to bring ideas to the table, backed by analysis and clear hypotheses, and to influence product direction through data.

Our data stack includes a Python backend, PostgreSQL production databases, Snowflake, dbt, and AWS.


WHAT YOU WILL DO

 - Proactively explore RevenueCat’s data to identify customer problems, opportunities, and product bets.

 - Translate ambiguous product and business problems and questions into clear analyses, models, and recommendations.

 - Partner with Product Managers to shape roadmaps, not just execute on them.

 - Design, build, and ship production-grade predictive and descriptive models that power customer-facing features.

 - Define and evaluate statistical approaches for experimentation, benchmarking, and forecasting.

 - Communicate insights clearly and persuasively to technical and non-technical audiences, with a focus on customer impact.

 - Continuously iterate on shipped models and features based on real-world usage and feedback.

This role has real ownership. You will not just support decisions, you will help drive them.


ABOUT YOU

You are a Senior Data Scientist who cares deeply about impact and product outcomes.

From a skills perspective, you bring:

 - 5+ years of experience working as a Data Scientist.

 - Strong SQL skills and comfort with data modeling.

 - Experience building and deploying predictive and descriptive models in production.

 - Experience writing or collaborating on production-ready Python code.

 - A solid understanding of statistics and experimentation, ideally including Bayesian approaches.

 - The ability to clearly explain complex ideas and results to broad audiences.

You recognize yourself in several of these:

 - You are highly proactive and opinionated, and you are comfortable pushing ideas forward.

 - You enjoy working with messy, real-world data and imperfect information.

 - You care more about creating customer value than academic elegance.

 - You are comfortable operating in ambiguity and building structure where none exists.

 - You enjoy working closely with Product teams and influencing decisions.

 - You are excited by the consumer subscription ecosystem and curious about how developers make money.


WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE


IN THE FIRST MONTH, YOU'LL:

 - Understand our data models.

 - Get to know the team.

 - Ramp up on the ongoing data feature work.

 - Implement and ship your first project.


WITHIN THE FIRST 3 MONTHS, YOU'LL:

 - Meaningfully contribute to shipping a data feature to thousands of developers.

 - Learn the basics of incident response, and be part of the on-call rotation.

 - Work with our Product, Analytics and Engineering teams to improve our data pipelines for data science features.

 - Launch your own explorations into our data to fulfill your own curiosity.


WITHIN THE FIRST 6 MONTHS, YOU'LL:

 - Own one or more core data-powered features end to end.

 - Influence the data feature roadmap with clear, data-backed proposals.

 - Be a go-to partner for product teams on data-driven decision making.


WITHIN THE FIRST 12 MONTHS, YOU'LL:

 - Propose and lead entirely new data-driven product initiatives.

 - Push the boundaries of how RevenueCat uses data to help developers grow revenue.

 - Help shape how data science operates at RevenueCat as the function grows.


WHAT WE OFFER:

 - Competitive equity in a fast-growing, Series C startup backed by top-tier investors, including Y Combinator

 - 10-year window to exercise vested equity options

 - A fully remote environment designed around autonomy and flexibility

 - 4-5 weeks of flexible time off annually

 - Paid desk at a co-working space

 - Workspace budget and continuous learning stipend

Founded in 2017, RoomPriceGenie is dedicated to helping hoteliers around the globe achieve optimal pricing. 🌍 We understand that many small hotels face challenges with digitalization, making their operations increasingly complex and often resulting in lost revenue. This is where we come in!

We have developed a powerful solution that enables hotels to set the right prices in just seconds. ⏱️ Our state-of-the-art algorithm analyzes both internal hotel data and market trends to recommend pricing strategies that enhance revenue and improve booking rates. 

With customers spanning the globe—from the USA and Canada to Iceland, South Africa, China, Slovenia, Italy, and the UK—RoomPriceGenie has made a meaningful impact in the hospitality industry, and our clients love the results. ❤️

Now, we are excited to expand our customer base and spread the word about how we can support hoteliers in optimizing their pricing strategies. We invite you to join us on this journey! We actively encourage applications from candidates with diverse backgrounds to enrich our team and drive innovation. 




YOUR ROLE

As Senior Product Manager for one of our Revenue Management teams at RoomPriceGenie, you'll own the experience where hoteliers see, trust and act on our AI-powered pricing, both in our app and embedded in our partners' PMSs through Revenue Intelligence. This is not a feature-delivery role. We're looking for a senior PM who sets the strategy and direction, makes hard trade-offs, and turns complex pricing logic into decisions a hotelier can make in seconds.

You'll lead a team of engineers, collaborate closely with design and research and work closely with leadership, Account Management, Integrations, Customer Success and Sales. Your mission: make RoomPriceGenie the pricing tool thousands of independent hotels rely on every day.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

Product Vision & Strategy

 - Own the vision, strategy and roadmap for your area, anchored in clear business goals: adoption, retention, revenue uplift and expansion.

 - Decide what not to build, and bring stakeholders along on why.

 - Shape how pricing shows up across surfaces, from our core app to partner integrations and multi-property accounts.

 - Champion simplicity and explainability: hoteliers should understand why a price was recommended and feel confident acting on it.

Discovery & Delivery

 - Talk to hoteliers regularly and, with UX research, turn hidden friction in their revenue management workflows into strategy, not just backlog items.

 - Work closely with the other RM team to turn forecasting and pricing model output into clear experiences that build trust and drive action.

 - Drive solutions end to end, from opportunity assessment to measured impact, knowing when to move fast and when to dig deeper.

Impact & Influence

 - Define and own KPIs for your area, be clear about what moved them and why, and be honest about correlation vs. causation.

 - Influence across teams without authority, especially where your area depends on other RM teams, Reporting and Integrations.




YOUR PROFILE

 - 5+ years as a Senior Product Manager, ideally in B2B SaaS, with clear ownership of outcomes, not just outputs.

 - A track record of making complex systems radically simple

 - Comfortable setting strategy in ambiguous spaces and making trade-offs with incomplete information.

 - Genuine excitement about how AI is reshaping software and how it´s build.

 - Plus: Experience in hospitality tech, revenue management systems or pricing.

 - You communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical audiences, including leadership.

 - You're a curious, structured thinker with strong product intuition.

 - You can say no to a stakeholder and keep the relationship intact.

 - You ask "why" until it's clear, and explain "how" until it clicks.

 - You reflect honestly on what didn't work.



What We Offer at RoomPriceGenie 💪

At RoomPriceGenie, we don’t just offer jobs; we offer an adventure! 🚀 Join us in an exciting startup atmosphere where you can grow your career while changing the world for tens of thousands of independent hoteliers. 🌍 Our global and diverse team is fueled by passion and a shared mission. We thrive in a culture that’s all about transparency, respect, and making a real impact together. 



Here’s what you can expect when you become part of our Genie family:

 - Remote-First Model: Work from (almost!) anywhere. 🌍🧑‍💻 Some roles need you in a specific country or time zone — we'll always flag that in the job ad. And whenever you like, come co-work with us in Mannheim, Berlin, or Sydney. 🏢

 - One Team, One Vision, One Goal: We’re in this together! 🤝 Our Genies are laser-focused on our mission, collaborating to make magic happen. ✨ It’s no wonder we score a stellar 9.3 from our team members! 🌟

 - Epic Team Gatherings: Every year, we bring our global crew together 🌎 for a week of networking, brainstorming, and fun. 🎉 Plus, enjoy regular hangouts in our offices to keep the camaraderie alive.

 - Growth and Development: We’re all about lifelong learning! 📚 Level up your skills with personal and professional development opportunities. You’ll even snag up to three extra days off each year to focus on your growth. 📈

 - 5 Years? 5 Weeks! Stick with us, and we’ll reward your loyalty. After five years, you’ll earn an incredible five weeks of bonus vacation time 🏖️ to recharge and explore the world. 🌍

 - Birthday Celebrations: It’s your day, so take it off! 🎂 Celebrate your birthday the way you want, guilt-free.

 - Flexible Hours: We get it—life happens! ⏰ We offer flexible working hours to help you balance your work and personal life seamlessly.

 - Wellbeing Matters: Your mental health is a top priority. 🧘 Every Genie gets access to Headspace, the leading meditation app, to help you cultivate a happier, healthier, and more zen life. 🌿

 - BetterHelp Support: We also offer BetterHelp, a professional online therapy and counseling platform, giving you additional support whenever you need it.💛🧠

The Royal Academy of Arts is currently seeking to appoint a Digital Product Manager to join our Retail team. This newly created role will have dedicated product ownership of RA Retail’s digital product estate, with Ecommerce as the primary area of focus.

The Digital Product Manager will explicitly own the Ecommerce platform and roadmap, alongside the wider suite of Retail digital products, including the Retail ERP solution, integrations with the RA’s CRM Tessitura and the tooling used to support trading, analytics, testing, customer insight and release activity.

This role will ensure these platforms and integrations are stable, secure, well governed and set up to support sustainable revenue growth.

About You

To be considered for this role, you will combine strong and substantial Ecommerce or digital product management experience in a commercial, customer-facing environment, with responsibility for digital platforms, systems, integrations and tooling.

You will have a proven track record of managing roadmaps, backlogs and the full product lifecycle, using data and testing to improve ecommerce conversion, customer experience and revenue. You will understand the customer journey, from merchandising and checkout to CRM, email and SEO, and will be digitally fluent without needing to be a developer.

With excellent stakeholder management, analytical thinking and supplier management skills, you will be confident working with technical teams and external agencies, able to define requirements and acceptance criteria and comfortable using performance data, customer insight and testing to prioritise improvements that deliver measurable commercial impact.

The Company

The RA dates way back to 1768 when a group of artists and architects persuaded King George lll to help them to ‘establish a society for promoting the Art of Design'. The original academy, in Pall Mall, was less than 10 meters long. Since then, there have been many changes, though the RA’s core purpose of bringing art and design to a broad audience and championing art and artists still holds true.

Today we are a contemporary art organisation hosting internationally acclaimed exhibitions and through investment in employee training and development, with courses such as Unconscious Bias, LGBTQ+ Awareness, Bystander, and Mental Health First Aid training, we are striving to foster a safe space for everyone through positive action. We also have Employee Network Groups, Ways In Groups, and an Employee Council so every employee has a voice and a way to feel heard by colleagues through the CEO.

The RA is truly a unique place, both as an attraction to our visitors, but also as a workplace. Our people are at the heart of all we do, and we support a broad and inspiring mix of departments; from exhibitions, curators, art handlers, researchers, publishers, and digital to schools and education, visitor welcome, fundraisers, and corporate support.

Applications Engineer – Coventry – up to £40,000 per annum

A £40,000 office-based role for an engineer who enjoys getting into the detail of how a hydraulic system really works.
 Customers will come to you with a problem, and you’ll be the expert who works out exactly which solution they need.
 It’s a specialist role in a settled, focused environment, where your technical knowledge is properly valued.

As an Applications Engineer, you will benefit from:

• An annual performance bonus of up to 5%

• 25 days holiday plus bank holidays

• An early finish on Fridays, with the option to start at 7am and finish at 3pm

• An office-based role in Coventry, with no constant travel

• A close-knit, open plan site of around 15 people

• The chance to build deep specialist knowledge of hydraulic valve and manifold technology

As an Applications Engineer, your responsibilities will include:

• Talking customers through their hydraulic system requirements and recommending the right products for each application

• Designing hydraulic manifold solutions, producing and reviewing schematics and technical documentation

• Developing and validating solutions, including supporting prototypes, testing and the test lab

• Investigating and resolving technical and application issues using root cause analysis

• Supporting customer projects from concept to production, working with sales, engineering, manufacturing and supply chain

• Providing technical guidance and training to customers and colleagues, including occasional on-site commissioning

As an Applications Engineer, your experience will include:

• A background in the hydraulics or fluid power industry, so you can hit the ground running

• Hydraulic schematic design and interpretation, with knowledge of valve and manifold technologies

• An understanding of electromechanical and electro-hydraulic control systems

• Experience with mobile or industrial equipment hydraulics (desirable)

• 3D CAD, hydraulic simulation or testing experience (desirable)

• Clear technical communication and report writing skills

If you’re an Applications Engineer who wants to be the trusted technical expert in a stable, specialist business, this is a role you can really settle into and grow. Apply today with an up-to-date CV or call Sophie at Rubicon for more information.

Operations Manager – Bournemouth – up to £55,000 per annum

Lead a busy headquarters site in Bournemouth on £45,000 to £55,000, with real authority over how it runs.
 You’ll own hire, service, training and project delivery, and your decisions will directly shape results.
 This is a high-impact Operations Manager role for someone who likes to take charge and get things moving.

As an Operations Manager, you will benefit from:

• Additional annual leave that grows with length of service

• Cycle to Work and Tech Scheme

• Regular company events

• Ongoing training and development opportunities

• A friendly, values-led working environment

• Direct reporting line to the Operations Director, with genuine influence on strategy

As an Operations Manager, your responsibilities will include:

• Leading site operations across hire, service and training, driving efficiency and tracking performance against KPIs

• Scheduling BA training and RPE fit testing to meet compliance and safety standards

• Planning and delivering client projects, including vent plans, rescue plans and vessel scoping

• Recruiting, managing and reviewing site staff and project labour to build a high-performing team

• Working with Sales and the Project Director to ensure orders and projects are delivered to client requirements

• Maintaining a clean, organised site to 5S standards

As an Operations Manager, your experience will include:

• Proven operations and project management experience within construction or engineering

• Experience in the process or oil and gas industry (desirable)

• Strong leadership, with a track record of managing and developing large teams

• Excellent organisational, problem-solving and communication skills, with a customer-focused approach

• Confident IT skills across Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Outlook

If you’re ready to take ownership of a site and lead it to the next level, this Operations Manager role is your next move. Apply today with an up-to-date CV or call Sophie at Rubicon for more information.

Sales Engineer – Coventry – up to £40,000 per annum + bonus

An up to £40,000 role where your hydraulics knowledge counts for more than a hard sell.
 You’ll look after established customer accounts, getting to know their systems and becoming the person they trust for the right answer.
 It’s stable and technical, and you’ll start with a company car from day one.

As a Technical Sales Engineer, you will benefit from:

• A company car from day one

• An annual performance bonus of up to 5%

• 25 days holiday plus bank holidays

• An early finish on Fridays

• A close-knit, open plan site of around 15 people

• Working with two experienced engineers who already know the accounts inside out

As a Technical Sales Engineer, your responsibilities will include:

• Managing and growing an established portfolio of customer accounts from a Coventry base, travelling across the UK with most customers close to home

• Visiting customers regularly to understand their hydraulic circuits and give first-line application support

• Putting together preliminary solutions and quotations within agreed pricing policies

• Working with the technical, customer services, quality and operations teams to deliver customer projects

• Keeping an accurate pipeline and sales forecast, and spotting new business opportunities as they come up

• Supporting product training, troubleshooting and warranty returns when needed

As a Technical Sales Engineer, your experience will include:

• A mechanical, hydraulic or related engineering qualification, or equivalent hands-on experience

• A background in the hydraulics industry, so you can hit the ground running

• Customer-facing experience in technical sales, engineering or service

• Confidence reading hydraulic schematics (desirable)

• Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office

• A full UK driving licence and willingness to travel across the UK, with occasional overseas trips

If you’re a Technical Sales Engineer who would rather build long-term customer relationships than chase cold leads, this role offers the stability and technical depth to really make it your own. Apply today with an up-to-date CV or call Sophie at Rubicon for more information.

SMT Operator | Poole | up to £15ph

Are you a hands-on SMT Technician who enjoys keeping a busy line running at pace?
Do you have solid, recent experience and want a role where you can step in confidently from day one?
This SMT Operator opportunity offers stable weekday hours in a fast-paced Electronics Manufacturing environment where accuracy and consistency matter.

As a SMT Operator, you will benefit from:

• Full-time, stable hours, 8am – 4pm, early finish on a friday!

• A fast-moving production environment that keeps your day varied and engaging

• A well-established SMT function with experienced colleagues and clear processes

• A practical, active role, on your feet and close to the machines throughout the shift

• The chance to make an immediate impact in a department with ongoing demand and workload

As a SMT Technician, your responsibilities will include:

• Setting up, running, and monitoring Europlacer SMT placement machines to meet output and quality targets

• Completing product changeovers efficiently and accurately to keep production on schedule

• Carrying out basic fault-finding and escalating issues promptly to minimise downtime

• Performing routine checks and adjustments to maintain consistent placement quality

• Following build instructions and process documentation to ensure standards are met

• Keeping the work area organised and supporting continuous improvement on the line

As a SMT Technician, your experience will include:

• Recent Europlacer machine experience within an SMT production environment

• Confidence working at pace while maintaining attention to detail and quality standards

• A practical, reliable approach, with the ability to spot issues early and act quickly

• Comfortable working in an active role, on your feet for most of the day

If you’re ready to take the next step as a SMT Technician and want a role where your experience makes an immediate difference, apply today with an up-to-date CV or call Beth at Rubicon for more information.

RudderStack helps companies build on top of their own data. Our warehouse-native Customer Data Platform enables engineering, data, and AI teams to collect, unify, govern, and activate customer data while maintaining full ownership and control. By running directly on top of the customer's cloud data warehouse or lakehouse, RudderStack reduces data movement, improves governance, lowers infrastructure costs, and accelerates modern data and AI initiatives.

Leading companies including Lovable, Jaguar Land Rover, and Foot Locker trust RudderStack to power mission-critical customer data infrastructure.

We're now in the middle of one of the most significant shifts in the company's history: evolving from the industry's leading warehouse-native CDP into a fully Agentic CDP built for the AI era — a platform that doesn't just collect and activate customer data, but reasons over it and takes action on our customers' behalf. EMEA is a critical part of that next chapter, and this hire will help define it.

About the role
This is a role for someone who enjoys ownership. You'll cover the EMEA region across both inbound and outbound, with proven processes and playbooks to start from, and the freedom to own your territory and bring your own ideas. That could mean trying new sequences, messaging, and account approaches, and spotting opportunities as they come up.

We're hiring a Sales Development Representative to start conversations with the data, engineering, AI, and marketing teams who buy RudderStack, moving between technical and business conversations. You'll research target accounts, reach the right people with relevant outreach, and book qualified meetings for our Account Executives.

You'll work closely with Account Executives, Marketing, and Revenue Operations. Our SDRs use AI research tools, intent data, and automation to handle the repetitive work, so you can spend more time on account research and real conversations. You'll learn how modern data infrastructure works and how technical buyers make decisions, which gives you a clear path into an Account Executive role.

This role is remote first and can be based anywhere in the UK (#LI-Remote).

What you'll do
• Own your EMEA territory across inbound and outbound, including account plans, sequences, and messaging.
• Book qualified meetings for Account Executives and meet monthly pipeline targets.
• Research target accounts and buying committees across Data, Engineering, Analytics, Platform, AI, and Marketing teams.
• Run multichannel outreach through email, phone, LinkedIn, and video, personalized to each account's data stack and priorities.
• Follow up quickly on inbound leads, product sign-ups, and intent signals, and qualify them before handoff.
• Use AI research and writing tools, intent data, and sequencing platforms to work more accounts with better context.
• Partner with Account Executives on account plans and with Marketing on campaigns and events.
• Keep activity, contacts, and next steps accurate in the CRM.
• Share what you hear from prospects so Sales, Marketing, and Product can sharpen messaging and targeting.

Qualifications
• 1+ years in sales development or another quota-carrying sales role, ideally in B2B SaaS.
• A track record of taking ownership: you test new approaches, measure what works, and share it with the team.
• Clear, concise writing and confidence on the phone.
• Curiosity about how technical products work and why companies buy them.
• Comfort moving between technical and business conversations, from data engineers to marketing and MarTech leaders.
• Comfort learning technical concepts such as data pipelines, cloud data warehouses, and APIs well enough to hold a credible first conversation.
• Daily use of AI tools to research, draft, or organize work, with judgment about when the output needs your own edit.
• Organization and follow-through: you plan your day, track your numbers, and adjust when something isn't working.
• Resilience with rejection and a habit of asking for feedback.
• Integrity in how you represent RudderStack to prospects and teammates.

Bonus Points:
• Experience prospecting into engineering, data, marketing, or MarTech buyers.
• Familiarity with Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, dbt, or other modern data tools.
• Experience with Salesforce, Outreach or Salesloft, ZoomInfo or Apollo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, or intent tools such as 6sense.

Extra Notes
If your experience isn't a perfect match for the job description, but you're still a good fit for the role, apply. We want to work with smart people who are good at their job, and, a lot of times, those people have non-linear career paths.

RudderStack helps companies build on top of their own data. Our warehouse-native Customer Data Platform enables engineering, data, and AI teams to collect, unify, govern, and activate customer data while maintaining full ownership and control. By running directly on top of the customer's cloud data warehouse or lakehouse, RudderStack reduces data movement, improves governance, lowers infrastructure costs, and accelerates modern data and AI initiatives.
Leading companies including Lovable, Jaguar Land Rover, and Foot Locker trust RudderStack to power mission-critical customer data infrastructure.
We're now in the middle of one of the most significant shifts in the company's history: evolving from the industry's leading warehouse-native CDP into a fully Agentic CDP built for the AI era — a platform that doesn't just collect and activate customer data, but reasons over it and takes action on our customers' behalf. EMEA is a critical part of that next chapter, and this hire will help define it.

About the role
Have you got a knack for explaining technical concepts? Do you want to work closely with big-name companies to solve some of their toughest problems, and stay with them long after the contract is signed? We're looking for a Senior Solutions Architect who loves teaching people, solving problems, and making sure our customers get real value from RudderStack. You'd be joining a team of talented engineers who love open source, support their community, and want to make people's lives easier. We care deeply about our users and partners, and we judge ourselves on how well we serve them.
You'll work alongside our Customer Success Managers as the technical lead on our EMEA accounts. The CSM owns the relationship and you own the technical side, and together you make sure every customer is successful with their RudderStack implementation. You'll be the technical face of RudderStack for these customers: the person they trust for answers, guidance, and honest advice. We get excited talking to engineers, product managers, and growth marketers, and we also know how to explain technical concepts to business stakeholders. We're here to make our customers' lives easier by giving them the right solutions for their customer data strategy and architecture.
This role is remote first and can be based anywhere in the UK or EMEA (#LI-Remote). You'll occasionally travel to customer sites for relationship building, onboardings, and workshops. It won't happen often, but expect a few trips a year.

What you'll do
• Partner with CSMs as the technical lead on a portfolio of EMEA accounts, owning their technical success from onboarding onwards.
• Lead customer onboarding, making sure new customers are set up properly and see value quickly.
• Design and manage migration strategies (for example from Segment, mParticle, GA4, or in-house pipelines) and other implementation plans, and guide customers through them.
• Be the go-to person for customers' technical questions across the platform, from SDKs and event streaming to warehouses, reverse ETL, and identity resolution.
• Run training sessions on different parts of the product, tailored to each customer's team and use case.
• Take the initiative to spot gaps in how customers use the platform, then show them, and demo, how features they aren't using yet can solve their problems and add value.
• Act as a trusted advisor to customers on their customer data strategy and architecture design.
• Gather customer feedback and share it with our Product and Engineering teams, advocating for customer interests to help shape RudderStack's roadmap.
• Develop subject matter expertise on the customer data landscape and RudderStack's role within it.
• Occasionally run onsite sessions with customers for relationship building, onboardings, and workshops.
• Act as an escalation point for technical incidents and work closely with Engineering and Support to drive resolutions for critical customer issues.
Qualifications
• You have 5+ years in a customer-facing technical role such as Solutions Engineer, Solutions Architect, Technical Account Manager, or Implementation/Professional Services Consultant, with 8+ years of progressive professional experience supporting technical products.
• You're proactive and self-driven. You don't wait to be told what to do. You find the next thing that will move a customer forward and you do it.
• You have high emotional intelligence. You read the room, build trust quickly, and handle difficult conversations calmly and with empathy.
• You're curious about how technology works under the hood, and you pick up technical concepts quickly.
• You're a customer-focused problem solver who balances creative solutions with doing what's right for the customer.
• You're a lifelong learner who enjoys taking in new information and sharing that knowledge with others.
• You're organised, driven, and able to switch context quickly throughout the day across multiple accounts.
• You have a strong understanding of how modern web services and mobile apps are built, and of the cloud infrastructure that powers them (e.g. Amazon Web Services, Google Cloud Platform, Microsoft Azure).
• You have professional experience in some of the following areas: web development, mobile development, device platforms and architectures, ETL concepts and workflows, high availability systems and business continuity, message queuing patterns and pipeline design.
Bonus Points:
• You've led platform migrations or large-scale implementations for enterprise customers.
• You've built websites or mobile apps, or you have experience working with ETL or data pipelines.
• You've worked in marketing or advertising and understand the technical challenges of working with customer data.
• You have some experience with data analytics, data science, AI, or machine learning.

Sabio is a global company and the leading independent UK Contact Centre solution supplier. We work with leading brands and partners across the globe, helping them to build high quality, secure, robust platforms and solutions. 

Sabio provides expertise and solutions that our customers need to respond to the ever-changing world. Our focus is on creating state-of-the-art real-time communications platforms and contact centre system integration. At our core, we are problem-solvers with a strong engineering mindset and a ‘can-do’ attitude. 

We are currently looking for a passionate and enthusiastic Data & BI Engineer (Mid-Level) reporting into our Global Data Integration and Systems Manager. 

This role combines data engineering and business intelligence development, with responsibility for building scalable data pipelines, integrating enterprise systems such as ServiceNow and Salesforce, and delivering high-quality reporting and insights through Power BI. 
The successful candidate will play a key role in shaping Sabio’s data landscape, ensuring data is reliable, accessible and optimised for business decision-making.

Data Engineering 
• Design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines across multiple systems 
• Develop and manage ETL/ELT processes to ensure high-quality, reliable data 
• Integrate data from enterprise platforms including ServiceNow, Salesforce and other systems 
• Implement and support modern data platforms, including Microsoft Fabric 
• Apply medallion architecture principles (Bronze, Silver, Gold layers) to structure and optimise data flows 
• Ensure data governance, security and performance standards are met 
Business Intelligence & Reporting 
• Design, develop, and maintain Power BI dashboards and reports 
• Build and maintain semantic models, measures and calculated logic (DAX) 
• Translate business requirements into scalable data models and visualisations 
• Optimise report performance, usability and consistency 
• Deliver actionable insights to support business decision-making 
Data Management & Quality 
• Ensure accuracy, completeness and integrity of data across systems

The opportunity

In this role, you shall work closely with senior management and the consultants to support them in understanding the performance of the business and interpret the financial results and KPIs to maximize cash and profitability, including recommending and subsequently implementing changes to the business processes, operations and controls. You shall use your excellent management skills coupled with a thorough knowledge of finance and commercial principles to utilise, prepare and analyse operational and financial reports and forecasts for the division.

To be successful in this position you will have worked in a similar role with proven work experience, along with a recognised accountancy qualification (e.g., ACA, ACCA). • Preparation and review of management accounts

You will have an eye for detail and will have the curiosity to analyse and interrogate the various pieces of information to provide meaningful analysis and support to your business contacts. Experience & Qualifications

About the role

Your work will range from building a full data platform to building data pipelines or helping with data architecture and strategy. • Collaborate with Data Scientists and Engineers to deliver production quality AI and Machine Learning systems

• Build frameworks and supporting tooling for data ingestion from a complex variety of sources

• Consult with our clients on data strategy, modernising their data infrastructure, architecture and technology

• Model their data for increased visibility and performance

• You will work in short sprints to deliver working software

• You will be working with other data engineers in Sahaj and work on building Data Engineering capability across the organisation

Skills you’ll need

• Demonstrated experience as a Senior Data Engineer in complex enterprise environments.

• Deep understanding of technology fundamentals and experience with languages like Python, or functional programming languages like Scala

• Demonstrated experience in design and development of big data applications using tech stacks like Databricks, Apache Spark, HDFS, HBase and Snowflake

• Commendable skills in building data products, by integrating large sets of data from hundreds of internal and external sources would be highly critical

• A nuanced understanding of code quality, maintainability and practices like Test Driven Development

• Ability to deliver an application end to end; having an opinion on how your code should be built, packaged and deployed using CI/CD

• Understanding of Cloud platforms, DevOps, GitOps, Containers

Give yourself an opportunity to

• Experience a culture of trust, respect and transparency powered by holacracy.

• An environment that will allow you to hone your craft.

• Collaborate with multi-disciplinary teams to solve some real business problems.

• Solve problems across different domains. Level-up on difficult problems.

• Find your balance between work and life’s ups and downs with unlimited leave when you really need it.

• Not be exploited, as everyone knows everyone’s salary. Radical pay transparency.

• Own what you build. When Sahaj grows in impact and value, you’ll have a share in that upside.

What are the benefits of being at Sahaj?

A different kind of organisation

• Radical compensation transparency

The role

As a Principal Consultant, you're often the first person a customer meets to brainstorm a business problem. You should be at home debating distributed systems with engineers and framing decisions with leadership. You'll frame the problem with customers, shape the approach with the team, provide technical direction, and stay hands-on through delivery. You will work in self-managing, experienced, small, and high-impact teams, solving hard problems. This is a consulting & tech delivery role  and while you will not have direct reports, you will regularly influence teams, mentor practitioners, manage stakeholders, and guide organisations through complex technology and business decisions.

What the work looks like

We can't promise which problem you'll pick up, but the menu right now looks something like this:

• Redesign a ClickHouse schema so an ad buyer can query 85 billion rows in under two seconds, and discover that pre-exploding the rows 168x is actually the right answer.

• Keep a vehicle telemetry platform moving billions of messages a day without the Kafka consumers falling over.

• Build the engineering spine of a mobile wallet used by more than two billion people across four continents.

• Ship the data product behind peer-review submissions for one of the world's largest scientific publishers.

The list changes every quarter. The pattern doesn't: data-heavy, distributed, and often sitting on top of something that already exists and isn't perfect.

What you'll do

Frame Problems & Propose Solutions

• Help customers find the right problem before jumping to a solution.

• Facilitate discovery sessions, architecture reviews, and technical workshops.

• Translate business goals into a technology strategy and an execution plan.

Lead Through Technical Excellence

• Stay hands-on; contribute directly to design, architecture, implementation, and review.

• Make pragmatic calls balancing business needs, engineering quality, and delivery timelines.

• Guide teams to build scalable, resilient, secure systems  and the practices that keep them that way.

Influence, Advise, and align

• Act as a trusted advisor on technology and investment decisions; assessments, due diligence, advisory.

• Build trust and alignment across Sahaj and customer teams

• Converge competing priorities into a path forward.

• Communicate complex ideas clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.

• Shape new work through discovery and proposals; mentor others and raise the bar as you go.

Operate Across Technology Domains

Distributed systems, data engineering, AI & agentic systems, DevOps/SRE. Depth in few areas; breadth across, and appreciation for trade-offs in context.

You'll thrive here if

• You reach for the simplest solution that gets the job done and distrust accidental complexity.

• You think in systems, not isolated parts.

• You stay calm when the path is unclear and build clarity for those around you.

• You move easily between the org-level picture and the technical detail.

• You're curious by default and pick up new domains fast.

• You'd rather be in the room with a customer solving a real problem.

What we're looking for

• Demonstrable building software systems in complex environments.

• Strong engineering fundamentals; expert in at least one language, ideally polyglot.

• Hands-on experience designing and delivering distributed systems at scale.

• Deep grasp of architecture, system design, and engineering trade-offs.

• Direct experience working with customers and business stakeholders.

What will you experience in terms of culture at Sahaj?

• A culture of trust, respect and transparency

• Opportunity to collaborate with some of the finest minds in the industry

• Work across multiple domains

What are the benefits of being at Sahaj?

• Unlimited leaves

• Life insurance & private health insurance

• No hierarchy

The Role

We are looking for someone who is curious about the domain: what the process is, where people struggle, what is worth solving and how and then solutionise what is worth building using technology. 

This is an opportunity to redefine the role of design for a world experiencing constant AI disruption. A world where human judgement, empathy, systems thinking, and creativity become the real differentiators, while AI accelerates the entire Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC). 

You will work closely with CXOs, product owners, engineers and data scientists to co-own the product vision and help them craft the path forward. Within the team, you will drive ambiguity towards real, valuable outcomes through design.

You will own and shape the product direction, challenge weak assumptions and stay close to implementation. You will leverage your collective experience as a design practitioner in this entire journey for driving impact on the client side. You will craft ‘new ways of working‘ from a design perspective with the influx of AI.

We are not looking for someone whose primary focus is making requirements turned into artefacts, make things look polished or pixel-perfect.

The Expectation

You're comfortable across the full design lifecycle, but you're exceptional at the parts that make it land: sharp problem framing, design that ships, and AI-accelerated craft.

Consulting with Delivery in mind: Challenging the ask and ideating intervention that matters, and seeing them through.

• Turn ambiguous client asks into well-framed problems, prioritised opportunities and practical delivery plans.

• Challenge assumptions, agreed scope and propose solutions constructively, using evidence and arguments to help clients choose the new scope 

• Pitch, consult and negotiate design decisions for faster iterations and decisioning. 

• Stay with the problem, be the custodian for the north-star  throughout delivery.

• Constantly reframe design decisions as new constraints and evidence emerge.

Design that ships: Owning the work from framed problems to live product.

• Own design across the lifecycle: discovery, concept, design, build, launch and iteration.

• Create artefacts precise enough to build from, including flows, wireframes, prototypes.

• Design for production reality: complex workflows, edge cases, data and system constraints.

• Work inside the engineering cadence with technologists, data specialists and product owners, balancing user value, business impact, technical feasibility and delivery pace.

• Measure what changed after launch and iterate using product analytics, user conversations and iterate.

AI-accelerated craft: Using AI to design better, and designing better AI native products

• Use AI across research, synthesis, ideation and prototyping to compress design cycles.

• Apply judgment to AI output: know when it's good enough, and when it isn't.

• Spot where AI and automation genuinely move user and business outcomes, and where they don't.

• Design AI-enabled experiences that handle model behaviour, uncertainty, failure states beyond screens from user experience perspective.

The Experience

You'll also move comfortably across your wider design practice and bring its collective strength as the work needs them:

• Experience in B2B - Enterprise Platforms, SaaS products, Data products or AI-native products.

• Apply service-design and systems thinking across complex processes, teams and technology.

• Led discoveries by planning and conducting research, including stakeholder and user interviews, workflow analysis and conceptualising directions.

• Design and facilitate workshops that align client and delivery teams and get decisions made.

• Shape interaction design and information architecture for complex products.

• Work with Design systems and alongside AI tooling from the start.

• Contribute to Sahaj's product-design capability by crafting new ways of working, building supporting case studies and client-facing thought leadership.

• Opportunity to collaborate with some of the finest minds in the industry

• Work across multiple domains

• Unlimited leaves

About the Program

The Human Frontier Collective (HFC) Fellowship brings together top researchers and domain experts to collaborate on high-impact work that are shaping the future of AI. As an HFC Fellow, you’ll apply your academic and professional expertise to help design, evaluate, and interpret advanced generative AI systems—while gaining exposure to cutting-edge research and working alongside an interdisciplinary network of leading thinkers.

What You'll Do

• Collaborative Work: Get invited to engage in high-impact projects with our partnered AI labs and platforms. Develop and evaluate complex financial scenarios to test and enhance AI accuracy in valuation, forecasting, and analysis; collaborate in interactive sessions to assess model outputs for market relevance and compliance; provide detailed feedback to improve AI capabilities; and contribute to specialized projects in financial modeling, risk assessment, and equity research.

• HFC Community: Beyond the work, you’ll become part of a supportive, interdisciplinary network of innovators and thought leaders committed to advancing frontier AI across domains.

• Contribute to Research Publications: Collaborate with Scale’s research team to co-author technical reports and research papers—boosting your academic visibility and professional recognition (e.g., SciPredict, PropensityBench, Professional Reasoning Benchmark).

Who Should Apply

• Education: PhD, Master, BBA in Finance, Economics, or related degrees.

• Certifications: CFA or CPA strongly preferred.

• Professional Background: 5+ years in FP&A, Investment Banking, Portfolio Management, Financial Consulting, or equivalent research experience.

• Skills: Strong proficiency in financial modeling, valuation methodologies, forecasting, asset pricing, DCF analysis, market analysis, and risk assessment. 

• Professional Mindset: Detail-oriented, innovative thinker with a passion for financial technology and a commitment to collaboration. Prior experience with AI is not required, but a plus.

Why Join the HFC?

• Advance Finance AI Solutions: Apply your financial expertise to solve complex, real-world challenges where your judgment shapes advanced AI reasoning and decision-making.

• Professional Development: High-impact finance experts expand their influence through review projects, advisory roles, and research—while deepening their AI expertise, sharpening analytical and financial skills, and gaining hands-on experience with cutting-edge AI applications.

• Join a Top-Tier Network: Collaborate with a global network of academics and experts to advance responsible AI through impactful, flexible research and training. 80% of our members come from leading institutions.

• Flexible Schedule: Set your own schedule, with flexible 10–40 hour weeks that fit around your life and other commitments.

• Competitive Pay: Project pay rates vary across platforms and are depending on a number of factors, including but not limited to; projects, scope, skillset, and location. 

Application Process

• Apply: We review applications on a rolling basis.

• Complete a Challenge: Selected candidates will undertake a brief task designed to reflect HFC work and evaluate their domain expertise.

• Interview: Candidates will get to discuss their research experience, professional background, and alignment with our mission to advance human-centered AI.

• Join the Collective: Successful candidates will receive an invitation to join the Human Frontier Collective Fellowship.
