job_description:
Lead the team. Elevate the experience. Shape what comes next. 
AutoStore is transforming how the world stores, moves, and fulfills goods. As we scale globally, the experience we create for Sellers, Partners, and customers must scale with us. 

We are looking for a Director, Global Sales Support & AI Transformation to lead our global Sales Support organization and help shape the future of commercial support at AutoStore. 

This is first and foremost a people leadership role. You will lead a distributed global team, raise the bar on performance and capability, and create an environment where people grow, take ownership, and consistently deliver a high-quality experience. 

At the same time, you will help move Sales Support into its next chapter through stronger operating discipline, better use of data, automation, AI, and increasingly agentic ways of working. You will work closely with senior leaders across Worldwide Sales, Commercial, Operations, Supply Chain, Product, 
Finance, and IT, bringing clear insight, strong judgment, and a point of view on how the function should evolve globally. 

What You’ll Own 
Build and lead a high-performing global team 
• Your most important responsibility is the people you lead. You will: 
• Coach, develop, and elevate a distributed team across regions, building stronger commercial, operational, technical, and digital capabilities. 
• Create clear expectations, accountability, development paths, and strong coaching rhythms. 
• Develop future leaders and deepen expertise across the organization. 
• Build a culture of ownership, responsiveness, curiosity, high standards, and continuous improvement. 
• Raise the pace and quality of execution while maintaining a strong, supportive team environment. 

Deliver an exceptional Seller, Partner, and Customer experience 
• You will own the quality, responsiveness, and reliability of Sales Support globally, from purchase-order intake and booking through execution, shipment coordination, and delivery readiness. 
• Build a strong operating rhythm around Seller and Partner experience, customer responsiveness, SLA performance, booking flow, first-time-right quality, backlog health, and execution risks. 
• Use performance data to identify patterns, remove root causes, and continuously improve the experience. 
• Stay close enough to the work to understand what customers, Partners, Sellers, and the team actually experience. 

Connect commercial commitments to execution 
• Sales Support sits at the intersection of commercial commitments and physical execution. You will ensure strong coordination across Sales, Operations, Supply Chain, Logistics, Production, and Finance so customer commitments translate into accurate orders and reliable delivery. 
• Improve visibility across the order and delivery journey and surface execution risks early. 
• Strengthen escalation and decision-making mechanisms for critical or high-value orders. 
• Help ensure robotics and system orders move through the organization with clarity, quality, and predictability. 

Shape the future of AI-enabled Sales Support 
AI experience is a requirement for this role. We are looking for someone who has worked with AI-enabled tools, automation, intelligent workflows, or digital support transformation and understands how these technologies can reshape support. 

• You do not need to be a software engineer, but you should be technically fluent and able to engage credibly with Product, IT, Data, and engineering teams.
• Identify and prioritize high-value use cases such as intelligent intake, AI-assisted triage, PO validation, knowledge assistants, proactive risk detection, next-best actions, and partner self-service. 
• Shape agentic workflows that can coordinate routine tasks and actions across systems. 
• Turn operational needs into clear business requirements, drive adoption, and build AI capability within the team. 

Raise the operating standard and be a senior partner to the business 
This role extends well beyond Sales Support. You will represent the function with senior executives, Presidents, SVPs, and global functional leaders, translating operational complexity into clear insight, recommendations, and action. 

• Influence decisions across Sales, Operations, Supply Chain, Finance, Product, and IT. 
• Simplify processes, strengthen ownership, reduce recurring friction, and turn successful improvements into scalable global practices. 
• Bring a global perspective while understanding regional realities, and help shape priorities, capacity, operating models, and transformation roadmaps. 

The leader we are looking for 
You are an exceptional people leader who genuinely enjoys coaching, developing talent, and creating teams that perform at a higher level because of your leadership. 

You thrive in ambiguity and create clarity when the answer is not obvious. You understand modern support operations and can move comfortably between executive discussions and operational detail. 

You have worked in a technology-led environment, have hands-on experience with AI-enabled transformation, and are excited by the opportunity to bring that experience into robotics, automation, and physical AI. 

Most importantly, you can balance two priorities: deliver an exceptional operation today while building the capabilities, talent, and technology needed for tomorrow. 

What You’ll Bring 
• 8+ years of relevant experience in Sales Support, Customer Operations, Commercial Operations, Order Management, Sales Operations, Technical Support, or a related environment. 
• Significant direct people leadership experience, including coaching, talent development, performance management, and capability building. 
• Experience leading distributed or global teams in complex, high-scale organizations. 
• A strong track record of building high-performing teams and raising organizational capability. 
• Experience in a technology-led environment such as cloud, SaaS, enterprise software, digital platforms, or e-commerce. 
• Demonstrated experience with AI, automation, or intelligent workflow transformation. 
• Strong understanding of customer, partner, technical, or sales support operations. 
• Experience working across complex commercial-to-execution workflows, such as order management, fulfillment, supply chain, logistics, or similar operational processes. 
• Experience managing SLAs, quality, cycle time, workload, and operational performance. 
• Strong analytical judgment and the ability to turn data into action. 
• Executive-level communication and the ability to influence senior leaders across functions and geographies. 
• A leadership style that combines high standards, empathy, accountability, curiosity, and bias for action. 

Particularly valuable 
• Experience from a high-scale, digitally mature technology organization where support operations have evolved through data, automation, AI, and self-service. 
• Experience with Salesforce, CRM, ERP, case management, workflow, BI, automation, or AI platforms. 
• Experience supporting complex products, enterprise customers, Partners, or ecosystem-driven business models. 
• Experience in environments where commercial commitments must translate into complex physical or operational execution is especially valuable. 
• Experience in robotics, automation, physical AI, or complex technology is helpful, but not required. What matters most is the ability and desire to bring strong technology and support leadership into this environment. 

Why AutoStore. Why Now. 
AutoStore sits at the intersection of robotics, software, automation, and physical AI. 
This role gives you the opportunity to lead a global team, work with senior leaders across the company, raise the standard of Sales Support, and help build a more intelligent, AI-enabled support organization. 
You will not simply manage what exists. You will help shape what comes next. 

If you are an exceptional people leader with strong technology and support experience, and you want to help define the future of Sales Support in robotics and physical AI, we would love to hear from you. 

This role can be based remotely in the UK, Norway, or Germany, with occasional travel to an AutoStore office.

Application deadline: November 15th. Please note that we review applications continuously—if this opportunity excites you, we encourage you to apply as early as possible! All inquiries are treated confidentially.

Почему эта роль важна

Наши кванты используют бэктест — симулятор биржи, для того, чтобы тестировать идеи и создавать торговые стратегии.

Для правильной симуляции нужно очень аккуратно работать с историческими данными. Сначала мы сохраняем сырые данные онлайн во время торгов максимально простым и надежным способом. Данные с разных бирж приходят в разных форматах, они могут быть очень разными. Поэтому после сохранения мы ежедневно преобразовываем данные в наш внутренний единый формат. После этого качество полученных данных проверяется по множеству параметров специальной программой-чекером.

Очень важно, чтобы на готовые данные можно было положиться при симуляции — они должны не содержать пропусков и артефактов, и максимально совпадать с тем, что в действительности происходило на бирже. Garbage in — garbage out.

Что предстоит делать и почему это интересно

На этой позиции вы будете развиваться и как инженер, и как исследователь.

Предстоит:

• Расследовать потери и расхождения в данных — они все же иногда случаются, часто по новой нетривиальной причине. Каждый отдельный случай несоответствия требует вдумчивого подхода и тщательного расследования

• Разрабатывать парсеры биржевых данных. Строить и поддерживать пайплайны: заниматься инфраструктурой сбора и обработки биржевых данных, которая написана на Python 3 и С++20. Инфраструктура обработки состоит из нескольких этапов и запускается раcпределенно в Google Cloud. Много нетривиальных задач.

Как узнать себя в этой роли

• Интерес к разработке и тому, как устроены сложные системы

• Любовь к данным. Предстоит много и тщательно всматриваться в биржевые данные

• Желание докопаться до сути вещей. Ты не бросаешь задачу, если несколько твоих идей оказались неудачными, а наоборот двигаешься от неудачи к неудаче с нарастающим энтузиазмом

• Пытливость ума и интерес к исследованию

You've been a strong data engineer or data lead for years, and you're comfortable in front of a client as well as in a pull request. • Defining and evolving our internal standards for data work: testing, documentation, project structure, code review

• Mentoring and growing data engineers across the company

Client and commercial (core, from day one)

• Shaping proposals and pitches, translating client problems into a credible data approach and a defensible scope

• Travelling to client sites for workshops, discovery sessions, and in-person relationship building, and representing YLD at external data events

Practice, talent, and external profile (growth, over the first year)

• Owning the growth of YLD's data practice: capability, reputation, and headcount over time

• Contributing to attracting and hiring strong data engineers into YLD

• Representing YLD at data events and in the wider community as your standing in the market builds

• Supporting our sales team so that data becomes something we can proactively sell, not just respond to

Leadership and commercial

• Consulting or agency experience is a strong plus, but real client or stakeholder-facing exposure elsewhere is acceptable

• A track record of technical leadership: leading a team or function

• Comfortable presenting to senior client stakeholders and holding your own under commercial pressure

• Cross-functional fluency: you translate engineering constraints into business terms and negotiate realistic commitments

• Appetite to build a public presence in the data community over time, even if you don't have one yet

Technical

Your main focus is the Monetisation and Content clusters: our core e-commerce experience, Yoto Club and subscriptions, and the way families find content.

What you’ll be doing:
• Focus on research for the Monetisation and Content clusters. You’ll work with their design and product leads to agree what we need to learn and in what order.

• Study the buying experience from the family’s side: how people find, choose and buy players, cards, bundles and digital content, how checkout, delivery and order updates feel, and what happens in the first 30 days after purchase.

• Understand Yoto Club: what makes it valuable to families, what it’s like to join, and how we communicate and deliver that value through the product.

• Research how families find the right content for a child: browsing and filters, age guidance, recommendations and upsell moments, and what gives a parent the confidence to buy more.

• Design and run a range of studies, from interviews, concept and usability testing to diary studies and surveys. Use quantitative methods when they’re the right fit, and run the analysis yourself (for example correlation, regression or driver analysis).

• Work with the data team on experience measures and A/B tests, and present what you find to designers, product managers and senior leaders.

• Expand the reach of research by supporting others to do it: help designers and product managers plan and run good research themselves, and brief and work closely with agencies for outsourced work

What you’ll bring:
• Significant experience researching digital or hardware products with a product team, and evidence that your research changed what was designed or built. You’ve studied how people actually behave with a product (usability testing, interviews, diary studies), not only what they think of a brand or a price.

• Strong quantitative skills. You design surveys, choose scales and sample sizes, and run correlation, regression and driver analysis yourself in a statistical package (for example R, SPSS or Python), with sound judgement about their limits (self-report, response bias, small samples, correlation versus causation).

• Comfort working with behavioural data, including reading funnels, cohorts and experiment results, and joining them to survey responses.

• Strong qualitative skills, with good judgement about when to go deep, when to go broad, and when to move fast.

• Experience working independently as a researcher across more than one team or product area, managing competing priorities, stakeholders and expectations.

• Confidence in influencing senior stakeholders and communicating insight clearly, including challenging assumptions and navigating disagreement with credibility and empathy.

• Nice to have: experience researching products for children, families or education.

• Nice to have: experience researching across the subscription lifecycle (acquisition, onboarding and retention) or willingness-to-pay.

Salary: £70,000 - £80,000 based on experience

How we use AI at Yoto
We think using AI to work smarter is part of the job.
At Yoto, we use AI to help us move faster and reduce manual work so we can focus our time on creativity, problem-solving and impact. We don’t want to use AI to cut corners - it’s about smart usage that makes space for the work that really matters. Our intention is to be thoughtful about how we use AI. We treat its outputs as a starting point, not the final answer, and we take care to use it responsibly - especially given the trust families place in Yoto.
We don’t expect everyone to be an AI expert, but we do expect people to be curious, to experiment, and to keep improving how they work. If you prefer to do everything manually, you might find our pace and expectations challenging.
The magic at Yoto comes from people working here, not their prompts. AI should help us move faster, not change what makes working here great.

Workplace Pension offering up to to 4% employer contributions, following probation. Generous employee referral bonus scheme.

Equity and Diversity
At Yoto, we love creating a world where childhood is rich with discovery and joy. We’re also passionate about building a workplace where everyone can thrive - both professionally and personally. We value flexibility and give our team the freedom to balance life and work in ways that suit them.

We are pleased to announce a new opportunity for a Product Manager to join our team. This is a full-time permanent role based in Scotland, working hybrid from our Edinburgh office.  

#### Who You’ll Be Working With

At Zudu, we’re building more than software. We partner with ambitious organisations to deliver AI-enabled, human-driven digital products that create real impact. Our teams move fast, think smart, and work side by side with clients to solve challenges that matter. We’re outcome-obsessed and relentlessly human in everything we do.

As part of our exponential growth, we’re looking for people who want to be part of something exciting: high-growth, high-impact projects with some of the most forward-thinking businesses in the UK and beyond. If you want to challenge the norm, deliver innovation at speed, and do your best work alongside a collaborative, ambitious team, Zudu is where you’ll thrive.

#### What You’ll Be Doing

This is a hands-on, client-facing product role. You will lead product work across customer engagements, working closely with clients, Design, Engineering, Quality Engineering and Commercial to turn complex challenges into coherent, valuable and deliverable digital products. You will take ownership from early discovery through product definition, delivery and iteration.

The focus is on establishing clear product scope with the client, making trade-offs visible, turning unanswered questions into decisions and giving teams the shared understanding they need to deliver successfully. If you want real responsibility, autonomy, and the chance to shape a capability, read on.

- Lead product vision and backlog strategy, collaborating with designers, developers, and stakeholders to deliver exceptional digital experiences. 
- Translate business objectives into clear user stories, acceptance criteria, and actionable development tasks. 
- Prioritise features based on user value, analytics insights, and strategic goals, ensuring the team is always working on the most impactful tasks. 
- Guide Agile processes (e.g., sprint planning, discovery workshops, retrospectives). 
- Continuously gather feedback via user research, data analytics, and stakeholder input. 
- Monitor product performance and iterate based on user data and market trends. 
- Champion collaboration, roadmapping, and a shared vision across teams. 

#### **Why This Role Exists**

Great delivery begins with a clear understanding of the product, the problem it solves and the boundaries within which it must be delivered.

As Zudu grows, we are taking on larger, more complex and more strategically important engagements. We need strong product leadership that connects customer ambition, user needs, commercial commitments and technical delivery. This role will help us:

- Turn customer goals and business problems into coherent product strategies and definitions.
- Establish clear outcomes, priorities, scope boundaries and measures of success.
- Improve the quality and consistency of discovery across engagements.
- Give Design, Engineering and Quality Engineering the clarity needed to deliver confidently.
- Identify product, scope and delivery risks early.
- Ensure new requests and insights become intentional, transparent decisions.
- Build trusted relationships with customers through clarity, challenge and honest communication.
- Establish product management as a strategic capability that contributes to delivery excellence.

#### **What You Will Work On**

You will work across bespoke web platforms, business-critical applications, mobile apps, digital services, API integrations and data-enabled products, on a mix of greenfield builds and existing products at scale.

Our clients trust us with meaningful problems. You may join an engagement at the earliest stage to understand the opportunity, help turn a broad concept into a bounded proposition, lead discovery and product definition, or take ownership of an existing product through delivery and iteration. You will see your work used in the real world, not parked in backlog purgatory.

You will help shape and improve how product management is practised across Zudu, working alongside colleagues across Product, Design and Engineering.

#### **How We Work**

- Agile delivery, two-week sprints are typical
- A mix of fixed-price and time and materials engagements
- Multidisciplinary teams spanning Product, Design, Engineering and Quality Engineering

This is an agency environment. Variety is part of the deal. In a single week, you might facilitate discovery with a new client, resolve a complex product decision with an existing team, assess a request against agreed scope and prepare the next phase of work for delivery. If that energises you, you will thrive here.

#### **What This Role Is Not**

- It is not project management with a product title
- It is not a single-product environment
- It is not suited to people who need every answer before they can move forward

It is ownership-heavy, client-facing, fast-moving and ambiguous. That is exactly why people join us.

#### **responsibilities**

#### **Product Strategy and Direction**

- Understanding the customer, their users, the business problem and the outcomes the product must create
- Establishing and communicating a clear product vision, direction and measures of success
- Connecting user needs, customer goals, commercial context and technical feasibility
- Shaping product strategies and roadmaps that are valuable, realistic and aligned with the client’s vision
- Using evidence, data and product judgement to guide priorities and trade-offs

#### **Discovery and Product Definition**

- Leading collaborative discovery with customers, users, Design and Engineering
- Framing problems before committing to solutions
- Turning complex or ambiguous needs into a coherent and bounded Product Definition
- Defining relevant journeys, behaviours, capabilities, data, rules, integrations and acceptance criteria
- Surfacing assumptions, dependencies, exclusions, contradictions and open questions
- Facilitating workshops that result in clear decisions, shared understanding and meaningful next steps

#### **Scope and Commercial Alignment**

- Working with Commercial and Engineering during scoping and estimation
- Making product boundaries, assumptions, dependencies and customer responsibilities explicit
- Ensuring the proposed product is sufficiently understood for Engineering to estimate and Commercial to price responsibly
- Assessing new requests against the agreed product and identifying whether they are clarification, reprioritisation or potential scope change
- Communicating the impact of product decisions and trade-offs clearly and early
- Supporting proposals, statements of work and change control where required

#### **Roadmap and Backlog Management**

- Translating product direction and definition into a clear, outcome-led roadmap
- Maintaining a prioritised, high-quality and delivery-ready backlog
- Keeping decisions, requirements, designs and delivery work connected and current
- Balancing business goals, delivery effort, risk and commercial constraints
- Making timely product decisions so teams can maintain momentum

#### **Client and Stakeholder Leadership**

- Building strong, trusted relationships with customer stakeholders
- Rapidly understanding different organisations, industries and operational contexts
- Bringing recommendations and constructively challenging assumptions where needed
- Communicating direction, progress, decisions, risks and uncertainty transparently
- Guiding customers towards valuable, user-centred and deliverable outcomes
- Creating alignment between decision-makers, users and delivery teams

#### **Multidisciplinary Delivery**

- Working side by side with Design, Engineering and Quality Engineering throughout the product lifecycle
- Bringing the right disciplines into discovery and definition at the right time
- Supporting delivery planning while maintaining ownership of product priorities and decisions
- Reviewing completed work against the agreed Product Definition and acceptance criteria
- Supporting successful product acceptance, handover and iteration

#### **Product Practice and Capability**

- Contributing to Zudu’s product management standards, methods and reusable assets
- Sharing learning and good practice across engagements
- Supporting and coaching colleagues as the product capability grows
- Helping improve how we approach discovery, product definition, scope management and outcome measurement
- Using AI to improve product research, synthesis, definition and delivery without replacing human accountability
